Appearance Admire Groove is an Umamusume of slightly above average height with pale skin and ocean blue hair that fades into a dull color at the bottom. It is styled in a bob with longer strand at the front, with her side-swept bangs being streaked with white. Admire Groove has heterochromia, with her left eye being lilac and her right eye being a bright blue. Both of her eye colors fade into a light pink at the bottom. She also wears bright blue ear covers, with the left one sporting a golden ring and a navy ribbon, a navy headband, and a matching pom-pom accessory coupled with a ribbon that holds up a small braided section of her hair. Admire Groove's racing outfit consists of a frilly cyan dress with an asymmetrical skirt, a dark blue waistline and a red belt with a gold buckle. Below that, she wears navy shorts with gold accents. She also wears a floral black translucent lace top with feathery sleeves and a small red tie, and a royal blue sash with gold accents drapes from her right shoulder. Admire Groove also wears frilly black form-fitting sleeves accented with golden jewelry, dark translucent stockings, the right of which having a bright blue arrow pattern held up by gold garters, each embedded with a red gem as well as a pair of golden diamond-shaped anklets. Her shoes are white with chunky golden heels with red soles. Relationships Air Groove- A reliable senior and mentor. Air Groove watches out for Admire Groove and often worries for her wellbeing, making sure that she's alright. She shows great care for Admire Groove, despite Admire Groove's cold and withdrawn demeanor.IRL, Admire Groove was foaled by Air Groove.[1] IRL, Admire Groove was foaled by Air Groove.[1] Rulership- Friend and classmate, introduced through Air Groove. They both get annoyed by each other, and Rulership hates it when Admire Groove finds her to be a nuisance. However, Air Groove encourages both of them to get along with each other and not bicker. On occasion, Rulership asks Admire Groove to play games with her and help her with studying.IRL, Admire Groove is Rulership's older half-sister. Currently, in Umamusume, it is not confirmed whether or not Admire Groove and Rulership are biologically related due to Admire Groove being an orphan. IRL, Admire Groove is Rulership's older half-sister. Currently, in Umamusume, it is not confirmed whether or not Admire Groove and Rulership are biologically related due to Admire Groove being an orphan. Still in Love- Rival. Still in Love's "alter ego" is especially fired up about racing with her, going as far as to chase after her and call her "her prey." The two are shown to be opposites; while Still in Love is full of warmth and love, Admire Groove rejects love and mentions being "cold" inside. Despite Admire Groove being the favorite in all three Triple Tiara races, it's Still in Love who wins them. Admire Groove is visibly upset about losing to Still in Love, which makes Still in Love wonder why Admire Groove dislikes her so much. Still in Love seems to respect Admire Groove a lot, especially after witnessing how many people cheer her on and root for her.IRL, They are 2 prolific rivals throughout the 2003 Classic Season, and across their careers, they raced each other 9 times. Notable, Admire Groove lost all three legs of the Triple Tiara to Still in Love despite being the favorite. Notable, Admire Groove lost all three legs of the Triple Tiara to Still in Love despite being the favorite. Red Desire- Roommate. Admire Groove gets annoyed when Red Desire prays for her before they go to sleep. Despite Admire Groove's personality, Red Desire believes that she's a nice girl deep down. Duramente- Friend and underclassman. Admiring her strength, Duramente gets taken under her wing. Meanwhile, Admire Groove feels oddly familiar when around Duramente, and watches her races in support.IRL, Admire Groove is the dam of Duramente. IRL, Admire Groove is the dam of Duramente. Sweep wants to challenge Admire Groove, while Admire Groove is unbothered by her.IRL, Sweep Tosho and Admire Groove competed with each a few times, such as in the 2004 Queen Elizabeth II Cup and the 2005 Takarazuka Kinen. She also shows great concern for her, as her universal knowledge of her past as a horse lets her understand what Admire Groove is going through.IRL, Admire Groove, Zenno Rob Roy, and Neo Universe were a part of the 2003 generation. Chinese (Traditional) 愛慕律動 Admire Groove Translated name used on the TW servers. The name is translated literally. Trivia She was announced during thePakaLive TVVol.56 stream on August 22nd, 2025. In the game, other characters call her "Aruvu" (アルヴ), similarly toAdmire Vega's nickname "Ayabe". Like Admire Vega, Admire Groove had different nicknames in real life, like "Adoguru" (アドグル) by fans and "Gurumi" (グル美) by her stablehands. Admire Groove grew up in an orphanage and has no memory of her parents. Admire Groove being an orphan is likely a reference to how Air Groove's owner and trainer, Satoshi Yoshihara and Yuji Ito, were unable to purchase Admire Groove due to her high price.[3] Her unique skill animation features the same flower garden from Still in Love's unique skill animation, further cementing their rivalry. During her career mode, an event in her senior year shows her suddenly collapsing as she tries to attend Duramente's race. She feels as though something is compelling her not to go.[4]This is a reference to how Admire Groove died shortly after having Duramente in real life. This is a reference to how Admire Groove died shortly after having Duramente in real life. She is very good at first aid.[5] Her favorite story isThe Snow Queen, a Danish fairy tale written by Hans Christian Andersen. This story is the inspiration for her racewear.[6] She likes books about nature and animals.[7] She secretly likes to pet cute animals, such as dogs.[8]Her love for dogs is likely a nod to Air Groove, as Air Groove also likes dogs in Umamusume. She finds music cafes relaxing.[9]She also secretly likes listening to nostalgic songs from when she was younger.[10] As a reference to how Air Groove is her dam in real life, Admire Groove's racewear has a feather pattern on her right shoulder. That I would win, even if I have to do it alone." The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve. A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics ofT.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers. Appearance Admire Vega fashions her long brown hair into a low ponytail, tied at the back by a white bow. She has two black star-shaped accessories at the base of her ears. Her right ear has a blue cover on it, bearing a star design. Her eyes are a pink color, which surround her round, small pupils. Her race outfit consists of a blue dress with gold trim, ornaments, and belts at the front, in addition to two golden zipper pulls. Two star-shaped ornaments hang down at her blue skirt, which has black stripes separating streaks of blue. A white necktie hangs down over her chest, bearing a familiar star design. Her left shoulder has a cloth-like navy blue pauldron with gold trim. Her arms and legs both sport black tights. An elbow pad sits on each arm, held in place by a blue ribbon, and jeweled with a blue gem. She wears a white gauntlet on her left hand. A belt lies over her leggings on both legs, at the thigh. She wears black and white color-mismatched, golden-heeled shoes, each with a blue trim. Relationships Narita Top Road- Classmate and rival. Appearance Agnes Digital wears her bubblegum-colored hair in two half-up pigtails that come to a curl at the end, while the rest of her hair lays straight down her back. Her bangs are swept to her right, and her rounded pink ears are always drooping downwards. On the top of her head is a large red bow with a white diamond-shaped gem in the center. Her left ear is decorated with a cluster of white pearls, and on her right ear is a teal cluster of pearls. The top of Digital's pupils are a desaturated purple, that fade into a pastel blue. Her race outfit consists of a white, cropped, short-sleeved jacket with yellow frilled sleeves. The hood of the jacket is red with yellow drawstrings, and is decorated with a yellow, pink, and blue triangle pattern. Underneath the jacket, she is wearing a white lacy tube top, laced with a baby blue ribbon. Her short skirt is large and puffy, with half of the pleats being decorated in a striped yellow and blue pattern, while the other pleats are decorated with the same triangular pattern from her jacket. In between these pleats is polka-dotted blue and yellow fabric, and the edge of the skirt has white frills, and a yellow half-petticoat underneath. The skirt is held up with a bright red belt, and is adorned with a giant red ribbon with a yellow, and blue striped star in the center. Underneath the skirt, she wears short white bloomers with red trim on the legs. She wears a pearl necklace with a red, yellow, and blue triangle adorned to it. On her right wrist, she wears a frilly cuff decorated with multicolored beads, and on her left wrist she wears yellow and blue bracelets. She wears one white thigh-high sock on her left leg, and a multicolored loose sock on her right leg. Her shoes are white sneakers with red and yellow trims, tied up with bright cyan laces. Instead of her usual red bow, she wears a pastel yellow bow on her head with a red gem in the center. Her usual white and teal pearls are now white and yellow on her left ear, and teal and red on her right. Relationships Agnes Tachyon- Friend and roommate. You, me, the other Umamusume—everyone!" A mad scientist who fears no law. Weaknesses of the flesh can be overcome! Equal parts researcher and runner, Agnes Tachyon pursues the limits of speed with the power of science. She will stop at nothing to quench her pure thirst for knowledge, performing all manner of experiments on living subjects—unauthorized, dangerous experiments, at that. Her extreme tunnel vision means that without someone to support her, day-to-day necessities quickly fall by the wayside. Self-IntroI'm Agnes Tachyon. She buys her clothes online without much thought, so most of them don't fit well. Appearance Agnes Tachyon has short brown hair, with the back section slightly curling at the ends. The middle section of her bangs falls between her eyes, while the remaining hair frames her face. She has a large ahoge that swoops in an "S" shape to the back of her head. Her ears are round and stubby, with a dark brown gradient on the tips. She wears a silver earring on her right ear in the shape of the chemical structure ofindane, with the benzene ring being filled in with teal. Her eyes are dark red, with four light red lines running through them, a single black pupil in the center, and no white shine. The most prominent part of her racing outfit is the oversized lab coat, with sleeves that completely engulf her hands, and teal and brown striped patches on the upper arms. The coat's midsection is embroidered with leather straps that hold multiple vials of a mysterious blue liquid. The hem of her lab coat is fashioned with several unzipped zippers fastened with a golden diamond emblem. Underneath her lab coat she wears a light yellow sweater with a black necktie over a black button-up shirt underneath. She wears a plain pair of black pantyhose underneath, and white, ankle-high heeled boots. Relationships Jungle Pocket- Friend and rival. Jungle Pocket is a co-protagonist alongside Tachyon in theBeginning of a New Era. Due to Tachyon's talent, Pocket has a bit of an obsession with Tachyon, wanting to prove herself against Tachyon, and was disheartened at Tachyon's hiatus. Their rivalry begins when Pocket, undefeated since her summer debut, is defeated by Tachyon in the G1 Hopeful Stakes. Pocket brings Dantsu Flame to Tachyon's abandoned classroom to deliver a "declaration of war," which Tachyon accepts. They compete again at the Satsuki Sho, where Tachyon wins by a landslide. Shortly after, Tachyon announces her indefinite racing hiatus due to a leg injury. In Pocket's mind, Tachyon becomes stuck ahead of her, always outrunning her. The official synopsis describes this as "a looming specter—the final barrier that stands between Pocket and her dream."IRL, Agnes Tachyon and Jungle Pocket raced against each other only twice. It created one of the most dramatic contrasts and rivalry in Japanese racing, with Agnes Tachyon became a legendary "Phantom Triple Crown Winner" despite running only four races in his entire career, his exceptional dominance was matched only by his tragic early retirement. Jungle Pocket, however, had a longer career, achieving 5 wins from 13 starts including the Japanese Derby and the Japan Cup, earning ¥704,258,000 in total. He also notably earned the 2001 JRA Award for Best 3-Year-Old Colt, despite fighting in Tachyon's shadow for much of the year.There would eventually be a horse named Jungle Tachyon - sired by Jungle Pocket, damsired by Agnes Tachyon, and named after the pair of rivals. Despite their differing philosophies, they spend plenty of time together, and Tachyon is always looking for opportunities to experiment on Cafe. The two have made an abandoned classroom a shared hangout space. Cafe has a knack for getting Tachyon out of sticky situations, and intervenes when she tries to drop out of Tracen Academy. Tachyon, in return, attempts to stop Cafe from going to France during Cafe's career story. Cafe is the only person Tachyon doesn't refer to as -"kun," indicating Tachyon views her more as an equal than anybody else, and Cafe is also the only person who can intimidate Tachyon. In theBeginning of a New Erafilm, Cafe eventually distances herself from Tachyon after becoming fed up with her obsessive attitude toward watching her peers' races from the stands rather than participating.In actual horse racing history, Agnes Tachyon and Manhattan Cafe were both sired by Sunday Silence. The two horses raced against each other once at the 2001 Yayoi Sho, where Agnes Tachyon won by five lengths while a sickly Manhattan Cafe finished fourth. In Beginning of a New Era, after Tachyon wins the Satsuki Sho overwhelmingly (with Dantsu 2nd, Pocket 3rd), Tachyon suddenly retires. Dantsu tries to argue with Tachyon, but hearing Tachyon's "bizarre logic," she scolds her while "almost on the verge of tears": "I can't understand why you'd give up running when you have that much talent... Even without you, we'll keep running." Dantsu trains intensely for the Derby "without Tachyon," pulling an incredibly large tire, but loses to Pocket again, finishing 2nd. Dantsu serves as one of the four main characters alongside Tachyon, Jungle Pocket, and Manhattan Cafe. Daiwa Scarlet- Friend. Scarlet admires Tachyon, Scarlet is one of the few students actually intrigued by Tachyon's experiments, even volunteering to be her test subject. Her beaming enthusiasm has overwhelmed Tachyon in the past, but Tachyon still welcomes her company.Tachyon is her father in real life. Daiwa Scarlet was born in 2004, three years after Tachyon's forced retirement in 2001, representing the next generation carrying forward his genetic legacy. She won four G1 races, including the 2007 Oka Sho, 2007 Shuka Sho, 2007 Queen Elizabeth II Cup, and 2008 Arima Kinen, becoming Agnes Tachyon's most successful progeny. Tachyon is "somewhat put off" by Digital's fangirl enthusiasm, but doesn't harbor negative feelings; their interactions are generally friendly. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:The blue vials of liquid held to her lab coat with red stripes are intended to represent the sleeves of her real-life counterpart's jockey silk, which are red with blue stripes.Her earrings having both a hexagon and a pentagon are representative of her mother, Agnes Flora, winning five out of the six races she ran in.The diamond shape on the zippers of her lab coat has four sides, representative of her winning all four races she ran in. The blue vials of liquid held to her lab coat with red stripes are intended to represent the sleeves of her real-life counterpart's jockey silk, which are red with blue stripes. Her earrings having both a hexagon and a pentagon are representative of her mother, Agnes Flora, winning five out of the six races she ran in. The diamond shape on the zippers of her lab coat has four sides, representative of her winning all four races she ran in. Tachyon's special skill name in-game is "U=ma²," a reference to Albert Einstein'sMass—Energy equivalenceequation, E=mc². The trio consisting ofJungle Pocket, Agnes Tachyon, andManhattan Cafe, the three winners of the 2001 Classic Triple Crown races in real life, is often referred to as "JAM." WhenDantsu Flameis included, the resulting quartet is called "JDAM" (by Japanese fans) or "JAMD" (by English fans). She enjoys drinking tea, in contrast toManhattan Cafe, who likes coffee. She drinks her tea with a lot of added sugar, due to her hatred of bitter flavors. This is showcased in Agnes Tachyon's SR Power card. In Tachyon's career, her goal after the Satsuki Sho depends on her mood during that race. If it is Good or above, her goal remains theJapanese Derby, but if it is Normal or lower, she decides to run in theNHK Mile Cupinstead due to not feeling well enough to run a longer race.Since Tachyon has a starting mile aptitude of D, she is likely to fail this goal without raising the aptitude. This may be intended to recreate how the real-life Agnes Tachyon had to skip the Derby and later retire due to tendonitis. In chapter 2 of Tachyon's character story, a trainer remarks that everyone had high expectations of her due to her mother winning the Oka Sho and her grandmother winning the Japanese Oaks. This is consistent with reality, where Agnes Flora won the Oka Sho in 1990, and Agnes Lady won the Japanese Oaks in 1979. Her summer racewear's level 5 evolved skill name,Blinding Luxon, is likely a nod to the horse Luxon, who is Agnes Tachyon's granddaughter. Her experiment racewear's skill animation is a reference to a 2012 JRA commercial, which showcases Agnes Tachyon's 2001 Satsuki Sho victory.[2]The equations that show up in her skill animation are a reference to the 2001 Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka Sho. The coolly calculating Empress. Highly gifted and ambitious. The vice president of Tracen Academy's student council, known to the other students as the "Empress". The daughter of an accomplished racer, she constantly strives to live up to her mother's racing prowess and ability to guide others. To this end, she has joined her friend and confidant, Symboli Rudolf, in the student council. Despite her strict schedule, she still makes time to tend the flowers in the garden. Appearance Air Groove has short, sleek warm gray hair that is parted to her right, with one strand of hair falling between her eyes. The insides of her ears are pink, and the tips of her ears fade to black, with two distinct tufts of fur at the tips. On her left ear, she wears a gold ribbon, adorned with gold chains. She has pale blue irises, and wears red eyeliner on her sharp, cat-like, eyes. For her race outfit, she wears a yellow and black cropped sailor uniform-style top with a yellow bow in the center. On her arms, she wears two short, flowing open black sleeves, with a yellow underside. She wears a large plume of dark purple feathers on her left shoulder. Underneath her top is a black harness connected to a choker. She wears a black shirt underneath her top that flows over a royal blue pleated skirt with white frills. Over the shirt is a blue belt with gold adornments, and a dark blue cape is draped down her right thigh. She wears two belts around her right leg, and on her left is a black thigh-high stocking with gold adornments. She wears short white boots that have a blue and yellow cusp around the top, and down the center of the shoes is a black stripe with gold buttons in the center. Air Groove sticking her tongue out in her original illustration is likely a reference to how in real life, Air Groove would lick humans.[1] Her tolerance for ladybugs is likely a reference to her sireTony Bin, an Irish-bred Italian racehorse. In Italy, ladybugs are known for good luck. Appearance Air Messiah has a light olive green hair and tail. Her slightly wavy hair is sharply cut off at the shoulders, as if it had been freshly cut. Air Messiah's bangs are loosely parted to the right and held in place by an intricate blue and gold brooch, exposing most of her forehead and face. On her left ear, she wears a dark blue band with gold trim and a teal blue frill on the top. Two white pom-poms hang low off of the front of the band. She also wears orange rounded glasses over her soft purple eyes. She wears a dress reminiscent of an Italian folk dress, with pale green frills for both the sleeves and the skirt of the dress. The collar has a white 'Innocence' flower at its center. Over the dress, she wears a yellow frilled top with yellow sleeves that flow along the sleeves of her dress. Underneath the yellow top is a navy blue tank top that is split down the center. It drapes over the skirt, and has two teal blue ribbons tied at the bottom. She wears black above-the-knee leggings with rounded holes cut-outs at the tops. Her shoes are black ankle boots with teal blue inner fabric, and two pom-poms in the center. At its core, a race comes down to mathematical aggregation." Always takes the logical approach! A brilliant but eccentric racer.. A rebel who only trusts the data she has collected. If she is winning a race, it is due entirely to her calculations and is never due to chance. It is tousled and uneven, with several strands jutting out in different directions. Her hairstyle also features two longer strands at the back. When looking from the front, these can give the illusion that she has traditional long hair. Her eyes are a golden yellow, and she has subtle piercings above her left eyebrow. Her right ear is adorned with a gold/bronze piece that is connected by chain to an ear cuff directly above. Shakur's race outfit is a mesh of many random different articles of clothing and designs. She sports a short-sleeved black jacket with blue accents, blue linings, yellow studs and an asymmetrical zipper on the left side. From competing to winning." Excelling at both academics and athletics, she also has the makings of a star; she is the ultimate model student, flawless in all aspects. She was only able to achieve this, however, thanks to her defining trait of absolutely hating to lose, a trait which must be prefaced with no fewer than nine "really"s. The inner layer of the hair is light blue with a soft lavender gradient and small sparkles. A single, tight braid wraps from the back to the side of her head, secured with a black ribbon. She has a headband with a large white bow that has black tips, framing her left ear. Her bangs part neatly at the center, revealing a white highlight in the middle of her forehead that resembles a small cross-like sparkle. Small hair clips and accessories decorate the right side of her hair. Her eyes are lavender with sparkling blue gradients that grow lighter toward the bottom. Her irises feature intricate star-shaped pupils. Her race outfit is a detailed pastel blue idol dress. The bodice is a pale blue, corset-like top with white frills along the neckline and down the chest, tied at the neck with a choker-style ribbon. Red, button-like accents trail down the front, contrasting the cool color scheme. Puffy, off-shoulder white sleeves are adorned with yellow bows, and a set of blue fingerless gloves cover her hands. The skirt is multilayered, alternating between white, blue, and black ruffled tiers, with a large red bow at the front of her waist and a smaller black bow beneath the left hip bearing her name in blue. Two long, diamond-patterned tails hang from her hips, giving the impression of stylized banners. White thigh-high stockings. trimmed with sky-blue straps with pink gradient, rise up her legs, while her ankles are wrapped in curling pastel pink and blue loops. Her shoes are vibrant blue high-top sneakers with white soles and gold emblems on the tongues. Red bows adorn the laces. Appearance Aston Machan has short, messy brown hair that reaches a little past her chin becoming wavier at the ends. Her fringe is cut unevenly with the middle part swept slightly to the left. A portion of her hair is tied back on the left side of her head with a red scrunchie. Her ears are loosely upright and fades into a dark brown. On her left ear are two heart-shaped checkered earrings; the top one being red and the one below blue. Sitting on the back of her head opposite from her ponytail is an emperor-style crown with a golden trim and a triangular pattern with charcoal and red colors. Her soft, lime-colored eyes are slightly down turned. Her racing outfit consists of a white dress shirt with red sleeves and black cuffs. On top of that, she wears a tan-colored vest with four black buttons. A black bow rests on her dress shirt collar. Her tan skirt is composed of two layers, with the top being short and gathered and the one below pleated with a red line running around it. On both sides of the upper skirt are red bows that sit below a charcoal colored martingale belt with a golden trim. Above these bows are smaller ones with red and charcoal stripes. Starting from her shoulder, a sash runs down her torso ending with a red bow with a golden trim. It is decorated in occasional golden emblems. A charm is attached to the sash below the bow. She wears black stockings that cover half of her thighs. Her shoes are white loafer heels with a charcoal colored bow on top. Relationships Daiwa Scarlet- Friend and classmate. They both get along well, and Scarlet sees her as a notable rival. Scarlet also shows concern for her at times, like when Machan disappears from time to time. Machan appreciates her friendship, and makes her participate in the films she makes. With Machan photobombing in every camera she sees, Scarlet and Vodka do their best to keep her out of trouble.. Vodka- Friend and classmate. While they didn't get to race each other much, Vodka admires the fact that Machan chooses her own path, with Machan choosing to run in shorter distances, while Vodka chooses to run in the Japanese Derby instead of the Japanese Oaks. Machan appreciates her friendship, and makes her participate in the films she makes. With Machan photobombing in every camera she sees, Scarlet and Vodka do their best to keep her out of trouble.Vodka and Aston Machan had a rivalry in real life, racing against each other in the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies and the Oka Sho. Vodka placed first in the former while Machan lost by a neck, while the two placed second and seventh respectively in the Oka Sho, both losing to Daiwa Scarlet.IRL, Aston Machan, Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka were known as the "big three" of the 2007 Classic filly racers. The two raced against each other in the 2007 Oka Sho, which Daiwa Scarlet won. As Aston Machan focused more on sprint races after the Oka Sho, the two did not race against Aston Machan ever again before her passing. Trivia She was announced during the 1st AnniversaryPakaLive TVstream on February 22nd, 2022. She gives names to stray animals, as seen in her career story and Episode 2 of her character story. She likes the cookies her mother makes.[2] In her career story, her trainer works on a Machan-themed weekly manga after her win in the Fantasy Stakes in junior year.[3] Her mother is a doctor, and when Aston Machan was little, she used to play at the hospital her mother worked at.[4]This is a reference to her owner, Mayumi Tosa, as she is a doctor. Due to Aston Machan being named afterAston Martin, a car brand popularized by theJames Bondfilm franchise, she bears various references to both the car and the film:She is attached to spy-themed media, especially movies.[5]Her favorite food isfish and chips, as she ate it with her father when they went to England.[6]This is also another possible nod to theJames Bondfranchise, as the titular character is British.Her father is known to be a great driver. This also references James Bond driving theAston Martin DB5in the 1964 filmGoldfinger. Her father is known to be a great driver. This also references James Bond driving theAston Martin DB5in the 1964 filmGoldfinger. Due to her desire to be remembered by others, she tends to "photo-bomb" and make appearances in other peoples' photos. Throughout most of her media appearances, especially in Season 3 of the anime, she is often seen making cameo appearances and gazing directly into the camera, making her one of the few characters from the series known to break thefourth wall. In her SR speed card artwork, the recording time on her phone reads 00:09:30. This is a possible reference to her Sprinters' Stakes victory, which was held on September 30th, 2007. She wears a crown because she wants herself to be memorable. The ribbon on her racewear is there because she wants to tie everyone together so that they could remember her.[7] She is fond of sea creatures, and sees them as potential mascots.[8] She is good at smashing udon.[9] The glasses she wear in her casual outfit are actually fake, and are only worn for disguise purposes when she becomes famous according to her. She is particularly skilled at brewing tea.[10] She mentions that her younger sister has a wild personality.[11]This is a reference to her younger sister, Jaja Machan. "Jaja" means "wild" in Japanese. If the acupuncturist career event is successful, Machan says she feels warm and fuzzy, similar to when her Mom gives her a compliment. This is a reference to her voice actress,Honoka Inoue, being the real-life daughter ofSasami Anshinzawa's voice actress,Kikuko Inoue. Despite having a visible blaze in real life, this was not incorporated into her Umamusume design. Aston Machan's desire to be remembered is based on the horse's real life career and early passing. She was considered one of the "big three" of the 2007 Classic filly racers alongside Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka, however she tragically passed away from colitis-X on April 21st, 2008. Her achievements have since been overshadowed by that of Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka, which is why the Umamusume version of her does not want to be forgotten.Furthermore, it was Aston Machan's owner, Mayumi Tosa, who reached out to Cygames to request her being added to Umamusume, rather than Cygames requesting the rights to use the racehorse's name in Umamusume, as she did not want her horse to be forgotten.There are several references in game to Machan's early passing:Because the real horse died during April, she tends to feel sick and lightheaded during the spring season. I wanna beat any and all rivals!" Lookin' for some real competition! The hot-blooded disciplinary committee chair. A red-hot racer fueled by passion. She takes inspiration from her father's storied past, in which he was often locked in fierce competition with a rival. Her blood boils with a desire to one day have a rival to match. Inspired by a cool, bamboo sword-wielding disciplinary committee chair in a TV show she watched as a kid, she decided to take up the same mantle at Tracen Academy. Self-IntroHey, sup! She has exceptionally strong teeth. She has exceptionally strong teeth. Appearance Bamboo Memory has short, primarily brown hair with a distinctive white streak running through the middle. A teal ribbon wraps around her right ear, and she wears a headband with the kanji "夢" (Yume), meaning "dream," symbolizing her dreamer spirit. Her blue eyes and sharp brows perfectly reflect her competitive nature. Her race outfit is complex, adorned with numerous gold accents and metallic designs. She sports a black jacket with a green lining on the inside, highlighted with intricate gold trims and bamboo-like patterns near the hem. The jacket's style evokes a sense of power and prestige, reminiscent of formal, militaristic attire. It features white buckles with gold latches, and a waist chain adds further detail. An armband on her left arm bears the kanji "風紀" (Fuuki), meaning "morals" or "discipline." She also wears long white gloves secured by three straps. Underneath the jacket, Bamboo Memory wears a green skirt with detailed gold hems, and a white vest edged in gold, buttoned at the center. Beneath the vest is a gray button-up shirt and bike shorts. Her boots are white with metallic gold detailing near the toes and a green stripe down the center, fastened with white straps and gold accents. She finishes the look with black socks trimmed in even more gold. Relationships Yaeno Muteki- Friend, rival, and training partner. Bamboo looks up to Yaeno. To Yaeno's surprise, Bamboo likes the fiery side of Yaeno when she races. Oguri Cap- The strongest rival of her generation. Bamboo looks up to her and occasionally plans races for the hope of winning against Oguri. Inari One- Friend and upperclassman. Gold City- Roommate. K.S.Miracle- Friend. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Event Appearances 6Song Discography 7Trivia 8Student Introduction 9External Links Biography "There's no need to help. This work is mine to do." Possessed with an adamant conviction, this Umamusume has the makings of a meister. She has the patience and resilience to silently work toward her goal until the work has been done with care and perfection. Uncompromising when it comes to speed; holding the belief that "fastness comes from persistence", she dedicates herself to the path of short-distance races. It's been said that she's pretty attached to her grandpa. LikesThreading with needles, Belaying. Threading with needles, Belaying. DislikesThe idea of locking eyes with a sad puppy. The idea of locking eyes with a sad puppy. EarsShe depends on her hearing when mixing mortar. She depends on her hearing when mixing mortar. FamilyThe pillars of her grandparents' house still bear the marks of height comparisons. The pillars of her grandparents' house still bear the marks of height comparisons. SecretsShe often listens to the radio to study English conversation. She often listens to the radio to study English conversation. She belongs to a local mountain climbing club. She belongs to a local mountain climbing club. Appearance Believe is a small-statured Umamusume that often has a standoffish posture. Her short fringed hair is a de-saturated purple, with her right side being longer than the left. Her bangs fall over her right eye, and she has a white blaze on her head, the top half being a large blot, with a stripe coming down the center. She also has an ahoge coming off of the top of her head. She wears a red ear cover on her left ear that has a blue stripe at the base, however, it doesn't fully envelop her ear, and instead leaves the bottom of her ear uncovered. She also wears a navy blue headband that goes around her ears, and has two white stripes. Her eyes are pink, fading into a light orange at the end. For her race outfit, she wears a blue cropped hoodie with short sleeves. Her large hood has not only a white hem, but a zipper around the edge. The base of her jacket has red lines on the front, and a red X on the back. Her sleeves are cut open at the top, with a zipper to close them. Underneath the jacket she wears a navy blue sports bra, and red compression sleeves with a white stripe on either arm. She has a navy blue pair of gym shorts on. Atop of the shorts she wears an interesting set of blue, white, and red baggy pants, with the center holes cut out of them, clipped onto her skirt. She wears a simple pair of black ankle socks, and as for her shoes, she wears navy blue sneakers with light blue heels, and white stripes in the center. Relationships Lucky Lilac- Roommate. The very particular Believe finds relief in her roommate, Lala, for being a dependable presence who always keeps her side of the room in order. The two of them are surprisingly in sync, comfortably living together despite their differences in lifestyle. Though there are times Believe's strong sense of discipline and the awkwardness that comes with it catches Lala off guard, that same discipline is what earns her a deep respect from her roommate and senior.The reason they are roommates may be due to them both having won Grade 1 races in a racecourse different from where they are usually held. Believe won 2001's Sprinters Stakes which was held in Niigata instead of Nakayama due to then ongoing renovations in Tokyo (and the subsequent schedule changes this entailed), while Lucky Lilac won 2020's Queen Elizabeth II Cup which was held in Hanshin instead of Kyoto, also being renovated at the time. Believe won 2001's Sprinters Stakes which was held in Niigata instead of Nakayama due to then ongoing renovations in Tokyo (and the subsequent schedule changes this entailed), while Lucky Lilac won 2020's Queen Elizabeth II Cup which was held in Hanshin instead of Kyoto, also being renovated at the time. Calstone Light OandDurandal- Friends, rivals and classmates. Though their convictions and running styles may be at odds, what the three of them seek is the same— the pursuit of ultimate speed. Through their strong sense of individuality they have distinguished themselves as the quickest sprinters of their time, measuring up against each other and bumping heads on the racetrack whenever possible. Believe often finds herself in between Durandal and Light O's comedy routine, but her rhythm is not disturbed by it. She even finds that their strong sense of self fits in well with her own. Their unique personalities do not clash, only complement each other. Only through challenging them does she take more steps to become the fastest of all.Believe and Calstone Light O were contemporaries belonging to the 2001 generation. They raced each other several times.Durandal was a year younger, belonging to the 2002 generation. He also clashed with Believe and by extension Calstone Light O on several occasions. He also clashed with Believe and by extension Calstone Light O on several occasions. Dantsu Flame- Friend. While training for possibility of running shorter distances, Dantsu looks to her same generation contemporary Believe for help. As they train throughout the summer, Dantsu becomes aware of their stark difference in philosophy—while she wants to become a key player, Believe actively rejects standing out. Believe is nonplussed about the matter, but Dantsu's frustration (and confusion) grows as her precious contemporary's hard work and accomplishments go unnoticed by the public.Dantsu Flame and Believe were contemporaries belonging to the 2001 generation. They ran together in 2003 Yasuda Kinen. Dantsu Flame and Believe were contemporaries belonging to the 2001 generation. They ran together in 2003 Yasuda Kinen. Curren Chan- Friend and underclassman. The de-facto ring leader of the "Sprinter Girlies" (whose other members areDaiichi Ruby,Nishino Flower,Aston MachanandGran Alegria), often organizing parties and get togethers while trying to draw in Believe, who is not one for such festivities (despite them expressly being held to celebrate Believe herself). Despite the mismatch in sensibilities Believe is always thankful towards the gesture. Curren sees Believe as a reliable upperclassman who she can look to for advice and guidance, which may explain her boundless gratitude towards her.Believe and Curren Chan's careers are quite similar— both were dominant "Sprint Queens" in their eras, having won both Sprinters Stakes and Takamatsunomiya Kinen, only to have their second Sprinters Stakes bid be thwarted by a younger rival colt (this being Durandal and Lord Kanaloa respectively). Appearance Biwa Hayahide has thick, highly voluminous white hair that spreads widely behind her head and falls down her back. The ends of her hair are large and curly, contributing to its distinctive fullness. Her white horse ears and white horse tail are also slightly wider than average. Below each horse ear is a small gold shield-shaped hair ornament featuring crescent-like indentations along the lower sides. Around the base of her right horse ear is a small gold crown accessory. Her bangs are straight and white, ending just above her eyes. The far left side of her forehead remains exposed, while a single long strand extends from the left side of her bangs, curving outward and away from her face. Two long white strands frame her face and reach down to her chest. The left strand is noticeably wider, while the right strand is thinner and hangs farther outward. Both strands curl slightly away from the face near their ends. On the right side of the top of her head is a white ahoge that curves upward and inward in a C-like shape. She has light, shiny gold eyes and wears a pair of red under-rimless glasses. Her race outfit consists of a fitted dark magenta jacket, adorned with gold buttons, and a pink collar and light pink accent. Her long sleeves have a pink triangular spike pattern on the cuffs. Underneath the jacket is a black button-up blouse with a red ribbon. She wears a dark magenta pleated skirt with a spiked pink design at the top. The skirt has waist cutouts on either side, and there's a red ribbon tied around her waist. Paired with thigh-high stockings with the same pink spikes—one leg featuring a cut-out circle at the top. She wears cool gray heeled loafers with buckles at the top. Relationships Narita Taishin- Friend and rival. Taishin is somewhat cool with Hayahide compared to Ticket. Winning Ticket- Friend and rival. Hayahide usually helps Ticket whenever it comes to studying or training.IRL, Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket make up the famous trio of rivals, "BNW", who won each leg of the 1993 Triple Crown. IRL, Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket make up the famous trio of rivals, "BNW", who won each leg of the 1993 Triple Crown. Narita Brian- Younger sister. Despite it all, the two of them care about each other.IRL, the two of them are actual half-brothers from the same mother. They were planned to race against each other in the 1994 Arima Kinen, but the showdown was left forever unrealized; Hayahide was found to have tendonitis after the 1994 Tenno Sho (Autumn), and his connections decided it was best to retire him. Sakura Chitose O- Friend and rival. Hayahide admires Chitose O's unshakable calmness and perseverance. T.M. Opera O- Roommate. Hayahide usually gets annoyed by Opera O's antics, like spreading rose petals all over their dorm room's floor. Royce and Royce- Friend and rival. Royce views Hayahide as a strong and popular racer, and wants to surpass her. She even goes so far as to remove her glasses while training, as she doesn't want herself and Hayahide to "overlap" in traits. She also finds Hayahide's friendship with Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin interesting as their personalities mesh according to her. Both Hayahide and Royce get along quite well, as they are both data analysts and bond over how glasses can be a struggle while racing.IRL, Royce and Royce and Biwa Hayahide competed with each other numerous times, including in the 1993 Kikuka Sho and 1994 Sankei Sho All Comers (G3). Biwa Hayahide won both of these races. Gold City- Due to Gold City being a famous top model, Hayahide often asks for her help how to keep her hair silky. Phalaenopsis- Childhood friend and cousin. During Phalaenopsis' classic year, Biwa Hayahide acts as her mentor, specifically during the Japanese Oaks as to prepare her stamina. They both train together, and Hayahide looks out for Phalaeno as her family.In real life, Phalaenopsis' dam, Catequil, was the half-sibling of the dam of Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide, Pacificus. She wears knee-high black socks with white horizontally striped belts secured with garter belts that go up to the belt around her hips and continues down into high-top sneakers. Appearance Bubble Gum Fellow has long, flowing orange hair with a white tuft of hair, overlapped by a dark brown tuft of hair. Her hair, ears, and tail, all fade into dark brown at the tips. Wrapped around her ear is an elaborate flowing orange and white decor, with three blue gems on top. Her hair is styled with two prominent tufts on top of her ears and a blue scrunchie tying part of her hair into a high ponytail, and she has a blue hair clip on the right side of her bangs. Her expressive blue eyes and determined expression convey a sense of strength and character. Her race outfit consists of a crop-top with a yellow garment layered under a yellow cropped bomber jacket with techwear-esque buckles and decorations, featuring black and blue accents. Her sleeves are adorned with decorative patterns, and she wears high-waisted, white shorts with black leggings underneath, showcasing a trendy contrast, and two belts in blue and orange around her waist. The right leg of her leggings have an explosion-shaped pattern on the shin. There are black fingerless gloves on both of her hands, with blue stripes around her wrist. She wears yellow sneakers with blue straps, black accents, and white heels. Relationships Fenomeno- Roommate. Air Groove- Rival and friend. The two were seen as their generation's potential Triple Tiara and Triple Crown winners. However, those hopes went unfulfilled. Bubble missed the Satsuki Sho and Japanese Derby due to injuries and later did not participating in the Kikuka Sho, while Air Groove missed the Oka Sho due to illness and lost the Shuka Sho. Air Groove is one of Bubble's main inspirations and visited her in the hospital after Bubble's injury. They also study together from time to time.IRL, they were from the same generation and raced each other twice, in the 1997 Tenno Sho (Autumn) where Air Groove finished first and Bubble Gum Fellow second, and in the 1997 Japan Cup where Air Groove finished second and Bubble Gum Fellow third. Appearance Buena Vista has fluffy light brown hair that flows just past her shoulders, and both her hair and tail fade into a lighter brown at the tips. She has a small white tuft of hair on her bangs. She wears a brown and yellow checker headband, with yellow ribbons on the end that braid the sides of her hair. On her ears, she wears yellow ear covers, with her left ear cover decorated in the same checkerboard pattern, and a red "X" in the center. She has cheery light pink eyes. Her racing uniform has a two-piece dress. Her top is a white blouse with a frilled collar, and a black tie with a red "X" in the center. The bottom half is a brown skirt with red buttons along her waist, and three prominent pleats. The center pleat is red, while the two others are white, with criss-crossed red ribbon lacing to her waist. The end of the skirt has yellow frills. Atop of her dress, she wears a dark brown cropped jacket with medium-length puffy sleeves. The collar has a yellow and dark yellow checkerboard pattern, and she wears a clover-shaped medal on the left side. Attached to the jacket are two yellow straps. Her dark brown puffy sleeves have frills at the end, and she wears a white glove on her right hand, with a black on her left. Both have gold trim. She wears two different brown socks, her left leg's being knee-high with a thigh belt at the top, and her right leg having a thigh-high sock with white frills at the top, held up by a garter strap. She wears heels with "X" belting on the front, and straps going up her shin. The right heel is red, while the left is white. Relationships Gentildonna- Roommate. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Event Appearances 6Song Discography 7Names in Other Languages 8Trivia 9Student Introduction 10External Links Biography "What I'm after is the maximum speed. I'll be faster than anyone—faster than a deer, or even a pronghorn!" She's cool, she's straight as an arrow, and she's hardheaded—for she is Captain Straight-line! In pursuit of "the maximum speed", this stiff-necked Umamusume simple-mindedly and stoically charges forward on her path to the peak of fastness. As long as she's the fastest, she'd be faster than anyone! In other words, she'd be the one with the maximum speed! Anyway, she's undeniably honest and straightforward, being the kind of person who's open about both her feelings and actions. LikesCleaning, dizzy bat races Cleaning, dizzy bat races DislikesQuadratic functions, diving Quadratic functions, diving EarsThey can hear cats meow from miles away. They can hear cats meow from miles away. TailShe cuts it perfectly straight using a ruler. She cuts it perfectly straight using a ruler. FamilyShe can tell what her parents are thinking about from their facial expressions alone. She can tell what her parents are thinking about from their facial expressions alone. SecretsFor some reason, her white ahoge only ever curves to the right. For some reason, her white ahoge only ever curves to the right. It was discovered that all of her PIN numbers were set to "1111", so she was forced to change them all. It was discovered that all of her PIN numbers were set to "1111", so she was forced to change them all. Appearance Calstone Light O, the fastest, has straight, long black hair that reaches her waist, and a distinct solid white cowlick swept to the right side of her head. She wears yellow ear coverings on both ears, and has a yellow tassel shaped ornament adorning her right ear cover. Her eyes are a piercing yellow, with black pupils. Calstone Light O's racing outfit consists of a dark blue double-breasted jacket with long, frilled sleeves, and a white frilled skirt. The front of the jacket is adorned with golden buttons, and red buckled decorations on the upper arm of both sleeves. The inside collar of the jacket matches the golden buttons with a bright yellow diamond-shaped inner pattern. The jacket also has red colored shoulder decorations, matched by the red colored ascot that Calstone Light O wears. Above the skirt is a leather belt with golden decorations, with a single blue diamond shaped gem at its center. A yellow string is tied around her waist under the belt, the knot sitting neatly where the white frilled skirt is. Under the white frilled skirt are a pair of white shorts and black pantyhose, with a black garter on her right thigh, adorned with a golden pattern running across it. She wears mismatched black and white heeled shoes, with the right shoe resembling a boot that almost reaches her knee, and her left shoe reaching just past her ankle. Relationships Durandal- Friend, classmate, roommate and rival. Durandal gets exasperated with Light O's strange behavior, especially with how blunt Light O can be. However, she does view her not only as a notable rival, she appreciates her friendship, and even goes along with Light O's strange antics sometimes. Believe- Friend, classmate, and rival. Despite differing personalities, Believe gets along with Light O, and views her as a good friend alongside rival. Light O likes her company, but gets frustrated when she sees Believe's racewear and tries to zip up every zipper on it, much to Believe's annoyance. Sakura Bakushin O- Friend and rival in the pursuit of speed. They train together, and Light O wants to surpass Bakushin in being the fastest Umamusume. K.S.Miracle- Friend. Though blunt, Light O does show concern for Miracle's health, and tries to reach out to her in her own way. Agnes Tachyon- Friend. Tachyon is one of the few Umamusume to not find Light O's dream to be the fastest as strange, and in fact has a similar dream herself. While Light O does not fully understand Tachyon's experiments, she is willing to help her out when they are related to light. Jungle Pocket- Friend. They hang out together, and sometimes go out to eat. Godolphin Barb- Friend. Godolphin Barb watches over Light O, and is one of the few Umamusume to support her dream of becoming the fastest Umamusume. Godolphin Barb also helps Light O with her dream by making custom VR simulations for her.IRL, Calstone Light O is Godolphin Barb's distant descendant through his sire-line. IRL, Calstone Light O is Godolphin Barb's distant descendant through his sire-line. Gold City- Friend and classmate. On occasion, Light O asks her for fashion advice, like finding straight-themed nails. Trivia She was announced during thePakaLive TVVol.42 stream on June 24th, 2024. Calstone Light O is tied withKisekiandVictoire Pisa, having the 5th shortest time gap from introduction to being playable trainee, with 25 days between when she was first announced and when she was added as a trainee, behindPhalaenopsisat 20 days,Transcendat 19 days,Gran Alegriaat 17, andDream Journey's immediate banner. Her love for cats is a possible reference to her real life ancestor,Godolphin Arabian, in which he was noted to be friends with a cat named Grimalkin.[1] She tends to yell loudly in her sleep.[2] She has the ability to run on water.[3] She celebrates New Year's as early as December. She tends to dream herself racing against animals like jaguars and pronghorns in her mind. She tends to lose her wallet due to her speed. In her good ending, Light O shows intense interest in overseas racing, and Durandal and Believe briefly help her out with planning her trip.[4]This is a reference to how all of three of them have competed in Hong Kong at some point, with Believe having competed in 2002, while both Calstone Light O and Durandal competed in 2004. She likes to watch underwater diving videos.[5] One of her favorite snacks isyokan.[6] She is particular about her skincare products, because she wants to reduce friction in her skin.[7] She has the ability to catch fish with her bare hands.[8] Her goal to be faster than a pronghorn is a reference to an NHK quiz program that aired on May 24th, 2019, where one of the questions "what is the second-fastest land animal?" The answer was pronghorn, and Calstone Light O was used as a reference regarding speed. Her father is a legal prosecutor, while her mother is an optical scientist. In her solo song,O-Light-O, the lyric "53 byō 7" is a reference to her IRL counterpart's former record time, 53.7 seconds, in the 2002 Ibis Summer Dash. Excluding the intro, the song's main section also lasts exactly 53.7 seconds as a tribute to that record.This record, however, was beaten by Puro Magic by 0.2 seconds in the 2026 iteration. This record, however, was beaten by Puro Magic by 0.2 seconds in the 2026 iteration. Her white ahoge curving to the right is a reference to how the real Calstone Light O had a tendency to lean his head to the right when racing. In her classic year, it is noted by the trainer that the Sprinters' Stakes is being held at Niigata Racecourse due to repairs.[9]While this did happen in real life, this happened in 2002 in which Believe was the victor of the race, which was Calstone Light O's four-year-old season.In her classic year, she also achieves her speed record of 53.7 seconds in the Ibis Summer Dash (G3), though that happened in the four-year-old season in real life as well.[10] In her classic year, she also achieves her speed record of 53.7 seconds in the Ibis Summer Dash (G3), though that happened in the four-year-old season in real life as well.[10] While at the hot springs, Calstone Light O tells her trainer that pumice stones can be used for foot care.[11]This is a reference to her traditional Chinese name (specifically the one on the TW servers instead of the HKJC one, as it was different), which means "Pumice Light O". It's time for me to show the way.” Cesario is an Umamusume of intelligence and compassion. Influenced by her father, a famous trainer, and mother, who is passionate about education, she holds a great interest in nurturing the next generation of Umamusume who come after her. She holds retired Tiara-winning Umamusume as her ideal type since she learned that they also focus on being role models to younger Umamusume. According to her best friend, whom she rooms with, she has a very clear on-off routine. You know... I know this may seem like a bit of a stretch, but... Someday, I'll do my best to be great... No, I will be great." Ambitious with a timid heart. Aiming to become a great Umamusume. She's introverted, withdrawn, and has an inferiority complex about her talented older and younger sisters. She spends her time working hard to hopefully surpass them both one day, and have her own abilities acknowledged. She's not on bad terms with either of her siblings... but they both have a glamorous temperament, which makes her a bit out of place when they're together. Appearance Though she is the quiet middle child of the family, Cheval is a soul that dreams big. Like her sisters, her eyes are blue with white pupils, but hers are a much lighter shade compared to their deep blues. Her hair is simple yet distinct—a grayish-brown, medium-length layered bob with soft bangs. It carries a slightly messy charm, with the ends jutting out unevenly. The most striking feature is a platinum streak that runs along the right side of her hair, setting her apart from other Umamusume, who often have center streaks. Cheval's sailor cap might as well be her prized possession, as she wears it everywhere. The white cap features a blue band, her family's crest and neat ear pockets, perfectly tailored for her ears. Cheval wears a distinctive white jacket over a black underlayer. The jacket subtly resembles a classic sailor uniform, with light blue collars and cuffs, while incorporating elements of naval jackets, such as the double rows of gold buttons. Her underlayer features a neat yellow ribbon neck tie. Draped over her shoulders is a cape. The cape's interior is a deep blue, reminiscent of the night sky, while the exterior is a lighter blue adorned with unique markings. Its design can be interpreted as wings—a metaphor for her desire to grow and become the person she aspires to be, much like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon. Another interpretation could be her personal voyage under the stars. She pairs her jacket with slightly baggy black shorts, detailed with gold buttons. A unique belt with metallic gold highlights runs through her shorts, and a blue strap hangs from her shorts, displaying her name "Cheval Grand." Completing her robust look, she wears knee-high black socks with white stripes and sleek, modern white shoes with strap designs. Relationships Verxina- Elder sister. They share similar adversities in their racing careers, despite taking different routes in their classic years. Because Verxina took the Tiara route and not the Crown route like Cheval, she struggles to help her and give her advice like she does with Vivlos, though she admires the strength Cheval has inside. Cheval feels frustration towards her and Vivlos internally, because she feels weak compared to both of them. Vivlos- Younger sister. Despite their relationship being a bit rocky, both of them still care for each other. Vivlos looks out for Cheval Grand while also teasing her from time to time, while Cheval Grand supports Vivlos' races. Cheval however feels inferior to Vivlos, as her alongside Verxina have always gotten more attention in racing ability compared to her, and she feels like Vivlos is stronger than her. While Cheval keeps her distance from her at times, deep down she truly cares for Vivlos.IRL, Verxina, Cheval Grand, and Vivlos are all foaled by Halwa Sweet.Verxina and Vivlos are both sired by Deep Impact, whereas Cheval Grand was sired by Heart's Cry. They both bond over their struggles against their rivals, and get along well.IRL, Win Variation and Cheval Grand were both sired by Heart's Cry. In addition to both being unable to best their rivals -Orfevreand Kitasan Black respectively. However, Cheval Grand ultimately won against Kitasan Black in a race, which Win Variation never did against Orfevre. IRL, Win Variation and Cheval Grand were both sired by Heart's Cry. Kitasan Black is a source of envy for Cheval Grand, as Kitasan Black is a more open and cheerful individual, it is in deep contrast with Cheval's more reserved and pessimistic personality. Satono Crown- Friend and rival. While Cheval struggles with herself, Crown reassures her, and tells her that it's okay that she is different from her sisters. She sees the strength that Cheval has deep down, and they both get along well. They also train together from time to time. Satono Diamond- Friend. That is... my dream...!" A reserved Umamusume with a passion for studying history. In particular, she is the most interested in the history of racing, and the heartfelt drama weaved together by the 'dreams' of Umamusume and their trainers. She is so fond of it that she likes to get invested in predicting the results of upcoming races, or taking her large camera to racetracks on a weekly basis. Appearance She has long, straight hair colored a cool silvery-gray, which deepens into a shadowy steel blue toward the ends. Her bangs are cut evenly across her forehead with longer strands framing her cheeks, and a small, curved fringe at the center parts slightly. Her long hair cascades freely down her back, nearly reaching her thighs. A golden ornamental hairpiece resembling a compass rests atop her right ear. Two red ribbons are winding into her hair strands behind her head, fixed in place by two gold accessories. Her eyes are large and round, colored a piercing icy blue with a gradient that grows paler near the bottom. Her race outfit resembles a ceremonial battle dress, blending regality with magical motif. The bodice is white with a high collar, layered beneath a deep plum vest outlined in gold. The vest is adorned with a crimson and white ribbon at the neck and secured by ornate golden pins at the waist. One arm is covered with a flowing white sleeve trimmed in gold, while the other is gloved in a long, fingerless dark violet glove. The skirt is a sharp combination of crimson and navy panels, with diagonal stripes and golden crest details. A large, billowing white sash flows from her left side, layered under a golden hip guard that echoes the design of her headpiece. Her legs are clad in mismatched thigh-highs: one deep red with black diagonal patterns, and the other bare deep red with black. Her footwear consists of sleek, heeled gold-and-white boots, trimmed with red and marked by arcane symbols. Relationships Loves Only You- Friend, roommate, and classmate. Loves enjoys Chrono's eccentricity, and enjoys hearing her talk about race history. She also dries Chrono's hair for her when she is engrossed in history. Gran Alegria- Friend and classmate. Her hair clip was a gift from her grandfather.[3] When she was little, she used to put vintage racing magazines under her pillow so she could dream about historical races.[4] She dislikes snow, as it could cancel the upcoming races she wants to see.[5] During her career mode's senior year, there is an event named "失環" in which her trainer gets struck by a car trying to save a child. This causes them to be in the hospital for a while, until they gain the strength to watch Chrono Genesis' Arima Kinen.This is a reference to what happened to her real life jockey,Yuichi Kitamura. During a maiden race at Hanshin Racecourse on May 2nd, 2021, another horse on the track caused the horse he was jockeying to trip, and Kitamura fell in the process. This resulted in multiple bone fractures, he was forced to recuperate for a year, and he was unable to jockey Chrono Genesis for the rest of 2021.[6] This is a reference to what happened to her real life jockey,Yuichi Kitamura. During a maiden race at Hanshin Racecourse on May 2nd, 2021, another horse on the track caused the horse he was jockeying to trip, and Kitamura fell in the process. This resulted in multiple bone fractures, he was forced to recuperate for a year, and he was unable to jockey Chrono Genesis for the rest of 2021.[6] Throughout her junior and classic year in her career story, Chrono Genesis focuses on an Umamusume named Schon Lilie, an Umamusume who competes in the Takarazuka Kinen and the Arima Kinen.[7][8]This Umamusume is a reference to the real horseLys Gracieux, who was the first mare to win consecutive Grand Prix races (both the Takarazuka Kinen and the Arima Kinen in 2019). This Umamusume is a reference to the real horseLys Gracieux, who was the first mare to win consecutive Grand Prix races (both the Takarazuka Kinen and the Arima Kinen in 2019). In her career story's normal ending, an Umamusume called "Particularly-petite Umamusume" shows up to take revenge on Chrono Genesis, and she vows to beat her in the Arima Kinen coming up.This Umamusume is a reference to the real horseMelody Lane, who was known for being the lightest horse in the JRA to win a race. While she did not win a G1 race, she competed in multiple of them, and raced with Chrono Genesis in the 2021 Takarazuka Kinen and Arima Kinen respectively. Leave the racing and bestowing of good fortune to me!" Rickey☆Lucky☆A Caring Feng Shui[1]Girl☆ A bright and cheerful Umamusume known for her amazing luck. Her knowledge of feng shui is second to none, and she uses it to navigate not only her daily life, but also her approach to training and races. She insists on making those around her happy with the power of feng shui, and her advice for attaining good fortune is highly sought after. Appearance Copano Rickey has light orange hair that falls past her shoulders, and a large ahoge coming off the top of her head. She wears her hair in two round buns on either side accompanied by red and yellow tassels, and the center of her bangs are solid white. She wears ear covers on both of her ears, the left side being plain black. However, her right ear cover is yellow with a diagonal red stripe, and the base of the ear cover is a bagua octagon[2], representing her interest in feng shui. Her eyes are bright pink, and she has a fang on the left side of her mouth. Rickey's race outfit is bright, and full of ruffles. She wears a layered off-shoulder dress with a sweetheart cut, decorated with red trim at the neckline. The dress' skirt is decorated with two large four-petaled flowers, both being white with red outer petals. Underneath her yellow dress skirt are two ruffled layers, the first being red, and the second being white. She wears a pair of light blue bloomers underneath. Her white collar is accompanied by a large red rope, tied into a ribbon, with a blue rounded diamond in the center. Rickey's yellow sleeves are detached from her dress, and have red bands around both the top and bottom, with long, frilly, bell sleeves. She wears blue fingerless gloves on either hand, both with octagonal holes at the back, and wears a blue pearl bracelet on her left wrist. As for her boots, they frill outwards at the top, almost making a heart shape. Both boots have red interiors, red out-soles, and blue ribbons on the back of her heels. However, her left boot is white, while the left is yellow. Relationships Hokko Tarumae-  Rival and close friend. Rickey's obsession with good luck and fortune often irritates the more logical Tarumae, but they maintain a very close bond despite this, and Rickey respects Tarumae's racing immensely. Wonder Acute- Rival and close friend. Acute is very supportive of Rickey's feng shui, and she makes sure that Rickey and Tarumae don't become too rowdy. Smart Falcon- Friend. As Rickey's senior, Falco usually takes it upon herself to help Rickey when needed, and Falco also tends to follow Rickey's feng shui advice. Likewise, Rickey respects Falco's seniority and follows her advice when it comes to being an Umadol. Espoir City-  Roommate and Friend. Rickey often embarrasses Espoir City by being incredibly energetic and clingy around her, but deep down Espoir is happy with Rickey's kindness.IRL, Copano Rickey, Espoir City and Smart Falcon were all sired by Gold Allure, and went on to become successful dirt racers. IRL, Copano Rickey, Espoir City and Smart Falcon were all sired by Gold Allure, and went on to become successful dirt racers. Transcend- Friend. Transcend is often left stunned by Rickey's feng shui. Regardless, she thinks very highly of Rickey's sharp mind, and her desire to help people no matter what. Furioso- Friend. The two talk often enough that Rickey's feng shui is subconsciously stuck inside of Furioso's head. Furioso does her best to keep hold her at arm's length, but Rickey's sheer energy typically powers through anyway. Seiun Sky- Friend. Rickey admires and praises Seiun regularly, as noted by Seiun herself. The two sometimes fish together.IRL, Seiun Sky and Copano Rickey's owners are good friends. IRL, Seiun Sky and Copano Rickey's owners are good friends. Kitasan Black-  Childhood friend.IRL, Kitasan Black and Copano Rickey's owners are good friends. IRL, Kitasan Black and Copano Rickey's owners are good friends. Curren Chan-  Friend. Matikanefukukitaru- Friend. Fukukitaru often seeks Rickey's help in misfortunate situations through her expertise, calling her "Master" Rickey. An overwhelmingly kind-hearted Umamusume who likes tending to flowers and flower arrangement. She is thoughtful and yielding, considering others' feelings before her own. This, combined with some of her peers from the same generation having a stronger impression, often results in her being left out of the spotlight, but her prowess is nevertheless legitimate. She's but a single flower, but she is one that firmly belongs in the bouquet that is an 'era'. Appearance Curren Bouquetd'or has muted gray coming into beige eyes and long brown hair with a small white strand at the front, with loose twin curly braids at her sides slightly below her shoulder with straight bangs that cover her forehead. She wears a black ear cover on her right ear and an ear cover with a multicolored floral pattern on her left. She also wears a frilled beige headband with a large bow at her left ear adorned with a black tag that reads her name, "Curren Bouquetd'or." Her race outfit resembles an upside-down floral bouquet, consisting of a layered black and white dress with a high-low hemline, shorter in the front and longer in the back. The inside lining of the skirt is vibrant and colorful, featuring a floral pattern with various flowers in shades of pink, yellow, blue, and green; both dress layers feature some gold accents. It is tied with a black sash on the empire waistline with a large black bow at the side with a small golden flower on the bow. She wears shoes with mismatched colors, with a black shoe on her right foot and a white shoe on her left, both with red ankle straps at the top. Curren Bouquetd'or also wears long white gloves that reach above the elbows, with the right glove's hand being colored in black. Relationships Yamanin Zephyr- Friend and roommate. They both get along as fellow calm Umamusume, and Zephyr particularly likes the tea Bouquet makes. Almond Eye- Friend and upperclassman. They are close friends, and Almond Eye looks out for Bouquet. Bouquet looks up to her as her upperclassman, and aspires to be as strong as her.Curren Bouquetd'or is Almond Eye's stablemate in real life. Curren Bouquetd'or is Almond Eye's stablemate in real life. Chrono Genesis- Friend and classmate. As rivals, Bouquet wishes to catch up to Chrono. Off the racetrack, they are friendly with each other, and connect as they are both soft-spoken. Loves Only You- Friend and classmate. Gran Alegria- Friend and classmate. They sometimes take care of flowerbeds together. Curren Chan- Friend. They have been friends ever since childhood, and Curren was the one who initially inspired Bouquet to race after she watched her run. They both look out for each other, and Curren tries to encourage Bouquet on being more assertive. She is also the one who helped her with her racewear. Kawakami Princess- Friend. On occasion, they go to cafes together, and Kawakami likes to talk to her about Princess Fighter. Bouquet also makes her flower tiaras. Lucky Lilac- Friend and upperclassman. Bouquet finds her funny, and they sometimes hang out together. When you think of "cute," you think of Curren Chan, and when you think of Curren Chan, you think of the selfie goddess boasting over 3 million followers on Umastagram. Realizing just how adorable she was from the moment she was born, she's used her natural charm to bend her parents and seniors alike to her whims. Thanks to that, she is able to climb the social ladder of life with ease. To show everyone just how cute she is, she now aims for the top of the Twinkle Series. She's a black belt in aikido. She's a black belt in aikido. Appearance Curren Chan is a fair-skinned Umamusume with light pink pupils. Her round eyes have a single eyelash in the corners, and several smaller lashes on the bottom. Her short white hair frays into spikes at the end, with her bangs growing past her eyebrows, and the sides of her hair are curved to frame her face. She wears a black headband with black ear covers, and a simple red bow on her left ear. Her race outfit is a long-sleeved off-shoulder dress. She has a black and white striped halter top with a white embellished collar around her neck. The top of her sleeves are a folded black fabric, and underneath that are long sleeves with two red cuffs at her forearm and wrist. She has black cuffs around her wrists, and wears white gloves underneath. She is wearing a black corset-esque skirt with light gold detailing, and frills at the end that frame the black and white-striped pattern. She wears red thigh-high socks held up by a metal crest, and two plain black knee-high boots. Relationships Admire Vega- Roommate and close friend. Curren has been friends with Ayabe long enough to adapt to her standoffish behavior, so she is one of the few people who notice when something is seriously off with her. Curren Chan also looks out for Ayabe. Eishin Flash- Friend and rival. Curren supports Eishin Flash greatly, helping to comfort her when she is nervous before a big race specifically the Derby. Curren Chan is somewhat jealous of Flash, wanting to have people passionate about her racing the same way people are passionate about Flash. Curren also doesn't understand why Flash is the "more beloved runner," despite them starting their careers around the same time. However, Curren still loves Flash and doesn't hate her or hold it against her. Nishino Flower- Rival. Flower is Curren's "biggest obstacle" in her words, a talented runner who also has captured the hearts of many by being adorable. In fact, Curren is worried Flower is too cute, and is jealous that she gets people's attention so easily when Curren has to try so hard on her posts and image. Mayano Top Gun- Friend. They both enjoy taking selfies and fashion, and will go to boutiques and malls together to window shop and take photos in the photobooth. Like her, Mayano is also obsessed with Umastagram. Biko Pegasus- Rival and friend. Biko is very popular on Umatok, so Curren Chan considers her a fierce rival entirely based on that fact. The two are still friends though, with Curren Chan happy Biko is popular and supporting her by liking all her posts and collaborating with her. She also notes that she admires the fact that Biko is able to grow despite only targeting a specific group, unlike Curren who just posts generally without any niche. Hishi Akebono- Rival. Curren Chan considers her a very fierce rival, primarily when it comes to Umastagram. Curren notes how Akebono posts a large amount of variety content, meaning her content is for everyone. Smart Falcon- Friend, specifically from dance practice. Smart Falcon, Curren Chan, and Eishin Flash often practice together. Curren Chan is also a big fan of Smart Falcon's career as an umadol and a big supporter. Taiki Shuttle- Rival. Curren Chan admires her bubbly and open personality, but considers her a fierce rival due to her amazing sprinting capabilities and her popularity on Umatube. However, this rivalry is one-sided on Curren's end. Gold City- Friend. Gold City is very easily annoyed by Curren Chan's obsession with Umastagram, but the two often go to cafes together and Gold City genuinely likes spending time with Curren Chan. King Halo- Friend and idol. Curren Chan admires King Halo and truly sees her as a first rate Umamusume. Curren Chan, in her own words, says she would love to sit down with King Halo and "pick her brain." Curren Chan also thinks King Halo is incredibly powerful and wants to be like her, even asking King Halo to help her train. Transcend- Friend. The two get along well, and Transcend often gives Curren Chan info on things like trends and new overseas smartphone releases.In real life, they were both trained by Takayuki Yasuda. In real life, they were both trained by Takayuki Yasuda. Aston Machan- Friend. Because of their names, the two have formed the "Chanchan Alliance". Curren also showcases a Machan doll in one of her streams as a nod to this alliance. Dream Journey- Friend. Curren Chan visits the Expeditionary Support Committee from time to time, and even comes up with a collaborative stream with Dream Journey to bring more publicity to the club. Curren also helps Journey with choreography during dance lessons. Durandal- Friend. On occasion, they do streams together outdoors. Sweep Tosho- Friend. Curren wants to borrow Sweep's magical girl clothes, because it would look good on Umastagram.In real life, Curren Chan, Durandal, Dream Journey, and Sweep Tosho were all jockeyed by Kenichi Ikezoe. In real life, Curren Chan, Durandal, Dream Journey, and Sweep Tosho were all jockeyed by Kenichi Ikezoe. Curren Bouquetd'or- Friend. They have been friends ever since childhood, and Curren was the one who initially inspired Bouquet to race after she watched her run. They both look out for each other, and Curren tries to encourage Bouquet on being more assertive. She is also the one who helped her with her racewear. Sakura Chiyono O- Friend. They hang out together on occasion, and they bond other their appreciation for Maruzensky.In real life, Maruzensky is Curren Chan's great-grandfather. Maruzensky is also the sire of Sakura Chiyono O. In real life, Maruzensky is Curren Chan's great-grandfather. Maruzensky is also the sire of Sakura Chiyono O. Fenomeno- Friend. To be supreme is the duty of my family. I will strive to fulfill my duty." Victory is a must. An Umamusume of a brilliant family. She's the daughter of a "Noble Family" whose name is well-known around the world. She always tries to behave in a noble manner, befitting of her family name, and her solemn words and actions often give the impression of being somewhat unapproachable. Self-IntroGreetings.
