Appearance Ruby is a small-statured Umamusume that gives off an incredibly elegant air, almost resembling a doll. She has dark brown hair with blunt bangs, and framing her face are two drill-shaped side bangs. Her hair reaches down her back, and she has several braids adorning her hair— two on the top of her head, and one flowing down the side, tied together with a ruby. On her left ear, she wears an arrangement of roses, two in white, and one large rose in pink. The accessory has a string of pearls connected to either end. On the back of her head, she wears a large bow with elaborate gold decorations. Her race outfit consists of a simple dark purple Victorian-style dress. The long sleeves are puffed at the top, and decorated with gold décor, and a diamond-shaped ruby in the center. The cuffs of her dress have two distinct gold lines around the perimeter. The collar of her dress is white and frilled, and she wears a red ascot tie around it. The skirt of her dress is split down the middle, either side connected by strings of small pearls, with golden diamonds on either side. Her dresses underskirt consists of three layers, a white one with floral décor, a yellow frilled skirt with a red line around the perimeter, and another layer of plain white frills. On her legs, she wears two white leggings, and two black buckled shoes, adorned with roses as the buckles. Relationships K.S.Miracle- Roommate. The two get along well, due to them having very similar priorities. Ruby was the first person to visit Miracle in the hospital after her injury. Daitaku Helios- Rival and admirer. Their personalities clash like oil and water. Ruby treats Helios rather coldly, in contrast to Helios falling in love with her at first sight. Ruby is none the wiser to the extent of her feelings, often dismissing her solicitations in favor of previous engagements. However, Ruby does not actually harbor any ill feelings towards her passionate devotee.The two of them were storied rivals throughout their careers, facing against each other in several short and mile distance bouts. They both relate to each other, as they both had leg problems when they were younger. They sometimes discuss how to wear proper cleats for their conditions. She's a very talented musician, and practices the violin daily. She takes French, Chinese, and Italian classes.[1] In the intro toDaitaku Helios' career ingame, she vents toMejiro Palmerabout a rejection from Ruby. Two years before this career was released, a variation of this exact same scene appeared in the first episode ofseason twoof the anime. This episode aired before Ruby, the "cruel young lady" in question, was even introduced to the series. Daiichi Ruby's dog, Sapphy, appears to be based on First Sapphy, a fan-made foal between the real-life Daitaku Helios and Daiichi Ruby featured in the horse racing simulator series Winning Post. Her tail fades from brown to a light gray color. She wears white ear covers decorated with two pairs of multicolored earrings. She also has multicolored star and triangle-shaped makeup on her upper cheeks, below her eyes. Her fingernails are painted in a variety of vibrant colors from blue, light blue, and yellow. In the original Japanese release, Daitaku Helios usesgyaruterms in her dialogue. In the Global release, she useszoomerterms instead. Daiichi Ruby's dog, Sapphy, appears to be based on First Sapphy, a fan-made foal between the real-life Daitaku Helios and Daiichi Ruby featured in the horse racing simulator series Winning Post. Incidentally, this game also contains a horse named Second Sapphy, a fan-made foal between Daitaku Yamato (a real son of Helios) and Daiichi Cigar (a real daughter of Ruby)Daitaku Helios'real-life last cropwasnotborn to Daiichi Ruby but was named First Sapphy in reference to this fan-made horse. Despite a pedigree that would have made her an incredible turf sprinter, she did not register with the JRA, debuted on dirt, and ran 141 local dirt races with a race record of 2-4-5-130. Daitaku Helios'real-life last cropwasnotborn to Daiichi Ruby but was named First Sapphy in reference to this fan-made horse. Despite a pedigree that would have made her an incredible turf sprinter, she did not register with the JRA, debuted on dirt, and ran 141 local dirt races with a race record of 2-4-5-130. Helios' real life counterpart liked to prank his caretakers by playing dead and dropping to the ground. This is referenced in both season two of the original anime and in the 'family' section of her in-game biography. Helios is often seen laughing mid-race. This is in reference to Helios' real life counterpart being nicknamed "laughing horse", as the horse frequently raced with his mouth wide open. Daitaku Helios is the only Umamusume based off a stallion besideGold Cityto have the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies as a race goal in her career. This is because both of them ran in the race before it became a filly-exclusive race in 1991. In the game's lobby, she is one of the few Umamusume who skips her steps in a upbeat manner. Other Umamusume who do this includeHaru Urara,Twin Turbo,Vivlos, andSonon Elfie. (Digital Single) Group Trivia Her initial character profile was uploaded on the officialTwitteraccount on March 8th, 2017 with her voice actress,Chisa Kimura. Daiwa Scarlet was originally announced to be voiced bySumire Uesaka, who later on went to voiceAgnes Tachyon.[2] Scarlet's phone background is an image of a flower bouquet as a reference to her real-life dam (mother), Scarlet Bouquet.[3]On a similar note, in the 6th chapter of her Character Story, while choosing a gift for her mother, the player trainer suggests offering a bouquet of flowers, which also references Scarlet Bouquet. On a similar note, in the 6th chapter of her Character Story, while choosing a gift for her mother, the player trainer suggests offering a bouquet of flowers, which also references Scarlet Bouquet. In Daiwa Scarlet's career mode, she by default has the Japanese Oaks as one of her career goals to continue the Triple Tiara. However, the player may opt to enter her in the Japanese Derby instead in order to compete directly with Vodka. In the real life, Scarlet did not participate in either race due to illness.[4] In the OVA ofSeason 1, Scarlet is shown to have acquired an eye injury due to a wood chip hitting her eye. This event occurred in real life during training before her participation in the 2008 February Stakes, resulting in a diagnosis of wound keratitis, and Scarlet was withdrawn in that race.[5] "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:As she was rivals with Vodka, her race outfit was designed to be neat and elegant, a direct contrast to Vodka's cool and sleek race outfit.Her tiara has four pearls atop the crests, representing her four G1 wins.The white with two blue stripes pattern on her cuffs and long boots are in reference to the bandages her counterpart wore during races. As she was rivals with Vodka, her race outfit was designed to be neat and elegant, a direct contrast to Vodka's cool and sleek race outfit. Her tiara has four pearls atop the crests, representing her four G1 wins. The white with two blue stripes pattern on her cuffs and long boots are in reference to the bandages her counterpart wore during races. Daiwa Scarlet's final race with Vodka was during the 2008 Tenno Sho (Autumn), in which Vodka famously beat her by a margin of 2cm. Because of this, Daiwa Scarlet is 2cm shorter than Vodka. Despite the real horse having a visible blaze in real life, this was not incorporated into her Umamusume design. Her ability to draw straight lines without a ruler is likely a reference to her older half-brother in real life, Daiwa Major. "Ruler" in Japanese is written as "メジャー" (English: "measure"), which is the same spelling as Major. Her goal of being number one in reference is a reference to how she would behave while active, as she was said to have acted like she was the best. It is also based on the fact that Daiwa Scarlet never placed below 2nd. I mean, it'll be nice if that happens....” Dantsu Flame is a good-natured Umamusume who often goes along with the whims of others. Although not extremely confident in herself, she works very hard in the hopes that she can run in races forever. Because she can be easily swayed, she is usually pushed around by her unique peers. On her ears, she wears two pink covers with a silver trim, and there is a green and pink checkered ribbon on her right ear. Her eyes are round with amber-colored pupils. In her race outfit, she's sporting a pink undershirt, with a white collar fastened with a large golden zipper, and a white ribbon tied at the bottom. On top of this is a black long sleeved top with a pink checkered pattern going across the right sleeve, and a green checkered pattern on the left. The sleeves are rolled up, and have a pink and green checkered pattern. Underneath the hoodie sleeves are the black sleeves of a compression shirt. She wears a pair of black joggers with pink stripes going down the side, and on top of this, a pair of pink shorts with a white belt. The belt has pink and green tassels coming down either side, and the belt has a golden checkered buckle. Her shoes are plain pink and white sneakers. Introduced by Hishi Miracle, Dantsu Flame gets along well with No Reason, and Dantsu also finds No Reason's attitude to be admirable in her own way. You're looking at me, queen of the future!” An Umamusume who grew up in the United States, Daring Heart has a personality befitting a leader. She loves to stand out from the crowd, and is usually surrounded by a lot of people. Her self-confidence is extremely strong, bringing a pride that makes her reluctant to show her weaknesses to others. Carrying her weapon in the form of her strong heart, she aims to become the Queen of the Triple Tiara. LikesAcoustic guitar improvisation, tail brushing. Acoustic guitar improvisation, tail brushing. Appearance Daring Heart has long, wavy, brown hair, with bangs parted to the right. The large strand of her bangs has a dominating white stripe. Her ears each have yellow insides that don't quite reach the tip. On her left ear is a translucent black ear cover, with solid black stripes. Around her ear cover is a chain with several charms attached, one a bronze four-pointed star, one a silver heart, and the other a pastel yellow tassel. Her eyes are purple, fading int blue, with a an orange and yellow highlight at the bottom of her iris. Heart's race outfit is as bright and flashy as she is. She wears a yellow and black top, decorated with checkerboards, blue triangles, black vertical stripes, and ribbons. The black layer of her shirt seems to have a cutout, exposing her hip. She wears a bright yellow pleated skirt with lacy black trim, with a silver chain that forms a large metal heart on her left hip. Atop of this ensemble, she wears a fuzzy yellow jacket that has a furry black collar. The jacket has two bright blue chevrons on either shoulder, and the waist is cuffed with blue bands and a fluffy black outline. She wears black gloves on both of her hands. On her left leg, she wears a singular fishnet sock. She sports knee-high black boots with a "V" cutout, both decorated with yellow and blue stripes on the top right-hand side. Relationships Rhein Kraft- Friend and rival. Daring Heart was inspired by her determination, and her races remind her of the reason why she came to Japan. They are good classmates, and hang out and train with each other. Daring Heart also teaches her English, which Rhein Kraft is bad at. Cesario- Friend and rival. Air Messiah- Friend and rival. Daring Tact- Friend. Heart is some sort of mentor to Daring Tact, and Heart is very supportive towards her. They hang out together, and like to go on shopping trips.In real life, Daring Tact is Daring Heart's granddaughter. In real life, Daring Tact is Daring Heart's granddaughter. Fusaichi Pandora- Roommate. Heart tends to spoil her sometimes, and the two of them hang out together. However, Heart makes note of Pandora's intellect and strength, and looks forward to seeing her grow. They also go mountaineering together from time to time.In real life, both of them lost all three Triple Tiara races in their respective generations. They are also related to Triple Tiara winners. Fusaichi Pandora is the mother of the 2018 Triple Tiara winner,Almond Eye. Meanwhile, Daring Heart is the grandmother of the undefeated 2020 Triple Tiara winner Daring Tact. A cheerful, polite and strong-minded Umamusume who grew up in the harsh but beautiful wilderness. She trains day and night in order to achieve her dream of proving the magnificence of her homeland, which nurtured her. She is often seen heading off to the mountains with her seniorDaring Heart. This gap, however, is nowhere close toBiko Pegasus' record, at over 6 years (2,476 days). With the introduction ofEpiphaneiain the game's 5th Anniversary, she has four consecutive generations of her in-real-life pedigree appearing in the franchise, with Epiphaneia as her sire,Cesarioas Epiphaneia's dam andSpecial Weekas Cesario's sire. Unlike Special Week, Cesario,Buena Vista, and Epiphaneia, Daring Tact does not have a four-leaf clover on her racewear. This is because she is only related to Special Week via the sire-line, since she is herpaternalgreat-grandfather.However,Efforiahas the same motif (albeit designed slightly differently), despite also only descending from Special Week's sire-line instead of his dam-line. This leaves Daring Tact as the odd one out. This leaves Daring Tact as the odd one out. Although she had an appearance in Season 3 of the anime, it is still unconfirmed if she is also a part ofTeam Rigil.It is likely she is part of it, as Team Rigil is known to house two Triple Crown winners (Symboli RudolfandNarita Brian) and is the strongest team before her appearance - Daring Tact is a Triple Tiara winner and the first undefeated one in real life. Heavily influenced by a certain "big sis" she met in her childhood, she runs in races with the purpose of seeing the "journey's end" she talked about. You could have just asked me about that directly. Appearance Dream Journey has long and messy warm-gray hair, with a white underdye. Her fringed bangs almost cover her eyes, and she has several white and yellow streaks scattered throughout her hair. In the center of her bangs is one very large white strand of hair, and on the strand next to it, a diamond-shaped marking, and on top of her head, a large warm-gray ahoge. Her ears are large and fluffy, with yellow on the inside. On her right ear, she wears a metal ring with a diamond charm protruding upwards, attached is a white tassel that fades into a yellow gradient. Her narrow eyes are very unique, with her light purple irises fading into baby blue, and a dark blue pupil in the center. She wears a pair of oval-shaped glasses, with a thin, silver wire under-rim. Her racing outfit is befitting of someone as cool and composed as her. The main piece of this ensemble is a piece of attire that is equal parts dress and jacket. It is colored a warm gray, similar to her hair. The jacket's collar is yellow on the right side, and black on the left. The dress is tied around her waist with a black leather belt, with several silver chains coming off of it. Underneath the jacket, she wears a dark red button-up shirt, with a line of several silver rings held together by leather straps going down the center of her chest. Her short and puffy sleeves are decorated with vertical yellow stripes. She wears black leather compression sleeves on both arms. On her left hand, several silver rings, and on her right, an elegant lacy glove. The dress' skirt reaches down to her ankles, with two slits on either side that reach above her thighs. The dress has a prominent red X design on the front, and is laced up with red ribbon at the front, and on the left side of the dress. She wears black heeled thigh-high boots with golden trim on the bottom. Relationships Orfevre- Younger sister and roommate. Family is the most important thing to her, and she does everything to make sure her family is happy and healthy. She is in charge of planning all of the travel-related endeavors when Orfevre races overseas, befitting her role in the Expedition Support Committee. The sisters share a room in Ritto dorm, where Dream Journey dotes intensely on Orfevre. Examples include preparing chamomile tea for her before bed, looking after her hair and clothes, and quietly watching over her sleeping face in the morning. Dream Journey affectionately calls her "Or," while Orfevre addresses her as "Ane-ue"(姉上). Orfevre respects and appreciates Dream Journey as her older sister and admires her terrifying strength. Orfevre sees her as reliable to the point where she lets her handle her schedule.IRL, both of them were full brothers, sharing both sire Stay Gold and dam Oriental Art (Mejiro McQueen's daughter). Trainer Yasutoshi Ikee trained both Dream Journey and Orfevre, reflected in the sisters' close bond. Jockey Kenichi Ikezoe rode both siblings as their main jockey, earning their trust through patience with their violent temperaments. IRL, both of them were full brothers, sharing both sire Stay Gold and dam Oriental Art (Mejiro McQueen's daughter). Trainer Yasutoshi Ikee trained both Dream Journey and Orfevre, reflected in the sisters' close bond. Jockey Kenichi Ikezoe rode both siblings as their main jockey, earning their trust through patience with their violent temperaments. Gold Ship- Friend. The two have developed a friendly and easygoing relationship, and Dream Journey is grateful for Gold Ship being Stay Gold's confidant. Despite Gold Ship's eccentric and unpredictable personality, Dream Journey appreciates their casual bond. Gold Ship once referred to Stay Gold as "Konjiki Oyaji" (Golden Pops) and appears to deeply respect her, a sentiment Dream Journey shares.IRL, the two horses never raced against each other due to Dream Journey retiring in early 2011 and Gold Ship debuting in July 2011. Their careers bookended different eras of Stay Gold's legacy. Dream Journey proving the bloodline's domestic excellence, and Gold Ship confirming its continued dominance. Dream Journey proving the bloodline's domestic excellence, and Gold Ship confirming its continued dominance. Nakayama Festa- Friend. Similar to Gold Ship, the two have developed a casual friendship. Apparently theOchazukein Nakayama's hometown is a favorite between Journey and Orfevre. Despite contrasting personalities, with Dream Journey being a "suave model student" who treats everyone with courtesy and formality compared to Nakayama's apathetic and lazy attitude, both connect with each other as they have their own special reasons for racing. Journey races as she was inspired by Stay Gold, while Nakayama races for the thrill and for her teacher's sake. Dream Journey approves of Nakayama's friendship with Orfevre, seeing her as a "good influence on her younger sister", despite her "wild" nature.IRL, Nakayama Festa notably defeated Dream Journey in the 2010 Takarazuka Kinen, where Nakayama Festa won by a dramatic upset while Dream Journey placed 4th. IRL, Nakayama Festa notably defeated Dream Journey in the 2010 Takarazuka Kinen, where Nakayama Festa won by a dramatic upset while Dream Journey placed 4th. Fenomeno- Friend. As Journey is the most polite out of the Umamusume in the Expeditionary Support Committee room, Meno rarely has any problems with Journey and they usually don't have qualms with each other. However, when it comes to prying too much, Journey easily manipulates situations so that Meno doesn't look into certain things, like when Meno questioned what exactly Journey was doing in suspicious areas around the school. Regardless, Journey acts cordial towards her, since Orfevre likes having her around so that she can tease her with Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa. Stay Gold- Friend and mentor figure. Dream Journey refers to Stay Gold as "Anego". This term is commonly used in yakuza circles to address a boss's wife or female relative, reflecting her deep reverence for her. The "big sis" mentioned in Dream Journey's profile who influenced her in childhood is Stay Gold, and Dream Journey races with the purpose of seeing the "journey's end" that Stay Gold spoke of. When asked about her inspiration, Dream Journey recalls:"At the end of the journey, I saw a streak of gold. A long, endless light stretching far beyond... I'll chase after it and go on another journey."Stay Gold appears to enjoy Dream Journey's tea, and though Journey says "I can never meet her when I want to," their bond remains the foundation of her racing philosophy. Before her arrival in Tracen Academy, Stay Gold asked her old ally Mejiro McQueen to watch over Dream Journey. The term "Anego" may also be wordplay, combining "ane" (sister) with Stay Gold's "go." Dream Journey's name itself is an allusion to Stay Gold's Hong Kong racing name, 「黃金旅程」(Golden Journey). Both the trainer and Dream Journey were connected by cheering on Stay Gold's run together.The game references the 19th Japan Cup in Dream Journey's character story, which is when Dream Journey found her admiration for Stay Gold. Dream Journey was sired by Stay Gold and out of Oriental Art (by Mejiro McQueen), making him a full brother to Orfevre, the 2011 Triple Crown winner. Dream Journey would also become Stay Gold's first G1 race winner, a monumental achievement that validated Stay Gold's prowess as a sire. Dream Journey retired to become a stud at Shadai Stallion Station in 2012, where Stay Gold was also stationed from 2003-2015.IRL, Dream Journey, Gold Ship, Fenomeno, Nakayama Festa, and Orfevre are all sired byStay Gold. The 19th Japan Cup is when Dream Journey found her admiration for Stay Gold, and Buena found her admiration forSpecial Week, so the two feel as if they understand one another. Journey also finds Buena's innocent personality adorable, but Buena feels somewhat envious of Journey and Orfevre's sisterly bond as she is an only child. Win Variation- Friend. While Win Variation feels inferior in racing ability compared to Orfevre, Journey sees the talent in her. In fact, she even envies her for the fact that she gets to compete with Orfevre, while she is unable to due to the fact that she had stopped racing at that point.[2] Vodka- Friend. The two have raced against each other several times. Journey has an appreciation for Vodka's straightforward nature. While others are confused by Vodka's desire to run in the Japanese Derby, Journey doesn't look down on her for it, and instead encourages her to run her own path. Vodka finds Journey cool as her upperclassman, and they get along well. Vodka is also one of the few people to not be afraid of Journey, as she doesn't notice anything suspicious about her. Daiwa Scarlet- Friend. They play chess together, and Dream Journey gives her chess tips and tricks. Kawakami Princess- Friend. Dream Journey always gives her tea, and in return, Kawakami Princess gives her information about Princess Fighter. Curren Chan- Friend. Curren Chan visits the Expeditionary Support Committee from time to time, and even comes up with a collaborative stream with Dream Journey to bring more publicity to the club. Curren also helps Journey with choreography during dance lessons. Mejiro McQueen- Friend. McQueen watches over Dream Journey from her debut race, having been asked by Stay Gold to support her.IRL, Mejiro McQueen is the damsire of Dream Journey. IRL, Mejiro McQueen is the damsire of Dream Journey. Aston Machan- Friend. Both of them shop for perfume together. Dream Journey also finds Machan's creativity intriguing and fascinating. Tosen Jordan- Friend. Dream Journey finds her interesting, while Tosen Jordan does her nails for her on occasion, like for her birthday. Red Desire- Friend. She helps Red Desire by giving her advice on overseas racing, and they both relate to each other as racers who have a major dream. While Red Desire dreams of taking on overseas races so that she could gain glory as a saint, Dream Journey dreams of reaching Stay Gold by racing. Sweep Tosho- Friend and underclassman. Sweep is jealous of Journey's prowess at persuading people, and asks her for help on how to manipulate people better. Lucky Lilac- Friend and underclassman. They get along well, and Lucky Lilac also views her as a strong senior. Dream Journey also appreciates Lucky Lilac's admiration of Orfevre.IRL, Dream Journey is the paternal uncle of Lucky Lilac. IRL, Dream Journey is the paternal uncle of Lucky Lilac. Seeking the Pearl- Friend. Pearl's dancing tends to exhaust Journey, and Journey can't handle Pearl's extroverted nature.[3] Durandal- Friend. Durandal shows interest in the Expeditionary Support Committee, which Journey appreciates. She also gives Durandal advice on overseas racing. Rulership- Friend and rival. Journey, alongside Orfevre, finds Rulership's strategies to be cunning. Journey also acknowledges Rulership's strength as a racer. When she wears sunglasses, they tend to fall off when she exercises. Appearance A descendant of excellence, her eyes are a piercing blue, enhanced by a subtle shade of violet. Her hairstyle is long, flowing, thick and layered. The color transitions seamlessly from a deep, dark brown at the top to a lighter chocolate brown as it extends to her waist. Small tufts flick outward and an ahoge sprouts atop her head. A unique small ponytail that resembles more of a birds crest rests at the back. The most distinguishing feature of her hair is the bold white blaze streak centered prominently at the top. On her ear, a gold chain attaches, adorned with a gem resembling the color of her eyes and three golden accents shaped like feathers or wings. Duramente's outfit is far more intricate than it may initially seem. While its militaristic style and commanding intensity reflect her name, the design carries a layered elegance inspired by majestic birds. The top is divided into 4 parts. The first is a sleek, form-fitting grey dress with a flat texture. It hugs her body, featuring straps across her chest and waist, and extends into a straight skirt. A black underlayer, separate from her dress and reaches below her skirt. Glossy black sleeves, which contrast sharply to the dress with its shinier texture. It looks like a cropped jacket when seen from the back. The sleeves are adorned with thick gold decals and baroque arches. A small white layer flares out at the cuffs, which could resemble feathers. Her right shoulder, without mistake, is adorned by black and white feathers. The final piece is the extended dress, strapped to her waist. At first glance, it appears to be a continuation of the skirt, but its flowing, layered design mimics the tail feathers of a majestic bird. Adding to the outfit, her left thigh is adorned with an ornate gold wrap featuring an assortment of patterns. Her boots are asymmetrical in height and color—one black, the other white—both accented with intricate gold detailing, seamlessly laced all around. Relationships Air Groove- Childhood friend and upperclassman. While Groove gets exasperated by Duramente's nature, she still cares for her as a friend. Duramente looks up to Groove, and calls her "Guru-nee" out of respect.IRL, Air Groove is the granddam of Duramente. IRL, Air Groove is the granddam of Duramente. Kitasan Black- Rival.IRL, Duramente and Kitasan Black faced off three times: the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby and the Takarazuka Kinen. In all three races, Duramente always beat or placed higher than Kitasan Black. IRL, Duramente and Kitasan Black faced off three times: the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby and the Takarazuka Kinen. In all three races, Duramente always beat or placed higher than Kitasan Black. Satono Crown- Roommate. Vivlos- Friend. They discuss lunch options, and Duramente always gives her nutritional ideas. Vivlos also teaches Duramente how to be "cute". Admire Groove- Friend and upperclassman. Admiring her strength, she gets taken under her wing. Meanwhile, Admire Groove feels oddly familiar when around Duramente, and watches her races in support.IRL, Admire Groove is the dam of Duramente. IRL, Admire Groove is the dam of Duramente. I am Durandal, a knight of oath and loyalty!" A chivalrous Umamusume who values manners above all else. She seeks to have a "keenly cutting spurt" that is as sharp as a blade. Conducting herself as a splendid knight like the ones in fables, she seems to be dreaming of a fateful encounter with a king worthy of her loyalty—a trainer ordained by fate, in other words. She puts in conscious effort to maintain a gallant and elegant demeanor in her daily life. Appearance Durandal wears her blonde hair into a high ponytail, held up by an elaborate diamond shaped clip, with gold and red fabric attached to it. Her fluffy bangs frame her face, and the middle section of her bangs are light cream, and grown past her eyes. The tips of her ears, hair, and tail all fade to a light brown, and her inner ears are pink. On her right ear she wears a red ear cover with elaborate gold trimming, and golden frilled fabric underneath. She has bright blue eyes with straight lids, giving her face a stoic and determined look. Durandal's race outfit has a white, form-fitting bodysuit as its base, decorated with elaborate ruffles along the sides of her waist. Atop the bodysuit, she wears a cropped yellow jacket adorned with gold trimming. The jacket's center is white, while the collar is black. The three pairs of golden buttons down the center are tied to one another with golden thread. She wears golden epaulets on either shoulder, with the left epaulet adorned with three aiguillettes fastened around her shoulder, underneath the armpit, and dangling off her shoulder blade. Her sleeves flare out into frilled cuffs at the end; her left sleeve is yellow, while her right sleeve is a deep crimson. The trim of each sleeve is black with gold stripes, and she wears a black glove on her left hand and a white one on her right. She wears black knee-high boots with golden trim. The base of her left boot, just above her ankle, is colored white, and both boots have golden toe boxes and heels. Relationships Calstone Light O- Friend, roommate, classmate, and rival. Durandal gets exasperated with Light O's strange behavior, especially with how blunt Light O can be. However, she does view her not only as a notable rival, she appreciates her friendship, and even goes along with Light O's strange antics sometimes. Fine Motion- Friend, classmate, and rival. As a maiden of royalty, Durandal respects her a lot, and holds her as sovereign. Fine respects Durandal, and plays into her "Knight" belief. Fine also gives Durandal advice on how to be more knightly, as Durandal struggles with being proper.In real life, Durandal and Fine Motion competed with each other numerous times in mile races.In knightly tales,Durendalwas a legendary blade wielded by the paladinRolandto protect his King and Kingdom. Everything she does is according to her plan. A solemn and diligent mädchen. A diligent and methodical exchange student from Germany. Everything she does is planned and scheduled down to the second. She likes to bake sweets as a hobby, and her precise nature may have arisen due to the unforgiving nature of measuring errors and baking. However, this same meticulousness makes her quick to panic when unexpected events of issues arrive.[1] Self-IntroMy name is Eishin Flash. I run to preserve Umamusume tradition. Appearance Eishin Flash, the meticulous daughter of German bakers, has an appearance as neat and measured as her lifestyle. Her hair is a sleek bob cut, colored in a rich, deep black. It descends just down shoulder length with prominent bangs that part neatly to the right. Her eyes are a gentle and docile blue. On her right ear, an elegant white fabric accessory with a distinctive shape, secured and tied around her ear with a blue-striped ribbon. Flash's outfit is reminiscent of classic tavern maids, very European designs fitting her origins and is much more noticeable in her 2D artwork. Like most maids of that time she wears a white blouse underneath, but her blouse (which historically descends down to the maid's ankle) descends down to her thighs as it sprouts into a blooming skirt with a red striped layer on top. Over her blouse is a black corset and one that is unique to her, fitted with leather straps and buckles. She actually uses straps, buckles, and saddles to connect every piece of her outfit. Her sleeves are puffy and white at the top, tapering into a black midsection with decorative cross patterns near the bottom, and finishing with white ruffled cuffs. And moving down is a very simple set of black stockings under some very neat and petite dark blue heels. Relationships Smart Falcon- Friend and roommate. Eishin Flash takes on a manager-like role to Smart Falcon, helping her practice and schedule concerts. El's the world's strooongest!" The North American Phantom Bird! A vivacious and quirky lucha libre. A masked luchadora, she's always hyped up and ready to wrestle. She has ultimate confidence that she's the world's strongest Umamusume, and loves to proclaim that fact to anyone who'll lend her an ear. Her mask is a present from her pro wrestler father and she insists on keeping it on all the timeーno matter what. Her best friend and roommate,Grass Wonder, constantly scolds her for being too reckless. Self-IntroA mighty crimson bird swoops onto the track! It's the one, the only! Appearance Making her way to the ring... the high-flying, gravity-defying, dynamite force of nature—El Condor Pasa!! And just look at her tonight—brown hair flowing like a storm down her shoulders, ready to take flight and slam a horse with her patented elbow drop! HerBig Bangbangs are in perfect form, flanked by those iconic framing locks, and of course, her legendary crimson mask, the same one passed down to her by her great father, rests proudly over those sharp, sparkling blue eyes. Her hair’s tied just right, no tricks, no games, and check it out: perched atop her ear, the lucky striped ruffle that’s seen her through countless victories! Rocking that classic red ensemble tonight—her signature long coat, trimmed with those unmistakable feathered fringes along the hem and laced with those bold golden crisscross patterns. Beneath it, the familiar yellow V-neck shirt, decked out with shining buttons that catch the light, paired with her pleated blue skirt, held firm by her fearsome belt, complete with its black design, golden buckle and red stripes. Woah! El Condor Pasa is sporting cropped black leggings and sharp red heels! Could this be a signal, folks? A hint that she’s got a new move ready to debut? If so, someone’s about to be in for a very rough night! Relationships Grass Wonder- Best friend and roommate. Teammates on the anime-only team,Team Rigil. Grass has a habit of pulling on her tail to keep El in check, much to the disdain and slight fear of El and despite that, Grass cares for her deeply. They both seem to be the ones that understand one another the most, and have a healthy rivalry on the track. Grass also keeps El's secret of owning a hawk in their dorm room under wraps. Special Week-  Friend and rival. Due to their similarly energetic personalities, El and Spe are very close friends, as El teaches Spe how to do special wrestling moves and how to name them, shares food sent from her family with her, such as cacti used with steak or as a smoothie, and even offered to share her strategy on how to beat Montjeu, who beat El in the Arc. El was also the one who taught Spe the French phrase she uses in the Japan Cup, though Spe is clueless about its actual meaning. Phalaenopsis- Friend and rival. They watch lucha libre matches together in their free time. Phalaeno also knows about El Condor Pasa's pet bird Mambo. I'll show ya my strength!” Espoir City is a rebellious gal who's always itching for a challenge. She is particularly defiant towards anyone in a position of leadership and runs races with great gusto in order to show who's really number one. She's often troubled by the fact that she tends to show a lot of her weaknesses when she's putting up her strong front. LikesTidying up rooms, Dice-stacking. Tidying up rooms, Dice-stacking. Appearance Espoir is a gyaru with a "moe fang" on the left side of her mouth. Her sharp eyes are sky blue that fade into pink, and then into white, with a white pupil in the center of her iris. She has red and blue eyeshadow on the corners of both of her eyes, and slightly thick blonde eyebrows. Both her hair and tail are a soft amber that fades into blonde, and her hair is styled with blunt bangs and side-bangs that frame her face. She has a white blaze on the left-middle side of her bangs, and a blonde cowlick that swoops downwards. She has a short side ponytail on the left side of her head tied by a black scrunchie, and her remaining hair falls below her neck. Her ears are short and come to a point at the end. The left side of her ear has two gold earrings near the base, and her right ear has multiple black piercings, with a clip in the shape of two black triangles at the base. She wears two black hair clips on the left side of her head, one in the shape of two jagged lines, and the other in the shape of a square spiral. Her race outfit has a black and red jacket, with three white zippers on the sleeves. Underneath is a black tank top that stops at her waist, with a blue and white sports bra-esque top layered over top. Her skirt is de-saturated navy blue, with two frilled layers. It is held up with a black belt which has a gold emblem on the buckle. The belt is decorated with a black and gray cloth draped on the right side, and a white, fluffy, tail-shaped mascot with button eyes and a red bow. She wears a black loose sock on her left leg, held up with a white belt, and a purple and black striped knee-high sock on her right leg. Her shoes are black sneakers with mauve laces, and gold horseshoes. Relationships Copano Rickey- Friend and roommate. Rickey often embarrasses Espoir City by being incredibly energetic and clingy around her, but deep down Espoir City is happy with Rickey's kindness. Smart Falcon- Friend. Falco thinks Espoir City can make for a good Umadol, which Espoir City objects. Falco's stare also intimidates Espoir City.IRL, Espoir City, Copano Rickey and Smart Falcon were all sired by Gold Allure. IRL, Espoir City, Copano Rickey and Smart Falcon were all sired by Gold Allure. Furioso- Friend and rival. The two are close friends however, often eating lunch together in the cafeteria. Transcend- Friend. Transcend and her often go to watch races together, and share a mutual friend in Furioso. Hokko Tarumae- Friend. Tarumae tends to give haskap berries to Espoir City when they race together, which embarrasses Espoir City even though she appreciates it. Appearance As described, Fenomeno carries intense and sharp eyes, deep violet and slanted with purpose. Her hair is raven black with strong purple undertones, spiky and wild yet somewhat controlled, descending just to her back. Along the sides of her face, longer strands flow slightly below shoulder length and curve inward, a bit smoother than the rest of her hair and slightly softening her face. She can be seen adjusting her large navy-blue officer's cap, its dark visor accented with yellow stripes. The cap's black band features purple chevron patterns and displays an emblem of her position. And also, relative to other umamusume, her tail is incredibly thick. Her uniform is akin to that of a traffic cop combined with a warden, Navy black in color and fitted with utility pockets, thick buttons, heavy reinforcements and red harness straps. These straps secure a semi-reinforced tactical coat to the right side of her outfit. Each sleeve features a yellow stripe running design along the sides, and, near her left shoulder hangs a yellow shoulder cord. A thick, heavy-duty skirt attaches to her left hip. Her straight-cut pants features more yellow stripes running along the sides, with additional pockets and straps hanging from the right side. Her long black boots are zipped up and have noticeable straps wrapping near the ankle. Relationships Bamboo Memory- Chairman of the Public Discipline Committee. Bubble Gum Fellow- Roommate. Gold Ship- Friend and rival. Gold Ship likes to prank and tease Fenomeno, since she tends to react poorly every time. Though Gold Ship teases her, she really does want to race with her. Fenomeno feels frustrated about her, since Gold Ship is a bad influence yet she is popular with children, while Fenomeno tries to be a good role model but gets little attention. However, Fenomeno grows to admire Gold Ship for her strength, and they are both viewed as a comedic duo by racing fans. Fenomeno also defends a child who likes Gold Ship, and acknowledges her as a valid inspiration for others even if she's unconventional. Stay Gold- Friend. Stay Gold watches her races from the sidelines alongsideMejiro McQueen. Orfevre- Friend. Orfevre likes to tease and pull tricks on Fenomeno, much to the latter's dismay. Fenomeno feels frustrated regarding her, because Orfevre is more popular with children compared to her. She does not view Orfevre as a good role model to children, and she wants to defeat her in races. Dream Journey- Friend. As Journey is the most polite out of the Umamusume in the Expeditionary Support Committee room, Meno rarely has any problems with Journey and they usually don't have qualms with each other. However, when it comes to prying too much, Journey easily manipulates situations so that Meno doesn't look into certain things, like when Meno questioned what exactly Journey was doing in suspicious areas around the school. Regardless, Journey acts cordial towards her, since Orfevre likes having her around so that she can tease her with Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa. Nakayama Festa- Friend. A lady of a distinguished family that is rumored to be royalty, she has come to Tracen as an exchange student from Ireland. Perhaps due to a sheltered childhood, she's very curious about everything, which can lead to some sticky situations. She hopes to make a lot of memories while at the academy. Appearance Fine Motion's soft, brown hair frames her face with two delicate locks on each side, while a soft white streak runs through the center. The hair is tied at the back with red and white ribbons. On each side, near her ears, she wears two hairpins shaped like shamrocks, their three-leafed clovers symbolizing her Irish roots. Notably, she is one of the few Umamusume who does not sport an ear accessory. Fine Motion dons a finely tailored, unbuttoned white jacket. The jacket features a crest near the chest, pockets at the waist, and an accessory belt at the back. Her sleeves are elegantly lined with red and green at the wrists, and she wears white gloves adorned with shamrock designs, another nod to her Irish heritage. Beneath her neck, a neat and unique bow completes the sophisticated look. Under the jacket, she wears a green vest, followed by a sleek black dress that flows down into a graceful skirt. Her pristine white boots are decorated with a string of hearts, and her white socks mirror the red and green lining seen in her sleeves. Relationships Air Shakur- Friend. Fine is unbothered by Shakur's unique, more harsh way of interacting with others, stating that while she's different from everyone else in Tracen, she loves that part of Shakur too. Fine has a lot of respect for Shakur. Shakur may act as if she is not fond of Fine, but really, Fine does not have much of a hard time swaying her into doing things, and acts quite playful around Shakur at times. The two have a complicated and intertwined relationship with the concepts of destiny and fate, and face it in different ways; Fine's method of facing the future becomes a painfully bright guiding light for Shakur, and when it is revealed that Fine has returned to Japan and is not going to stop racing, Shakur refuses to retire as well. Air Groove- Friend and roommate. Air Groove is often worried on Fine Motion's obsession with ramen and her behavior due to Fine Motion's upbringing. Durandal- Friend, classmate, and rival. Fine's noble knight, Durandal holds Fine to high regard and addresses her as Her Highness (殿下Denka).  Fine respects Durandal, and plays into her "Knight" belief. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Event Appearances 6Song Discography 7Names in Other Languages 8Trivia Biography "This rotation's kinda like an investment, y'know? Bit of a self-branding." An innovative Umamusume who boasts that she'll "revolutionize the world of Umamusume". Wielding traits like the vitality of a gyaru, logical thinking fostered by watching races and businesses from all around the world at a young age, and extraordinary creativity as her weapons, she's working toward her project day after day. As an aside, her birthday apparently coincides with a certain anniversary in this world. SecretsShe can sleep with any kind of pillow. She can sleep with any kind of pillow. Her weakness is often getting stuck on station ticket gates. Her weakness is often getting stuck on station ticket gates. Appearance Forever Young has brown hair with two slightly curly brown strands framing around her face and reaching down to her chest, with the left strand being red inside with light brown streaks, and the right strand being cream white inside with light brown streaks. Her bangs are slightly curled on the left, with two curly small strands of hair on either side of her face, the left being red inside and the right being cream white. There are red and brown braids on either side of her head that reach around the side of her head and end at the small red hair tie on the back of her hair. The back of her hair is tied up by a small red hair tie, styled as a messy, slightly wide ponytail with curled ends that reach down to her back. There are two long brown and red braids on either side of her messy ponytail, with the tips of them being slightly messy and curled. Her eyes are bright green, with one being a slightly darker green due to partial heterochromia. A small maroon fedora sits on the right side of her head with a gold decorative piece, including a ruby and diamond jewel. The fedora is fitted through her right horse ear, with a cutout for it. She wears rimless sunglasses with a gold frame, and lenses that are semi-transparent with a dull dark pink fading tint. Her brown horse ears are slightly fluffy, with four small gold ear cuffs on her right horse ear. Her brown horse tail fades into a lighter brown at the tips.  Forever Young's racing outfit consists of a black button-up tube top with a built-in bra, with four gold buttons on the torso part, acting like a way to open or close it. Over it, she wears an open maroon blazer coat with white lapels on the collar, accented by several maroon lines, with the chest lapels being only white. The front of the coat ends at the waist, while the back extends to just above her knees. The interior lining of the coat's tails is a dark grey, decorated with grey horizontal oval patterns and black diagonal designs. The white chest lapels continue around her waist and extend behind her into two long white cloth strips, each ending in a gold ring. Attached to the left ring are three small banners: a green rectangular banner, a blue banner featuring a thin white rectangle, and a red-and-white banner. Attached to the right ring are three additional banners: a red banner with a large white half design, a white banner, and a dull copper-colored banner. Each upper sleeve of the blazer features a white C-shaped cloth ring secured by a gold U-shaped button with a circular center. The lower sleeves are loose and open, exposing her forearms. The interior of the sleeves matches the coat lining with dark grey coloring and black diagonal patterning, while white shirt cuffs provide contrast at the sleeve openings. She wears black shorts beneath a white slit skirt that reaches mid-thigh. The slit extends to the waistband and is outlined in gold, with the upper corners decorated by gold-ringed semicircular ornaments. On either side of the skirt opening are sets of decorative banners. The right side features green, reddish-orange, dull light blue, and light purple banners, while the left side features light grey, dark yellow, light beige, and bright red banners. Each banner has a rhombus-shaped top, a gold button attachment, and a thin black internal outline. Around the skirt is a black belt-like strap supported by a gold chain, accompanied by a second, smaller strap beneath it. She wears brown-tinted thigh-high stockings. The right stocking is decorated with a gold ornament attached near the black silicone band. Her footwear consists of black platform ankle boots with crossed red-and-white laces forming X-shapes. The lace buttons are gold and marked with white plus signs. The boot soles are bright red, and the decorative motif from her right stocking continues onto the upper sole in a transparent, black-outlined design. The cuffs of the boots are thick and folded, with the inside being a brownish dull gold. Her jewelry differs between each hand. On her left wrist is a thick gold bracelet. Her left index finger wears a thick grey lattice-pattern ring, while her left thumb wears a simple gold ring. On her right wrist are three silver bracelets positioned side by side, each decorated with a blue pearl. Her right thumb wears a double silver ring, her index finger wears a thick silver ring, and her pinky finger wears a simple silver ring. Around her neck is a dark green choker held together by a gold "CA" emblem. She also wears a necklace composed of large gold rings, from which hangs a white-and-red tie bearing her name in gold cursive lettering. Trivia She was first teased during the Breeders' Cup weekend on November 1, 2025, just minutes after the real horse became the first Japanese horse to win the Breeders' Cup Classic. She was then introduced during the 5th anniversaryPakaLive TVstream on February 22, 2026, eight days after winning the Saudi Cup for a second time.She was actually hinted at being a possible addition to the game much earlier, when the horse's owner Susumu Fujita said he might add Forever Young if he won the Kentucky Derby. She was actually hinted at being a possible addition to the game much earlier, when the horse's owner Susumu Fujita said he might add Forever Young if he won the Kentucky Derby. She is the second Umamusume who got announced while her real-life counterpart was still active, with the first beingDaring Tact. Her biography references the fact that the real horse was born on the same day that the Umamusume mobile game originally released. Her fedora is a reference to the real-life Forever Young's trainer Yoshito Yahagi wearing one. Her eye color is green but it is slightly heterochromatic, with one of them being slightly darker to reflect the logo color ofCyberAgent, the main company of Cygames.This is due to the IRL Forever Young being owned by Susumu Fujita, the founder of CyberAgent. The blazer is left open, with a brown belt with gold metal holding either side together underneath her chest. She wears a white collared frilled shirt, with the center buttons left open, and a black tie with a green stripe at the end. She wears black gloves that leave the top of her hands exposed, with gold trim. On her legs are simple black slacks with flared ends. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Event Appearances 6Song Discography 7Names in Other Languages 8Trivia 9Student Introduction 10External Links Biography “Let's start training.... I have a reason as to why I cannot lose.” A special exchange student hailing from Funabashi's Tracen Academy. Although sincere and quiet most of the time, there is nobody who loves Funabashi more than her, as she was raised there her entire life. In order to prove that Funabashi has some serious strength, she has but one goal in mind as she steps into Tracen Academy... To beat the competition and overrule central racing. LikesFunabashi tourism guides (She makes the maps herself) Funabashi tourism guides (She makes the maps herself) DislikesJellyfish Jellyfish EarsWhen she feels the sea breeze and hears the sound of waves, they flicker happily. When she feels the sea breeze and hears the sound of waves, they flicker happily. TailWhen she feels like she's bonding with someone, it flicks against her leg and she scolds herself. When she feels like she's bonding with someone, it flicks against her leg and she scolds herself. FamilyHer family always makes her a Japanese pear tart on her birthday. Her family always makes her a Japanese pear tart on her birthday. SecretsShe can tell whether or not a carrot is from Funabashi with just one bite. She can tell whether or not a carrot is from Funabashi with just one bite. Since she started living alone, she began talking to her pet crayfish more often. Since she started living alone, she began talking to her pet crayfish more often. Appearance Furioso has layered golden-blonde hair tied in a ring-shaped ponytail that juts out from behind her head. She has a blue headband with flowers on it that drapes over the left side of her hair. Her ears are long and pointed at the ends, and on her left ear is a white ear cover with three diamond charms with checkerboard patterns in them, and they are blue, purple, and pink from bottom to top. Like the other Brian's Time offspring in Umamusume, she has golden yellow eyes. Her race outfit consists of an ornate doublet, short vest, and skirt. The doublet is primarily blue, with gold accents lining the hem and the zipper in the middle, going up to her mid-neck. She also wears a brown corset that sits right under her sternum. Over her top, she wears a white vest with blue and black accents. The cuffs on the vest are black and lined with white that goes all the way around to converge into a small diamond near the point. The main body of the vest is white and lined with black accents. The neck of the vest is high and black and white striped. On the back of the vest the blue is featured more prominently, with the back of the sleeves being light blue and the pattern on the back of the vest being a similar color. The pattern is like an arrow on both sides, with the fabric split down the middle. Above this pattern is a large F (for Funabashi).  Over all of this, she has a light blue scarf with gold hems that drapes over her chest and down her back. The longer and wider side of the scarf has five red stars at the end, symbolizing her jockey's racing silks. Her skirt is blue, with a purple and blue checkerboard pattern on every third pleat. Four star-shaped gems connected to two belts on her corset sit over her skirt. Lastly, she wears brown crew-length socks with two purple X's down the side. Her shoes are primarily white, but the straps, cuffs and edges sole are blue. However, the bottom of the soles are bright red with a silver horseshoe. Like the rest of her outfit, there are golden accents on the strap buckles and lining the blue cuffs. Relationships Espoir City- Rivals and Close Friends. Furioso prefers spending time with Espoir City alone and often eats with her in the cafeteria. Furioso didn't like Espoir City at first, due to her pride in her Funabashi heritage and seeing people from central as an enemy. However, after practicing with Espoir and Falcon, Furioso learned to trust them and became friends, especially becoming closer with Espoir City. Furioso also hopes one day she can take Espoir to see Funabashi with her. Smart Falcon- Rivals and Close Friends. Smart Falcon instantly took interest in Furioso when they met, and despite Furioso trying to push her away, Smart Falcon was determined to make Furioso her friend. Falcon, Espoir, and Furioso would often practice together, and over time, their friendship blossomed. Transcend- Rivals and Close Friends. Transcend is one of the few people who doesn't think Furioso is "scary" in Transcend's words. The two also share a friend inEspoir City. Wonder Acute- Friends. Wonder Acute helps to make Furioso feel at home and included at central through things such as cooking and giving her food from Funabashi, usually with the help of Transcend. This makes her "dangerous", in Furioso's words, but the two maintain a good bond regardless. Hokko Tarumae- Friends. Tarumae and Furioso bond over their shared goal of representing their respective hometowns, and Furioso seeks advice from Tarumae in how to better market Funabashi to the general public. Copano Rickey- Friends. Rickey respects Furioso's dedication to Funabashi, and wants to help her dream of representing it, and has also brought up the idea of going there on a trip to Funabashi alongside Transcend. Oguri Cap- Friends. Furioso relates to Oguri Cap as they are both transfers from the countryside, though Furioso envies her ability to transfer so seamlessly when Furioso struggles with her new life at central. In the center of her bangs is a prominent white streak of hair. She wears her hair into two curly ponytails that reach her shoulder, tied by two white fluffy scrunchie. Both of her ears have ear covers, with the right side being red, and the left side being yellow with two white beads at the top. She has bright red irises, each with dark red pupils, with a white highlight in the center. Her race outfit consists of two main components, a cropped frilled top, and a pleated skirt. Around her neck, she wears a pink shirt collar with white frills at the base, in the center is a large red ribbon with a heart gem in the center, and a pink pleated ascot, adorned with yellow trimming and white frills, attached to the base. Her sleeveless top is white with a pink trim, but is decorated with pastel yellow laced off-shoulder sleeves, decorated around the perimeter with white trim and red pleated frills. Her top also has white translucent sleeves, tied at the cuffs with a red band and a yellow stripe around the center. Pandora's red and light red striped skirt is decorated with translucent scalloped trim. The skirt is decorated with a yellow scalloped decoration around the top half, adorned with white trim. She wears a bright pink belt atop her skirt, a large ribbon split into two sections (one being hot pink, the other being yellow and red stripes) adorns her right hip. Attached to this ribbon is a pearly white charm that says "FP", and many other pearly white chains and accessories adorn the perimeter of the belt including a white key, and a pink star. She wears a hot pink thigh belt around her left leg, attached to it are two white chains. Her shoes are simple heels decorated with ribbons and square emblems with the letter "F" in the center. Her left heel is hot pink with pink ribbons, and her right heel is white with light blue ribbons. She wears a translucent white sock on her right foot, and a yellow sock on her left foot, both frilled at the top. Relationships Daring Heart- Friend and roommate. Before her release, she was alluded to as "Chestnut-haired Umamusume" inKawakami Princess' career mode. She has been scouted for modelling before.[8] Her design is based off hime-gyaru ("princess gyaru"), a sub-style of gyaru fashion that focuses on a princess-look. This can be especially seen in her casual outfit. This style was chosen for her character because the real life counterpart raced during the 2000s, and hime-gyaru was a popular trend at the time.[9] In her career story, Rhein Kraft is hospitalized during Pandora's classic year. This is a reference to real life events, as the real Rhein Kraft passed away in 2006, which was also Fusaichi Pandora's classic year. She dislikes vegetables.[5] Pink is her favorite color.[10] She enjoys hiking.[11] She loves to eat sweets, much to her detriment.[12] She enjoys renting out movies, since her grandmother used to be a film actress.[13] She likes to do dances on Umatok.[14] Fusaichi Pandora's "marshmallow temperament" in contrast with her talent is a reference to the real life Fusaichi Pandora, in which despite her strength in races, she was also quite moody.[15] Fusaichi Pandora's family spoiling her and being very wealthy is a reference to her owner, Fusao Sekiguchi, who was known to invest large sums of money into horses and horse racing.Her secret of purchasing every pillow that seems right to her is a reference to Fusao Sekiguchi's spending habits. See what a truly strong competitor looks like.” Strength is righteousness - An Umamusume who upholds the principal that might makes right. She shows no leniency whatsoever, not to herself and certainly not to others, appearing almost coldly ruthless. Conversing with the defeated, is pointless - this is precisely the conduct of a resolute, noble lady, Gentildonna. Personal RuleOnly entrusts her eyes to the best eyelash technicians. Only entrusts her eyes to the best eyelash technicians. Phone BackgroundA photo of a lovely tiara. A photo of a lovely tiara. Before a Race...She spritzes herself with her favorite cologne. She spritzes herself with her favorite cologne. SecretsShe can pulverize walnuts with her toes. She can pulverize walnuts with her toes. She has a closet at her parents' house for her ear cover collection. She has a closet at her parents' house for her ear cover collection. Appearance Gentildonna has dark brown hair, styled into slightly curly long bangs that neatly frame her face and two braids pinned into loops. She wears black ear covers; the left one features a golden crown design around the base, and attaches to a red heart-shaped ornament with white frilly trim. She also wears a matching pair of black and red hair ribbons with gold edges. Her eyes are a deep, regal shade of red. The core piece of her racing outfit is a short black dress, with yellow stripes on the bodice and skirt, sheer black mesh along its halter neckline, and layers of frills and lace underneath. The detached sleeves are covered in detail - copper lace, red and black puff sleeves, winglike embellishments at the elbows, black and yellow stripes below these, and a pair of neat white gloves. Over the dress, Gentildonna wears the most extravagant piece of her outfit - a red overskirt attached to a gold-trimmed corset, which makes the whole ensemble look more like a royal gown. The skirt also features black panels with yellow stripes, cascades into black ruffles closer to the hem, and is adorned with a pair of peachy-pink, flowerlike bows. The open front panel of the skirt shows off white thigh-high stockings adorned with gold lace, as well as her shoes - one black, one white, and both decorated with gold trim and a red gem on the vamp. Relationships Verxina- Rival and friend. Verxina sees herself as Gentil's foremost rival. The two share a rocky relationship defined by constant competition both on and off the track - always initiated by Verxina, even though Verxina typically loses. Gentil, on the other hand, does not necessarily see Verxina as a rival, and she leaves it entirely up to Verxina to decide whether they are. Despite this apparent indifference, Gentil does recognize Verxina as 'strong,' respecting her tenacity and the strength to never give up no matter how many times she faces defeat. This becomes a source of inspiration for Gentil. While Gentil enjoys the victories - proving her strength to be superior - she does eagerly await Verxina's own successes, which would act as testament to her own strength. Despite their competitive relationship, they treat each other cordially, with Gentil always humoring Verxina's challenges to the point her whole schedule is filled to the brim with mock races and other challenges by Verxina.They are both part of the 2012 generation, and the two famously faced each other for all three legs of the Classic Triple Tiara with Gentildonna claiming first and Verxina coming in second for all three legs. While their paths diverged as Gentil sought even greater heights, leaving Verxina behind, they did eventually come to face each other again a number of times, with Verxina even beating Gentil once in the placements at the 2014 Takarazuka Kinen with Verxina finishing 3rd and Gentil 9th. They also shared their last run at the 2014 Arima Kinen (where Gentil defeated Verxina for the final time). They are both part of the 2012 generation, and the two famously faced each other for all three legs of the Classic Triple Tiara with Gentildonna claiming first and Verxina coming in second for all three legs. While their paths diverged as Gentil sought even greater heights, leaving Verxina behind, they did eventually come to face each other again a number of times, with Verxina even beating Gentil once in the placements at the 2014 Takarazuka Kinen with Verxina finishing 3rd and Gentil 9th. They also shared their last run at the 2014 Arima Kinen (where Gentil defeated Verxina for the final time). Vivlos- Friend. Despite their differing personalities, they get along well, much to the surprise of Vivlos' older sister Verxina. They bond over having similar fashion and aesthetic tastes, for instance with handbags.[1] Orfevre- Classmate and rival. As a Triple Crown Umamusume and the reigning king of the year prior, Orfevre is one of the few obstacles in Gentildonna's path as she proves herself to be the strongest of them all. While Orfevre typically does not acknowledge those she sees as beneath her, Gentil is one of the few people she does honestly recognize as a potential threat to her reign. The two share a mutual respect for each other's strength, even if the words they might say to each other might indicate otherwise. Despite everything, they appear to get along.Orfevre and Gentildonna share the same owner, Sunday Racing, and they are both a Triple Crown and Triple Tiara respectively. The two very famously came to blows at 2012's Japan Cup, with Gentil claiming victory over her senior, becoming the first three-year-old filly to win the Japan Cup. Orfevre and Gentildonna share the same owner, Sunday Racing, and they are both a Triple Crown and Triple Tiara respectively. The two very famously came to blows at 2012's Japan Cup, with Gentil claiming victory over her senior, becoming the first three-year-old filly to win the Japan Cup. Gold Ship- Classmate, rival and friend(?). Much like many others, Gentil is frequently subjected to Gold Ship's antics. Despite how much of an unserious goofball Gold Ship typically is, Gentil does honestly recognize Gold Ship as 'strong.' Gentil describes Gold Ship's strength as chaotic and hard to control, even capable of overpowering her due to its unruly nature. She also respects Gold Ship's ability to ride chaos like a vessel on perilous waters. However, one of the marks to being 'the strongest one' is being able to perfectly control one's own strength, so Gold Ship is very far removed from Gentil's ideal.They are both part of the 2012 generation, and Gold Ship is a Double Crown winner. They faced each other several times, trading blow for blow. They are both part of the 2012 generation, and Gold Ship is a Double Crown winner. While Jordan's confidence does falter a bit at the prospect of facing the very decorated Gentil, Jordan still rises to the challenge since she hates losing most of all. On the other hand, Gentil respects Jordan as a strong senior capable of defeating all of her predecessors.The two raced each other several times. Much like Jordan, Gentil respects Flash's tempered strength forged over a long career, as well as the fact that Flash is a champion in her own right.Gentildonna and Eishin Flash raced against each other a few times. A blunt racer and the gold standard in racing and beauty. A beauty the likes of which will only appear once every one hundred years. She's been a model for as long as she can remember, and has always acted the part. She realized one day, however, that running is her true heart's desire. Since then, she has raced ever forward so that she may be recognized not for her looks, but for her talent. She's understood most by her good friendTosen Jordan.[1] Self-IntroThe name's Gold City. When browsing clothes or cosmetics, she thinks of the people those items would suit most. Appearance Gold City has platinum blonde hair that runs past the shoulders. It's evocative of her real life counterpart's chestnut flaxen color. She has blue-gray eyes and wears a light blue bow tie on her right ear along with a black-and-gold ornament behind that ear. Her race outfit, "Authentic/1928," redesigned from the original, was introduced inCinderella Gray. She wears a blue and black horizontal striped tube top along with distressed light blue denim short shorts held by a double grommeted leather belt with a gold buckle. Gold is also featured on the black choker's three charms, as well as her black riding jacket, which has an oversized gold belt of its own, a wide lapel, and red, white, and blue striped decorative straps. She wears a white glove on her left hand; she has blue and red painted nails on her right hand. Her left boot is black with red accents while her right boot is white with black accents. Relationships Tosen Jordan- Best friend and fellow gal. Yukino Bijin- Friend. Hailing from the countryside, Yukino admires Gold City and her apparent cosmopolitanism and model qualities. Oguri Cap- Friend and rival. Tamamo Cross- Classmate, rival and friend. Inari One- Rival. Bamboo Memory- Roommate. Calstone Light O- Friend and classmate. On occasion, Light O asks her for fashion advice, like finding straight-themed nails. Ellerslie Pride- Friend and fan. Trivia Her initial character profile was uploaded to the officialTwitteraccount on April 27, 2017.This tweet was a character name prediction quiz, that encouraged fans to try and guess which horse she's named after. The hint was "A beautiful girl with platinum blonde hair. She's always running late, and usually doesn't show up until about noon." This tweet was a character name prediction quiz, that encouraged fans to try and guess which horse she's named after. The hint was "A beautiful girl with platinum blonde hair. She's always running late, and usually doesn't show up until about noon." Gold City is remotely related toGold ShipIRL via Northern Dancer (2nd generationin Gold City's pedigree,5th generationin Gold Ship's pedigree). She is not related to the other City-named Umamusume,Tap Dance CityandEspoir City, however, they are of shared ownership, by the Yushun Horse Club. Her race outfit has "1928" in its name because it's alleged that City's trainers once quipped that the visually striking horse could get a job at Disneyland if a racing career doesn't work out. 1928 was the year Mickey Mouse debuted as a character in Steamboat Willie. Race uniform design notes fromUmamusume Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.02:Black was chosen as the main uniform color to provide contrast to her beautiful hair and skin color, referencing the real horse's striking flaxen chestnut coat and tailThe oversized jacket and short shorts combination is meant to accentuate City's stunning appearance and long legsThe "tough" looking leather jacket and distressed denim are a reference to City's difficult temperament. The bell accessory at the waistband serves as a charm for safety. Black was chosen as the main uniform color to provide contrast to her beautiful hair and skin color, referencing the real horse's striking flaxen chestnut coat and tail The oversized jacket and short shorts combination is meant to accentuate City's stunning appearance and long legs The "tough" looking leather jacket and distressed denim are a reference to City's difficult temperament. The bell accessory at the waistband serves as a charm for safety. In the chapter 3 and 4 of her Character Story, Gold City lost her phone before it is found by the player trainer. This event mirrors her voice actress, Saki Kosaka, who lost her phone before finding it later and obtaining her role as Gold City's voice actress. Gold City is one of the few Umamusume in the game to have a career event that locks the player out of training. This is a reference to how in real life, Gold City had a bad temperament. Gold City is the only Umamusume based off a stallion besideDaitaku Heliosto have the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies as a race goal in her career. This is because both of them ran in the race before it became a filly-exclusive race in 1991. Right?!" Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else! An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.[1] Self-IntroBow down! Gold Ship has arrived! Whether I gotta go through a raging inferno, the most downtrodden turf, or even way out there in outer space, I'm always up for adventure! ☆ Bow down! Gold Ship has arrived! She constantly lies about unimportant things, but hardly ever about the things that matter. Appearance Gold Ship has long straight silver-gray hair with straight bangs that cover her forehead. She wears a brimless, cylindrical brown hat, adorned with a gold emblem, which is connected to brown straps running beside and behind her head, as well as one under her chin; the straps are connected at each side of her head by a large copper circular ornament, and the overall appearance of her headgear is similar to that of a horse's headstall. Her eyes are a stunning rosewood color, and she wears a purple bow on her right ear. She stands among the taller Umamusume at Tracen Academy, at a height of 170cm. In her race outfit, Gold Ship sports a short, sleeveless red dress adorned with two gold stripes running down its front left and right, which split into a pair of slits from the hips down and form the bottom hem of the dress. Six gold buttons are found at her abdomen between these gold stripes. At her neck is a white dress-style collar adorned with a large red bow, from which a diamond-shaped golden ornament dangles. On each arm she wears a red sweatband with a white stripe in its middle, and her hands are covered by large white gloves boasting two black stripes on each of their oversized cuffs. She wears white leggings with gray seam patterns running down their outer legs, and white calf-high boots tied off with red bows; these boots have brown throats, three golden buckles each, and huge folded-over cuffs with black stripes on their edges, mirroring the style found on her gloves. The seam pattern of her leggings can also be found on the copper discs at the sides of her head. Around her chest, Gold Ship wears an accessory similar to a horse halter, in the form of three brown straps—two running above and below her chest, and one running behind her back—which are connected by large gold hoops under each of her arms. The straps are adorned with small gold studs. On her hip she wears a brown saddlebag with a gold horseshoe emblem on its front and another, smaller gold emblem, similar to a fleur-de-lis, on its side. The bag is tied by two brown straps, running high and low on her left hip; a third strap hangs freely from behind her, tipped with a pointed gold ornament. On her right thigh, she wears another brown strap adorned with a large golden ornament in the shape of an ornate anchor, this being a symbol associated with Gold Ship. Relationships Mejiro McQueen- Friend. Gold Ship often pulls pranks on McQueen and drags her into various antics. McQueen's dignified Mejiro family upbringing makes her the perfect target for Gold Ship. Some notable pranks include: kidnapping McQueen into Spica by putting her in a sack, putting hot mustard in her snacks, and fake crying to get McQueen to race with her. McQueen calls Gold Ship "a pest who won't leave me be" and is known to flee when she hears Gold Ship's voice approaching. However, she is also there for McQueen to help cheer her up when life gets her down. The two are teammates on both the anime-only team,Team Spica, and the game-only team,Team Sirius.IRL, McQueen was the maternal grandfather of Gold Ship. IRL, McQueen was the maternal grandfather of Gold Ship. Nakayama Festa- Friend. They often play games and entertain Orfevre together, along with that they both work together in order to prank Fenomeno. Orfevre- Friend, classmate and rival. Orfevre is one of the few people who is completely unbothered by Gold Ship's antics, instead finding great entertainment in them. Dream Journey- Friend. Dream Journey is grateful to Gold Ship for being friends with Orfevre. Fenomeno- Friend and rival. Often a victim of Gold Ship's pranks. Gold Ship likes to prank and tease Fenomeno, since she tends to react poorly every time. Fenomeno feels frustrated about her, since Gold Ship is a bad influence yet she is popular with children, while Fenomeno tries to be a good role model but gets little attention. Despite the pranks and the teases, Gold Ship does care about Fenomeno; as before, she has gifted Fenomeno a bouquet of flowers[2]and is one of the primary reasons why Fenomeno continues to race. Fenomeno grows to admire Gold Ship for her strength, and they are both viewed as a comedic duo by racing fans. Fenomeno also defends a child who likes Gold Ship, and acknowledges her as a valid inspiration for others even if she's unconventional. Stay Gold- Friend and roommate. She once referred to Stay Gold as "Konjiki Oyaji" ("Golden Pops" in English). She also seems to value Stay Gold's opinions, being one of the very few people that Gold Ship deeply respects. Gold Ship also watches Stay Gold's races, as before Stay Gold was implemented, Gold Ship was said to have cried when a certain "silver-medal Umamusume" won her first G1 race overseas, which is a reference to Stay Gold. Her initial character profile was uploaded to the officialTwitteraccount on March 1st, 2017. Gold Ship is often associated with the number 564. This stems from Japanese wordplay, wherein the number 5 can be read asgo, 6 can be read asru, and 4 can be read asshi; when put together, these three numbers spell outGorushi, Gold Ship's nickname. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart:The golden emblem on her leg strap is designed to represent a ship's anchor, in reference to her name, Gold Ship.Her outfit is red with white trim, reflecting the color of her real-life counterpart's jockey silks. Doesn't matter if it's 0.75 miles or 1.25 miles!" Miles and miles of possibilities! The strongest mile Umamusume. Innocent and hyper-assertive in nature, she is a genius Umamusume with remarkable reflexes. She has established her own principles and lifestyle, living by a rather curious routine of activities such as "relaxing to the National Diet radio broadcast"—a set of standards she has labelled "MiRules".
