Appearance Gran Alegria has medium-length brown hair, tied into high twin-tails that flare out in playful arcs. A striking white patch marks the center of her bangs, cutting through her fringe like a painted streak. Above it, a soft, subtle ahoge springs upward. On left side of her bangs is an x-shaped hairclip. Her ears are deep brown with crimson interiors, with multiple gold earrings on her left ear. Her eyes are a rich amber-orange. Her race outfit is mostly black and crimson with gold detailing. She wears a cropped vest with golden tassels and red plaid accents layered over a red halter top. A pair of decorative pins—including a yellow smiling face with "Ohamile" written on it and a gold megaphone with black and crimson letters "GA"—are attached to the left side of her chest. Her shorts are trimmed with red and gold, cut high and asymmetrical, with belts, chains, and tassels draping off her hips for added flair. A matching belt cinches her waist, adorned with a circular, gold-accented buckle. Black and red bracelets adorn her wrists. Around her thighs, she wears black garters and a golden strap on her left leg, paired with knee-high black socks that are decorated with white stripes. On her feet are oversized white sneakers, thick-soled and cartoonishly large. A red ribbon and gold tassels sways behind her, decorating the tail. Relationships Almond Eye- Friend and rival. Gran Alegria admires her running, while Almond Eye gets frustrated when she loses to her in miles.IRL, Gran Alegria was one of the few horses to defeat Almond Eye during her racing career. IRL, Gran Alegria was one of the few horses to defeat Almond Eye during her racing career. Loves Only You- Friend and classmate. Gran watches her streams after she finishes her homework. Curren Bouquetd'or- Friend and classmate. They sometimes take care of flowerbeds together. Chrono Genesis- Friend and classmate. Chrono admires her strength and adherence to her "MiRules", and takes note of how physically fit her body is. Taiki Shuttle- Friend and upperclassman. Gran admires Taiki as a fellow miler, and wishes to surpass her. They also both tend to forget to convert miles in meters sometimes. Vivlos- Friend. When it snows, they make snowmen, sled, and have snowball fights with each other.[1] Gentildonna- Friend and upperclassman. Gran Alegria admires how strong Gentildonna is, but she also sees the cute side of her. Gentildonna acknowledges her strength. They both like to compete with each other. Bubble Gum Fellow,Symboli Kris S, andZenno Rob Roy- Friends and upperclassmen. They all look out for Gran Alegria, and help her train. They also give her racing advice, and hang out with her.IRL, all three of them won the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Bubble Gum Fellow won it in 1996, Symboli Kris S won it in both 2002 and 2003, and Zenno Rob Roy won it in 2004. Meanwhile, Gran Alegria attempted to win it in 2021, but she lost and placed 3rd. Trivia She was announced during the 4th AnniversaryPakaLive TVstream on February 22nd, 2025. Gran Alegria has the second shortest time gap from her initial introduction to being added as a playable trainee, with 17 days between when she was first announced and when she was added as a trainee. The first isDream Journey, who was added as a trainee on the same day as her announcement. She watches go-kart videos when she isn't hungry.[2] She carries a pedometer with her to keep track of her miles.[3] She begins and ends her day with salad.[4] She likes airplanes.[5] Her family doing "English days" is a possible reference to Gran Alegria's mother in real life,Tapitsfly, as she was an American horse. Unlike the real life counterpart, Gran Alegria in Umamusume has multiple siblings.[6]The real life counterpart had only one younger brother named Blutgang, who passed away at an early age. Her height being 160cm is possibly a reference to her love of miles, as 160 is 1600 divided by 10, and 1600m is a mile. Her love for listening to the radio is a reference to the real horse, in which she would listen to talk shows about diets on the radio at her stable. In the senior year Yasuda Kinen, Gran Alegria gets something stuck in her eye.[7]This is a reference how in the 2020 Yasuda Kinen, Kenichi Ikezoe, Gran Alegria's jockey, got hit by a clod of turf in his right eye before the fourth corner and was given a bag of ice by Almond Eye's jockey, Christophe Lemaire during the post-race interview. Neat and sweet. Japanese at heart, she's back home from the U.S. Though born in America, her parents' love of Japanese culture influenced her to also love all things to do with the country—to the point of being called the spitting image of the ideal Japanese beauty. She speaks in a friendly manner and is easy to get along with, but her will is firm. Her determination to win is second to none. She shares a room with her close friend,El Condor Pasa. Appearance Grass Wonder has long light brown hair with a small white star mark in the middle. Her right ear has a gold buckle in the shape of a shield which has a dark blue ribbon decoration with a red stripe on the middle, along with two silver chains that hang from the buckle. She has light blue eyes with cyan highlights to them. Her racing outfit consists of a light blue sailor-style jacket over a white, pleated, short-style dress along with a white and gold neckerchief tied with a large bow. Her jacket is decorated with golden trims along the shoulders, wrists, and along the bottom. Two red armbands with golden decoration matching her hair clip fit right above her elbows. A red and gold belt with a decorative golden pin runs across her chest under her jacket. The dress sections at the upper thighs, revealing an embroidered underskirt with golden buttons. A loose red and yellow striped belt runs along her underskirt. She wears two differently colored boots, her right leg having a white boot with a bright tan collar and trim, and a black one on her left leg. Her right leg has a barely visible black wrapping resembling a bandage poking out from her shoe. Relationships El Condor Pasa-  Roommate, rival, and best friend. Teammates on the anime-only team,Team Rigil. Despite making frequent, and threatening, efforts to keep El in check when she steps out of line, usually by pulling her tail much to El's disdain and slight fear, Grass cares for her deeply. They both seem to be the ones that understand one another the most, and have a healthy rivalry on the track. She keeps El's secret of owning a hawk in their dorm room under wraps. Special Week- Rival, classmate, and friend. The two get along with each other quite well, but Grass is portrayed to have a slight obsession with Spe inSeason 1of the anime. King Halo- Friend, classmate, and rival. Seiun Sky- Friend, classmate, and rival. Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi- Friend, classmate, and rival. Phalaenopsis- Friend and rival. Phalaeno and Grass Wonder spar, and Grass gets along with her well because Phalaeno is one of the few friends she can discuss martial arts with.IRL, Grass Wonder, Phalaenopsis, Special Week, El Condor Pasa, King Halo, Seiun Sky, and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi were members of the Golden Generation, a group of horses that began racing in 1997 who dominated the majority of the Classics and their four year old races.IRL, Grass Wonder and El Condor Pasa were American-bred and Japanese-trained horses who shared the same jockeys, Hitoshi Matoba and Masayoshi Ebina. EXTRA STAGE- Grass Wonder ver. Trivia Her initial character profile was uploaded on the officialTwitteraccount on March 15, 2017. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:The "G" emblem on both her ear decoration and shirt collar stands for "Grass Wonder", "Graceful", and "Grand Prix" (a type of race she won three times).The color scheme of the real horse's jockey silks: white base with blue sleeves and a red sash, is carefully incorporated into a sailor uniform styled design.Due to Grass Wonder's real life counterpart suffering a fracture in his right hind leg early in his career, and then recovering to find success, she has careful taping in her right leg. The "G" emblem on both her ear decoration and shirt collar stands for "Grass Wonder", "Graceful", and "Grand Prix" (a type of race she won three times). The color scheme of the real horse's jockey silks: white base with blue sleeves and a red sash, is carefully incorporated into a sailor uniform styled design. Due to Grass Wonder's real life counterpart suffering a fracture in his right hind leg early in his career, and then recovering to find success, she has careful taping in her right leg. Grass Wonder has "dabbled" in Iaido.[2] In the game's home screen, Grass received a message from her sister saying she will defeat Grass. This is a reference to the in-real-life Grass Wonder's full younger sister, Wonder Again, who also won several G1 races in the United States and has a G2 race named after her as the Wonder Again Stakes. Her New Year's alternate outfit is meant to be a contrast to Special Week's Commander alternate outfit, which is why it's blue.[3] During a hotpot party in Special Week'sRuler of Japanalt event at the end of the year, Grass Wonder adds dandelions to the hotpot, which references the real horse's love of eating dandelions. Both the base and Fantasy outfit of Grass Wonder have an aptitude of B for medium and A for mile. However, the aptitudes for both distances were swapped in her New Year outfit. In the good ending of her career story, Grass Wonder says "There is no path before me, only in my wake." This quote originates from Japanese poetKotaro Takamura's poem "Journey". Appearance Haru Urara has rose-pink hair that is tied back into a ponytail that reaches to around her lower mid-back. She has short, messy bangs, and wears a tied red headband that causes her long sidelocks to frame the sides of her face. Her ears are covered by dark magenta ear caps, and she has a white bow on her left ear with matching magenta stripes at the edges. Her large, round eyes are a bright pink hue, and she has distinct cherry blossom petal patterns in her irises. Haru Urara's racing outfit resembles a traditional set of Japanese gym bloomers; she wears a very light, nearly white gym shirt with dark magenta stripes, and dark magenta bloomer bottoms with a single white tag on the left side. On top of the gym uniform, she wears a track jacket that matches the color and accents of her shirt. The jacket's sleeves end at her forearms, and her hands are clad in matching magenta fingerless gloves. She wears light pink-and-white striped socks that end below her knees, and heeled running shoes in the pink-white and magenta color combo as the rest of her outfit. Finally, she wears three band-aids on her legs, with one on her right thigh and two on her left. Relationships Rice Shower- Friend. The two have polar opposite outlooks on life, so Urara's cheery attitude makes for a good contrast when Rice can't seem to get out of her pessimistic mindset. Rice admires Urara's positive demeanor and likes hanging out with her, since no matter what happens, Urara is always happy to be around Rice. King Halo- Roommate and friend. While King does see Urara's determination and positivity as a good aspect, King tends to worry a lot about Urara, and usually helps her study and train, as well as help her with personal hygiene.The two were likely paired together due to their "never give up attitude," despite not being very successful racers. This attitude made them both beloved by fans. The two were likely paired together due to their "never give up attitude," despite not being very successful racers. This attitude made them both beloved by fans. Special Week- Friend. She helped Spe find her way around the campus upon first arriving at Tracen. The two of them hang out occasionally. Like many of the other students, Spe finds Urara endless optimism and determination invigorating and makes her want to try harder as well. Urara was also one of the few Umamusume to not laugh at Spe's dream of being number one in Japan. Seiun Sky- Friend. The two of them hang out quite often, such as playing with cats in the park and taking naps. Sei sometimes plays harmless tricks on her, which Urara never picks up on. Grass Wonder- Friend. El Condor Pasa- Friend. Mayano Top Gun- Friend. Occasionally, Mayano helps her out with stamina training. T.M. Opera O- Friend. Urara finds Opera O's unique eccentricities as entertaining and takes them seriously, such as when Opera O says that laughing makes her stronger. Narita Top Road- Friend. Urara and Rice Shower are repeatedly shown cheering on Top Road together, indicating a close relationship between the three.IRL, Haru Urara, T.M. Opera O, and Narita Top Road are from the same generation. IRL, Haru Urara, T.M. Opera O, and Narita Top Road are from the same generation. Yukino Bijin- Rival in competitions of hometown pride, with Urara representing Kochi. Agnes Digital- Friend. Digital finds Urara's naivete adorable, and likes being around her. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:Due to being notable for running many, many races, and still continuing to keep running after losing, Urara wears several band-aids to represent her indomitable spirit.Urara's real-life counterpart wore a face mask and ear coverings with red trims, represented in her design by the red ear covers and headband.Since the real horse wore pink and white bands around her leg, Urara has pink and white striped knee-high socks. Due to being notable for running many, many races, and still continuing to keep running after losing, Urara wears several band-aids to represent her indomitable spirit. Urara's real-life counterpart wore a face mask and ear coverings with red trims, represented in her design by the red ear covers and headband. Since the real horse wore pink and white bands around her leg, Urara has pink and white striped knee-high socks. She likes carrot ice cream, as it is shown in the19th episodeofUmayon, and likes to eat it when it is especially hot during the summer. As of this point, Urara is the only playable Umamusume whose real-life counterpart never raced in the JRA since she was a local racehorse. As such, as seen in the first episode of the first season of the anime, she is not in the same class as Special Week and the others. Her signature racing outfit is similar to a racing suit for races below G1 races, reflecting to her in-real-life counterpart having never won a single race and never participated in a graded race as all of her races were maiden races. Urara's eyes have a distinctive pink-sakura pattern, shared by Sakura Bakushin O, Sakura Laurel, and Sakura Chitose O. There is no connection between Haru Urara and the Sakura crown name, so the design itself may or may not be a reference to her name when translated, meaning "Glorious Spring".Ironically, Urara has the pink-sakura patterned eyes, yet Sakura Chiyono O, who despite sharing the Sakura crown name like the other Sakura Umamusume, does not have the signature pink-sakura pattern eyes. Ironically, Urara has the pink-sakura patterned eyes, yet Sakura Chiyono O, who despite sharing the Sakura crown name like the other Sakura Umamusume, does not have the signature pink-sakura pattern eyes. Haru Urara's casual outfit is similar to the Sanrio mascotHello Kitty's outfit, namely the trademark blue overalls.This is possibly due to her in-real-life counterpart's trademark face mask having several Hello Kitty stickers patched onto it. This is possibly due to her in-real-life counterpart's trademark face mask having several Hello Kitty stickers patched onto it. In the game's lobby, she is one of the few Umamusume who skips her steps in a upbeat manner. Other Umamusume who do this includeDaitaku Helios,Twin Turbo,Vivlos, andSonon Elfie. Her New Years' alternate racewear's unique skill, 114th Time's the Charm, is named after her 113 races in real life. Haru Urara is the only Umamusume in game to not have her racewear be based off her real life jockey silk colors, as the real horse did not have a fixed set of jockey silks. She is one of the few Umamusume, likeMejiro McQueen,Smart Falcon, andAlmond Eyeto have a career event if she loses her debut, as she never won a race in real life.Also, she is one of the few Umamusume, like Smart Falcon, to have an event if she wins a maiden race after losing her debut race. Also, she is one of the few Umamusume, like Smart Falcon, to have an event if she wins a maiden race after losing her debut race. Haru Urara is one of the few Umamusume to not have her personality entirely based on the real horse. While Haru Urara is bubbly and friendly in game, Haru Urara in real life was known to be difficult to handle.[1]Some of her real life traits are referenced in the game, as the trainer notes how Haru Urara struggles to focus on training in her story. I promise you it's very buono! ♪" Big and generous... portions? Get some more buono in your life! ♪ A magnanimous chef who loves to feed others just as much as she loves to eat. She is a gentle soul who wishes to see the smiling faces of those around her. Appearance Standing high above many of her colleagues at 180cm tall, Akebono wears her dark brown hair into two big pigtails tied by small white ribbons. She has cheery red eyes that fade into a light pink. When wearing her racing outfit, she wears a small soda jerk style hat on her right ear, mostly white with a dark blue top, and adorned with pink and blue stripes. The cuffs of her sleeves are pink with a blue stripe in the center. Around her neck is a white choker with a simple bow tie, and a gold medallion in the center. Her waist is tied with a blue ribbon, and she has a white apron with blue frills above her skirt, decorated with pictures of donuts and candies. She wears a white frilled petticoat under her skirt. Akebono likes to make chanko for Flower. Seeking the Pearl- Friend. Akebono is inspired by Pearl's attitude, and it inspires her to pursue the possibilities of "Buono". Hishi Miracle- Friend. Akebono likes to make food for her sometimes, and is considerate of how Pandora dislikes vegetables. Akebono sometimes gets concerned from how carefree Pandora can be, however. Appearance Hishi Amazon has glossy blueish-black hair that reaches all the way down to her upper legs; she wears her hair loose for the most part, with a large bang that hangs down between her eyes being a noticeable feature. A silver hairclip sits at the top of her right sidelock, and she has two prominent strands of hair that stick out at the sides of her head, just below her ears. Her hair also seems to naturally part in the back, with the main portion splitting in half at her middle back to fan out into two distinct sections on either side of her body. Her ears have a deep mauve interior, and her left ear is adorned by a red tiger-striped cloth that is decorated by a golden crescent-shaped piece of jewelry, which itself has five small diamond-shaped charms hanging from its body. Hishi Amazon's skin is of a darker tanned complexion, and sports a prominent fang on the left side of her mouth. Her eyes are a fiery garnet red. Hishi Amazon's racing outfit features a multi-layered garment worn over a black tube top; her chest is wrapped on the right by a dark blue half-top, a white half-shirt with dark blue edge lines layered over it on the left, and the bottom portion of both halves secured by a dark blue ribbon. Her left arm is bare, save for a dark blue ribbon wrapped in a criss-cross pattern on her bicep as well as her forearm, and her right arm is clad in a loose white sleeve with a dark blue interior and edge lines similar to that of the left half of her top. Her right hand is wrapped in a blue ribbon that is identical to the one on her left, with a golden ring ornament on the back of each hand, with simple golden finger rings on the middle finger of both. She wears a thin white choker necklace with two blue vertical stripes around her neck, and has a white mantle cloth on each shoulder, located directly beneath the golden fasteners of her top. Her outfit leaves her midriff exposed. Her skirt is also multi-layered; the main portion consists of a white pleated skirt with dark blue edge lines, which is worn over a dark blue skirt with white edge lines and a white ruffled interior. The top of the white skirt has a dark blue overhang that slightly resembles the collar of a Japanese sailor scout uniform, and the center is wrapped loosely by a dark brown leather belt with a golden diamond-shaped fastener. Slightly above the belt, a matching golden chain with diamond-shaped links hangs from the left side of the skirt. She wears a simple leather studded band on her right thigh, and her left calf is wrapped in a dark blue ribbon, styled in a criss-cross pattern that matches that of her left forearm. She wears yellow athletic sandals with raised heels; they are detailed with white and dark blue, and are tied on top by dark blue laces. Hishi Amazon's old outfit was much simpler, consisting mainly of an oversized white Japanese sailor scout top worn over a dark blue-and-white bikini top and a pleated dark blue skirt with white edge lines. The top was large enough that it hung down her shoulders, and was secured in front by a dark blue tiger-pattered neck scarf with a golden horseshoe fastener. The sailor top was split open at the edges, and was fastened together loosely by small diamond-shaped brass pins at the elbows and upper thighs. Hishi Amazon's right thigh was wrapped by a thick leather band with a golden ring woven into the leather, evoking the imagery of a horse's saddle or bridle, and she wore deep blue running boots with high heels. The boots featured a stylized cuff overhang, as well as golden bottoms and bridge fasteners. In terms of accessories, Hishi Amazon's hands and arms were completely unadorned, her ear ornament lacked the golden jewelry, and her tail was tied around the halfway point with a brass ring. She wears white ear covers with two blue stripes on both ears. On her right ear cover is a ring, with a yellow tassle-like ribbon attached. Her slightly droopy eyes are a de-saturated green, that fade into light orange. Her racing outfit consists of a sleeveless white dress with light blue trim around the collar, and two thin white straps on both of her bare shoulders. On the left side of the top is a dark blue stripe, and separating the top from the skirt is a golden trim. Her layered skirt is light blue at the top, with a zig-zag pattern adorned with gold trim, and underneath this layer is a simple white skirt, with a blue line at the bottom. Her puffed sleeves are separated from the dress, and are white with light blue accents. She wears light gray tights underneath her simple boots. Her right boot being white, and the left, black. Both boots have light blue trims at the base. Relationships Dantsu Flame-  Friend and roommate. Miracle is very comfortable around Dantsu, finding her cute and teasing her at any opportunity. She leverages her status as Dantsu's senior at every opportunity.Not only were they contemporaries who ran together often in real life, they were both considered underdogs as they debuted with very strong rivals. Her hair is styled in two braided twintails that fall down her back, tied at the end by a a red beaded hair tie. Her round purple eyes display her cheery demeanor. She has turquoise ear covers, and on her right ear, there is an orange and teal ribbon with a star in the middle. She is usually seen wearing a white cap atop her head. Her racing outfit refers to the "Hokko" racing silk, which consists of a white and red blazer-style jacket with a matching skirt, divided into sections separated by red trim. There are small, gold-colored buttons on the jacket. She wears a short-sleeved, slightly oversized blazer, and black and gray plaid cuffs. The lower portion of her uniform is a short white skirt with red pleats, and black plaid frills. She wears white socks with red trims, and white and red sneakers. She's pretty messy when eating hamburgers. She's pretty messy when eating hamburgers. Appearance Ikuno Dictus appears to be a sturdy and sharp Umamusume, just by how refined and sleek she appears. Her orange blunt bob is cut perfectly, with not a singular strand of hair out of place. Her narrow and long braid is neatly done, and reaches down to her upper leg. She has a white blaze on the center of her bangs. Her ears are narrow, and an elaborate metal ear decoration around her left ear. She wears large round glasses with silver frames over her pale yellow eyes. Her racing outfit resembles a dressage outfit. She wears a white button up vest with teal stripes on the outside. Under this is a white collared shirt, with a red tie tucked under the vest. To complete this ensemble, she wears a teal blazer with a long red coattail. The blazer is adorned with silver trim around the entire design, and she has red arm bands on either sleeve, with the tight-fit cuffs being made out of black leather, and reaching up her forearm. The collar of her blazer is held together by a silver metal chain. She wears white pants, with a dark brown belt and a silver decorative buckle. On her legs she wears a pair of dark brown boots that reach above her knees, and have steel toes and heels. Edo Umas don't let them legs rest until the day's well and spent!" You heard right! This Edo Uma is quick as lightning! A chic Edo Umamusume, she grew up in an old-school Tokyo neighborhood, where the locals gave her toys, candy, and scoldings in equal measure. Despite being a bit of a troublemaker, she hates underhanded tricks beyond harmless fun. She may be small, but she runs in all the big races with style and grace—if she doesn't run out of steam and stumble out of the limelight. Her favorite food is inari sushi. She really admires tatami mat makers. Appearance Inari One is a small-statured Umamusume, who makes up for her small size with her incredible amounts of character. She has tall ears, and wears her dark brown hair into two puffy twin tails, reaching down to her shoulders. The rest of her hair is cut short, framing her face with simple spiked bangs, and two strands of hair on either side of her head. On the left side of her head, her twin tail is tied with a yellow ribbon, and on the right side she wears a white kitsune mask with pink and purple accents. She has large round teal eyes, with small bean-shaped eyebrows. Her racing uniform resembles a kimono, made of various purple hues. The front of the kimono is open, with her chest wrapped in bandages. She wears a purple and red rope choker, with a bow tied on the right side. Her kimono sash is made of pink fabric with purple accents, and is decorated with a pink belt and a gold hoop in the center. Around her waist, she wears a magenta and white rope, with a large ribbon tied on her left hip, with three white pom-poms in the center. Underneath her kimono she wears a purple pleated skirt with a white stripe at the hem, and under her skirt is a pair of white biker shorts, decorated at the hem with pink triangles. Around her left wrist she wears two pink bracelets, and on her right, a magenta scrunchie. She wears wooden open-toed sandals on either foot, both with pink straps. On her right foot she wears a black sock, and on her left, a white sock. Both socks are tied with X-shaped pink ribbons. Relationships Oguri Cap- Rival and classmate. In Cinderella Gray, Inari is both inspired by Oguri's feats as a small-town Umamusume and determined to beat her in a race. A fellow member of the "Heisei Big Three." Super Creek- Rival and classmate. They race against each other multiple times in Cinderella Gray. A fellow member of the "Heisei Big Three." Tamamo Cross- Friend and rival. Her outfit is as sporty as she is reliable, she wears a short-sleeved, zipped pink jacket with white sleeves, layered over a sleek pink and white midriff shirt with green stripes and the letters "AF" printed on it. She is a mischievous Umamusume who proudly claims that she aims to be the strongest in terms of running. She used to be the leader of a group of ruffians in the world of freestyle racing, but was so shocked by Fuji Kiseki's performance that she decided she wanted to race officially. With her friends cheering her on, she is ready to go out with a bang. Self-IntroI'm Jungle Pocket. If it's a race you want, it's a race you'll get. She has a habit of licking her lips when her mood rises. She treasures the banners that her friends wrote on for her. She treasures the banners that her friends wrote on for her. Appearance Jungle Pocket has short, hazelnut-colored hair. The left section of her hair is tied up in a double-banded braid, with the rest either resting messily on the sides or being clipped with the three black hair clips she wears. She has a small ahoge atop her head and an arrow-shaped white streak running across her bangs. She also wears three earrings on her right ear, their colors alternating between soft yellow and light green. Her left ear has a noticeable notch in it. Her eyes feature a gradient that begins moderate orange, gradually fading into a soft yellow color. As for her race outfit, following the color scheme of her earrings, she dons a yellow and white cropped jacket with hints of light green and black on the sleeves. Underneath this jacket, she wears a black crop top decorated with a yellow bowtie in the center.  She wears a navy blue skirt with light green suspenders attached to its belt, with a leopard-patterned fur hanging off the left side of the skirt. She also wears light green socks—the right one worn loosely, while the left sock is a tight fit. As for her go-to racing shoes, she prefers navy blue steel-toe boots with heels that have the same leopard-pattern on the sides as the fur hanging off of her skirt. Relationships Fuji Kiseki- Friend, rival, and a mentor of sorts. She is the main inspiration for Jungle Pocket's quest of becoming the fastest Umamusume alive.IRL, both horses share the same owner, trainer, stable staff, and main jockey. IRL, both horses share the same owner, trainer, stable staff, and main jockey. Agnes Tachyon- Classmate, friend and rival, to the point of obsession. Jungle Pocket wishes to beat Tachyon, and gets frustrated at thought of never beating her. Meanwhile, Tachyon finds her interesting, and observes her as a fellow racer. Manhattan Cafe- Classmate, friend and rival. Dantsu Flame- Classmate, friend and rival. Narita Top Road- Roommate. Fusaichi Pandora- Friend, underclassman, and her former teammate. Jungle Pocket is very strict with her, and dislikes Pandora's carefree attitude when it comes to racing. She wants her to take it seriously instead of like a joke. However, Pocket does like it when Pandora is genuinely determined about something, like when she continues to pester her into going to the convenience store with her.[1]Pocket also lets Pandora borrow delinquent manga, which Pandora has grown to like.[2] Air Messiah- Friend. They get along well, despite their clashing personalities.IRL, they both had a foal together in 2010, a filly named Air Muscat. IRL, they both had a foal together in 2010, a filly named Air Muscat. Calstone Light O- Friend. They hang out together, and sometimes go out to eat. Tosen Jordan- Friend and underclassman. Jordan finds Jungle Pocket embarrassing and annoying. However, Jordan does respect Jungle Pocket, and thinks she is strong and cool in her own way.IRL, Jungle Pocket is the sire of Tosen Jordan. IRL, Jungle Pocket is the sire of Tosen Jordan. Trivia She was officially announced during the 2nd AnniversaryPakaLive TVstream on February 22nd, 2023.However, in the 25thPakaLive TVStream on January 28th, 2023, a clip of theEverlasting BEATSconcert was shown where Jungle Pocket was revealed next to Tosen Jordan. In the official upload of the Everlasting BEATS concert, Jungle Pocket was replaced by Air Groove. However, in the 25thPakaLive TVStream on January 28th, 2023, a clip of theEverlasting BEATSconcert was shown where Jungle Pocket was revealed next to Tosen Jordan. In the official upload of the Everlasting BEATS concert, Jungle Pocket was replaced by Air Groove. The trio consisting of Jungle Pocket,Agnes Tachyon, andManhattan Cafeis often referred to as "JAM". But withDantsu Flame, they are also known as the quadruplet often referred to as "JAMD". Jungle Pocket is the first eversemi-limitedcharacter to be added to the mobile game. This meant that while she is permanently added to the gacha pools, she cannot be chosen with paid 3-star trainee vouchers.She is also the first semi-limited Umamusume to receive an event alternative unit that is not semi-limited. She is also the first semi-limited Umamusume to receive an event alternative unit that is not semi-limited. Her roar when she wins a G1 race in the game is a reference to her real life Japanese Derby victory in 2001, where after the race, he positioned his head in a way that looked like he was roaring in triumph.[3] In her career story, there is an Umamusume NPC named Tsuzuki Raining that hangs around Jungle Pocket.This Umamusume is a reference to the real horseTagano Teio, who was in the same generation as Jungle Pocket. However, his career ended after placing 2nd in the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, because he sustained a catastrophic injury that forced him to be euthanized. This Umamusume is a reference to the real horseTagano Teio, who was in the same generation as Jungle Pocket. However, his career ended after placing 2nd in the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, because he sustained a catastrophic injury that forced him to be euthanized. She loves eating parfaits. She normally calls the trainer 相棒 (aibou), which means partner, though she still calls them "Trainer" sometimes. A notable example of this is that if she was made to race four consecutive times, she will call you "trainer" in a rather infuriated tone in her special voice line for attempting to make her race. Asides from an older brother, she has a younger sister as well. Jungle Pocket's school festival racewear being red and yellow is a reference to how in real life, Jungle Pocket switched owners from Yomoji Saito to Katsumi Yoshida during his career. Katsumi Yoshida's jockey silks are red and yellow. K.S.Miracle. I will repay everyone who gave me this life... I'll definitely show you a miracle." A miraculous sign of gratitude. A kind and gentle Umamusume. She's a kind-hearted Umamusume, with a calm and refreshing personality. She has a strong desire to "pay back those who saved her", perhaps from her experience of miraculously surviving two near-death experiences in the past. Despite her gentle attitude, she's willing to put her body on the line when it comes to racing. Because of everyone that has supported her, she's prepared to give everything she has everyday. Self-Intro...I'm K.S.Miracle. I vow to bring forth a miracle, for everyone who gave me the opportunity to live. ...I'm K.S.Miracle. She talks loudly in her sleep. Appearance K.S.Miracle has short light blue hair partially veiling her left eye. On the right side, a single long strand falls sharply, it is adorned with a metallic blue ornament accented with gold trims. Her royal blue eyes are somewhat narrow. Yellow coverings wrap around her ears, while her left ear bears the same metallic blue embellishments as seen on her hair. K.S.Miracle's racing outfit is a long, dark blue gentleman’s jacket that fades into a soft light blue at the hem with sky-blue interiors. Gold trims line the hems, while golden straps wrap around her arms. Light blue stripes trace the length of her sleeves, and the cuffs match the metallic blue of the ornaments on her ear and hair. Beneath the jacket, she wears a fitted deep blue shirt adorned with a delicate jewelry piece that clasps a white bow at the center of her chest. The jacket is fastened at the front by two elegant gold links. A high-waisted white strap, cinched with a gold belt, sits between her shirt and her sleek, fitted black pants. More gold straps wrap her left thigh. The pant legs taper into blue cuffs with gold trims at the hem. Her footwear is asymmetrical; on the right, she wears a pair of standard blue racing heels, but on the left, her heels envelop her entire pant leg. Shabondama,a song that appears in K.S.Miracle's story, is an old Japanese nursery rhyme where the bubbles that float in the air represent something beautiful yet fragile. The bubbles’ short lifespans are a reminder to cherish every moment. For Miracle, the songShabondamais likely a reflection of her own fragility, her journey to cherish every moment, and her bond with a trainer who promises to protect her hopes and dreams. As K.S.Miracle’s training scenario progresses, a story is told about a blue bird that brings joy to everyone around it at the cost of itself. As the story progresses, more is revealed about the blue bird, until the pages of that story become blank. It can be inferred that K.S.Miracle is that blue bird and the blank pages in the book represent the untold chapters of her story. K.S.Miracle, in Umamusume, is a very talented pianist. It was a skill that she picked up on because she felt the hospital kids around her were lonely and needed a little help in some way. In the game, Classic year Sprinter's Stakes was one of her objectives. However, the objective will be cancelled due to a sudden injury, making the objective moot.This is a reference to her real life counterpart dying during Sprinter's Stakes in 1991 due to "comminuted fracture of the left first phalanx".You will be given one turn with Tazuna afterwards. K.S.Miracle's love for bananas is a nod to the real life counterpart, in which he was noted to like eating bananas.[1] K.S.Miracle is one of the few Umamusume to be born in the United States, and she can speak English. This is a reference to how the real horse was born there. She has perfect pitch when it comes to singing. Appearance Katsuragi Ace wears her jet-black hair into a short ponytail, with the center of her bangs growing past her eyes. The side of her hair fringes outwards, giving her a bit of a wild but put-together look. She has two distinct white streaks of hair on her bangs, the bottom streak larger than the top. On her ears, she wears white ear covers, however the ear cover on her right ear has two blue stripes and one red stripe. She wears a round red ball-shaped ornament on her right ear, accompanied by a red tassel and golden clasps. Her determined eyes are a soft, yet saturated, blue. Ace's racing outfit is rather cool and sleek. She wears a light blue top with a small diamond cutout on her chest, layered underneath is a dark brown top split down the center, with the center being clasped together with ornate golden accessories. Underneath is a simple dark gray pair of shorts. However, over top of this outfit is a long, black, coat with a tall collar, decorated with golden engravings. Each of the jacket's shoulders have two triangles, pink and blue. Her black long sleeves ends at the half of the forearm with rolled-up cuffs, each adorned with two pairs of golden buttons. Both hands wear split bicolor gloves—red on the palm and black on the back—in the latter appears a wide golden half-octagonal shaped cut, which functions as a trim. On the back of her coat, an inscription written in golden chinese characters reading her name is found. The bottom of the coat is decorated by pink and blue belts with golden clasps. And most impressively, the inner-lining of the coat has an incredibly detailed print of a golden Chinese dragon[1]. As for her leg wear, she wears matching knee-high black socks, with brown belts at the top. For her shoes, she wears simple white sneakers with blue and pink accents. They both get along very well, with Ace seems to never restrict any of C.B.'s unconventional ways, which in return has C.B. thinking that Ace is one of the few Umamusume who is actually interesting to race against and run with. Before making it clear that they are each other's rival, Ace initially admired C.B. and saw her as a wall to overcome to become the true ace. Ace once expressed that C.B. is the closest thing she ever had to a role model. To her, C.B. is what an "ace" should be like. Due to this, she originally struggled to see C.B. as her equal let alone rival, thinking C.B. is in a league of her own. This soon changes after C.B. expressed her dislike at Ace seeing her only as an obstacle, neither as a rival nor as Mr. C.B. herself. Later on, they're finally able to see each other on the same level—as rivals, as equals.IRL, both of them are in the same generation, the two raced against each other several times in real life. The influence of Mr C.B.'s triple crown can be seen on how a lot of newspaper headlines during that time only mentioned Mr. C.B. even if Katsuragi Ace was the one who won the race[2]. These instances can be seen in their showdown during Kyoto Shimbun Hai 1983, where Ace finished first and Mr. C.B. at fourth, and Mainichi Okan 1984, with Ace successfully secured the first place and Mr. C.B. at second. That's what it means to be a princess!" She dreams of being a princess! A bold spitfire of an Umamusume. A scrappy girl who aspires to ascend from the confines of ordinary life into royalty. She was always a bundle of energy growing up, but after watching a certain anime in which a princess fights hand-in-hand with a prince, she's been able to channel her zeal toward her future dreams—the least of which includes walking the path of a princess and finding her own prince one day. She admires King Halo as a mentor. Self-IntroOhoho! I am Kawakami Princess. That's right! A princess among princesses. I'm here to smash my opponents into the dirt. Gracefully, of course! Ohoho! I am Kawakami Princess. That's right! A princess among princesses. I'm here to smash my opponents into the dirt. Gracefully, of course! She can catch beetles like no other. She can catch beetles like no other. Appearance Kawakami Princess has long pinkish-brown hair, that fades into a saturated pink at her wavy tips. Her hair is parted down the center, with very large hair intakes, exposing her forehead completely, and has her hair tied into braids on either side of her head. She has large ears, and on her left ear is a silver ring with upside-down heart shaped etchings, and a red and blue striped bow. Her eyebrows are small and thin, and she has large bright blue eyes, with vertically long pupils in the center. Kawakami Princess' racewear is a vibrant pink princess dress is held up with a dark pink halter top with a cutout on the chest, embellished with white and dark pink decor. Around her neck is a white choker with three green diamonds. Her poofy pink dress that is decorated with green diamonds has a cutout in the center, revealing two pleated layers, one pink, and one white with a pink stripe. She wears detached sleeves that frill out at the ends, with white trim on either arm, both arms also sport a pink and green cuff around her upper arm. She wears white thigh-high socks with a 'V' shaped cutout, each with a pink line across the top, and a green diamond in the center. Her boots, also sporting a "V" cutout are bright pink with elaborate white trims. Relationships Seeking the Pearl- Roommate and friend. Sweep Tosho- Friend and rival. They watch Princess Fighter every Sunday morning together, and they bond together as the witch and the princess. Sweep also encourages Kawakami when she's in a slump, and wants her to run in her own way regardless of the risk.IRL, Sweep Tosho and Kawakami Princess challenged each other a few times. Though she loses to her multiple times, she eventually finds the strength to beat her. Outside of racing, they are good friends. Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens! An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such. When watching TV dramas, she tends to criticize the characters out loud. Appearance King Halo has wavy brown hair that flows down to her shoulders. It's parted to her right, with a single strand falling in front of her face. She wears blue ear covers on both ears, and a green bow with gold charms on the end on her right ear. The bow ties a strand of her hair into a small side-ponytail. Her eyes are crimson, befitting of a king. Her race outfit is a green dress, decorated with violet stripes down the side, and gold trims, with the center being fastened by six large white buttons. The top of her dress is white and collared, with a green shadow roll around her neck. The green shoulder-line of her dress has a violet collar, with a white stripe going down the perimeter. The dress's sleeves are short, with violet cuffs above her elbow. The bottom section of her dress is left open, with a large petticoat underneath, and the split in her dress is held together by a pair of violet belts with silver buckles and gold chains. A thin blue ribbon is tied around her tail hole with gold octahedron decorations at the dangling ends. The gloves she wears on both hands are violet with a white slit, and six polka dots on her wrists. She wears a pair of thigh-high violet stockings with white frills around the top that are held up by violet garters. Her shoes are simple white buckled heels. Relationships Special Week- Friend, classmate and rival. King seems to enjoy Spe's company, though for reasons she can't understand, she is unable to keep her eyes off of Spe. She is also very respectful of Spe's dreams and emotions, though she won't admit it. Seiun Sky- Friend, classmate and rival. The two's personalities are polar opposites, leading to Sky's nonchalant trickster attitude getting on the prideful and ambitious King Halo's nerves. King Halo is usually exasperated by Seiun Sky's lazy behavior, and tends to call her out when she is lazing around. Sky teases King from time to time, though King secretly does admire her strength as a racer, even if Sky tends to be lazy. El Condor Pasa- Friend, classmate and rival. Grass Wonder- Friend, classmate and rival. King sees Grass not only as a rival on the track but also in their studies as Grass has higher grades. Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi- Classmate. Phalaenopsis- Friend and rival. They write poetry together in class.IRL, King Halo, Phalaenopsis, Special Week, Grass Wonder, El Condor Pasa, Seiun Sky, and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi were members of the Golden Generation, a group of horses that began racing in 1997 who dominated the majority of the Classics and their four year old races. Urara admires King and thinks she is cool.The two were likely paired together due to their "never give up attitude," despite not being very successful racers. Despite King finding Kawakami rather inconsolable, she tries to help her underclassman, especially to help her become more ladylike.IRL, Kawakami Princess was sired by King Halo, and is named "Princess" because she's the daughter of the "King". Digital admires King greatly, and even help King's fanbase with cheering for her properly. While King is worried that she lost her fighting spirit in races, Digital continues to support her, because she loves how hard she works and how she does not give up. Though King initially thinks that Digital is blindly worshiping her, King eventually befriends her, and they hang out with each other on occasion. She was the 60th character to be added to the franchise, and the final character to be announced until the releases ofKitasan BlackandSatono Diamondon December 20, 2020. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:The jockey silk of her real life counterpart is green with blue sleeves, and has white dots on both the arms and torso. The white dots are implemented in her design with both the hem of her dress, and the buttons in the center.Race horses often wearshadow rolls, which help a horse concentrate, and also symbolizes an indomitable fighting spirit. She has a strained relationship with her mother, as shown in her Career Mode. This is a reference to her in-real-life horse's jockey, Yuichi Fukunaga's early year in the job, where his mother refused for him to pursue his career as a jockey.King Halo's mother was also stated by Air Groove to have won several G1s in her time, which puts lots of pressure on King. This mob Umamusume was replaced afterwards.[1] Kiseki's story titles are references to various manga:Chapter 1 -NarutoChapter 2 -Kyō Kara Ore Wa!!Chapter 3 -Hunter × HunterChapter 4 -Hajime no IppoChapter 5 -CrowsChapter 6 -Ushio & ToraChapter 7 -Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead Chapter 1 -Naruto Chapter 2 -Kyō Kara Ore Wa!! Chapter 3 -Hunter × Hunter Chapter 4 -Hajime no Ippo Chapter 5 -Crows Chapter 6 -Ushio & Tora Chapter 7 -Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead She has younger siblings, and she used to wear matching clothes with them when she was little.[2] Her mother sends her daily movie recommendations on LANE.[3] When she was little, she had to wear an apron because she was a messy eater.[4] In the Kyoto Daishoten in her career mode's senior year, the commentator focuses significantly on her, commenting in awe "Ah, Kiseki".This is a reference to the real life 2021 Kyoto Daishoten that Kiseki participated in, where it became infamous for how the commentator mainly commented on him throughout the race, and how the commentator exclaimed "Ah, Kiseki".[5] This is a reference to the real life 2021 Kyoto Daishoten that Kiseki participated in, where it became infamous for how the commentator mainly commented on him throughout the race, and how the commentator exclaimed "Ah, Kiseki".[5] Kiseki's racewear is resistant to water and mud.[6]This is a reference to Kiseki's Kikuka Sho victory in 2017, where he won the race while it was raining. This is also referenced in Kiseki's casual outfit, where there is an umbrella symbol on her shirt. She tends to doodle in class.[7] Her younger sister was the one who suggested putting a ribbon on her beret.[8]This is a possible reference to her IRL younger sister named Big Ribbon. This is a possible reference to her IRL younger sister named Big Ribbon. She believes that glasses can boost intelligence.[9] Her love for manga is a reference to her owner in real life, Tatsue Ishikawa, who is the CEO of Digimerce. Digimerce runs an online manga distribution service. Her title, "神業の軌跡" (kamiwaza no kiseki, Trail of Divine Work), although not the original intended meaning, references her HKJC name "神業". Her1-komareferences various mangaka, likeRiyoko IkedaandHirohiko Araki. You'll never know unless you try, right?" Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine. Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way. Self-IntroI'm Kitasan Black. Appearance Kitasan Black has shoulder-length black hair styled in a slightly layered bob cut with bangs, and a few loose strands framing her face. She has a small ahoge, half-up twintails, and a white streak of hair in the center of her bangs. On her right ear, red rope tied into a ribbon with white and pink square flower-like decorations sit at the base. On her left ear, a singular pink square flower can be found. Her cheery eyes are dark red, fading into light orange at the end. Her racing outfit is likely inspired by a traditionalyukata, with a cutesy spin to it. The base of her dress is dark gold, accented with white, light gold, and black decor. The sash around her waist is black, with a white ribbon, in the center of the white ribbon is red rope tied into a cloverleaf knot. The sleeves of her outfit are detached from her dress. She has a metal etched collar piece, with a dark purple gem in the center. On her arms, she wears yellow compression sleeves, and atop that are black yukata-style sleeves, with an elaborate Japanese-inspired red, white, and gold design. There is a layer of white underneath the sleeves as well. Atop of her base dress is a black sleeveless jacket with red trimming, the ends decorated with gold stripes, and white and pink flowers. Around her tail is a white and red ribbon, meant to resemble ashimenawarope, tied at the end with golden beads. Kita wears a pair of black thigh-high socks, each with a small "V" shaped slit at the top, and layered with red trim. She wears red heels adorned with gold and black accents, and red ribbons tied into an "X" shape around either of her ankles. Relationships Satono Diamond-  Best friend, roommate, and rival. The two are incredibly close, with the two of them meeting when they were children and staying together ever since. The two joined Tracen at the same time, however Kitasan can be a bit jealous whenever Diamond outperforms her. Nevertheless, Kitasan is always there to support Diamond and vice versa, and the two have even promised each other they will always aim for the top, together. Copano Rickey- Childhood friend.In real life, they were both raised at the same farm. In real life, they were both raised at the same farm. Nice Nature- Friend. In the anime, she sees Nice Nature as a mentor figure, frequently seeking her out for advice. Duramente- Friend, and rival.IRL, in their three races, Kitasan Black has never beat nor placed higher than Duramente. IRL, in their three races, Kitasan Black has never beat nor placed higher than Duramente. Satono Crown- Friend and rival. Cheval Grand- Friend and rival. Kitasan Black is a source of envy for Cheval Grand, as Kitasan Black is a more open and cheerful individual, it is in deep contrast with Cheval's more reserved and pessimistic personality. Tokai Teio- Friend and teammate on the anime-only team,Team Spica. Teio is Kitasan's role model and the main reason why she wanted to become a great racer. Teio often acts as a supportive senior to Kitasan, offering encouragement when she faces the pressures of the Triple Crown races. Kitasan mainly wants to be the type of person that inspires others, like Tokai Teio does for her. So she pushes herself, and thus gets frustrated when she loses, especially when racing against Teio. Sweep Tosho- Friend. Kitasan Black hangs out Sweep often, and is happy when Sweep uses her "magic" to cheer her up, like after a bad result on a test. Kitasan Black also plays along with Sweep's Magical Girl team, as "Magical Black".In real life, Sweep Tosho and Kitasan Black had a foal in 2019 named Piedra de Luna. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Event Appearances 6Song Discography 7Names in Other Languages 8Trivia 9External Links Biography "As long as you keep on making good things... Well, I'm sure it'll reach someone someday." A quiet and steady Umamusume who is heir to a long-established hand-drawn sign workshop. She holds a deep appreciation for her family business and various other "good old things", and dedicates daily efforts to preserving them. In fact, the reason she started entering races is because she thought drawing public attention as the "signs girl" might help her family business find stability. SecretsShe has three pairs of denim that she is carefully "breaking in". She has three pairs of denim that she is carefully "breaking in". Appearance Logotype is depicted as a refined and gentle Umamusume with shoulder-length, dark brown-to-black hair tied in a low ponytail with a dark ribbon, neat straight-cut bangs, and a textured golden headband secured with a small hair clip on the side. She features warm amber eyes, dark horse ears with subtle gold stripe markings on the inner right ear, and a flowing dark tail extending behind her. In her racing outfit, Logotype wears a stylish, craftsman-inspired theme costume. She sports a deep maroon varsity-style jacket with light-colored ribbed lining along the collar and a round brown emblem on the right sleeve, worn over a layered top that features a white collared shirt beneath a mustard-yellow and black striped corset vest. Around her waist, a leather belt holds a brown apron-like half-skirt decorated with stitching along the lower border and a prominent gold-stamped "Logotype" seal on the pocket, accompanied by a small leather tool pouch slung at her side. She completes the look with dark shorts, a silver pendant necklace, a gold brooch on her lapel, and asymmetric beige leather gaiter boots buckled over cozy ribbed socks with black garter straps, standing casually with one hand tucked into her jacket pocket. Relationships Epiphaneia- Friend and rival. Epiphaneia is highly passionate and headstrong toward Logotype, and feels like their relationship is sticking together with some special kind of bond. As Logotype was Epiphaneia's first rival, Epiphaneia holds her in high regard. Logotype likes the hyperactive side of Epiphaneia.IRL, They are both part of the same generation. Appearance Loves Only You has yellow eyes and red hair, that flows far past her back in a high ponytail style with a long muted pink hair strand at her right side, and a red heart on her left cheek. Her race outfit consists of a fitted black jacket with green zigzag trim on the sleeves and gold accents on the cuffs. The jacket has a corset-like design with gold lacing at the front, emphasizing her waist. Underneath the jacket, there is a white ruffled blouse with a high collar and frilled cuffs that peek out from the jacket sleeves. She wears a skirt that is multi-layered with white ruffles underneath and a black outer layer that is open in the front, revealing the ruffles and her legs. There are decorative ribbons in green and purple tied around the skirt. She wears thigh-high boots with an asymmetrical design, with one boot is white with gold detailing and a red frill at the top, while the other is black with gold accents and a white frill at the top. She also wears accessories like a small black top hat on her head and white, black gloves and a single black and gold strap with a crimson bow that rests on her left thigh. Relationships Chrono Genesis- Friend, roommate, and classmate. Loves enjoys Chrono's eccentricity, and enjoys hearing her talk about race history. She also dries Chrono's hair for her when she is engrossed in history. Gran Alegria- Friend and classmate. Loves likes to follow Gran's "MiRules", and likes the salads Gran makes. Curren Bouquetd'or- Friend and classmate. Curren Chan- Friend. Marche Lorraine- Childhood friend. The two have a very close relationship; according to Loves, Marche is her #1 best friend. Loves is one of the only people Marche is comfortable speaking to without her puppet. Since she was young, Marche was happy to stand behind Loves and support her from the shadows. However, Loves wants Marche to recognize her own strength.Both wear matching straps, with Loves on her left thigh and Marche on her right thigh.IRL, both horses grew up together at the Northern Farm and were trained by Yoshito Yahagi. They would go on to win their own Breeder's Cup races in 2021, with Loves Only You winning the BC Filly & Mare Turf and Marche Lorraine winning the BC Distaff that year. Both wear matching straps, with Loves on her left thigh and Marche on her right thigh. IRL, both horses grew up together at the Northern Farm and were trained by Yoshito Yahagi. They would go on to win their own Breeder's Cup races in 2021, with Loves Only You winning the BC Filly & Mare Turf and Marche Lorraine winning the BC Distaff that year. Espoir City- Friend. They play fighting games together from time to time. Kiseki- Friend. They both enjoy manga together. Loves also helps Kiseki make a drawing stream. Almond Eye- Friend and rival. Almond Eye teaches her how to do yoga, and they attend yoga sessions together. Agnes Digital- Friend. Digital likes to watch Loves' streams, and she uses an anonymous online username to watch them. Loves eventually picks up on who she is, and appreciates her as a fan. Trivia She was announced during the 4th AnniversaryPakaLive TVstream on February 22nd, 2025. The mole on her neck is in the same place as a mole on her IRL jockey,Yuga Kawada's, neck. While usingLove-Linked AsteronBeyond Dreams, the player can start the Career with the9927 Wishescostume before swapping to the new one before entering Breeders' Cup. Victory in the Breeders' Cup during Beyond Dreams unlocks an event with commentary in English even on the Japanese version: "Here comes Loves Only You to win it for Japan!".This references the real-life commentary delivered byLarry CollmusforNBC. This references the real-life commentary delivered byLarry CollmusforNBC. She hates going to hospitals, especially the dentist.[1] Her parents give her feedback on her streams.[2] There are a total of 26 hearts on her racewear.[3] She used to be a tomboy when she was little, and she used to get covered in mud all the time.[4] She is very good at watermelon smashing.[5] In her solo song,(Oyasumi Haishin) Minna to Love Hojuu Shita~i,Agnes Digitalmakes a cameo appearance at the 2:51 mark. In her senior year, Loves Only You is forced to return to Japan after heading to Dubai, because a pandemic is going around.[6]This is a reference to the COVID-19 pandemic that started in 2020. While Loves Only You was initially scheduled to compete in the Dubai Sheema Classic in 2020, it was cancelled days before the race because of growing concerns regarding the pandemic.[7] This is a reference to the COVID-19 pandemic that started in 2020. While Loves Only You was initially scheduled to compete in the Dubai Sheema Classic in 2020, it was cancelled days before the race because of growing concerns regarding the pandemic.[7] In her classic year, a bacterial infection in her legs puts her plans for the Oka Sho in jeopardy. Because of this, the player can choose to either enter her in the Oka Sho or the Wasurenagusa Sho, a prelude for the Japanese Oaks.[8]This happened to Loves Only You in real life, where she contracted a bacterial infection in her hooves. This caused her to miss out on the Oka Sho.[9] This happened to Loves Only You in real life, where she contracted a bacterial infection in her hooves. This caused her to miss out on the Oka Sho.[9] In the homescreen, she mentions that her older sister likes to hang out withForever Young. This sister is a reference to the real horseReal Steel, who is Loves Only You's full older brother and the winner of the 2016 Dubai Turf. He is also the sire of Forever Young, hence why they hang out in Umamusume. She finds drawing a bit difficult. It’s my turn today to get ahead." An Umamusume notable for her fair Kansai dialect. She refines herself daily in order to bloom into a dignified flower of the racing world, much like her esteemed senior Orfevre has. To that end, she puts in conscious effort to act with grace at all times, trying to suppress her inner voice that protests it. Appearance Lucky Lilac has long straight dusky-rose hair that is tied up in a neat side ponytail, decorated with floral accessories. She has straight bangs with white highlights which resembles the markings of her real-life counterpart that cover her forehead, as well as two side bangs. She also sports two ear covers that have star shaped earrings on them. Lucky Lilac has light-magenta colored eyes. In her race outfit, she sports a white sleeveless halterneck shirt with detached sleeves, and a black silvered corset. She also wears a brown high-low skirt, with white knee-high socks. On her feet are two black boots with purple heels and a purple-colored flower in the middle of their shafts. Relationships Believe- Roommate. Almond Eye- Friend, rival, and classmate. Lucky Lilac is both annoyed yet inspired by Almond Eye's unwavering determination to win. They both train together, and Lucky Lilac wishes to surpass her. Meanwhile, Almond Eye wants to beat her in races as she views her as a strong rival she cannot lose to.IRL, Lucky Lilac was Almond Eye's main rival during her Triple Tiara campaign. IRL, Lucky Lilac was Almond Eye's main rival during her Triple Tiara campaign. Blast Onepiece- Friend, rival, and classmate. Orfevre- Friend, upperclassman, and idol. Lucky Lilac looks up to her, and tries to emulate her mannerisms. Lucky Lilac also likes to buy Orfevre plushies, and was inspired to emulate her after watching her races. While Lucky Lilac struggles in her rivalry with Almond Eye, Orfevre encourages her in a blunt manner, and they train together from time to time. Orfevre also finds Lucky Lilac's jokes funny, much to the latter's shock.IRL, Orfevre is Lucky Lilac’s sire. IRL, Orfevre is Lucky Lilac’s sire. Marche Lorraine- Friend. Marche Lorraine wants to adopt Lucky Lilac's persevering and courageous attitude. Lucky Lilac also admires Marche Lorraine's art skills.IRL, both Lucky Lilac and Marche Lorraine were sired by Orfevre. IRL, both Lucky Lilac and Marche Lorraine were sired by Orfevre. Kiseki- Friend, classmate, and rival. Kiseki believes that she's cool, and that her racing career could make for a great story in a manga. Buena Vista- Friend. Buena Vista gives her racing advice, and they both train together. Loves Only You- Friend. Lucky Lilac likes the perfumes she wears, and asks her where she gets the perfumes from. She also finds her catchphrase "love me, love you" catchy. Chrono Genesis- Friend. Lucky Lilac finds her eccentric, and is baffled by how big her race camera is. Tamamo Cross- Friend. They train together, and both of them have Kansai dialects. They also relate to each other as the "straight men" in the academy. Stay Gold- Friend and upperclassman. She gives her candy from time to time, which makes Lucky Lilac feel like a little kid.IRL, Stay Gold is Lucky Lilac’s grandsire. IRL, Stay Gold is Lucky Lilac’s grandsire. Gold ShipandNakayama Festa- Friends and upperclassmen. They both like to entertain Lucky Lilac in the Expeditionary Support Committee room.IRL, Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa were both sired by Stay Gold, while Stay Gold is Lucky Lilac's grandsire. IRL, Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa were both sired by Stay Gold, while Stay Gold is Lucky Lilac's grandsire. Dream Journey- Friend and upperclassman. They get along well, and Lucky Lilac also views her as a strong senior. Dream Journey also appreciates Lucky Lilac's admiration of Orfevre.IRL, Dream Journey is the paternal uncle of Lucky Lilac. IRL, Dream Journey is the paternal uncle of Lucky Lilac. Curren Bouquetd'or- Friend and underclassman. Bouquet finds her funny, and they sometimes hang out together. Red Desire- Friend. Red Desire believes that Lucky Lilac's mannerisms are saintlike, which she approves of. Lucky Lilac, despite finding Red Desire's beliefs strange, is uplifted by her positivity. She offers to help Red Desire out with her potions sometimes. Always chasing shadows... Quite the mysterious Umamusume. A mysterious girl who blends in with the shadows... and speaks with them. She can often be found sticking close to the walls, tracing odd patterns with her fingertips. According to her, however, she's always with her "friend." She enjoys sipping a nice cup of coffee, as gulping it down too quickly hurts her stomach.[1] Self-IntroI'm Manhattan Cafe. I have... a friend I want to catch up with... Appearance Cafe's most prominent feature is her long, jet-black, hair. The ends are cut perfectly blunt, with bangs framing her face. She has incredibly long bangs, swept to the side covering her left eye. Atop her head is a large curved white ahoge. On the right side of her jet-black ears, she wears a gold earring with a rectangular teal charm attached to it. She has pale yellow eyes with a simple, yet eerie-looking, black pupil in the center. As for her race outfit, she wears a black knee-length overcoat with intricate gold embellishments on either side, and gold pockets. She wears a black long sleeved shirt underneath, with gold stripes on the cuff, and black gloves. Underneath this shirt, she wears a white collared shirt, tied by a yellow tie with black stripes at the end, two stars, teal and black, in the center. There is a simple black choker around her neck. She wears a black pleated skirt with gold decor, and white trim around the edge. There's a black belt with gold chains tied around her waist, over her shirts. On her legs, she wears black stockings, the right shin decorated with golden diamonds. She wears simple white loafers with black heels. Relationships Jungle Pocket- Classmate, friend, and rival. Cafe gets concerned for her when she tries to drop out of Tracen Academy, while Tachyon attempts to stop her from going to France in Cafe's career story. Cafe is also the only person Tachyon doesn't refer to with the "-kun" suffix, showcasing that she has a unique level of respect for Cafe. 'Hey Hiii☆ Got anything to say to Mar-chan?'" An extreme introvert who struggles to even communicate with people nearby when she isn't using her puppet. She's best at painting when she's using acrylics. Appearance She has short brown hair that curls at the end and reaches her neck area. Her bangs hover over her eyes and are parted to the right. She has a singular white stripe on the right side of her hair. On her head is a maroon cap with a white stripe near the covering and white and green coverings for her ears. She has calm magenta eyes. Her racing outfit consists of a black top with a gold accent running down the left, a singular gold button, and a long black collar with similar gold accents. Her sleeves have the same accents but with a red and gold band. At the end of the sleeve, there's a black ruffled accent with three gold accents, finally ending with a red band. Under her top is a black and white striped undershirt, with gold accents on the stripes. She also wears two belts, a white one, and a red one; both with green ruffles. They also have gold accents. Her skirt has a similar white, black, and gold pattern. ending with green ruffles on the ends. A single black and gold strap with a crimson bow rests on her right thigh, and her boots are black with white ruffles on the top that have gold accents and a red ruffle near the opening of the boot. She has a friendly personality and is loved by everyone, even if her way of speaking tends to be a bit dated.[2] Appearance Maruzensky has very long, wavy light brown hair that cascades down her back, kept tidy by a large black bow on the back of her head, and is trimmed into fluffy bangs in the front. Her ears are a slightly darker shade of brown at the tips, and she has a blue bow around her right ear. She has downturned, bright turquoise eyes. The centerpiece of Maruzensky's racing outfit is a red cropped sailor top, with a brown and white striped collar around a keyhole neckline. It's adorned at the bust with a large white bow that has a gold decorative zipper tag in the center, and a red and gold horseshoe charm at the top of the collar. Over the sailor top, she wears a red cropped jacket with yellow trim, which has a belt-buckle detail at the collar. This is all layered over a brown cardigan with gold buttons. A brown belt-buckle garter is tied around her upper right arm, over her jacket. Her red pleated skirt, which also has yellow striped trim, matches the rest of the outfit, and there is a black bow above her tail that matches her hair bow. She wears red thigh-highs, held up by brown garters, and brown heeled boots that flare outward at the tops to show off even more yellow trim. Relationships Sakura Chiyono O- Friend and underclassman. EXTRA STAGE- Maruzensky ver. Trivia Her initial character profile and announcement was uploaded on the officialTwitteraccount on February 1, 2017. Her penchant for speaking with old-fashioned slang is due to her real life counterpart being the only playable Umamusume character that raced in the 1970's. As of this point, in terms of real life racing eras, Maruzensky is the oldest playable Umamusume to be added to the game.While there are other Umamusume in the game based on real horses that are older than Maruzensky, such asSaint Lite,HaiseikoandSpeed Symboli, they are all non-playable Umamusume, with Maruzensky acting as somewhat of a stopgap. While there are other Umamusume in the game based on real horses that are older than Maruzensky, such asSaint Lite,HaiseikoandSpeed Symboli, they are all non-playable Umamusume, with Maruzensky acting as somewhat of a stopgap. Her unique skill on her initial trainable unit is named "Red Shift/LP1211-M" (紅焔ギア/LP1211-M), with LP referring to a Lamborghini, and "1211" referencing the time in which her in-real-life counterpart reached the 1,400 meter mark during the 1976 Asahi Hai Sansai Stakes (1:21.1). Maruzensky owns a Lamborghini Countach nicknamed Tata or Ta-chan. Not only is it the sports car that popularized the Italian Wedge, but it was also first produced in 1974, the IRL horse's birth year.In Japan, a person must be 18 to legally acquire a license to own and drive a car. While Umamusume do age differently in comparison to humans, it can be presumed Maruzensky must be equivalent to a human adult to legally own the car. In her Career Mode, there are only five runners in the Spring Stakes, and Maruzensky is always stationed at the furthest gate when she enters the Japanese Derby.The small field in the Spring Stakes references the fact that as the real Maruzensky became more and more successful, owners began withdrawing their horses from races he'd entered because they feared losing to him. One open-class race he entered was nearly canceled.Maruzensky's jockey, Seiichi Nakanowatari, begged for him to be able to run the Derby, saying "I don't care if the horse starts from the furthest outside. We won't interfere [with] the other horses. We don't need the prize money. We just want to see how the horse would do." The JRA upheld their ruling that he was ineligible, because even horses transported in utero from abroad were not allowed to enter the Triple Crown races at the time, but the restriction was later relaxed thanks in part to the discussion surrounding Maruzensky's exclusion. Today's divination: great fortune!" Fortune be with me! This charm-tastic Umamusume loves fortune-telling. A fortune-telling fanatic and lover of the supernatural, she's content to leave the outcomes of races and many other things up to luck. If she's not divining for her own sake, then she's divining for someone else's. She places an immense faith in a revelation from a certain god stating that as long as she keeps running, the way forward will open up before her. The name of the cat shaped bag that she carries is "Miss Nya." Self-IntroGreetings! They call me Matikanefukukitaru! Miss Nya the lucky cat and Daruman the hair tie were gifts from her grandmother. Appearance Matikanefukukitaru has short orange hair that frays out at the ends, and bangs growing past her eyes. Her amber eyes display perpetual starry pupils. This Umamusume's ears are far longer than most, and she has tan inner-ears. Fuku's left ear has aDaruma dollat the base with its left eye painted and white tassels that resembleshidehanging below it. On her right ear, she wears a yellowfour-leaf clovershaped accessory with striped ribbons attached to it. Also on her right ear is a white ear cover with dark blue at the top and a thin red stripe. Her racing outfit consists primarily of a simple white, red, and blue sailor-style school uniform. The collar of her top is blue with white stripes, with abaguamotif on the back, and is tied at the front with a red necktie bearing a yellow knot with white five-point stars. Her top has open shoulders and is decorated with red bows on the sleeves. She wears a blue pleated skirt with white and red stripes around the perimeter. She also wears a belt with threeomamoriand twoemadangling from it, one saying "Great Luck" and the other saying "Assured Victory." On her back is a backpack shaped like a whitemaneki-nekowith a red and green collar. Its left paw is raised while the other holds a largekobanwith the character "福" (Romaji: fuku) inscribed. On her legs, Fuku wears white stockings with alternating red and blue dashes across the top, and sports simple brown loafers on her feet. Relationships Matikanetannhauser- Roommate. Both of them are so noisy that their room is called the "Jump Scare Room", which angersAir Shakur.[1]IRL, Both share the same owner and the same crown name as well having their names modified to fit the 18 letters name limit. They were also stablemates. IRL, Both share the same owner and the same crown name as well having their names modified to fit the 18 letters name limit. They were also stablemates. Silence Suzuka- Friend and rival. Fukukitaru supports Suzuka in her racing career, though she wishes to surpass her. Suzuka doesn't understand her obsession with fortune and the supernatural, but enjoys her companionship. Taiki Shuttle- Friend. Despite Taiki understanding Japanese, Fukukitaru tries to accommodate her by communicating to her in English, albeit poorly. Nonetheless, Taiki is intrigued by her occult interest, and is interested in learning the chants she yells. Meisho Doto- Friend. Fukukitaru tells her fortunes, and Doto believes in her occult ideology. Fukukitaru also gets her good luck charms to protect her. They also run the fortune-telling stall in Tracen together. Stay Gold- Friend. They both enjoy each others' eccentricities. Stay Gold trusts Fukukitaru regarding the supernatural, and she goes to her for a makeshift exorcism in her SSR Guts card.[2]Fukukitaru respects Stay Gold as a friend and rival, and even gets upset when she "ditches" her to run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in Stay Gold's career.[3] Mejiro Dober- Friend. Though not rivals, they get along well, and Dober even tries to help her find things via occult means.[4] Air Groove- Friend. Despite being strict with her, both Groove and Fukukitaru can get along and both of them support Suzuka at her races. Fukukitaru however tends to blurt out things about Groove that embarrass her, like how she was actually intending to watch Suzuka's Tenno Sho (Autumn) in support rather than just for studying Suzuka's racing style. K.S.Miracle- Friend. They train and hang out together from time to time, and Miracle is quite interested in Fukukitaru's love for fortune-telling. Copano Rickey- Friend. With similar interests in fortune and luck, Fukukitaru often seeks Rickey's assistance through feng shui. Media Appearances Season 1 Season 2 Season 3 Umayon Umayuru Starting Gate!
