The hint was "A superstitious Umamusume that loves fortune-telling. When she is overcome with "great fortune", she shows the power to overtake the fleeingSilence Suzuka!" This tweet was a character name prediction quiz, that encouraged fans to try and guess which horse she's named after. The hint was "A superstitious Umamusume that loves fortune-telling. When she is overcome with "great fortune", she shows the power to overtake the fleeingSilence Suzuka!" "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:"Fukukitaru" means "good fortune comes", and her lucky cat backpack, "Nyaa-san", her left daruma hair tie, "Daruman", and her right golden four-leafed clover hair tie are known to be symbols of good luck.Since her real-life counterpart's jockey wore silks that were red with blue stripes, aserafukuwas chosen for her racing outfit, as red and blue is a common color scheme for serafuku.The twoemaaround her waist represent her consecutive victories in the Kobe Shimbun Hai and the Kyoto Shimbun Hai, the preliminary races for the Kikuka Sho. "Fukukitaru" means "good fortune comes", and her lucky cat backpack, "Nyaa-san", her left daruma hair tie, "Daruman", and her right golden four-leafed clover hair tie are known to be symbols of good luck. Since her real-life counterpart's jockey wore silks that were red with blue stripes, aserafukuwas chosen for her racing outfit, as red and blue is a common color scheme for serafuku. The twoemaaround her waist represent her consecutive victories in the Kobe Shimbun Hai and the Kyoto Shimbun Hai, the preliminary races for the Kikuka Sho. Shiraoki, the god she worships, is the name of a real life racehorse who is an ancestor of the real life Matikanefukukitaru. Other horses in Umamusume who are descended from Shiraoki areVodkaandSpecial Week. In the game, due to her being dependent on luck, two of her objectives are randomly selected, with either the Yayoi Sho, Spring Stakes or Mainichi Hai as the second objective and the Hakodate Kinen, Sapporo Kinen or Kokura Kinen as the second to last objective. She performskagura dancesback at her family's home, though she trips and falls every time she does so. Her older sister passed away when she was young.This is a reference to the real life Matikanefukukitaru's older brother, simply named Atheno Tosho 1991 due to never receiving a racing name. This is because he suffered a fatal neck injury as a foal, and he had to be euthanized.[5] This is a reference to the real life Matikanefukukitaru's older brother, simply named Atheno Tosho 1991 due to never receiving a racing name. This is because he suffered a fatal neck injury as a foal, and he had to be euthanized.[5] Despite the real-life counterpart having a marking and a white sock on his right hind leg, this was not incorporated into Matikanefukukitaru's design. This unpolished gem is loved by all. Today's her day! Straightforward and positive-thinking, this model student always gives 110 percent! She has a unique sense for naming things. Appearance Tannhauser has shoulder-length, light brown hair that fades into a darker brown at the ends. Her fluffy medium length hair rests mostly over her shoulders, with two strands of hair curling to the back of her head. On the left side of her bangs are two red hair clips. She has a white strand of hair in the middle of her bangs that is combed to the right. Her ears fade to dark brown at the tips, with her right ear decorated in two large beads, one blue and one red. She has cheery and round, amber-yellow eyes that are dark purple at the top, with a dark purple pupil in the center. She wears a blueish-purple hat that almost resembles a newsboy cap, with a white brim and a white diamond -shaped marking in the center, and attached to the side is a pink ribbon, with two large strands flowing down her body. She has cut a hole in the hat to make way for her right ear. The top part of her racing outfit is a white blouse with ruffles in the center, completed with dark gray buttons. She has a ribbon the same color as her hat attached to the collar. The dress' long sleeves have shoulder cutouts and are adorned with dark blue "X" lacing down the center of her arm. The sleeve puffs out, but is completed with a dark blue cuff with a golden line. On her left wrist, she wears a bracelet with several multicolored wooden charms. On her waist, she wears a de-saturated red corset with brown leather trimming, laced up by dark blue laces. Atop of this is a long brown sleeveless jacket with white straw-like frills decorating the ends. She wears a plain dark blue skirt decorated with light blue flowers and a gold line at the base. The skirt has slits on either side, connected by two "X" laces, revealing the frilled white skirt underneath. Around her waist is a simple, brown, satchel held up by a belt. On both legs she wears red frilled knee-high socks tied with blue ribbons. As for her shoes, they are dark brown boots, tied at the top with blue ribbons, and decorated with tan flaps. The toes of the boots are golden metal. Relationships Nice Nature- Friend and teammate on the anime-only teamTeam Canopus. Appearance Mayano Top Gun has long orange hair that reaches past her lower back. Her sidelocks extend past her chest. The sides of her hair are styled in small pigtails that jut out sideways before curling inwards. Her right ear is adorned by a dark brown cloth ribbon tied in a simple knot. She has large, round eyes that are a deep golden shade. Mayano Top Gun's racing outfit predominantly features a military-green bomber jacket with a dark brown fur collar. The jacket itself is emblazoned with several patches on both sides of the chest, down the length of both arms, and the back. Beneath the jacket, Mayano Top Gun wears a green, white, and yellow crop top that leaves her midriff exposed, and wears a set of military-style dog tags around her neck. She also wears white short shorts with gold accents on the edges, with a dark green strap belt around her waist. Two additional belts run up the inside of her thighs towards the sides of her main belt, giving an appearance similar to a pilot's harness. The sides of her shorts also feature two decorative black-and-yellow striped rings that heavily resemble the ejection handles of an F-14 fighter jet. Her legs are clad with dark brown thigh-high stockings with yellow and white detailing stripes, with the top of both stockings featuring a decorative strap similar to the ones on her shorts. She wears brown boots with yellow and red detailing stripes. Relationships Tokai Teio- Roommate. Mayano tends to tease Teio about her not knowing anything about love, much to Teio's dismay.IRL, both horses were ridden by the jockey Seiki Tabara. IRL, both horses were ridden by the jockey Seiki Tabara. Yukino Bijin- Friend. They hang out and discuss things like shopping. Sometimes, Mayano gets thrown off by Yukino's Iwate accent. Haru Urara- Friend. Occasionally, she helps her out with stamina training. This energetic duo hangs out a lot together, and they do many wild and exciting activities. Anyone that comes with them, usually are put through their "boot camp". Nice Nature- Friend. Nature takes advantage of Mayano's naivete and usually gives her nonsense advice on how to be more mature, like telling her to go to sleep early. And if Mayano ever finds out Nature lies about any of the advice, Nature takes advantage of Mayano's gullibility and flatters her, making her drop the subject. Curren Chan- Friend. They usually go out shopping for trends and fashion, and Mayano comes to Curren for tips on fashion accesories, and Curren even lends Mayano fashion items. Hishi Akebono- Friend. They both go shopping together, and discuss trends. Maruzensky- Friend. They hang out together, and Maruzensky gives advice on how to be an adult, though her advice is a bit dated. Super Creek- Friend. Narita Brian- Rival. Mayano views her as twinkly, and wants to beat her. While Brian finds her annoying, deep down she is interested in Mayano's strength. Mayano also likes to bug Brian from time to time in daily life, as she pesters her to admit that her wedding racewear is cute.In real life, the two of them were both sired by Brian's Time. They were both Horse of the Year, 1994 and 1995 respectively, and raced against each other three times: 1995 Arima Kinen, 1996 Hanshin Daishoten, and 1996 Tenno Sho Spring. Trivia Her initial character profile was uploaded to the officialTwitteraccount on June 22, 2017.This tweet was a character name prediction quiz, that encouraged fans to try and guess which horse she's named after. The hint was "A genius Umamusume who uses a variety of tactics to win races with her ever-changing running style. She has a carefree personality." This tweet was a character name prediction quiz, that encouraged fans to try and guess which horse she's named after. The hint was "A genius Umamusume who uses a variety of tactics to win races with her ever-changing running style. She has a carefree personality." "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:Due to her being named after the movieTop Gun, her jacket is similar to main characterPete "Maverick" Mitchell(Tom Cruise)'s jacket.The tassel on her hip has yellow and green stripes on it, similar to the IRL jockey silks.Furthermore, the strap may have been designed to resemble an "ejection handle" on an aircraft.To represent her energetic and carefree nature, her outfit was designed to be easy to move around in.In 2021, Mayano Top Gun eventually became part of official advertising events for the sequel movieTop Gun: Maverick, with her appearing on posters and her voice actress Mio Hoshitani being invited to the official Japanese premiere of the film, where she met Cruise andJerry Bruckheimer. This is referenced in her Secret Pride in her biography: speaking to a world-class actor.She also sang a cover of the song "Danger Zone," which was featured in the original movie and inMaverick, withGold Ship.She also received a personalized thank you note from the singer of "Danger Zone,"Kenny Loggins. Due to her being named after the movieTop Gun, her jacket is similar to main characterPete "Maverick" Mitchell(Tom Cruise)'s jacket. The tassel on her hip has yellow and green stripes on it, similar to the IRL jockey silks.Furthermore, the strap may have been designed to resemble an "ejection handle" on an aircraft. Furthermore, the strap may have been designed to resemble an "ejection handle" on an aircraft. To represent her energetic and carefree nature, her outfit was designed to be easy to move around in. In 2021, Mayano Top Gun eventually became part of official advertising events for the sequel movieTop Gun: Maverick, with her appearing on posters and her voice actress Mio Hoshitani being invited to the official Japanese premiere of the film, where she met Cruise andJerry Bruckheimer. This is referenced in her Secret Pride in her biography: speaking to a world-class actor. She also sang a cover of the song "Danger Zone," which was featured in the original movie and inMaverick, withGold Ship. She also received a personalized thank you note from the singer of "Danger Zone,"Kenny Loggins. Her jacket's rear center patches originally featured the flags of several countries, but was changed before the game released. In Season 2 of the anime, Mayano Top Gun spends most of the season asleep. This is due to the fact that the real Mayano Top Gun was just foaled during Tokai Teio's career. When Mayano Top Gun was first announced,Ayaka Iwamurawas supposed to be her seiyuu, although this was later changed to the current one, Mio Hoshitani. Ayaka retired from the industry due to health complications at that time, before Mayano Top Gun was properly introduced. In her SSR Power card's artwork, the belt on her shorts say the words "Alp Me Please", which is a reference to her IRL dam's name. While her real life counterpart had a blaze and white socks on his left front and hind legs, this was not adapted in the Umamusume design. Both her and her father like rock music. Appearance Meisho Doto has short brown hair that curls inwards to frame her face. She has a large white patch in the middle of her bangs, as well as a white curled ahoge that zig-zags at the base. Her eyes are purple, with swirled pupils in place of normal pupils. Her ears are often depicted as drooping downwards and she wears a blue cord bow with a good luck knot on her right ear along with a pink headband. Her race outfit is reminiscent of a mail carrier with a collared white top and a blue overall dress. Her top has a ruffled center and a collar with two black stripes right above the bottom edge. The sleeves have lace ruffles that are tied off with a pink ribbon. She wears white gloves with the same lace ruffles that have pink cuffs with a white stripe in the middle. The bow on her collar resembles a wax postage stamp and has a horseshoe imprint.The two ribbons attached to it are red with a vertical yellow stripe. Her messenger bag is brown with gold edge and a pink strap that crosses diagonally across her body. On the center is another bow and a carrot keychain dangles from the right side. Her dress has golden buttons and accents, with a dark stripe along the bottom. The underside of the pleats are red and lace peaks out from under the dress. She wears plain white loafers with pink ribbons and stockings with alternating blue and red carets. Relationships Admire Vega- Friend and rival of the same generation. Doto is very considerate of Ayabe, and looks up to her as a proper rival to Opera O. A role model second only to Opera O. Agnes Digital- Friend.In real life, Agnes Digital would unexpectedly beat Meisho Doto at the 2001 Tenno Sho Autumn. In real life, Agnes Digital would unexpectedly beat Meisho Doto at the 2001 Tenno Sho Autumn. Air Shakur- Roommate. Living with Doto makes life difficult for Shakur, but ultimately the two take good care of each other. Doto's chaotic nature contrasts with Shakur's logic, and in a way gives Shakur hope. Matikanefukukitaru- Close friend. Fukukitaru does fortune-telling for her, and in the anime they run the stall together. Fukukitaru is always there to support Doto. Haru Urara- Friend. Doto really enjoys Urara's company as Urara's positivity always makes her feel better about herself. Narita Top Road- Friend and rival of the same generation. Taiki Shuttle- Friend. Taiki tends to hug Doto out of nowhere, which startles her.In real life, the two retired on the same farms together and were frequently seen together before Taiki Shuttle's passing. Doto also inherited Taiki's blanket and is often seen wearing it during cold days. The two are almost never apart, and Doto is one of the only people Opera O does not refer to with an honorific.In real life, Meisho Doto was T.M. Opera O's rival. She wants to shine bright, no matter how briefly! This well-to-do girl has legs of glass. A sheltered young lady—ephemeral, gentle, and thoughtful. Despite her fragile, "glass" legs putting her at a disadvantage when running, she refuses to let cynicism keep her down. As a child, her frail body kept her from most recreation and social activities, so she finds community life at the academy to be quite the novel experience. Self-IntroA pleasure. I'm Mejiro Ardan. My legs may be fragile, but I want to shine brightly on the track, even if only for a moment. A pleasure. I'm Mejiro Ardan. Appearance Mejiro Ardan has long, light blue hair, styled in loose waves at the end. She wears a crown braid atop her head, and has blunt cut bangs, parted primarily to the right. On her ear, she wears a teal cuff, lined with golden trim, and attached to it is a pleated red ribbon. She has purple down turned eyes, showcasing her gentle demeanor. She wears a black dress, adorned with white ruffles both along the neckline, and down the center of the dress, with a golden horseshoe with a circle in the center where the two pieces intersect. It is held up by two teal ruffled straps. Around her waist is a black sash with gold trim, tied at the center with a small red ribbon. The skirt of Ardan's dress is asymmetrical, the left half sporting a thigh-length black skirt with ruffles at the end, and the right side, a white underskirt with teal ruffles and stripes around the base. Around her tail is a light teal ribbon, cut into a scallop pattern at the ends. Despite the dress exposing her shoulders, her right sleeve is long, with a yellow tassel tied around her upper arm, and has a teal stripe down the center. This sleeve has a white ruffle at the end, along with a black glove underneath. Her left arm is bare, aside from a white glove tied with a thin golden ribbon. Both of her shoes consist of white boots with a black base, and teal ribbon tied up her leg. However, her left shoe is ankle-height, and her right shoe is knee-height. Relationships Sakura Chiyono O- Roommate, rival, and close friend. Chiyono looks out for Ardan due to her health, and Ardan appreciates her kindness. Ardan also cares for Chiyono, and shows empathy when Chiyono gets injured after the Japanese Derby. Yaeno Muteki- Rival and close friend. Despite being rivals, they care deeply for each other. When Yaeno is stuck in a slump, Ardan is often the first one to reach out to her. Both see each other as formidable competition. Ardan, like Chiyono, also lights a fire in Yaeno, even though Ardan has to miss out on races due to her poor health. Because Yaeno does not Ardan nor Chiyono to be overshadowed by Oguri, she vows to defeat Oguri and the other members of the Eternal Big Three; Super Creek and Inari One. Daitaku Helios- Friend. Ardan is confused yet intrigued by Helios' way of speech, and finds it enjoyable. She respects her as a friend of Palmer's, and even gets interested in gyaru speech herself. To Helios' delight, Ardan even says "wei" on occasion due to Helios' influence. Mejiro McQueen,Mejiro Ryan,Mejiro Dober,Mejiro Palmer,Mejiro Bright,Mejiro Ramonu- Family.Ramonu is Ardan's older sister. Ardan wishes to be out of her shadow, and wants to carve herself into history on her own. From time to time, Ramonu helps Ardan out with her hair.Palmer tends to ask Ardan for help on her homework, and Ardan is fond of Palmer's interest in gyaru. Ramonu is Ardan's older sister. Ardan wishes to be out of her shadow, and wants to carve herself into history on her own. From time to time, Ramonu helps Ardan out with her hair. Palmer tends to ask Ardan for help on her homework, and Ardan is fond of Palmer's interest in gyaru. Agnes Tachyon- Friend. They both like drinking tea together. Ardan is also unbothered by the mysterious glow the tea has when they drink together.[1] Super Creek- Friend. They get along well, and Creek refers to her with the "-chan" suffix in a friendly way. She looks out for her, and even helps her with games since Ardan had to miss out on most of them as a child. Katsuragi Ace- Friend. Ardan feels weak in comparison to how Ace can easily keep up with everything. However, Ace encourages Ardan, and tells her that she doesn't have to be exactly like her older sister Ramonu. Maruzensky- Friend. Maruzensky looks out for Ardan sometimes, and notices when she feels down. While Ardan did not appear in the main anime series, she did appear in Cinderella Gray, which is a spin-off. Because she is very used to hospital food, she tends to worry if the food she makes is bland.[2] She likes going to theaters to watch plays. She is not easily scared of scary things, like tests of courage and eerie restaurants.[3] She likes eating konpeito.[4] She enjoys kite flying, as she never got to do it as a child.[5] She is able to make healthy drinks.[6] Her love for going to her favorite Chinese grocery store is a possible reference to how in real life, Mejiro Ardan was transferred to China in October 2000. In her character story, Mejiro Ardan briefly mentions that she had a twin who was stillborn. This is a reference to the real horse, in which he had a twin in the womb, but the foal came out stillborn.[7] The player has the option of either entering Mejiro Ardan into the Kikuka Sho or the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in her classic year. This is because in real life, Mejiro Ardan did not run in other races after the Japanese Derby in 1988 due to a fracture, and made his return in 1989. Besides, I'm not used to getting so much attention..." She wants to change! This Umamusume bears the scars of her past. While cool and reticent, she remains tense in many social situations, especially if men are present. Though she was raised in the prestigious Mejiro household, where visitors are never rare, she has nonetheless led a very sheltered life. Perhaps because of this, she can come off cold to strangers, but those who take time to talk to her realize that she is not quite as uptight as she first seems.[1] Self-IntroYes, hello. I'm Mejiro Dober. I... plan to race in a way worthy of the Mejiro name. Yes, hello. I'm Mejiro Dober. I... plan to race in a way worthy of the Mejiro name. Her piano skills are on par with a kindergarten teacher. Her piano skills are on par with a kindergarten teacher. Appearance Mejiro Dober has very neat and tidy burgundy-violet hair that is grown just past her back. A single teal hair clip pins her bangs to the left side of her hair. On her left ear, she wears an assortment of various teal ribbons, some with white accents, some with gold, and a bundle of de-saturated blue ribbons contrasts the bunch on the back. She has light lilac eyes. For her race outfit, she wears a simple short sleeve white frilled blouse, with a teal ribbon tied at the collar. Around her waist she wears a brown belt with gold accents, with multiple belt sections coming off the sides. Her thigh-length skirt is teal, and has white frills around the hem, and has a white and teal bow over her tail. Layered underneath this is another skirt with dark teal fabric and gold accents, also decorated by frilled white fabric. She wears white socks with teal stripes on both legs. Her shoes are short heeled boots with teal accents, black heels, and a white ribbon tied in the center. Relationships Taiki Shuttle- Friend and roommate. Taiki sometimes overwhelms Dober, but they both care for each other as friends. Taiki also asks Dober for help on her homework sometimes.[2][3] Mejiro McQueen,Mejiro Ryan,Mejiro Palmer,Mejiro Ardan,Mejiro Bright,Mejiro Ramonu- Family.Dober looks up to Ryan, and Ryan treats her well alongside Bright.IRL, Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright are both sired by Mejiro Ryan. Dober looks up to Ryan, and Ryan treats her well alongside Bright.IRL, Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright are both sired by Mejiro Ryan. IRL, Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright are both sired by Mejiro Ryan. Seeking the Pearl- Friend. Pearl considers her a part of her "racing family", alongside Bright. Matikanefukukitaru- Friend. Though not rivals, they get along well, and Dober even tries to help her find things via occult means.[4] Kawakami Princess- Friend. Kawakami inspires her to be the best version of herself[5]and stands up for Dober.[6] Air Groove- Upperclassman and rival. Dober sees Air Groove as an ideal she should strive towards, she looks up to her. However, the need to emulate Air Groove, as well as the other Umamusume she admires, ends up consuming her to the point where she is unable to succeed on her own terms. Recognizing this issue eventually has her look to Air Groove not as an ideal, but as a rival and an equal. Rulership- Friend. They both train together on occasion, and they both admire Air Groove. However, Dober gets exasperated by Rulership's behavior, and dislikes how lazy she can be.IRL, Mejiro Dober has conceived two foals from Rulership; Ho O Dream in 2014 and Pinscher in 2016. Trivia Her initial character profile was uploaded to the officialTwitteraccount on June 22, 2017.This tweet was a character name prediction quiz, that encouraged fans to try and guess which horse she's named after. The hint was "Although she is insecure about her masculine name, she is a beautiful Umamusume with a very girly appearance. She hates men to the extreme." This tweet was a character name prediction quiz, that encouraged fans to try and guess which horse she's named after. The hint was "Although she is insecure about her masculine name, she is a beautiful Umamusume with a very girly appearance. She hates men to the extreme." In chapter 6 of her character story, she mentions having a much younger sister and brother. These refer to her two full siblings in real life, Mejiro Jones (younger sister) and Mejiro Corsair (younger brother). IRL, Mejiro Jones was born 5 years after Dober, while Mejiro Corsair was born 8 years after.[7] As her name was based on the Doberman dog breed, her ears were designed to look like a Doberman post-ear cropping. Due to all Umamusume being female, regardless of their sexes in real life, Dober's fears are only limited to the crowd. Although, she sometimes feel some slight discomfort when talking to a few Umamusume. The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady. Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate. Self-IntroI am Mejiro McQueen. I shall surely fulfill my family's ambition to claim the Tenno Sho crown. I am Mejiro McQueen. I shall surely fulfill my family's ambition to claim the Tenno Sho crown. Appearance McQueen has lavender hair that has grown to her upper back, it is parted to her left, with two long side-bangs resting on her shoulders. Her pointed ears are pink on the inside, with dark brown tips, and she wears a simple teal bow on her right ear. Her pointed eyes have purple irises, with a white pupil in the center. Her elegant race outfit consists of a black coat, with the bottom flaring out to her sides. It is adorned with golden buttons and trim, with large black cuffs. Underneath the cuffs are white frills. Her white bodice is frilled, with a teal ribbon holding it together. Underneath the coat, she wears a large, fluffy petticoat with the front cut out. She wears a teal and white striped undershirt, with a pleated black skirt. She wears teal knee-high socks with a white stripe at the top, and black boots adorned with gold trimming, tied by white laces. Relationships Tokai Teio- Friend and rival. The two are also teammates on the anime-only team,Team Spica. McQueen’s relationship with Teio is the central emotional and competitive focus ofseason 2. Though they are close friends and teammates within Team Spica, their bond is shaped by a fierce rivalry. Their relationship reached its competitive peak during the Spring Tenno Sho, where Teio sought to maintain her undefeated streak while McQueen aimed to defend her title. McQueen's victory in that race saw Teio defeated for the first time, earning Teio's respect. Despite their rivalry, McQueen harbors deep affection and concern for Teio. In their everyday interactions, McQueen often acts as the "straight man" to Teio’s impulsive and energetic antics.IRL, Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio only faced each other once, that being the 1992 Tenno Sho (Spring). A combination commonly known as "Stema Combination". Dream Journey- Friend. McQueen watches over Dream Journey from her debut race, having been asked by Stay Gold to support her. Gold Ship- Friend. The two are teammates on both the anime-only team,Team Spica, and the game-only team,Team Sirius. Gold Ship calls McQueen "Big Mac" and "Mac-Chan". Gold Ship loves pulling pranks on her often, often singling McQueen out. McQueen, who prides herself on the dignity of the Mejiro family, usually reacts with exasperation and/or scolding. Despite the frequent squabbles, they are close friends. Gold Ship is often one of the first to notice when McQueen is upset and cheers her up or distract her from her worries in her ownuniqueway. Well hey, I'm here if you need me." Let's have a good time! This Umamusume is upbeat and always there for friends. A young lady from the renowned Mejiro family, though you might not guess it from her casual, friendly attitude. She's quite a socialite and notices even little changes in the people around her, but having such talented relatives caused her to develop a bit of an inferiority complex. Eventually, she found a way to handle those feelings—run, run, and run some more, smiling all the way. As long as she keeps running ahead, she'll one day forge her own destiny. Her initial trainable unit's unique animation in the mobile game features her running through an obstacle course that bears some resemblance to the ones featured in the competitive multiplayer platformerFall Guys. Her skill at golfing is a reference to the famous American golfer,Arnold Palmer, which is also the origin behind her name.In her Fan Fest event, she finds she has a fan club called "Palmie's Army" in reference to "Arnie's Army", so named because it began from soldiers at Camp Gordon (now Fort Gordon) just southwest of Augusta, Georgia who became fans of Arnold Palmer beginning at the 1959 Masters. In her Fan Fest event, she finds she has a fan club called "Palmie's Army" in reference to "Arnie's Army", so named because it began from soldiers at Camp Gordon (now Fort Gordon) just southwest of Augusta, Georgia who became fans of Arnold Palmer beginning at the 1959 Masters. In the anime, Mejiro Palmer's running form is straight up instead of leaning forward like most Umamusume, which is a reference to her in-real-life counterpart running in the same way.This is due to his steeplechase training, in which a higher head position is preferred compared to flat racing due to steeplechase races having much longer distances, thus requiring more stamina than flat racing. He never lost the habit after switching back to flat racing.This also reflects in her unique animation where she jumps through an obstacle only to fail it, referencing the real horse's failed career in steeplechase races. Her inability to do well in steeplechase races was briefly mentioned by Tokai Teio while she was gathering intel of her opponents in the 11th episode of Season 2. Appearance Mejiro Ramonu has black hair with a white streak, styled into an elaborate half-updo, her bun wrapped in various layers of braids with the rest of her wavy hair falling down either side of her face. Her left ear has a ribbon which has a white and teal band around it, a teal ribbon held by a golden ring protrudes from it. She has down-turned narrow eyes, that are a beautiful light gray color, with a mole underneath her right eye. Ramonu's simple but elegant race outfit is telling of her personality. She wears a white top with a deep V-neck, and underneath that, a black tank-top. The sleeves of her shirt are teal, with a white stripe down the center. On her right arm, she wears a black arm band featuring a gold crest with a black bracelet on her wrist, and on her left arm, a white glove with elaborate lacing. Around her waist is a black belt with a teal outline. She wears a black form-fitting skirt with the back half of the skirt flaring out longer than the front, which reaches down to her thighs, and two rows of silver buttons down the center, and at the base of the skirt is a row of simple ruffles. On her right leg, she wears a black lacy thigh-high sock held up by a garter strap. Her shoes are a plain pair of heels, the left white, while the right is black. Relationships Symboli Kris S- Friend and roommate. Kris S finds her speech easier to understand compared to other Umamusume, which she likes. Symboli Rudolf- Childhood friend and rival. When they were children, Ramonu nicknamed her "Loulou" and believed Rudolf was a perfect, flawless moon. Ramonu seeks the ultimate race, and knows Rudolf can give her that through her overwhelming running. She continually pushes for Rudolf to race with her, to Rudolf's dismay. Because Rudolf has taken on the duty of the Emperor, she believes she must only work on her goal of happiness for all Umamusume rather than running. For her own ideals, Rudolf tries to conceal her true self. Ramonu dislikes her Emperor persona and wants her to come back to the turf as her old self rather than as the Emperor. Ramonu says getting Rudolf to move is as easy as turning on a faucet. Ramonu also dislikes the flowery language Rudolf uses.IRL, Symboli Rudolf and Mejiro Ramonu were bred together and had a foal named Mejiro Rivera, whom was titled the "Ten-Crown Foal" due to the combined G1 wins her parents had. Though Mejiro Rivera only raced in her maiden race, lost and never raced furthermore. IRL, Symboli Rudolf and Mejiro Ramonu were bred together and had a foal named Mejiro Rivera, whom was titled the "Ten-Crown Foal" due to the combined G1 wins her parents had. Though Mejiro Rivera only raced in her maiden race, lost and never raced furthermore. Sirius Symboli- Childhood friend and rival. Ramonu gets along well with Sirius and the two of them understand each other. Both of them dislike the idea of running for history or other people and prefer to run for their own brilliance and love. Ramonu enjoys running with Sirius and considers it a simulating experience. Sirius has also escorted Ramonu to get French cuisine. Mejiro Ardan- Younger sister. Ardan wishes to be out of Ramonu's shadow, and wants to carve herself into history through her own merits. From time to time, Ramonu helps Ardan out with her hair. The two of them understand each other well, since they were both unable to run as children and had to stay inside. Ramonu still considers Ardan to be a child and finds her cute. Mejiro McQueen,Mejiro Ryan,Mejiro Dober,Mejiro Bright,Mejiro Palmer- Family. Still in Love- Rival and underclassman. As Ramonu was the first one to win the Triple Tiara, Still feels very envious of her. What doesn't help her is that in her career story, Still's trainer particularly admires Ramonu and finds her dazzling. When Ramonu begins to tease Still and say that she will "steal" her trainer away from her, Still gets angered and pursues the Triple Tiara because of her influence. As a racer in the Tiara route, Still wants to surpass Ramonu. Mr. C.B.- Friend and rival. Ramonu considers C.B. to be contradictory, believing she is tightly bound yet also carefree and free-spirited. She's fond of C.B.'s honest passion for racing. Ramonu admires C.B.'s fierce aura while running and says her running was unlike anything she felt before. Ramonu wishes to race with a Triple Crown Umamusume like Rudolf in order to create the ultimate race, and C.B. perfectly fulfills her desire for a Triple Crown Umamusume to race with her. Tanino Gimlet- Friend. Though Ramonu thinks Gimlet sounds self-conceited, she thinks that Gimlet is very honest to the point of sounding foolish, which she likes. She finds Gimlet to be interesting.IRL, Tanino Gimlet and Mejiro Ramonu had a foal together named Mejiro Rastaban. IRL, Tanino Gimlet and Mejiro Ramonu had a foal together named Mejiro Rastaban. Speed Symboli- Friend. Sometimes Speed and Ramonu would have late night chats with each other. Maruzensky- Friend. Maruzensky is completely unbothered by Ramonu's standoffish behavior, and views her as a good friend of hers. Katsuragi Ace- Friend and classmate. Ace is used to Ramonu's habits. Although born into the prestigious Mejiro family, her animated personality somewhat betrays that fact. She has something of an inferiority complex surrounding her childhood friend,Mejiro McQueen, and wishes to be as fast and pretty as her. Though physically strong, her heart is rather delicate. Appearance Mejiro Ryan's design depicts the vibe of someone who is sporty and practical. Spiky short brown hair that flows down with a white tuft that stands out at the center. She has uneven bangs that frame her face and her right ear is adorned with a metallic piece matching her color scheme and two piercings to boot. For her racewear, Mejiro Ryan wears a cropped jacket, mixed with white and teal stripes, rolled up sleeves, and on one wrist she wears a golden bracelet and on the other a black bracelet with metal studs. Beneath her jacket is a striped tied up shirt with the name "Ryan" on it. She wears high waisted black shorts that seem to be tied down by a unique looking belt. Both sides of her upper thighs seem to be wrapped by a brown belt with gold trims, and she wears practical and plain looking white racing boots. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:Her jacket is white with teal stripes, in reference to the real horse's jockey silks. However, as with all of the Mejiro horses, the original green has been changed to teal.Since she is named after the Major League Baseball playerNolan Ryan, she wears a shirt that resembles a baseball player's uniform.Her real-life counterpart had white markings on both his front and back hooves, which is why she wears both white boots and white gloves. Her jacket is white with teal stripes, in reference to the real horse's jockey silks. However, as with all of the Mejiro horses, the original green has been changed to teal. Since she is named after the Major League Baseball playerNolan Ryan, she wears a shirt that resembles a baseball player's uniform. Her real-life counterpart had white markings on both his front and back hooves, which is why she wears both white boots and white gloves. Ryan's belt in her racing outfit is also present in Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright's outfits, reinforcing their IRL counterparts as Ryan's children. Her real-life counterpart was known to have a very short mane as to prevent rashes, which is why she has short hair. The short mane has been described as a unique charm point which was very popular with the fans. It even has its own nickname, ライアンカット (Ryan Cut).[1] Ryan's athletic personality comes from her real-life counterpart being more muscular than most other horses. Ryan was in the first season of the anime, and raced in the Autumn Tenno Sho where Silence Suzuka broke her leg. However, the real life Ryan retired years before Suzuka's debut, the inclusion was meant to be a stand in for Mejiro Bright (who actually raced in the same Tenno Sho), who wasn't introduced as an Umamusume yet. Ryan is the only Mejiro member to be a 1-star unit initially, while all the other Mejiro members were 3-star units. In her career mode, following the Senior Year Arima Kinen, a "Gentleman with a Beret" is noted as being particularly ecstatic about Ryan's victory. This NPC is likely based on horse racing critic Keijiro Okawa, nicknamed "the God of Horse Racing" for achieving four perfect predictions. He is best known for shouting Ryan's name during the 1990 Arima Kinen, as the horse faced off against Oguri Cap on the final straight. Commencing Operation: Triple Crown." Always follows commands! The cyborg Umamusume. An Umamusume also known as the "Cyborg". She views the world through the lens of programming and databases, carrying out her objectives in an expressionless and robotic manner. Even so, she is not an emotionless machine—her constant training since her youth has simply resulted in less interactions with people, leading to her current personality. Underneath that robotic shell, she does indeed have feelings.[1] Self-IntroMy name is Mihono Bourbon. My objective is to win the Triple Crown. Those who have experienced her piggyback rides say her back is comfortingly spacious. Appearance Mihono Bourbon's hair is a de-saturated pink color that reaches to the end of her back. Both her bangs and the rest of her hair appear to be voluminous, and she has a large ahoge coming from the top of her head. On the top of her head she wears a silver headband, with a futuristic antenna-like decoration composed of two diamonds coming from the left side of her head. On her right ear, she wears a singular light blue glowing ring. She has blue eyes with a light blue ring around her pupils. Her race outfit is as futuristic as they come. She wears a white leotard and a light gray miniskirt with several high tech accessories. Around her neck is a metal collar, and at the end of this is a glowing pink tie with a yellow circle at the top. On her arms are two gray compression sleeves. At the top of her sleeves are two glowing rings, one pink, and one blue, and at the end are gray metal cuffs. Around her tail she has two pink and black floating rings. Her skirt has two speaker-like apparatuses on either side, with metal protrusions coming out from the front. On her legs she wears white thigh-high socks with a gray stripe at the base. Her shoes are made completely of metal and have a pink glowing stripe in the center. Coming off of both of her shoes are two metal wing-like plates. Race uniform design notes fromUmamusume Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.02:The mecha-oriented design is inspired by Bourbon's "cyborg" nickname, given to him by the horse's stable for his steady running style.Jockey silk colors featuring pink with yellow circles inspire a design where yellow circles are found on Bourbon's chest and feet.Silver hair ornaments are meant to reference IRL Bourbon's white leather bridle, specifically the headpiece and cheek piece. The mecha-oriented design is inspired by Bourbon's "cyborg" nickname, given to him by the horse's stable for his steady running style. Jockey silk colors featuring pink with yellow circles inspire a design where yellow circles are found on Bourbon's chest and feet. Silver hair ornaments are meant to reference IRL Bourbon's white leather bridle, specifically the headpiece and cheek piece. Her trainable unit's name "MB-19890425" may be interpreted as "MihonoBourbon, 1989/04/25". The date is the day Bourbon was foaled (born).[2] She owns a pet bunny. While she calls the trainer "Master" in the Japanese version, she calls them "Trainer" in the global version, though "Master" is still heard in her voice lines. This also extends to her Valentine's alternate costume animation, where the chocolate she holds says "Trainer", but it was originally "Master" in the Japanese version. It's light, clear, and... like an unfettering tailwind. ―I'm Mr. C.B.. Pleased to meet you." Bound by nothing! A cheerful and flawless Umamusume. A Umamusume who loves the free world of racing. The unbounded ambiance she exudes gives her a mysterious charm. At first glance, she appears to be free-spirited, but it's because she's stubborn and refuses to do anything she doesn't agree with. Surprisingly, she may be a bit clumsier than most other Umamusume. Self-IntroThere's a wind you'll only find while racing. It's a gentle tailwind, calm and true to itself. Enjoy it to the fullest. SecretsShe's not great with elevators. She's not great with elevators. She loves kabuki theater and goes to see it often. She loves kabuki theater and goes to see it often. The third Umamusume to win the Triple Crown throughout history. A talented girl with a cheerful personality that exudes a mysterious charisma. She loves the freedom of the racing world, and tends to run in wild and unconventional races.[1] Appearance Mr. C.B.'s hair reflects the dichotomy of her character—wild yet elegant. It flows gracefully down her back while her bangs and locks jut out in wild, spiky strands. She has graceful blue eyes, an unruly ahoge up top and three hair clips securing her hair. Lastly, a small but stylish white "CB" hat adorned with a green ribbon sits near her right ear. Mr. C.B.'s outfit is a bold and incredibly stylish callback to retro fashion. She wears a striking green and yellow bustier, paired with an off-the-shoulder jacket that features an asymmetrical design—one sleeve missing while a single green sleeve with a buckle wrap hangs elegantly from her left arm. A subtle gold choker is also present wrapping her neck. Her pants are high-waisted and flared with floating straps hanging, a very stand out and eye-catching appeal. A big belt hangs on her waist, which features a comically large gold emblem at the center, complemented by smaller golden details along its band. To complete her ensemble, she wears high-heeled Mary Janes. As the oldest Triple Crown recipient inUmamusume, Mr. C.B.’s outfit feels like a loving homage to the popular fashions of the early-to-mid 1900s. Relationships Katsuragi Ace- Friend/Rival. They both get along and understand each other very well. Ace is one of the very few umamusume who isn't scared to run with C.B., and goes as far as challenging C.B. into Triple Classics duel, resulting in C.B. thinking that Ace is very fun and interesting to race against. Ace never restricted any of C.B.'s unconventional and carefree ways when it comes to running as she values C.B.'s freedom deeply, which can be seen in her defending C.B. when some people are pushing their expectations on C.B. to win the Triple Crown. While C.B. genuinely thinks of Ace as a rival on the get-go, Ace struggled to see C.B. as an equal at first, as she initially thought of C.B. as her role model. This resulted in disappointed and upset C.B., who dislikes that Ace saw her as a wall to overcome rather than seeing her as Mr. C.B. After a confrontation during their Classic Year, they're finally able to see each other on the same level as rivals and equals.IRL: Being in the same 1983 generation, the two raced against each other several times in real life. The role they had on each other's racing career was very significant, and this can be seen on how Mr. C.B.'s name is written on the epitaph of real life Katsuragi Ace's gravestone, which reads:"I remembered your performance at that Japan Cup. I was moved by what you did in that Japan Cup. I wish to see you race against Mr. C.B. again."[2]The said epitaph sentence was also referenced in the happy ending of Katsuragi Ace's career story. Rudolf's composure tends to break when around C.B. due to her being so free-spirited, but they respect each other as rivals.IRL: They raced against each other a few times all while bearing the triple crown title, with Mr C.B. holding the 1983 Triple Crown and Symboli Rudolf the 1984 Triple Crown. Mejiro Ramonu- Friend. Ramonu admires how free-spirited C.B. is, and respects how fierce she runs on the track. She also likes how passionate C.B. is about racing, and she ignites a fire in Ramonu as she wishes to compete with a Triple Crown Umamusume in a race. Sakura Chiyono O- Friend and underclassman. Mr. C.B. looks out for Chiyono as she admires Maruzensky. She also warns Chiyono that Maruzensky's life isn't as ideal as she thinks, and that she should truly think over how much she idolizes her. Maruzensky- Friend and classmate. They hang out together, and C.B. is one of the few people to notice the sadness Maruzensky feels over not getting to compete in the classic races. In her career story's introduction event, the trainer remembers a certain Umamusume before C.B.'s time that not only won 15 times in 19 races, but won the Triple Crown as well. This Umamusume is a reference to the real life horse Shinzan, who became the second Japanese Triple Crown winner in 1964. Her parents eloping is a reference to how her dam and sire in real life were not supposed to mate at the time due to club rules. Her love for rain is a reference to how in real life, Mr. C.B. won the Triple Crown in unfavorable conditions, such as rain. In herSSR Speed Card, she is holding a book that looks similar to the book "Ware ni Gogatsu o" ("May for Me" in English) written by Shuji Terayama. The book opens up with the line "Twenty years old", while both Mr. C.B. and Katsuragi Ace passed away at twenty years old in 2000. Though she lives alone in Umamusume, Mr. C.B. was actually trained at Miho Training Center in real life. She used to lack drive, but under the guidance of her elementary school mentor, she discovered the adrenaline-pumping thrill of racing. The hint was "An Umamusume with a fierce fighting spirit and passion in her heart. She dreams of making her beloved violets bloom in France together with her trainer." Nakayama’s hobby of growing violets is most likely a reference to their team name during the 2010 Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe, Sumire (Violets).The name of the team is also a reference to the song "When the Violets Bloom", as that was the favorite song of Nakayama’s previous owner.That team name was chosen because violets symbolize modesty and sincerity, and also bloom in places where most people may overlook them. Get out of my way, or get torn apart." Actions speak louder than words! A tough and stubborn lone wolf. A lone wolf of few words and ample strength, Narita Brian is feared throughout the academy due to both her personality and her performance on the turf. She herself has little interest in anything besides running, which she does only to quench her own endless thirst. Off the racecourse, she is Biwa Hayahide's little sister and, for some reason, a student council vice president. Self-IntroI'm Narita Brian. I'm here to run circles around my opponents, not chit-chat. That's it. I'm Narita Brian. I'm here to run circles around my opponents, not chit-chat. That's it. She occasionally likes to visit owl cafes. A Strait-Laced, Stubborn Lone Wolf.... And Such A Girl's Favorite Thing Is Her Stuffed Animals. Appearance Narita Brian has long, dark gray hair with a purple tint, styled into a ponytail, cut bluntly at the end, tied in an orange and white rope. She has two long strands of hair growing past her chest, and her bangs appear to be windswept. She wears a white and baby blue rope accessory on her right ear, and a simple white bandage on her nose. Her sharp and determined eyes are yellow. She can often be seen with a green beanstalk in her mouth. As for her racing outfit, her chest is wrapped in bandages, layered under a cream-colored top, with a magenta collar. The top and bottom of this crop-top is decorated by orange and white ropes, and a yellow star is attached to the left side of her chest. She wears a black pleated skirt with pink and white plaid, held up by a dark brown belt with silver trim. Atop of this ensemble is a long white jacket with a purple tint. It appears torn at the ends. Around the jacket's tall collar is a white shadow-roll, with orange epaulets on either side, decorated with the same orange and white rope. The cuffs of the jacket are magenta with an orange trim on the outside. She wears metal cuffs around either wrist, and magenta and black fingerless gloves. On her right leg, she wears more bandaging, decorated with orange and white rope. Her striking asymmetrical leg-wear sticks out among all else. On her left leg, she wears a dark gray thigh-high boot, with a giant metal cuff, and a giant dark gray horse shoe emblem in the center, decorated with brown belts. On her right leg is a simple, dark gray, short boot, with magenta flaps and brown trimming. Around both of her ankles are ginormous metal horseshoes, decorated with bolts. The toes of her boots are also pure metal, with short matching metal heels. Relationships Biwa Hayahide- Older sister. Despite her taciturn nature, Brian cares and respects Hayahide greatly, and looks forward to racing her, though can be irritated by her older sister's inquisitiveness.In real life, the two of them are actual half brothers from the same mother, and were planned to race against each other in the Arima Kinen before Hayahide retired due to tendinitis during the Tenno Sho Autumn, leaving the showdown forever unrealized. When Brian watched No Reason win the Satsuki Sho, it reminded her of her own Satsuki Sho win back then. Mayano Top Gun- Rival.  Mayano views her as twinkly, and wants to beat her. While Brian finds her annoying, deep down she is interested in Mayano's strength. On December 1st, 2020, her current voice actress,Rika Kinugawa, took over the role fromYuka Aisakadue to the latter taking a break from activities.[1] Despite having a blaze in real life, this was not adapted in her Umamusume design. The bandage on her nose alongside the white collar on her racewear is a reference to how in real life, Narita Brian had to wear a shadow-roll when he was active. While Narita Brian is shown to hate vegetables in Umamusume, the real horse liked a variety of vegetables. The nickname that Samson Big calls her-"Buu-chan"-is based on how Narita Brian's IRL stablehands referred to him as "Buu".[2] Student Introduction ContinueDismiss ContinueDismiss ContinueDismiss ContinueDismiss External Links Narita Brian official English Introduction ↑Oricon News ↑https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ナリタブライアン#cite_note-162 Characters Main Characters Umamusume Characters Ritto Dorm Pages using Tabber parser tag Navigation menu Create account Log in Page Discussion Read View source View history Main page Recent changes Random page Random Umamusume Contributing List of Characters List of Albums List of Live Events List of Media List of Merchandise New Player Guide List of Skills List of Trainees List of Support Cards List of Scouts (EN) List of Scouts (JP) What links here Related changes Printable version Permanent link Page information Cargo data Cite this page This page was last edited on 19 September 2026, at 18:41. Appearance Narita Taishin has wavy brown hair that reaches to the back of her neck, styled in a slightly messy way that leaves several strands curling outwards, with a singular bang hanging down between her eyes. Her long ears are the same shade of brown as her hair, and have fluffier sections near the bottom edges. She wears a folded yellow bandana with a dark stripe pattern on her right ear, with a silver-and-blue circular ornament pinned to it. Her sharp eyes are a dark blue that fades to a lighter shade at the bottom. Her racing outfit prominently features a hot pink bomber jacket with a white fluffy collar, with the collar's ends transitioning into long white tassels. The hot pink, patterned with darker pink zig-zag stripes, is complemented by yellow ribbons and insignias that run up the length of the arms, and has darker sections at the lower front where the jacket's pockets are. She wears a small handful of pin buttons on the right pocket section. Her jacket is worn over a sleeveless yellow top with the same color and pattern as her ear ornament, and is tied off at her left side to expose her midriff. Narita Taishin also wears a dark metallic horseshoe ornament around her neck. A red-checkered flannel long-sleeve shirt is tied around her waist, which goes over her form-fitting jeans (the likes of which have been customized to have the right leg cut short completely, and the left knee stylistically torn to expose her knee). In other words, I'm in your hands." A little mysterious? Scratch that. Very mysterious? An out-of-this-world Umamusume. A diligent Umamusume with a clear mind. The only problem is, she can't communicate normally. She's clever to a fault, sometimes acting in ways and saying things that are hard to understand. Appearance Neo Universe has long and wavy blonde hair that almost appears to be floating, with a light blue underdye. Two strands of hair frame her face, the left strand longer than the right. On either side of her head she has two strands of wavy hair, levitated above the rest. She has bangs parted to her left, and a small blue star-shaped blaze, as well as an S-shaped ahoge on the top of her head. She has yellow ears with bright blue insides, and her blonde tail fades into light blue at the end. On either ear she has white, rounded diamond shaped charms with blue gems in the center. On her right ear is a star shaped charm dangling off of her ear. Her blue, half-lidded eyes often seem spaced out. Neo Universe wears a large white jacket with blue and yellow accents as her race outfit. The jacket has an upturned V-shaped collar with a blue lining. The right side of her jacket is yellow at the upper torso, and has a circular, silver button with her name printed on it as well three long black straps that dangle off her jacket. The jacket has a pocket to the left near the waistline with a shorter black strap hanging off it. Underneath her jacket, she wears a white bodysuit with a triangle-shaped cutout at the neckline and a black tube top. Her shoes are white ankle boots that have fluffy collars connected by black straps in the center. The soles of her boots are deep blue, with a yellow rim, and a yellow strap on the top. She is shown to be supportive towards Still in Love, often offering her advice and hearing her out. Sometimes, they stargaze and observe the night sky together. Zenno Rob Roy- Close friend. Rob Roy was one of the first people who went out of her way to understand Universe's strange mannerisms, they both share interest in books, and Rob Roy often recommends Uni books about space. She has two reddish-brown cowlicks on the center of her bangs, swooping to the right, one is larger than the other. Her ears have two red covers with green knots laced to the top, and her right cover has a green bow at the base. Her eyes are light brown. Her racing outfit is a layered dress, the base is black with four golden buttons on her waist. Around her neck is a large red and green bow, with a golden medallion in the center. Her short dress has a red fluffy petticoat underneath. Her long sleeves are cream-colored with green and red bands wrapped around her wrist, and the end of the sleeve is made of a spiky white fabric. On her left leg is a red X-shaped leg strap with metallic silver clamps holding the fabric together, it continues to her lower leg, and holds up her left sock. She wears a pair of brown knee-high laced-up boots, with red socks underneath. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:Her race outfit design was made to be both calm and chic, attempting to showcase both the girly and mature mentality of her character.Her ribbon is inspired by the hood of her real-life counterpart with the same pattern, with the N.N. initials on the end standing for Nice Nature.The thigh belt she wears represents the injury her real-life counterpart faced. In the Umamusume universe, several girls wear belts on their legs in hopes that it will prevent them from becoming injured when running. Her ribbon is inspired by the hood of her real-life counterpart with the same pattern, with the N.N. initials on the end standing for Nice Nature. The thigh belt she wears represents the injury her real-life counterpart faced. In the Umamusume universe, several girls wear belts on their legs in hopes that it will prevent them from becoming injured when running. In her initial setting she was "looking for a rich and handsome boyfriend," which is slightly referenced inSeason 1of the anime.[1] She is one of the few Umamusume who thinksSymboli Rudolf's jokes are funny. She is nicknamed "Bronze Collector" due to her in-real-life counterpart finishing third in the Arima Kinen for three consecutive years, and the game makes multiple references to this.Her unique skill requires her to be in third place towards the end of the race to activate.She gets her epithet if she achieves third place in three G1 races.There is a secret event for her placing third in any non objective race.When the results are confirmed after a race, she waves at the stands while jogging if she placed third. This animation typically only plays if the Umamusume wins the race.She has a history of getting third place prizes in various events, such as the New Year's raffle where she has the title of "Third-Prize Collector". Her unique skill requires her to be in third place towards the end of the race to activate. She gets her epithet if she achieves third place in three G1 races. There is a secret event for her placing third in any non objective race. When the results are confirmed after a race, she waves at the stands while jogging if she placed third. This animation typically only plays if the Umamusume wins the race. She has a history of getting third place prizes in various events, such as the New Year's raffle where she has the title of "Third-Prize Collector". In the game, she is a singer forHonnou SpeedandNEXT FRONTIERdespite her real-life counterpart having never achieved a G1 win. This is due to the real horse having won the 1995 Takamatsunomiya Hai, a 2,000 meter G2 race that became a 1,200 meter G1 sprint in 1996 and currently known as the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, and taking part in the Arima Kinen 5 times respectively. Her mother raised her on her own. She snacks at midnight. She has a little brother. Appearance Flower has dark purple hair in a simple bob with blunt bangs. She wears magenta ear covers, and white and pink ribbons attached to her left leg. She wears a pink headband and has "X" hair clips on either side of her hair. She has round purple eyes. Her race outfit is a short sleeved dress with a poofy skirt. The white top of her dress is frilled at both the sleeves and collar. On her chest is a large pink and yellow striped ribbon, with a large pink flower in the center. The center of her dress is white with yellow sides, yellow buttons, and purple trim. Her poofy skirt has white and yellow fabric, cut to resemble the petals of a flower. The ends of the flower petals each have a flower design on the tips. Underneath the flower petals is a yellow and purple layered petticoat, with a large white petticoat underneath. She wears pink cuffs around her wrists with white frills on either side. Her yellow boots have one white stripe down the center, and light purple heels. The top cuffs of her boots are red, and have a purple and yellow ribbon with a white flower in the center. Relationships Seiun Sky- Close friend. She is mostly seen hanging out with Seiun Sky and is very close to her. Seiun Sky looks out for her, and usually doesn't pull pranks on Flower due to her being so nice. Sometimes, she invites Flower to nap with her outside. Despite Seiun Sky's antics, Flower sees the good in Sky, and admires her for being herself.In real life, both Flower and Seiun are from the same stable and owned by Masayuki Nishiyama. Sweep also ropes Flower alongside her other classmates into "magical" hijinks on occasion. Super Creek- Friend. Creek tends to look after Flower often, and has done so ever since Flower came to the academy, especially when Flower struggles with problems. Tosen Jordan- Friend. Eishin Flash- Friend. Flower may find Bakushin O's silly and unpredictable behavior hard to keep up with at times, but she gets along with her relatively well. The hint was "A (little girl?) prodigy who is unmatched when running short distances. She is an honest, cheerful, hardworking, and very kind girl." At 135 cm, Nishino Flower is the smallest Umamusume up to date. Her mother is bad at cooking, and Nishino Flower tends to help her out with cooking at home.[4] She is scared of ghosts at night.[5] Unlike the majority of the other careers in the game, when Quick Mode is used on Nishino Flower's trainee scenarios, instead of the player, Nishino Flower will narrate her own career from her perspective. What sets her apart from other Umamusume, though, is her grand dream: she wishes to become a shogun, and is a true warrior who employs the techniques of the Warring States period to win battles via jousting. ...Though, apparently she is prone to making big mistakes. Her alarm clock is set to the sound of a conch horn. Appearance No Reason's bright, ambitious yellow eyes gleam with determination as they gaze toward her future. Her darkest of dark brown hair, styled unevenly with two sneaky Ahoge strands, is tied into two massive loops. Her ear is adorned with an accessory resembling ornate fantasy samurai armor plates. Tied across her forehead is her custom red Hachimaki (鉢巻) proudly emblazoned with an emblem and the Fusa of Shimenawa (標縄) hanging on each side of her face. She dons a blazing red and blue samurai robe, adorned with Shimenawa ropes that separates the red into white at the hem. At its center is a striking blue Hiyoku featuring wave patterns—a motif closely tied to samurai tradition. Her shoulders and arms are protected by red armor plates. Beneath the robe lies a red dress bearing her emblem and cinched at the waist is an obi rope. Below the waist, her armor continues with protective plates covering her knees, shins, and feet. Another obi rope ties her shin guards. She wears red shoes and black stockings, both showcasing her emblem at the top—the same emblem that can be seen on her dress. Relationships Yaeno Muteki- Friend and roommate. Tanino Gimlet- Friend and rival. No Reason views Tanino Gimlet as a rival she must defeat at any means necessary, and Gimlet is intrigued by No Reason's boldness. However, when Gimlet gets injured after the Japanese Derby, No Reason is angered by the fact that she cannot race with her anymore, showing a close rivalry. Symboli Kris S- Friend and rival. No Reason also views Symboli Kris S as a formidable rival, and gets upset when Kris S runs in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) instead of the Kikuka Sho. Hishi Miracle- Friend, classmate and rival. No Reason relates to Hishi Miracle, as they are both "underdogs" in the racing world. No Reason sees the potential and strength in Hishi Miracle, and they both train together. No Reason also brings out the confidence in Hishi Miracle, and Hishi Miracle begins to believe in herself with No Reason's help. Durandal- Friend. Though they have not raced each other due to taking different paths, they are good friends and get along due to their eccentric behaviors. No Reason goes along with Durandal's belief of being a knight.IRL, No Reason, Durandal, Hishi Miracle, Symboli Kris S, and Tanino Gimlet were all a part of the 2002 generation. IRL, No Reason, Durandal, Hishi Miracle, Symboli Kris S, and Tanino Gimlet were all a part of the 2002 generation. Narita Brian- Friend and upperclassman. Despite No Reason's eccentric personality clashing with hers, Narita Brian sees the strength in her. When Brian watched No Reason win the Satsuki Sho, it reminded her of her own Satsuki Sho win back then. Dantsu Flame- Friend. No Reason connects with her as a fellow "underdog", and encourages her to get stronger. Introduced by Hishi Miracle, Dantsu Flame gets along well with No Reason, and Dantsu also finds No Reason's attitude to be admirable in her own way. Phalaenopsis- Friend.IRL, No Reason, Dantsu Flame, Narita Brian, and Phalaenopsis were all sired by Brian's Time. Tanino Gimlet was also sired by Brian's Time. IRL, No Reason, Dantsu Flame, Narita Brian, and Phalaenopsis were all sired by Brian's Time. Tanino Gimlet was also sired by Brian's Time. Her samurai theming is a reference to the real horse participating in the Soma Nomaoi, a traditional festival in Fukushima Prefecture after his racing and breeding career. The line about "big mistakes" in her biography is likely a reference to the 2002 Kikuka Sho, where the real horse was the betting favorite, but stumbled at the start of the race, unseating his jockey, disqualifying himself and instantly making 11 billion yen of betting tickets worthless. She likes to act out Sengoku-era period dramas.[1]She also likes Kabuki theatre.[2] She is skilled at reciting haikus.[3] Her career story is the only one to directly reference howSunday Silencedominated Japanese pedigrees throughout the racing world. A reference to this is No Reason trying to stop the "Silent Clan" from dominating races, which includes Umamusume likeSpecial Week. She loves to drink soda, specifically cola.[4] No Reason has an Umamusume that she looks up to. She has rosemary earrings, and used to run before an injury forced her to quit.[5]This is a reference to No Reason's half sister in real life, Rosmarinus, who had to quit after the open-class race Shiragiku Sho due to injury. As a reference to how her sire Brian's Time and her dam Ambrosine are American horses, No Reason is American in Umamusume. Appearance North Flight has light brownish-orange hair styled in a layered bob-cut, that fades into a light tan at the end. Her fluffy hair is decorated with blonde and pink streaks, and three black and pink hair clips on the right side of her bangs. She wears a magenta boater hat around her left ear, decorated with black trim, and tied with a black and teal ribbon, a white frilled ribbon, as well as a golden "N" accessory. Part of her inner ears are magenta, and she has two triangle-shaped golden clips on her left ear. Her eyes are light magenta, that fade into a pastel yellow. Flight's racing outfit is equal parts chic and stylish. She wears a form-fitting bodice, decorated in black and magenta sections, with a skirt that flows out, the ends cut to resemble feathers. Her dress has golden buttons on the bodice, as well as several other golden embellishments. On the right side of the dress' skirt is a laced up blue ribbon, and red bows clipped to where the ribbon intersects. Around her waist, she wears a thin light blue belt, with an emblem resembling wings with a heart in the center. Under her dress' skirt is another skirt, but this time in white, with the ends also cut to resemble feathers. She wears a multicolored striped scarf tied into a ribbon around her neck, striped in black, magenta, and light blue. Decorating her tail are two large white plumes of feathers. She wears short black and magenta detached sleeves on her upper arms, and black lacy gloves tied with pink and blue ribbons on her hand. She wears black low-denier tights, with simple black heels decorated with magenta ribbons and a golden winged charm in the center. Relationships Aston Machan- Roommate. In her SR support card, she is shown making clothes for Machan's mini doll. Sakura Bakushin O- Friend, classmate, and rival. Though they may have different aptitudes in distance, Flight and Bakushin O are fierce rivals all the same. A rivalry strong enough to shake Bakushin O's confidence at first. On the track, it's no holds barred, but off the track, they are very close friends who have a deep understanding of each other despite their differences in hobbies and sensibilities.In real life, they held a rare stallion-mare rivalry. Sakura Bakushin O never yielded the sprint to North Flight, and in turn North Flight never yielded the mile to Sakura Bakushin O. A gray-haired Umamusume that enrolled in Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Oguri's a hearty eater that lives life at her own pace. On the track, she's a strong competitor who competes in a variety of intense races against her many rivals.[2] Appearance Oguri Cap has long, light-gray hair that goes down towards her knees. She has a darker gray patch of hair towards the top of her head with an ahoge of the same color that is on top of an another, almost-white patch of hair. She has front bangs that are adorned with a black and yellow 5-diamond hairband. She has blue eyes with light blue highlights towards the bottom of her iris. She wears a blue band with a center yellow stripe around her right ear. Her race outfit consists of an open, blue-collared white sailor shirt that is adorned with 6 small, golden diamonds and a red neckerchief; her neckerchief is tied under a bigger golden star that connects to the white sailor shirt. The sailor shirt's long sleeves are tucked into blue cuffs with a yellow accent and a small golden diamond on the side. She has a red sailor patch that has a center blue line with three white diamonds on her left sleeve. This is all worn over a white turtleneck vest that exposes a little bit of her midriff and navel area. She wears a blue choker with a white center stripe over. She wears a blue pleated skirt with a yellow accent and a white/light blue belt that is over a pair of black pantyhose; from her skirt, she has an orange cord accessory. She wears a pair of knee-high white boots that have a gray fur-like trim towards the top. Relationships Tamamo Cross- Friend, rival, and roommate. Tamamo lit a fire in Oguri when it came to racing, and they both get fired up when competing against each other. While Tamamo gets exasperated by Oguri's airheaded nature from time to time, she still genuinely cares for her as a friend. Oguri also appreciates her friendship, and would even eat less if Tamamo said she couldn't buy her a lot of food for her birthday. Super Creek-  Friend, rival, and classmate. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:As her real-life counterpart found success after transferring from Kasamatsu Racecourse to JRA central racing, the star she wears on the center of her collar represents the "the Star of Kasamatsu".The yellow diamond crown atop her head is reminiscent of the gold diamonds found on her real-life counterpart's jockey silks.Her sturdy boots are in reference to her real-life counterpart's historical story that, while facing injuries and ailments, making a spectacular comeback at the end of his career. As her real-life counterpart found success after transferring from Kasamatsu Racecourse to JRA central racing, the star she wears on the center of her collar represents the "the Star of Kasamatsu". The yellow diamond crown atop her head is reminiscent of the gold diamonds found on her real-life counterpart's jockey silks. Her sturdy boots are in reference to her real-life counterpart's historical story that, while facing injuries and ailments, making a spectacular comeback at the end of his career. HerCinderella Graycostume is asemi-limitedtrainable unit, meaning that it could be pulled from gacha but cannot be chosen with paid 3-star trainee vouchers.This is the first time a certain trainable unit from an already existing Umamusume became semi-limited. The initial trainable units of other semi-limited characters released prior to Oguri Cap's costume alt were all semi-limited. This is the first time a certain trainable unit from an already existing Umamusume became semi-limited. The initial trainable units of other semi-limited characters released prior to Oguri Cap's costume alt were all semi-limited. Oguri Cap has a tendency to shake herself from side-to-side, a trait that is present from her in-real-life counterpart which often means he is in a good mood. While it is subtle in her in-game G2 or lower victory animations, it is in full display in the anime and manga ofCinderella Grayand her idle animation in the costume of the same name during the Career mode. In the Global version of the game, she has a line where she talks about a debate she had with Tamamo Cross earlier on whether pineapple goes on pizza or not. However, in the Japanese version, the original line was talking about whether squid should be grilled whole or not. Her Christmas alternative outfit is based on when a fan gave the real life counterpart a Christmas-themed hood around the time of his final run at the Arima Kinen. Her love for food is a reference to the real horse, as he was known for having a voracious appetite. In her career story, Oguri Cap befriends a cat that she named "Hatsuratsu".[3]This cat's name is a reference to the real Oguri Cap's nickname as a foal, which was "Hatsuratsu".[4] Her voice actress was originally going to beAyane Taketatsu, before she left the project for unknown reasons. Oguri Cap loves hot springs. This is because her IRL counterpart enjoyed equine hot springs.[5]While the real Oguri Cap loved hot springs, he was not a fan of pool training, and was a terrible swimmer. This is referenced in her stamina training, as she is one of several Umamusume who uses a kick board while swimming. Now bow down and prostrate before my supremacy." The sole honored one throughout Heaven and Earth, the Tyrant Umamusume who doesn't hesitate to call herself the King of the Racing World. The turf is her territory, the Triple Crown has always belonged to her—therefore she will simply go and reclaim it. At the academy, students captivated by her overwhelming talent and charisma are said to constantly attend to her as her subjects. Appearance Orfevre has radiant orange hair that reaches gracefully past her waist and softening into a lighter hue as it descends. It parts and turns a light beige at her face, framing her noble features and drawing all attention to her presence. She has celestial blue eyes. Adorning her right ear is a golden ornament crafted by her father. Suspended from this regal piece is a black and red ribbon, fastened with golden buckles. And lastly, on the opposite side, a golden chain weaves through her hair. When she dons her racewear, a crown with six golden diamonds levitate above her head. The beige coat she wears has golden epaulettes on the right and a luxurious fur trim on the left. The collar, encrusted with dazzling jewels, reflects her grandeur, while the back flows into a cape of red and black and featuring patterns of elegance. At the center of the collar lies ruffles of black adorned with a ribbon that showcases another piece of fine jewelry. Her black sleeves feature pearls, red ruffles, and trims of gold. The coat cascades into a dress, revealing an inner lining of shimmering diamond patterns resembling the cosmos, with golden trims outlining every edge. Her fitted black and red skirt, adorned with golden motifs, continues the theme of royalty. Even her leggings, black with red accents at the top, are trimmed with gold and feature detailed symbols running along the sides. On her left, the leggings transition seamlessly into refined heels, while on the right, they give way to an equally elegant beige heel. Relationships Stay Gold- Friend. Orfevre seems to listen to Stay Gold, and seems to value Stay Gold's opinion and asked her for her thoughts on certain matters. Stay Gold is also the only person asides from Dream Journey that calls her "Oru", showing a closeness between them. Despite Orfevre's frustration that Stay Gold leaves all the time, she is eager to listen when she tells stories about her travels. Dream Journey- Older sister and roommate. Dream Journey tends to spoil and pamper her, as she tends to Orfevre's tail and wakes her up in the mornings as examples. She also helps her cut difficult food, and arranges nearly everything for her. She also monitors how people talk about Orfevre online, and posts about her on her social media to promote her.[2]However, despite all she does for her, Journey doesn't feel resentful, but instead honored that she gets to support her younger sister and her goals.[3]Orfevre respects and appreciates her as her sister and admires her terrifying strength. Orfevre sees her as reliable to the point where she lets her handle her schedule. Gold Ship- Friend and rival. She often entertains Orfevre in her spare time alongside Nakayama Festa. When Orfevre is bored, she usually calls out to Gold Ship, hoping that she brings entertainment. Nakayama Festa-  Friend. She often entertains Orfevre in her spare time alongside Gold Ship. Fenomeno- Friend. Orfevre likes to tease and pull tricks on Fenomeno, much to the latter's dismay. Fenomeno feels frustrated regarding her, because Orfevre is more popular with children compared to her.
