Because of the scale of the disaster, which may lead the reference to cause discomfort in individuals affected by it, the official Umamusume X account posted a warning about the reference.[5] In her Senior Year, Tazuna will accompany the player for one turn, where Orfevre will go to France to race in the L'Arc, while leaving them alone in Japan.This is a reference to her real life counterpart having Christophe Soumillon as Orfevre's jockey for both the Prix Foy and L'Arc instead of Kenichi Ikezoe, his main jockey in Japan. Kenichi Ikezoe, Orfevre's jockey, heard that this fan wanted to see him, so he arranged a meeting with Northern Farm so that the boy could see him. Despite Orfevre usually being a rough horse, especially when stroked, he was docile when the boy petted him. Legs that dull at such trifles have no business claiming victory." An Umamusume who possesses both the regal quality of a noble daughter and the boldness of a warrior. She is prepared to become the flower of the Twinkle Series’ battleground so that she can repay her gratitude to the training club that turned her from an Umamusume with a weak constitution to a strong racer. She is the cousin and childhood friend of Biwa Hayahide and Narita Brian. Self-IntroI am Phalaenopsis. The disadvantages and sorrows that ail my body are nothing to me. Appearance Phalaenopsis has long, curly, dark purple hair that fades into a paler heliotrope color at the ends, and is tied into a side ponytail on top of her head. Her eyes are a vivid gradient that transitions from lavender, hot pink, and into a brilliant golden hue, complemented by red eyelashes. She wears matching white ear covers with a pink checkerboard pattern, while her left ear is adorned with a pair of gold rings and threephalaenopsisflowers, fastened together by a ribbon with the same pattern as her ear covers. Relationships Biwa Hayahide- Childhood friend and cousin. During Phalaenopsis' classic year, Biwa Hayahide acts as her mentor, specifically during the Japanese Oaks as to prepare her stamina. They both train together, and Hayahide looks out for Phalaeno as her family. Narita Brian- Childhood friend and cousin. Phalaeno looks up to Narita Brian. Though Brian acts cold towards Phalaeno, she cares about her, and watches her race. Brian also likes the ohagi Phalaeno makes.IRL, Phalaenopsis' dam, Catequil, was the half-sibling of the dam of Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide, Pacificus.Additionally, Phalaenopsis and Narita Brian were both sired by Brian's Time. Phalaeno also looks up to Special Week as a strong runner in their generation, and wants to surpass her.IRL, the two had a foal together named Ranunculus. IRL, the two had a foal together named Ranunculus. El Condor Pasa- Friend and rival. They watch lucha libre matches together in their free time. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances4.1Manga4.2Others 4.1Manga 4.2Others 5Event Appearances 6Song Discography 7Names in Other Languages 8Trivia 9Student Introduction 10External Links Biography "Blessings upon you, and radiance upon the 'world'..." An Umamusume who (according to herself) bears the destiny to arrive at an "otherworld" one day, where she will become a highly revered saintess. She's often seen uttering such remarks as "Alack, it all must be an ordeal, a 'trial of the saintess' I must overcome to ascend to that 'world'—so overcome it I shall," while sipping a cup of latte made by her senior she admires. LikesFirst aid, baking cookies, laundry First aid, baking cookies, laundry DislikesRough tissue paper Rough tissue paper EarsThey hear Manhattan Cafe's voice clearly They hear Manhattan Cafe's voice clearly TailIts cleaned with cold water even during winter Its cleaned with cold water even during winter FamilyShe visits her mom's film sets, and used to be a child actress She visits her mom's film sets, and used to be a child actress SecretsShe drinks grape juice from a wine glass as a hobby. She drinks grape juice from a wine glass as a hobby. Appearance A fair skinned Umamusume, Red Desire has deep cherry red hair that extends down to her midsection, cut off bluntly. Two chunks of her hair extend outwards around the middle of her head, also cut bluntly. Her eyes are a pale yellow tone with prominent eyebags underneath. Her face is framed on both sides by her hair, a loose strand curling out and leftwards from her bangs. A large, curled ahoge sticks out from the top of her head. She wears a dark red, almost gothic hairband adorned with intricate gold patterns on top. White frills come from the underside and two diamond shaped jewels (presumably) come from under the headband, resting on her bangs.  The headband extends downwards on both sides of her head, undersides white with gold diamonds and two five-pointed stars hanging from them by golden beads. Black lace covers the base of her left ear. Her tail is neatly kept. Her race outfit carries a similar theme to her already mentioned accessories, familiar diamond and gold patterns making a return. She wears a short, patterned cape, small gold necklace wrapping around the collar of it, the same cylindrical teal accessory that Manhattan Cafe wears on her right ear attached to it.  The underside of the cape has a black, curvy pattern around the trim, golden diamonds visible above it. She wears a ruffled shirt under the cape, red lace adorning the middle. She wears long sleeves that puff outwards before tucking into cuffs, golden buttons on either side. Frilly, white armcuffs rest on her upper arms, a black bow in the middle of either. She wears a layered corset skirt, a large white bow offset to the right on her midsection and wrapped around, white and red ruffles extending from it. The bow has another five-pointed star resting firmly in the center. Gold patterns rest on three pleats on the right side of the skirt, the last and innermost layer being an off-black. She wears floral patterned stockings, off-black frills at the top of them, that are held up by garters. Layered on top of her stockings are shin-high socks, a dark red bow resting at the top. Diamond patterns are cut down the middle of the socks, gold lacing them, ending at the bridge of her feet. Finally, she wears simple, red Mary Jane shoes, black bows on the outer sides of the straps. If you want, come here.... sit next to me!” Bright and cheerful, Rhein Kraft's favourite thing to do is to bask in the sun's warmth at any opportunity. She yearns for the Triple Tiara races, which she holds a passionate admiration for, and wishes to go for them, thus working hard every day for that dream. While stubborn to a fault and extra dynamic, she is usually easygoing and makes everyone around her feel relaxed. She's absurdly good at marble battles. She's absurdly good at marble battles. Appearance Rhein Kraft has short brown hair that frays out at the ends. On the left side of her head, she wears her hair into a round bun, with a cute hair-loop encircling it. Coming from the top of her head is a large, white, ahoge, almost in the shape of a broom, and she has a white streak of hair on the right side of her bangs. On her left ear, she wears a cute shooting star decoration, with the star being light green, and the trail being white and pink. Her large, cheery eyes are emerald, and she has a star shaped highlight. Her race outfit is simple, but almost represents an idol outfit. It consists of a cropped pink jacket with short, frilled, white sleeves, and a light pink collar with green frills. In the center of her collar is a large red bow with a light pink star gem in the center. This jacket is layered on top of a white, red, and pink dress. She wears a red corset-like piece on her waist, tied in the center with a small red bow, and adorned with several cute red belts. Her white dress has four prominent gold buttons in the center, and is lined at the base with two large light pink stripes, and a layer of red frills. She wears a large green bow around her tail. As for her leg wear, she wears white knee-high socks with decorative cuts along the top of the socks, adorned with small red ribbons. She wears a simple pair of sneakers, each decorated with a green toe, and light blue padding on the sides. However, her right sneaker is white with red laces, and her left sneaker is red with white laces. Relationships Cesario- Best friend, rival and roommate. Teammate in the game-only team,Team Ascella. I really... really hope I can change that!" Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook. A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune." Self-IntroI'm Rice Shower... Appearance Rice Shower has long ears, and dark brown, almost black, hair. Her hair reaches her mid-back, and curls up at the tips, and she has long bangs that are swept to cover her right eye. She has pinkish-purple eyes. On her right ear, she wears a dark blue fascinator, with a blue rose as decoration. Her race outfit consists of an off-shoulder dress, with black lace around the bodice, and in the center, a blue rose. The base of her dress is dark blue with dark magenta sleeves. The sleeves flare out at the end with cutouts almost resembling the petals of a flower, and have decorative black trim. The dress' dark blue skirt has a scalloped magenta line going around the center, and the trim of the dress is decorated with the same black lace found in the bodice. Her tail has a very large, black, tail bow. She wears high-denier thigh-high stockings, decorated with black lace at the top. Around her waist is a brown dagger holster decorated with a silver rose, with a dagger inside the holster. For her shoes, she wears a simple black pair of heels, laced at the center, with decorative black ribbons on either side. Relationships Mihono Bourbon- Best Friend and Rival. Rice Shower greatly admires Mihono Bourbon and wishes she could be as strong as her. She will push herself extremely hard because of this idolization, and despite being best friends Rice Shower sees herself as less than Mihono Bourbon.In real life, Rice Shower infamously beat Mihono Bourbon at the 1992 Kikuka Sho, denying him the 1992 Triple Crown in an upset victory. Prior to this, he had come 2nd to Bourbon in the 1992 Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby). Matikanetannhauser- Friend and Rival. Zenno Rob Roy- Roommate and friend. They both enjoy books, Rice's interest being in picture books, and can understand each other as they're both a bit reserved. When she notices how Rice feels sad due to people judging her for winning the Kikuka Sho, she proposes the idea to Rice to have her challenge the Tenno Sho (Spring) with her. Rice also likes McQueen's way of speaking, because it reminds her of the princesses in the storybooks she reads.In real life, Rice Shower defeated Mejiro McQueen in the 1993 Tenno Sho (Spring), where the latter was favored to win for the third year in a row. Born to the distinguished 'Rose Family', she received elite education to grow into a noble Umamusume befitting of her place. Her mission in racing is to elevate her family's standing in the world of racing to a height beyond merely prestigious; essentially, she seeks to become the 'king' who leads her family. She's had such a noble upbringing that worldly things are rather foreign to her. Appearance Rose Kingdom’s hair is styled in an evenly parted wavy bob that falls to her shoulders. Her hair color is a dark gray that transitions into a red gradient near the ends, with a subtle ahoge at the crown. The base of her right ear is adorned with a red rose accented by several leaves and a small bead, while the ear itself is wrapped in a golden thorned rose. Her eyes are slightly downcast and a pale pink in color, and her pupils appear to be encircled by a circular pattern, giving them an almost emblem-like appearance. Rose’s race outfit resembles a formal court uniform inspired by classical European aristocracy. It is primarily black, with a deep red panel running down the center, adorned with gold braided dress cords and rose ornaments. A golden rose embellishment rests at the neckline of her embroidered collar. A larger golden rose brooch secures her cape. The cape itself features a layered panel design resembling stylized feathers each one decorated with rose symbols, and a final golden rose charm dangles elegantly from the cape’s end. Her sleeves are puffed and black, with white diamond-quilted undersides. Gold-colored trim runs along the length of the sleeves to the wrists, which are fitted and adorned with additional golden rose accents. She also wears white gloves. A red sash with silver trim runs diagonally over her torso, secured at the hip with a large red rose. She wears tailored white fitted pants and black boots that reach up to her thigh. A few more red roses decorate the cuffs of her boots. Relationships Victoire Pisa- Friend and rival. While at first, Rose is closed off, Pisa reaches out to her, and shows her that friendship and connection is a good thing. They get along well, and they train together from time to time. Eishin Flash- Friend and rival. Rulership- Friend and rival. Rulership tends to heavily exaggerate her speech when around Rose, which confuses the latter. Rulership also tries to get Rose to try "normal" food, such as hamburgers.In real life, Eishin Flash, Rose Kingdom, Rulership and Victoire Pisa were rivals throughout their careers, starting with their classic years. In real life, Eishin Flash, Rose Kingdom, Rulership and Victoire Pisa were rivals throughout their careers, starting with their classic years. Tanino Gimlet- Friend and senior. Rose admires Gimlet and is intrigued by her behaviours, to the point of keeping a notebook of the language Gimlet uses to better understand her. In turn, Gimlet mentors Rose, teaching her about the art of fence destruction.In real life, Rose Kingdom and Tanino Gimlet are stablemates at Versailles Resort Farm. Rose Kingdom has been seen imitating Gimlet’s fence-destroying habits, much to the chagrin of farm staff, who attributed this behaviour to Gimlet taking Rose Kingdom as his disciple. Appearance Royce and Royce has long brown hair, tied into a bun at the back of her head, and decorated with braids. Underneath this bun, she wears a diagonally-striped bow, colored purple and dark purple. The first layer of her side bangs are cut bluntly, and she has two long strands of hair falling past her shoulders on either side. She has a purple ear cover on her right ear, accompanied by a golden ear clip, with a golden diamond linked to it. She wears green over-rim glasses, and has de-saturated red eyes. Her racing uniform consists of a multi-colored and multi-layered outfit. A reddish-orange jacket with white puffed sleeves and black cuffs is worn over a white button-up top. She wears a yellow layered half-skirt with a purple interior seen in the ruffles. Underneath this is a white pencil skirt, with purple "X" shaped laces on either side, and teal slits in the front. On the right side of her waist, she has a teal piece of fabric attached to a black belt. She also wears black tights, and black heeled boots with gold accents. The game's already in the palm of my hand." A hardcore board game enthusiast who enjoys the genre as a whole, from classics like Reversi to modern ones. She's an intellectual who likes to plan and scheme her way into dominating the flow of the game. The ingenuity serves as an asset in races as well, but...her frail ego is her greatest weakness. When her plans derail by accident, she instantly buckles and folds, hiding away in her room and refusing to come out. She has a regular tailor that she visits in Italy. Appearance Rulership has pale blue eyes and short, unkempt hair arranged in a messy, chin-length bob with a slight ahoge on top. Her hair is mostly a light umber color accented by a white undertone, with a prominent zig-zag-shaped blaze to match. She wears two alternating black-and-white triangular hairclips on the left side of her bangs. She also dons a green, diamond-shaped ring over her right ear; it is adorned with two circular black and white earrings, which also happen to resemble miniaturereversigame pieces. Rulership's race outfit reflects her affluence and braggadocious persona, consisting of a white halterneck dress shirt underneath a black waistcoat and high-waisted shorts. She dons a cape resembling a jacket worn over the shoulders, with detached black sleeves decorated with black and white feathers. The cape is primarily yellow, with a striped black-and-yellow lining, and has longer strips of fabric and black belts dangling off the sleeves. The back of the cape is dark grey, with a pair of red belts forming a saltire connected by a silver, cross-shaped buckle. The shirt is fastened with a bolo tie featuring a black-and-white color scheme and a green square-shaped charm with a checkerboard design similar to a reversi board. The waistcoat features a red saltire on its right, while the left is decorated by a yellow stripe and an assortment of pins: one featuring a corner of a reversi board with matching black and white pieces, a green capital letter "R", arookchess piece, and a triangular pin embossed with a die icon. Her shorts have eight silver buttons, as well as a thin pair of belts connected by a diamond-shaped buckle with a cross emblem. Attached to these belts is a yellow tassel on the left side; on the right, she wears a key ring with an assortment of trinkets: a pair of charms consisting of another rook chess piece and a pair of dice, and a chain that wraps around her waist. She wears white gloves with a striped green trim and triangular black buttons. Her footwear is a pair of black thigh-high boots, each of which are adorned with two green straps and a long, white stripe that stops just above the ankle. Rulership also tries to get Rose to try "normal" food, such as hamburgers.[1] Victoire Pisa- Friend and rival. Victoire Pisa tends to comfort her when she's in a weakened mental state. Rulership looks up to Pisa, and is somewhat envious of her good qualities, such as her kindness. Trivia She was announced during the fifth anniversaryPakaLive TVstream on February 22nd, 2026. As a reference to how Air Groove is her dam in real life, Rulership's racewear has feather patterns on her right and left shoulders. Rulership's favorite tailor being from Italy is a possible reference to either her real life damsire,Tony Bin, or the Italian jockeyUmberto Rispoli, who jockeyed the IRL horse to win the 2012 Hong Kong Queen Elizabeth II Cup. During training, one of the in-game events includes an earthquake that references thesame earthquakethat happened in Japan on 11th March, 2011 in real life. Because of the scale of the disaster, which may lead the reference to cause discomfort in individuals affected by it, the official Umamusume X account posted a warning about the reference.[4] In her unique skill animation, the knight chess piece she uses is an armored Umamusume instead of a horse, as horses do not exist in the Umamusume world.[5] Her younger brother's piano music is a reference to a horse named Chopin,[6]who was Rulership's younger brother in real life. She has a liking for sweets.[7]She also tends to eat dessert when she is upset after losing a game.[8] Her dislike for cats is likely a reference to the real horseNeko Punch, who defeated Rulership in the 2012 Nikkei Sho. Win Variation also references this horse, as she mentions that a cat punched her earlier.[9] She likes going to amusement parks when there's no one else around.[10] In her career and character story, when she is upset or frustrated, she tends to repeat words over and over. Her tendency to suffer late starts in races is a reference to the real horse, as Rulership was infamous for starting late in many of his races.Her skills also reference this tendency:Her unique skill will either activate immediately if she does not get a late start, or will activate mid-way through the race if she does get a late start, and is still at the back of the pack.Her evolved version of the skill Concentration will make her significantly more delayed following a late start, in turn giving her a great boost in speed around the middle part of the race. Her skills also reference this tendency:Her unique skill will either activate immediately if she does not get a late start, or will activate mid-way through the race if she does get a late start, and is still at the back of the pack.Her evolved version of the skill Concentration will make her significantly more delayed following a late start, in turn giving her a great boost in speed around the middle part of the race. Her unique skill will either activate immediately if she does not get a late start, or will activate mid-way through the race if she does get a late start, and is still at the back of the pack. Her evolved version of the skill Concentration will make her significantly more delayed following a late start, in turn giving her a great boost in speed around the middle part of the race. In episode four of her character story, Rulership notes that three Umamusume from the 5th, 9th, and 12th gate are fighting for the lead during a race she's competing in. This is a reference to the 2011 Kinko Sho that Rulership won. Captain Thule was in the 5th gate, Earnestly was in the 9th gate, and Unrivaled was in the 12th gate. She shows interest in opening a board game inn with her trainer.[11] According to Air Groove in the lobby, Rulership tends to be late for exams, causing her to fail them. She likes to read manga in internet cafes.[12]This is likely a nod to Kiseki, as she also likes manga. In her classic year, she will get two debuffs that will greatly reduce her performance and mile aptitude before the Mainichi Hai (G3). This is a reference to Rulership's 5th place in the Mainichi Hai (G3) on 2010, where he not only suffered a late start, but another horse-The Taiki-began to break down near him, causing his performance to worsen. She heavily dislikes being outside, and prefers to be indoors. She is very knowledgeable about visual novels, such as dating simulators.[13] In the homescreen, Rulership mentions that Air Groove constantly asks her if she ate lunch.[14]Rulership also tends to eat junk food, and has an unhealthy diet in general.[1]Her eating habits are likely a reference to how the real horse did not eat very much, especially when he was preparing for the Hong Kong Queen Elizabeth II Cup.[15] In the lobby, Rulership and Gold Ship do a pose that looks like a prancing horse while playing a game. This pose is a reference to the 2012 Arima Kinen, where Rulership stood on his hind legs like he was a prancing horse, which caused him to suffer a late start by ten lengths. Appearance Sakura Bakushin O sports a polished high ponytail, with her hair parting slightly to the right in an asymmetrical style and two sleek face-framing layers gracefully fall on each side of her face. She wears a golden headband shaped like a subtle crown, a regal touch and a purple ribbon adorns her ear. And unique to her, striking pink eyes resembling the petals of cherry blossoms. Her outfit begins with a militaristic, sleeveless pink and white top with rows of gold buttons/decals down the front and it cascades or sprouts out on the sides and back like a flower. A tie, reminiscent of those found in certain school uniforms extends into a mini cape at the back. Golden epaulettes are worn on the shoulders adding further regality to her appearance. She wears mismatched gloves—one black and one white—on each hand, a little playful asymmetry. Her black shorts are accented with a crisp white trim near the hem and are complementing by the white thigh-high socks, each topped with pink accents at the band and diamond pattern silhouettes on the side. Her mismatched boots—one black and one white—mirror the gloves but are swapped in color placement and feature pink buttons and a strap design. She has two hair protrusions coming out of either side of her head that many compare to dog ears. Her inner-ears are tinted purple, and she wears white ear covers that only cover the top half of her ears. On her right ear is a ribbon tied with green rope, decorated with a large pink sakura flower, and a smaller, dark pink, sakura flower. She has light blue eyes. Her race outfit resembles a yukata[1], however it is sleeveless. The kimono's collar is black with white dashed lines at the trim, tied in the center with a white bow and a dark pink flower in the center. The kimono's sash is dark magenta, the same color as her hair, tied with a black bow, and a small green ribbon in the center. She wears a white pleated skirt with two distinct pink lines at the base, and black ruffles, cut in the pattern of a cherry blossom sleeves. The skirt has cutouts in either hip, decorated with white flowing ribbons. The sleeves of her kimono are detached, and are pink with a white floral pattern, and a black trim. Underneath she wears black full-length fingerless gloves. On her legs, she wears a pair of white tights, with intricate cutouts resembling falling sakura petals. Her running shoes are black sandals with pink toe-posts, and a pink cherry blossom flower in the center. My goal is the world. The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! ―Hehe, but it's just a "dream" right now. But... I'll make it come true someday!" Gentle but persistent. A cherry blossom blooming through winter. She's a positive Umamusume with an indomitable spirit, who's cheerful, optimistic, and unfazed by every obstacle. She was born with weak legs, and has been plagued by injuries, but she gets back up every time she gets knocked down. She has special feelings for her classmate, Narita Brian, and she hopes to beat her someday. Self-IntroMy name is Sakura Laurel, and I'm aiming for the top. Appearance Sakura Laurel has bright reddish and chestnut colored hair, cut into a cute bob-cut that curls inwards, with bangs parted down the middle. She wears a golden laurel crown on the top of her head, and on her right ear she wears a purple ring of diamonds, with gold and purple ribbons attached. She has pinkish-purple eyes with bright pink highlights in the shape of a sakura flower. Her racing uniform is light, simple, and cute. She wears a white blouse with short, puffy sleeves that have dark pink cuffs and ruffles. Over this, she wears a pink sleeveless vest with a dark gray sailor collar and a thick gold trim. The coat tail of the vest is adorned with a white sakura flower, and has two distinct ribbons coming off either side, both shaped like the petals of a cherry blossom. Underneath the vest is a dark pink top fastened with golden sakura-shaped buttons.  A pink ribbon with a gold chain and sakura pins accents the neck. Her wrists are accented with matching pink cuffs with a similar design to her vest. She wears a simple pair of white shorts with gold trim and layered pink ruffles. On her right leg, she wears a dark gray sock with a heart shaped cutout and a gold laurel wreath trim. Her outfit is completed by white boots with pink fold-over tops and dark pink out-soles. Good work, Ms. Big! You were the 18th strongest! That's amazing, Ms. Big!" "A BIG Umamusume whose aura echoes through the world!" ...is the aspiration of this Umamusume who is nothing if not patient. Although she's aware of the gap between her big dreams and the harsh reality, she nevertheless tackles all sorts of troubles and hardships head-on each and every day, with "Just try first!" as her motto. Strangely enough, her same-year colleagueNarita Brianseems to consider her a force to be reckoned with. Appearance Despite what her name suggests, Samson Big is an Umamusume of short stature. She has long, wavy bay-brown hair and round lime-green eyes. She wears a very distinctive cyan beanie, with pink stripes and a large pom-pom on top. The beanie has white ear covers with pink horizontal stripes on them, and pink pom poms which dangle from either side. The beanie is also decorated with a small medal featuring a fist in front of her right ear. Her racing outfit has a white, mint-green, and pink sleeveless vest which resembles boxing attire. It has a black crop top in the middle with the word "BIG" in large, bold, white lettering. She wears black spats underneath white shorts that have teal trim, and a pink stripe on either side. A green boxing belt with a gold snarling lion emblem in the center worn on her waist. She also wears bright blue and black gloves on her hands and matching knee-high boxing shin guards on her feet, which are accented with pink lines. Relationships Sakura Laurel- Friend. Narita Brian- Friend, role model and rival. Big loves to hang out with Brian, and calls her "Buu-chan". Though their personalities clash, Brian gets along well with Big, and is fine with her company. InStar Blossom, they are shown to hang out together, as well as in the game. Brian also helps Big play the guitar in Big's R card story.IRL, they were rivals in the 1994 generation. While Narita Brian won the Triple Crown, Samson Big placed low in all three races, which earned him the nickname "Reverse Triple Crown Winner". Narita Brian and Samson Big's friendship is also likely based on the mangaUmanari, where they are shown to be best friends. IRL, they were rivals in the 1994 generation. While Narita Brian won the Triple Crown, Samson Big placed low in all three races, which earned him the nickname "Reverse Triple Crown Winner". Narita Brian and Samson Big's friendship is also likely based on the mangaUmanari, where they are shown to be best friends. Phalaenopsis- Friend and roommate. They both get along, and they became roommates because they both admire Brian in some way. Biko Pegasus- Friend and underclassman. I'll be sure to bring glory to the Satono clan. I'll do everything in my power to achieve victory, and even adversity will give me strength! You can count on me!" Turf Magician! An elite sister you can rely on. She is a cheerful and determined older sister who lives in both Hong Kong and Japan. She's also one of the talented members of the Satono family, and carries the family's high expectations. She has a personality that burns more brightly in the face of adversity, and sometimes solves problems as brilliantly as magic. Her nickname is "Kura-chan". Appearance Satono Crown has dark gray hair, styled into a wavy side-ponytail on the right side of her head, tied by a white ruffled ribbon and a chain of several white diamonds. Her bangs are fringed, and parted to the left, exposing the right side of her forehead. At the center of her bangs, she has a prominent white marking, shaped like a crown, with four distinct points. Her ears are scalloped, resembling ear fluff, and fade into dark gray at the tips, and she wears an elaborate silver crown around her right ear. Her eyes are a de-saturated green. Her race outfit consist of a dark green top with vertical stripes, and black shorts with suspenders. The collar above her shirt is black with blue diamond decor at the tips, and she wears a yellow tie with dark yellow floral decor. Her suspender shorts have elaborate gold trimming, and a cutout in the center with X-shaped lacing connecting either side. The end of her shorts have a yellow and green diamond pattern. She wears a pair of black full-length gloves, with gold trim at the top. On her hip, she wears a bright green ribbon. Underneath this ensemble she wears black tights. Above those tights is a pair of black thigh-high boots, with gold trimming at the top, on her toes, and down either side. Relationships Duramente- Roommate.In real life, the two were stablemates. Cheval Grand- Friend and Rival. Satono Crown is very clingy with Cheval Grand and considers her a great friend. While Cheval struggles with herself, Crown reassures her, and tells her that it's okay that she is different from her sisters. She sees the strength that Cheval has deep down, and they both get along well. They also train together from time to time. Vivlos- Vivlos hangs out with her on occasion, alongside Satono Diamond. Crown also tells Vivlos about the latest trends, much to her enjoyment. Kitasan Black- Friend. She's not very good at slurping up ramen noodles. She's not very good at slurping up ramen noodles. Appearance Satono Diamond has de-saturated, light brown hair, that flows far past her back. She has blunt side bangs that frame her face, accompanied by braids tied to the back of her head. In the center of her bangs, she has a large white diamond marking. Her ears are a bit longer, compared to many other Umamusume, and fade to dark brown at the tips. On her right ear, she has an elaborate cuff with a golden base, wrapped with dark brown lace with a small, light blue diamond attached. Accompanying the lace is a green and dark brown piece of ruffled ribbon, and underneath this is a white scalloped kerchief. She has large, round, golden eyes. Her race outfit consists of a green dress, decorated with intricate golden trim. In the center of her collar is a large white diamond with a brown, ruffled, ribbon underneath. Her dress is separated into many parts, the first being a small, cropped jacket with long sleeves that completely cover her hands. The sleeves have elaborate decoration at the end, consisting of golden embellishments, a layer of yellow ruffles, and a layer of white ruffles. Underneath the jacket is a white ruffled top, covered by a dark brown corset with yellow buttons. The skirt of her dress is green with golden decorations around the border, and black lace around the trim. She wears a black pair of leggings with a scalloped "V" shaped cutout, and golden embellishments. Her white boots flare out at the top, and have a diamond shaped cutout in the center, each boot having golden toes, with a small diamond in the middle. It's like an oyster that bore a pearl such as me!" She's taking on the whole world, ready to make the impossible look easy. An active older-sister type who insists on standing out and demonstrating that anything is possible on the world stage. Owing to the fact that she has lived in many countries growing up, she embodies confidence and unique methods of self-expression. She is a talented soul who can accomplish all she sets out to do while eliciting laughter from those around her. She has a hopeless grasp of the English language, but she does a good job of compensating for it with her body language. Self-IntroHohoho! Seeking the Pearl here! She can tell what shop a bento lunch is from just by looking at its contents. Appearance Seeking the Pearl has long, dark brown hair that dynamically cascades far past her back. A single strand of hair falls past her eyes. Atop her head she wears bright red sunglasses, and on her left ear is a red scrunchie, decorated with gray trim, and accessorized with a string of pearls and gold charms. Her eyes are purple, and she has a mole under her right eye. She wears lipstick, so her lips are noticeably fuller than other Umamusume. Her racing outfit consists of an off-shoulder red dress, with various white accents and gold trimming. The collar of the dress folds downwards, tied at the center with a white, red, and black ribbon, and she has two white stars on either side of her chest,  The dress' sleeves reach her lower arm, and puff out at the end. She wears a pair of black gloves with gold trimming, with a red band around her wrist. On her right arm is a pearl bracelet, and on her neck is a pearl necklace, with gold and purple gems. Underneath, she wears a cropped black tank top. Her white pleated skirt has a red stripe at the base, and a layer of black pleats underneath. She wears several decorative belts, one black, one white and red, and one purple and red. All meet in the  center of her waist, attached with an intricate golden buckle. She wears a pair of black heels, laced above the top line, with a golden toe box. She wears two pearl anklets and a red ribbon around her right ankle, and laced up her left shin is a thick red ribbon. Relationships Kawakami Princess- Roommate and friend. Stay Gold- Friend. They respect each other as fellow travelers. As they are both carefree, they get along well. Seeking the Pearl is also the only one that calls Stay Gold "Stay", showing a close friendship between them.[1] Mejiro Dober- Friend and rival. Pearl considers her a part of her "family", while Dober is intrigued by her eccentricities, and invites her to tea parties sometimes. Mejiro Bright- Friend and rival. Pearl also considers her a part of her "family". Grass Wonder- Friend and underclassman. El Condor Pasa- Friend and underclassman. As a fellow American, El deeply admires Pearl, and wishes to get on her level. Taiki Shuttle- Friend and rival. Pearl sees Taiki as a rival she must surpass, and feels an odd familiarity when around her. They both communicate to each other in English sometimes, with Pearl pretending that she is fluent.IRL, Seeking the Pearl and Taiki Shuttle were the first American-bred and Japanese-trained horses to win an international G1 in France. IRL, Seeking the Pearl and Taiki Shuttle were the first American-bred and Japanese-trained horses to win an international G1 in France. Shinko Windy- Friend. As a team, they call themselves "Worldwide Windy". Dream Journey- Friend. Pearl's dancing tends to exhaust Journey, and Journey can't handle Pearl's extroverted nature.[2] Hishi Akebono-  Friend. Akebono is inspired by Pearl's attitude, and it inspires her to pursue the possibilities of "Buono". King Halo- Friend. Media Appearances Umamusumeshi Umayon Event Appearances Let Those Cheers Roar! Appearance Seiun Sky embodies an easygoing lifestyle, reflected in her relaxed appearance. She has blue down-turned eyes with short, fluffy, muted green hair. Her right ear is adorned with a green cover featuring soft cloud patterns and fluffy white puffs (most likely to resemble clouds) at the base. She wears a bright yellow dandelion hair clip on the left side of her bangs. Her outfit complements her laid-back demeanor with a fashionably simple yet charming basic white blouse accented with subtle hints of green. The blouse features somewhat "wild" ruffles at the chest, sleeves, and waist, with the waistline flaring out in a skirt-like fashion. Paired with this are green shorts adorned with cute cloud-like patterns that echo the same design as her ear. A set of straps and a yellow-and-green band wrap her left thigh. She also wears a brown choker around her neck, decorated in the center with a silver horse-shoe shaped emblem. And finishing her look are basic gray heels, embellished with fluffy cloud-like puffs that, like her shorts, mirror the ones on her ear. Relationships Sakura Laurel- Friend and roommate. Laurel buys sunscreen for Sky, as Sky tends to get sunburns from fishing outside in the heat. Nishino Flower- Close friend. The two were very close in real life, had a foal together named Nishino Mirai[2], and were buried next to each other when they passed on. Appearance Shinko Windy has short brown  hair, with parts that curl up from the bottom. A white tuft sits at the center near her forehead, and above that lies a thick ahoge which angles to the left. Her head is framed by dark-brown patterns in her hair that could be likened to a pair of pincers, at the sides of her head. A white band with purple accents sits at the base of her right ear. Her eyes are a dark purple, but grow lighter near the bottom. Her sharp pupils are a darker shade of purple. Additionally, her teeth are pointy. Her race outfit consists of a purple cropped jacket bearing a fur collar, under the jacket is a black tattered top, resembling a long corset, cut off at the upper body. She wears a necklace adorned by sharp, fanged teeth. Her wrists, along with her ankles, are wrapped in a furry trim, which secures both her gloves and her boots. A series of black bands is tied around her left arm. Her black, cropped shorts are topped with fur trim at the thighs and side along with a purple studded belt with five fanged teeth at the buckle. She wears ripped tights secured to her legs by thigh garters. Her black boots have a purple trim at the flats of the feet. The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier. An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates withSpecial Weekand many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality. Appearance Suzuka has long, silky reddish-orange hair that cascades gracefully to her waist. Her straight, neatly trimmed bangs frame her forehead, with two even strands completing her hairstyle. She wears a simple white headband secured with a silver star accessory. Her ears are wrapped in green fabric, with a small ribbon in her signature green and yellow hanging from her right ear. Her vivid aqua-blue eyes complement her graceful demeanor. Her outfit features a collared white dress with puffy shoulders, highlighted by horizontal and vertical stripes in green and yellow. The sleeves transition into fitted green arm covers with button details and striped cuffs. Gold clasps run down the center of the dress, lending an elegant touch. A navy-blue ribbon tied into a bow at her neck is adorned with a golden star clip. And she wears a simple pair of black gloves on both hands. Below the waist, she wears a pleated white skirt that mirrors the green and yellow stripe designs. She pairs it with dark purple tights and mismatched heels—one white and one brown—each adorned with charming green ribbons. Relationships Special Week- Best friend and roommate. They met each other when they were assigned as roommates, and Suzuka later transferred to Spe's team. The two are teammates on both the anime-only team,Team Spica, and the game-only team,Team Sirius.While Special Week looks up to Suzuka, Suzuka often finds herself moved by Special Week’s earnestness and optimism. Special Week's presence helps Suzuka open up and find joy in racing beyond just the act of winning. When Suzuka suffers a major injury, Special Week was often there for her in the hospital to assist in her rehabilitation, while providing companionship and moral support.IRL, Both of them are sired bySunday Silence. Fukukitaru supports Suzuka in her racing career, though she wishes to surpass her. Suzuka doesn't understand her obsession with fortune and the supernatural, but enjoys her companionship. Taiki Shuttle- Friend. Taiki Shuttle is very competitive and loves racing against Suzuka, though she can sometimes let this friendship get in the way of her competitiveness. Suzuka also looks up to Taiki Shuttle, and is impressed by her speed and her ability to keep going no matter what. Taiki Shuttle is also very supportive, making sure to attend all of Silence Suzuka's races. Admire Vega- Friend. The two of them occasionally stargaze together. Stay Gold- Friend. As Stay Gold has memories of how the real Silence Suzuka was devastatingly injured during the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she looks out for her and her health. Even though she had appeared in the project before this date, her original character profile was uploaded to the officialTwitteraccount on February 18, 2018 as a part of a giveaway campaign.Her voice actress,Marika Kouno, was announced to be playing this role throughTwitteron July 27, 2017. Her voice actress,Marika Kouno, was announced to be playing this role throughTwitteron July 27, 2017. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:Her race outfits simplistic design was chosen due to the real horse being described as "a fast and functional beauty."The hood, bridle, browband, and ball tied to the mane of her real-life counterpart are incorporated to the design as her ear covers and various hair accessories.Her loafers are two different colors to represent the real horse having one brown hoof and one white hoof on his hind legs. Her race outfits simplistic design was chosen due to the real horse being described as "a fast and functional beauty." The hood, bridle, browband, and ball tied to the mane of her real-life counterpart are incorporated to the design as her ear covers and various hair accessories. Her loafers are two different colors to represent the real horse having one brown hoof and one white hoof on his hind legs. She is the only member ofTeam Spicawho never won one of the races of the Triple Crown or Triple Tiara. Despite the real life counterpart having a blaze, this was not incorporated into the Umamusume design. Her tendency to walk around in circles counterclockwise was adapted from the real horse, who used to spin in circles in the same direction when stressed. In her summer alternate outfit, it was Special Week who helped her out with her hairstyle. Despite their depictions as teammates in Umamusume, Special Week and Silence Suzuka never raced together in real life. They shared the same sire, Sunday Silence, and both ridden by jockey Yutaka Take.Yutaka Take was Silence Suzuka's jockey in the ill-fated 1998 Tenno Sho Autumn. A year later, he won the 1999 Tenno Sho Autumn with Special Week in record time.[2] Yutaka Take was Silence Suzuka's jockey in the ill-fated 1998 Tenno Sho Autumn. The top spot is mine for the taking." She's gonna be the biggest star in the world! A charismatic Umamusume of great ambitions. "The brightest star out there is Sirius." With unmatched confidence and the prowess to back it up, she dreams of winning big on the world stage. Her rough mannerisms and crude way of speaking exude a toughness and charisma that attracts many to her. She despises lies and ambiguity, so everyone knows that she means exactly what she says. In other words, she's a natural-born star in every sense. Self-IntroSirius Symboli, ready to go! There's no room for complaining in a race. Just keep silent and watch—I'm gonna win and prove that I'm the greatest in the world. Sirius Symboli, ready to go! There's no room for complaining in a race. Just keep silent and watch—I'm gonna win and prove that I'm the greatest in the world. She can't sleep without earplugs. TailIt has a habit of crumpling up when she's frustrated. It has a habit of crumpling up when she's frustrated. FamilyHer father signed her up for tutoring, and the tutor changed every day. Her father signed her up for tutoring, and the tutor changed every day. A verse from a poem. Before a Race...She kicks up from the floor, standing with all her strength. She kicks up from the floor, standing with all her strength. SecretsShe has a pilot license. She has a pilot license. She has several favorite pool halls, both inside and outside Japan. She has several favorite pool halls, both inside and outside Japan. Appearance Sirius Symboli has deep brown hair styled with a distinct flair: medium-length at the front and top, framing her face in a bob-like cut with a few wild strands jutting out, while the back flows dramatically down to below her waist. Her bangs are slightly parted and lean to the right, featuring a prominent white star streak at the center, a subtle nod to her namesake. Her sharp brows complement her vibrant red, piercing eyes. A golden accessory, intricately designed with her own unique markings, adorns one of her ears. At the top of her outfit, Sirius wears a choker adorned with a golden Fleur-de-Lis pendant, symbolizing royalty, perfection, and purity, a motif found across various cultures. Her dark teal jacket features a distinctive asymmetrical design: on the right side, it has a classic jacket structure with white sleeves and intricate markings along the hem that match the design of her earpiece. On the opposite side, a greyish-green, long-sleeve fitted shirt seamlessly integrates into the jacket, connected by a strap trimmed with white and orange and a star-shaped buckle at the shoulder. A smaller green strap wraps around her waist to connect the rest of the outfit. At her hands are fingerless gloves, each sporting a sleek cutout. Around her waist, Sirius wears a polished orange belt with golden buckles, with a decorative belt strap hanging down, continuing the extravagance of the Symboli's unique belts. Her pants are a sleek dark teal, cut just above the ankle, with the same markings seen on her jacket and earpiece running along the bottom. The pants feature a slit design, and at the slits, golden zippers with their sliders are visible. Finally, on her feet, she wears mismatched strapped heels with gold bottoms—one side is white, while the other is brown. Relationships Nakayama Festa- Friend and roommate. They both like to play games together, and they both like to gamble. As they are both like loners, they are like kindred spirits.In real life, both of them challenged the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, which could explain their connection. In real life, both of them challenged the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, which could explain their connection. Symboli Rudolf- Childhood friend and rival. Sirius has a very complicated relationship with Rudolf. As a child, Sirius looked up to Rudolf and nearly matched her in terms of running. Because of Rudolf's fierce running, Sirius was one of the only people who would run with her. Rudolf was Sirius' goal. As time went on, Sirius grew to dislike how Rudolf has become the Emperor. There are various reasons for why she dislikes Rudolf's Emperor persona. She believes that Rudolf has "lost her fangs," now that she has dedicated herself to being the Emperor. She dislikes how Rudolf has unnecessarily burdened herself with this duty.  Sirius also dislikes the way Rudolf runs Tracen. She thinks that she doesn't account for all the Umamusume that slip through the cracks and are born with unfortunate circumstances. Alongside everything else, Sirius hates being seen as someone to be guided by Rudolf. Sirius wants to shine brighter than Rudolf and overshadow her achievements, to the point of obsession. She even forgets her own goal of trying to become the brightest star in exchange for surpassing Rudolf. Mejiro Ramonu- Childhood friend and rival. Sirius and Ramonu understand each other well, as they both dislike running just for the sake of history or others, instead preferring to run for themselves. Sirius thinks Ramonu's desire to run with Rudolf is a sign of her having bad taste, and wishes she would choose her instead.Ramonu and Sirius share the same sire that being Mogami. Ramonu and Sirius share the same sire that being Mogami. She's always focused on looking cute while winning, and aims to be the center at every winning concert. She loves to interact with her fans and participates in any event that may serve as good publicity. Despite being a proficient dirt racer, she has a slight complex about being associated with the unsightly substance.[1] Self-IntroMy name's Smart Falcon, but you can call me Falco! Appearance Smart Falcon has almond-colored hair fastened into twintails with pink and purple checkered ribbons. On the right side of her hair, she wears three ribbons, which are purple, pink, and yellow. Her almond ears are small and come to a point at the tip, and her long almond tail is cut bluntly. She has yellow and amber-colored eyes. In her race outfit, the previously pink and purple ribbons are now pink and black, and the three ribbons are now dark purple, lavender, and pink. She wears a frilly white dress with short puffed sleeves, tied at the end with a black lace. Her frilled blouse is fastened with a black bow at the top, with a red gem in the center. On top of the blouse is a pair of red suspenders that hold up a pink corset, and a checkered pink and black skirt layer. In the center of the corset is a white patch of fabric, with two red bows in the center. On her left leg is a red garter belt with white frills. She wears two red knee-high socks with white frills at the top. Her shoes are multicolored white, red, pink, purple, and black sneakers tied with red laces. Relationships Eishin Flash- Friend and roommate. Eishin Flash takes on a manager-like role to Smart Falcon, helping her practice and schedule concerts. Flash is generally easygoing but will become strict when helping Smart Falcon practice, as she has a lot of potential and she truly believes in Smart Falcon becoming an amazing umadol. Curren Chan- Friend, specifically from dance practice. Smart Falcon, Curren Chan, and Eishin Flash often practice together. Curren Chan is also a big fan of Smart Falcon's career as an umadol. Furioso- Friend and rival. Smart Falcon instantly took interest in Furioso when they met, and despite Furioso trying to push her away, Smart Falcon was determined to make Furioso her friend. Falcon, Espoir, and Furioso would often practice together and over time, their friendship blossomed. Espoir City- Friends. Smart Falcon admires her guts and her boldness, and will often practice together with Furioso. Copano Rickey- Friend.IRL, Smart Falcon, Espoir City and Copano Rickey were all sired by Gold Allure. IRL, Smart Falcon, Espoir City and Copano Rickey were all sired by Gold Allure. Fuji Kiseki- Friend. Smart Falcon sees Fuji Kiseki as extremely pretty, and believes she is a "prince". She often helps Fuji Kiseki with her acting after school. Silence Suzuka- Friend and fellowRunaway Sister. Suzuka will often help Smart Falcon with her various umadol responsibilities and tasks, such as putting on concerts and fanmeets. Smart Falcon also looks up to Silence Suzuka, due to being such a great runner. She specifically desires to have the ability to run Turf Races, and sees Silence Suzuka as a mentor figure who can help teach her. She also feel it a great honor when fans call her the "Silence Suzuka of the Sand", though Suzuka herself is uncomfortable with the name, but does not outright disallow Falcon to use the name, just that she doesn't overuse it since it is embarrassing.IRL, both were frontrunning racehorses that had extraordinary undefeated streaks later in their careers and their jockey was Yutaka Take during said streaks. Mihono Bourbon- Friend and fellowRunaway Sister. Smart Falcon easily sees past Mihono Bourbon's cold persona, and thinks she has a heart of gold. Agnes Tachyon- Friend. Tachyon wishes to analyze Smart Falcon's potential for speed, as well as "the measurable difference in the effects of endorphins she secretes," in Tachyon's words. Smart Falcon takes Tachyon's interest in her as being a huge fan, and is flattered that Tachyon wants to study her so badly. Thus, Smart Falcon happily goes along with any tests Tachyon wishes to do on her, though Falcon will run away from said experiments when she realizes she is in danger. Symboli Rudolf- Friend and upperclassman. Due to having interest in the prosperity of all Umamusume, Rudolf respects Falcon due to the fact that the latter's efforts have increased the interest in dirt races, as Umamusume in those races are usually overlooked, and Falcon is honored when Rudolf personally congratulates her, and wishes to live up to her expectations. Agnes Digital- Friend. Smart Falcon appreciates the support Digital gives her when she performs for concerts. Falco notices her as a fan of hers, and Falco thinks that Digital's bow is cute, much to the latter's shock. Ines Fujin,Maruzensky- FellowRunaway Sisters. Light Hello- Friend. As they both hold the same dream to give thanks to their fans and supporters, Falco helps Hello with the Grand Live. Whoever she carries quickly falls asleep. Appearance Special Week has a short brown-purple bob, with white bangs that swoop slightly to her left. She has white braids tied around to the back of her hair, and short, stubby brown ears, with a purple bow on her right ear. Her round and cheery eyes are light purple. Her race outfit is very idol-like in appearance. Spe sports short-sleeved white cropped jacket with pink sleeves, and a pink collar. Underneath her coat is a white collar fastened with a dark purple ribbon, and a dark purple top underneath, fastened by two golden clover-shaped medals. She wears a white skirt with a prominent purple zig-zag pattern on the base, and a pink petticoat underneath. The tail-hole on the skirt has a large purple ribbon above it. She wears white thigh-high socks with pink lines at the top, with dark purple ribbons on either side. Both of her shoes are ankle boots with pink collars on the top. Her left shoe is dark purple, and her right is white. She wears two pink cuffs around her wrists. Relationships Silence Suzuka- Best friend, role model and roommate. Teammates on both the anime-only team,Team Spica, and the game-only team,Team Sirius. Special Week is shown to be enamored by Suzuka's running, looking up to her. Silence Suzuka was the first Umamusume Special Week met after moving from the countryside.IRL, although they never raced against each other, they shared a common jockey with Yutaka Take. Silence Suzuka competed from 1997 until his tragic death in November 1998, while Special Week raced from 1997 to 2000. They were connected as half-siblings (both sired by Sunday Silence), and were linked through the tragic 1998 Tenno Sho (Autumn); where Suzuka, ridden by their shared jockey, suffered a fatal leg fracture and was euthanized. Special Week won the same race one year later in 1999, breaking the course record. IRL, although they never raced against each other, they shared a common jockey with Yutaka Take. Silence Suzuka competed from 1997 until his tragic death in November 1998, while Special Week raced from 1997 to 2000. They were connected as half-siblings (both sired by Sunday Silence), and were linked through the tragic 1998 Tenno Sho (Autumn); where Suzuka, ridden by their shared jockey, suffered a fatal leg fracture and was euthanized. Special Week won the same race one year later in 1999, breaking the course record. Seiun Sky- Classmate, friend and rival. Sky's easygoing, "scheming" personality contrasts with Special Week's earnest, hardworking nature. Despite being rivals on the track, the two share a friendly relationship off the track as classmates and friends, with Seiun Sky visiting to encourage Special Week before major races and participating in group activities with their "Golden Generation" cohort. King Halo- Classmate, friend and rival. King Halo seems to enjoy Special Week's company, especially due to the fact that she aims to be Japan's best Umamusume, a goal King Halo gets some inspiration from as Special Week has won the Derby and the Japan Cup with those goals. El Condor Pasa- Classmate, friend and rival. Despite their competitive tension, both characters share the same passionate, energetic personality and similar goals; with El Condor Pasa with her luchadora confidence, aiming to be "the world's strongest Umamusume" and Special Week with her cheerful determination, aiming to be the "best Umamusume in Japan". Due to their similarly energetic personalities, El and Spe are very close friends, as El teaches Spe how to do special wrestling moves and how to name them, shares food sent from her family with her, such as cacti used with steak or as a smoothie, and even offered to share her strategy on how to beat Montjeu, who beat El in the Arc. El was also the one who taught Spe the French phrase she uses in the Japan Cup, though Spe is clueless about its actual meaning. Grass Wonder- Classmate, friend and rival. Grass Wonder uses her wisdom to give advice to Special Week, somewhat orienting her in her path towards her goal's realization. She also helps her in class studies, given that she's intelligent. Phalaenopsis- Friend and rival. Phalaeno helps Special Week with classic literature classes and tea ceremonies. Phalaeno also looks up to Special Week as a strong runner in their generation, and wants to surpass her.IRL, the two had a foal together named Ranunculus. IRL, the two had a foal together named Ranunculus. Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi- Classmate, friend and rival. Special Week often worries about Tsuyoshi's poor constitution which prevented the latter from racing. While Spe is friends with Tsuyoshi, she admittedly feels envious and frustrated when Tsuyoshi starts to win races, and feels like Tsuyoshi won't look up to her anymore. However, Spe and the others inspire Tsuyoshi to get stronger as a racer and become her rival, and Spe starts to take her seriously.IRL, Special Week, Seiun Sky, King Halo, El Condor Pasa, Grass Wonder, Phalaenopsis, and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi make up the Golden Generation, a group of horses that began racing in 1997 who dominated the majority of the Classics and their four year old races.Special Week, Seiun Sky and King Halo were rivals starting in their classic years up until the end of their racing careers.El Condor Pasa and Special Week only competed once at the 1998 Japan Cup, where El Condor Pasa won. El Condor Pasa is also one of the two Golden Generation horses that Special Week couldn't defeat, although he did defeatMontjeu, who bested El Condor Pasa in the Prix de l'Arc the Triomphe.Grass Wonder won against Special Week twice (the 1999 Takarazuka Kinen and Arima Kinen), with the second race being by a four-way photo shoot and ultimately resulting on Special Week's defeat by a nose. This meant that he was one of the two horses that Special Week never defeated. On retirement, they were placed next to each other in the same farm after retirement, but Special Week purportedly did not like Grass Wonder much.Despite having a late start in his career, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi triumphed over Special Week in the 1999 Kyoto Daishoten, which created an upset. Even though she had appeared in the project before this date, her original character profile was uploaded to the officialTwitteraccount on January 11, 2017.Her voice actress,Azumi Waki, was announced to be voicing Special Week throughTwitteron July 20, 2017. Unlike the majority of Umamusume who take many of the quirks and qualities of the horses they are based on, the Umamusume Special Week drastically differs from the real life Special Week, possibly due to the fact that Special Week is considered the mascot of the franchise, and such changes had to be made to make her more marketable.While she is portrayed as an optimistic, idealistic, naive and silly countryside girl who is friendly with other Umamusume who makes an effort in maintaining friendships with one another, the real life Special Week was a loner who was indifferent to his own kind, only friendly to humans.Special Week looks up to Silence Suzuka as a role model. In real life however, the two horses never once met in their lifetime. Their interactions were based on their real life counterparts being ridden by Yutaka Take, and possibly for the reason that they were both sired by Sunday Silence, even though horses that only share a sire aren't considered siblings.Despite being known to eat a lot in the Umamusume universe, her real life counterpart wasn't known to be a glutton. Their interactions were based on their real life counterparts being ridden by Yutaka Take, and possibly for the reason that they were both sired by Sunday Silence, even though horses that only share a sire aren't considered siblings. Despite being known to eat a lot in the Umamusume universe, her real life counterpart wasn't known to be a glutton. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:The golden four-leaf clover accessories on her race outfit references her real-life counterpart's four G1 wins.The same four-leaf clover accessory is present in Umamusume who are descended by Special Week such as Cesario, Buena Vista andEpiphaneia.A differently-designed four-leaf clover is present onEfforia's race outfit. This is to indicate that Efforia is a descendant of Special Week's, but is a sire-line descendant instead of dam-line descendant. This is not the case onDaring Tact's race outfit as she doesn't have a four-leaf clover, however, leaving her as the odd one out.Due to the real horse nicknamed the "Supreme Commander of Japan", the four-leaf clover is similar to akamon, which shares a similar design to the Ikeda clan's family crest which is also a four-leaf clover crest.Retaining the white and purple color scheme, the zig-zag design at the hem of her skirt are reminiscent of the zig-zag design seen in her jockey's silks.Similarly, the reason her boots have purple folds at the top is because of her jockey's purple racing pants and boots with a purple upper section. The golden four-leaf clover accessories on her race outfit references her real-life counterpart's four G1 wins.The same four-leaf clover accessory is present in Umamusume who are descended by Special Week such as Cesario, Buena Vista andEpiphaneia.A differently-designed four-leaf clover is present onEfforia's race outfit. The same four-leaf clover accessory is present in Umamusume who are descended by Special Week such as Cesario, Buena Vista andEpiphaneia.A differently-designed four-leaf clover is present onEfforia's race outfit. This is to indicate that Efforia is a descendant of Special Week's, but is a sire-line descendant instead of dam-line descendant. This is not the case onDaring Tact's race outfit as she doesn't have a four-leaf clover, however, leaving her as the odd one out. A differently-designed four-leaf clover is present onEfforia's race outfit. This is to indicate that Efforia is a descendant of Special Week's, but is a sire-line descendant instead of dam-line descendant. This is not the case onDaring Tact's race outfit as she doesn't have a four-leaf clover, however, leaving her as the odd one out. Due to the real horse nicknamed the "Supreme Commander of Japan", the four-leaf clover is similar to akamon, which shares a similar design to the Ikeda clan's family crest which is also a four-leaf clover crest. Retaining the white and purple color scheme, the zig-zag design at the hem of her skirt are reminiscent of the zig-zag design seen in her jockey's silks. Similarly, the reason her boots have purple folds at the top is because of her jockey's purple racing pants and boots with a purple upper section. Despite many Umamusume whose IRL counterparts were born from Hokkaido, Special Week is one of the few Umamusume that speaks with Hokkaido's accent. Other Umamusume who speak with the accent includeHokko Tarumae. Don't you think so, too?" Full of curiosity, and loves traveling like no other. She likes to make reckless travel plans and wander about whenever she feels like, not to return for a long while more often than not. At the academy, she is the subject of admiration for many Umamusume who is on the quirkier side, drawn in by her aloof and philosophical character. "Strangely enough, there's something about her that makes it hard not to adore her", or so they say. Appearance Stay Gold has deep brown hair that slowly fades into a light ochre at the tips, her tail following the same pattern. She has a white marking with the shape of a diamond with a thin wake from the bottom of her center bangs all the way to near the top of her head. Her ears are covered by black ear cuffs adorned with gold decorations. Her right ear is more decorated than her left one, with two aquamarine beads and a feather connected to the cuff. Her half-lidded eyes have rosewood pupils which progressively turn to a golden color; she has barely visible eyebags. Her race outfit consists of an untucked white button-up shirt beneath a sandy yellow trench coat, which is heavily worn out at the bottom and has blue armbands attached below each shoulder. The coat has pockets at waist-length on both sides and black belts with gold buckles strapped around the shoulders, chest, and above the cuffs. She wears black leather gloves, the left one being fingerless, and she has a pair of aviation goggles around her neck. She wears a black body harness going over her chest and waist that has a glass flask and a black hunting knife attached. She wears torn black pants with a small silver buckle and a patch of gray fabric to the right of her waist, adorned with a golden compass. She wears black, laced knee-high flight boots with golden toe boxes. Relationships Silence Suzuka,Mejiro Bright, andMatikanefukukitaru- Friends and rivals of the same generation. Stay Gold feels a strong fated connection with them, and treasures their relationship.Both Matikanefukukitaru and Stay Gold enjoy each others' eccentricities. Stay Gold trusts Fukukitaru regarding the supernatural, and she goes to her for a makeshift exorcism in her SSR Guts card.[3]Fukukitaru respects Stay Gold as a friend and rival, and even gets upset when she "ditches" her to run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in Stay Gold's career.[4]As Stay Gold has memories of how the real Silence Suzuka was devastatingly injured during the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she looks out for her and her health. Seeking the Pearl is also the only one that calls Stay Gold "Stay", showing a close friendship between them.[6]IRL, Seeking the Pearl was the first American-bred, Japanese-trained horse to win an international G1 race while Stay Gold was the 1st Japanese-bred and trained horse to win an international G1 race. Dream Journey- Friend. Dream Journey refers to Stay Gold as "Anego" (Big Sis, commonly used by Yakuza to refer to the wife/female relative of the boss).[7]Dream Journey has known Stay Gold for a long time, and greatly admires her not just as a racer but as a friend. Ever since she watched the Japan Cup, Dream Journey has admired Stay Gold, and was inspired to race because of her. Dream Journey likes the unpredictable side of her, and wants Stay Gold to continue being herself and stay carefree. Stay Gold thinks that Dream Journey is a good person, as she always cares for everyone. Stay Gold also appears to enjoy Dream Journey's tea.[8]Stay Gold also invites Dream Journey to travel with her sometimes, like on Dream Journey's birthday. Orfevre- Friend. Orfevre appears to respect Stay Gold’s opinions and has sought her perspective on certain matters.[7]Stay Gold is also the only person asides from Dream Journey that calls her "Oru", showing a closeness between them. Despite Orfevre's frustration that Stay Gold leaves all the time, she is eager to listen when she tells stories about her travels. Stay Gold also brushes Orfevre's tail on occasion.[9] Nakayama Festa- Friend. She refers to Stay Gold as "Stego"[7]. She bets on whether or not Stay Gold will get her souvenirs from her trips, as she always wants some. Like Orfevre, her eyes widen when Stay Gold tells her stories about her travels. Fenomeno- Friend.  Stay Gold watches her races from the sidelines alongside Mejiro McQueen. Gold Ship- Friend and roommate. Gold Ship also watches Stay Gold's races, as before Stay Gold was implemented, Gold Ship was said to have cried when a certain "silver-medal Umamusume" won her first G1 race overseas, which is a reference to Stay Gold. I... I'm not worthy of any more introduction... I like to... keep those things to myself...” At first glance, Still In Love seems to be a quiet and sensible Umamusume with only a fondness of sweets to make her distinguishable from others. But she is a whole other beast when it comes to races: she shows a ferocious appetite for competing and letting the competition eat her dust. Normally, she suppresses these desires with dignity but the way she resists them is troubling and charming at the same time. Appearance Still in Love has long auburn hair that falls well past her waist. She has a white streak of hair in the center of her bangs. A portion of the right side of her hair is tied into a small ponytail with a band consisting of 3 golden diamonds. Wrapped around the back of her hair is red ribbon with golden trimming. Her ominous, half-lidded eyes are bright red, with a dark red ring around her pupil. She is normally seen wearing a white veil with red outline and blue ear covers wrapped in red straps, with the left ear straps having a gold trim and tied with a ribbon. On the back of her veil, there are two gold-trimmed ribbons crossing each other starting from each ears which extends until her front side, and a heart-shaped ring at the center of the ribbons' intersection. Underneath her veil, her ears are of the same color as her hair. Still in Love's racing uniform consists of a red dress with intricate golden heart designs on the skirt. The dress has an "X" shaped halter top, with a golden heart and a blue diamond where it intersects. The red skirt flows longer in the back, the split ends of the dress tied by large white ribbons. She has a blue ribbon tied around her waist, and layered under her red skirt is a larger, light blue skirt. Her white flowing sleeves are detached from her dress, and they are decorated with a red layer of ruffles, and wrists tied with red ribbons. Aside from her left ring fingernail, which has red nail polish, her fingernails remain unpainted. Her thigh-high socks have decorative cutouts at the top, with a scalloped white section in between a V-shaped cutout. She has red strings tied around both of her legs, and wears laced, red ballet flats with a gold trim. Relationships Neo Universe- Roommate and friend. Neo Universe knows about Still in Love's "alter ego," but doesn't seem to mind it. She is shown to be supportive towards Still in Love, often offering her advice and hearing her out. Sometimes, they stargaze and observe the night sky together. Admire Groove- Rival. Still in Love's "alter ego" is especially fired up about racing with her, going as far as to chase after her and call her "her prey." The two are shown to be opposites; while Still in Love is full of warmth and love, Admire Groove rejects love and mentions being "cold" inside. Despite Admire Groove being the favorite in all three Triple Tiara races, it's Still in Love who wins them. Admire Groove is visibly upset about losing to Still in Love, which makes Still in Love wonder why Admire Groove dislikes her so much. Still in Love seems to respect Admire Groove a lot, especially after witnessing how many people cheer her on and root for her. Zenno Rob Roy- Friend and classmate. Both Still in Love and Zenno Rob Roy are soft-spoken and often go unnoticed, and the two find companionship in their joint love of reading.IRL, Still in Love, Neo Universe, Admire Groove, and Zenno Rob Roy are all horses from the same 2003 generation.While Neo Universe became a Double Crown champion on that year, Still in Love was that year's Triple Tiara champion. IRL, Still in Love, Neo Universe, Admire Groove, and Zenno Rob Roy are all horses from the same 2003 generation.While Neo Universe became a Double Crown champion on that year, Still in Love was that year's Triple Tiara champion. While Neo Universe became a Double Crown champion on that year, Still in Love was that year's Triple Tiara champion. Mejiro Ramonu- Rival. Before Still in Love, Mejiro Ramonu was the first one to win the Triple Tiara. At the beginning of Still in Love's career, her trainer says Mejiro Ramonu was truly dazzling, which makes Still in Love jealous. After Mejiro Ramonu teases her about that, going as far as to imply she'd "steal" her trainer, Still in Love sets her sights on being the second Triple Tiara winner in history.Mejiro Ramonu became the first Triple Tiara champion while the Queen Elizabeth II Cup was still the final leg, while Still in Love became the second Triple Tiara champion while the Shuka Sho is the final leg. Mejiro Ramonu became the first Triple Tiara champion while the Queen Elizabeth II Cup was still the final leg, while Still in Love became the second Triple Tiara champion while the Shuka Sho is the final leg. Hokko Tarumae- Friend. Still in Love and Hokko Tarumae share a passion for sweets, and Hokko Tarumae sometimes makes some for her.[1]While Hokko Tarumae can sometimes find Still in Love's intensity unnerving, she finds Still in Love's mannerisms cute and wants to learn from her cuteness.[2]They have gone golfing together.[3]IRL, they were both jockeyed by Miyuki Hideaki in all but five of Hokko Tarumae's races. IRL, they were both jockeyed by Miyuki Hideaki in all but five of Hokko Tarumae's races. Sweep Tosho- Friend. Sweep Tosho mistakes Still in Love for a vampire due to her alter ego, and takes it upon herself to help her with what she mistakes as blood-drinking urges[4], as well as keeping her out of direct sunlight[5]. Manhattan Cafe- Friend. They drink coffee together, and discuss how to brew it to perfection. Kiseki- Friend. Kiseki helps her with updating her social media, since Still in Love doesn't use it very often.[6]IRL, Still in Love and Kiseki were Shimokobe Farm's first G1-winning filly and colt respectively. She was then fully announced during the 3rd AnniversaryPakaLive TVstream on February 22nd, 2024. They are also reminded to keep an eye on their physical condition as they play. Admire Groove wins it, and the spectators start talking about how she will probably win the Shuka Sho.[11]This is a direct reference to thereal life 2003 Rose Stakes (GII), a preliminary race for the Shuka Sho. This is a reference to the IRL Still in Love's final race, the 2005 Fuchu Himba stakes, which shares the same number and placement. In No Reason's career, Still in Love appears to ask No Reason to take a member of her family who is interested in the Soma Nomaoi under her wing.[12]This is a reference to the IRL Still in Love's only foal, Judah, who participated in the Soma Nomaoi after he retired from racing.[13] In the event that Still in Love wins the Complete Triple Tiara in her career (Fillies' Revue, Flora Stakes, and Rose Stakes in addition to the Triple Tiara), an unnamed Umamusume with bluish hair approaches Still in Love and her trainer to congratulate Still in Love and ask the trainer to also guide her in the future. She comments that Still in Love and the trainer seem like they've been tied together by the red thread of fate. This Umamusume is a reference toAkai Ito(whose name refers to said red thread of fate), who won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup with Miyuki Hideaki as her jockey in 2021.[14] Asides from liking coffee, she also likes tea, as she makes iced lemon tea.[15] Her appearance in Party Dash is referenced in Umamusume, as she shown competing in various mini games based off the game withDaiwa Scarlet,Vodka,Aston Machan, and Sweep Tosho.[16] She shows a dislike for crowds, since they make her uncomfortable.[17] Student Introduction ContinueDismiss External Links ↑Still in Love Homescreen Conversation: Slice of Life 5 ↑Still in Love Homescreen Conversation: Happy Birthday!
