Appearance Creek’s hair is a deep, brownish auburn, kept in an extra long braid that reaches below her back, with the end tied by a large black ruffle. The sides of her hair curl up, framing her face, with strands of hair reaching just above her shoulder. She wears another braid above her forehead, with a single white strand of hair passing through her braid. Over her right ear, she wears a cerulean bow, with four silver circles arranged in a diamond shape in the center. Her blue down-turned eyes showcase her gentle and motherly personality. Her racing uniform is simple, yet feels elegant. For starters, she wears a dark blue scarf around her neck. She wears a flowing dress with tank-top sleeves. The dress itself is light blue, with the center being white. The dress is split down the middle, both sides with framed with silver-blue trim, buttoned up by three distinct dark blue clasps, with blue diamonds on either side. Underneath her dress is a white tube dress, the top embellished with blue gemstones. As for accessories, she wears a dark blue bow around her tail, and around her waist is a dark blue purse with an intricate design on the front, featuring a silver emblem with blue gemstones, as well as two strings of pearls underneath. She wears a pair of thigh-high boots, each shoe having two diamond-shaped cutouts, with blue gems and silver trimming. Her right shoe is solid blue, whereas the right fades into a light gray gradient. Relationships Narita Taishin- Roommate. Initially, the two of the got off on the wrong foot due to Taishin's hostility, but they somewhat got along over time, with Creek valuing Taishin's personal feeling, and Taishin respecting Creek. Tamamo Cross- Friend. Creek tends to try and coddle Tamamo due to her size, to the latter's annoyance. Inari One- Friend and rival. Part of the "Heisei Big Three". Similar to Tamamo, Creek also tends to coddle Inari, also to the latter's annoyance. Oguri Cap- Friend and rival. Part of the "Heisei Big Three". Creek and Oguri seem to get along really well to the point that there is hardly any competitiveness between them despite them being rivals. Maruzensky- Friend. Mejiro Ardan- Friend. They get along well. She looks out for her, and even helps her with games since Ardan had to miss out on most of them as a child. Gold Ship- Friend. Fumino Nase- Super Creek's Trainer inCinderella Gray. Fumino would be flustered if Creek says any praise towards her, leaving her blushing hard. In her classic year, Super Creek will getUnder the Weather- a debuff that gives her a flat 5% fail rate in training after racing in the Sumire Stakes until she wins the Kikuka Sho, making her Career Mode very likely to experience failures. Ironically, despite her motherly personality in Umamusume, the real life Super Creek wasn't well known for his breeding success. In fact, he sired no graded race winners, and was the damsire of only one G3 winner.[2] Super Creek's motherly personality is likely a reference to how in real life, Super Creek andYutaka Take, his main jockey, had a close bond and was said to be the horse that "nurtured" Take to become the prodigious jockey he is today. This is also shown in Cinderella Gray, where her trainer Fumino Nase acts caring towards Super Creek and vice versa.[3]Take would win his first of many G1s with Super Creek, the 1988 Kikuka Sho.[4]He has since ridden and won with many other Umamusume in the series. 'Cause I'm Magical Girl Sweepy!" A totally spoiled brat! She swears she'll be a witch someday! A stubborn grandma's girl, she aspires to one day become a magical girl. Hoping to match her grandmother, a self-proclaimed witch, in magical prowess, she truly believes that if she keeps on winning races, her magic will also level up in turn. Since she's still learning magic, she often falls back on the good old-fashioned way of solving problems—with force. When she starts crying, it's hard to get her to stop. She names each and every one of her plushies. Appearance Sweep Tosho has striking violet eyes. She has notably sharp eyebrows, and auburn hair that cascades into soft, uneven bangs. Her signature braids are styled into elegant loops, and she has flowing twintails that are adorned with gleaming gold and crimson ornaments at the ends. Her witch’s cap, a most treasured gift from her grandmother, features golden bands and ear pockets tailored for her ears tipped with the same ornaments you can find on her hair and capped off with a cute red ribbon. However, the ears on her hat are fake and merely decorative, and move in sync with her actual ears inside the hat. Her robe has a black exterior that contrasts with a rich purple lining, golden embroidery stitched down along the hem, and seamlessly blending with a striking red and yellow diamond pattern that can also be seen near her chest. Her open robe is fastened at the top and cinched by two belts—one practical, one decorative—and it reveals a red cardigan over a shirt and tie. She also wears white gloves with her outfit. And finally, she wears a layered white skirt with red trims, and thigh-high black boots capped with golden heels. Relationships Air Groove- Upperclassman. Sweep sees Air Groove quite often for disciplinary concerns. While Air Groove is strict with her, she sees great potential in Sweep as a racer. Though she initially views her as just an underclassman, she changes her approach when seeing Sweep's strong running and treats her as an equal. Despite her behavior, Sweep has respect for her deep down. Fuji Kiseki- Upperclassman. Dubbed the wizard to Sweep's witch for handling her mischievousness and seemingly always being one step ahead of her. She also tries to encourage Sweep to eat her vegetables, much to the latter's dismay. Kitasan Black- Friend. She is seen hanging out with Sweep, and shows genuine interest in her magic. I am indebted to the Symboli family. As a Symboli, I will carry out the objective I have set, and the mission I have been given." A foreign-born, taciturn missionary. She is a taciturn, emotionless foreign exchange student who places the utmost importance on efficiency and winning percentage in racing. Appearance Symboli Kris S has a dark brown hair with side-swept bangs covering her forehead and a twin tail ponytail at her back. On her right ear, she wears an earring that resembles a dagger having a cross and a blue-colored kite diamond. On the left side of her head, she wears a silver laurel hair pin. Her eyes is a cyan-blue with wide thin eyebrows, a thicker eyelash on top and a smaller eyelash at the bottom. Both of the eyebrows and eyelashes being colored dark brown. She is one of taller Umamusume at Tracen Academy, with the height of 170cm. Her G1 racewear consists of a dark green clothing with gold embossing on the sides of the clothing, representing the Symboli family. She wears a cropped military jacket, having the same dark green clothing with gold embossing, dark  strips on the sides before the gold embossing, 4 gold-colored buttons strapped on each of the 4 dark green striped fasteners on the top of jacket, and a gold diamond-shaped clasp center with an ivory-colored ruffle in the center to hold the jacket in place. The right shoulder of her racewear has a golden shoulder pad with a piece of black cloth containing a light gray embossment a red tail attachment with a gold head hooked into the upper side of the shoulder pad. She wears black gloves that have gold stripes adorned on them. Her short top is ivory-colored (matching the ivory frills on her jacket) embossed with a gray design with two connecting diamonds on the center part of the top mixed with several crescent shapes on the sides of the design, resembling her personal emblem that sits high on the chest part of her short top. Her shorts is dark green to match the military design, with 4 gold polished golden buttons aligned on its sides. Tied to her shorts is a black belt with a gold buckle, gold stripes on the top and bottom sides, and a laurel-like emblem in the center. A black strap with a gold-plated buckle wraps around her left thigh. She wears navy knee-high boots that are colored black embossed with gold stripe design at the top ends. The upper part of the boots contains two belts, each having a golden buckle and a gold diamond next to it, on each side. The bottom of the boots contain an outsole with the same golden buckle belt design attached above the ladder grip, made to hold both the upper part and outsole of the boot in place. On the bottommost part of the boots, they contain a golden plate on each side in the front end and a high heel at the rear end of the boots. Relationships Zenno Rob Roy- Friend, underclassman, and mentee. Rob Roy deeply admires Kris S, and wants to emulate her. She is one of the reasons why she wants to take on the Triple Crown route, especially the Derby. She looks up to her strength and her quiet demeanor. Kris S, though not very sociable, acknowledges Rob Roy as a strong racer, and they both train and spend time together. Rob Roy also finds Kris S' ears cute and fluffy.IRL, Symboli Kris S andZenno Rob Royraced together once in the 2003 Arima Kinen, where Symboli Kris S won by nine lengths. Her secret pleasure is challenging herself to stamp documents with perfect precision, no smudges. Tracen Academy's student council president. Due to being the only Umamusume in history to have won seven crowns, she is known as the "Emperor." Even after her retirement, her authority remains unshaken. Although she exudes a dignified aura, she also has a bit of a playful side.[2] Appearance Symboli Rudolf has light brown hair that reaches below her waist, with the front of her hair being dark brown. And two large strands of hair lay on either side of her shoulders.  On each side of her bangs, a large strand of hair reaches down and loosely frames her face, with the center of her bangs being a patch of hair. And a cream white streak of hair is curved to the left side of her face, that starts in the left side of her bangs. Her horse ears have slight fluff on the sides, with the tips fading to a dark brown. Her right horse ear has a large teal crystal, silver frame ear ring on the right side of the base of her ear. Her eyes are a light magenta. Her attire commands both respect and awe, embodying the militaristic style and color scheme of the Symboli family. She dons a white button-up shirt with a cravat underneath a dark green jacket with silver buttons, draped with a large golden sash. Three golden medal ribbons adorn the jacket's right lapel, while four silver medals arranged in a diamond formation are fastened to the jacket's lower left side. An epaulet graces her left shoulder, decorated by a long aiguillette and a red cape draped over her back, adding to her imperial presence. The sleeves are embellished with golden, arrow-shaped embroidery and a jagged black zig-zag pattern at the cuffs. To further continue the Symboli lineage, she wears a large, striped leather belt with a silver, cross-shaped centerpiece. She wears a dark green skirt with an elegant ruffled hemline. Her black stockings feature the same golden arrow patterns found on her sleeves, and she wears black heels with gold buckles and buttons. Relationships Tokai Teio- Underclassman. Rudolf is Tokai Teio’s ultimate idol. Rudolf also enjoys spending time talking with Teio, and often has Teio assist with tasks. Having witnessed Rudolf’s legendary undefeated Triple Crown run as a child, Teio’s primary motivation was to follow in her footsteps. While Rudolf serves as the stoic and authoritative Student Council President for the student body, she displays a noticeably softer, "parental" concern for Teio. Teio almost exclusively refers to Rudolf as "Kaicho" (President) and models her career goals entirely on Rudolf’s legacy. Inseason 1, Teio is introduced as Rudolf's devoted follower, often seen by her side or seeking her approval. Rudolf is shown quietly encouraging Teio's potential, viewing her as a candidate who could match her own achievements. Their relationship dynamic deepens inseason 2, as when Teio faces career threatening injuries, Rudolf quietly supports her recovery and ultimate comeback. As Teio preps for her return in the Arima Kinen, Rudolf calls out her name and quietly cries tears of pride when Teio's victory is confirmed. Their bond is reinforced through shared costume design elements (cape, epaulettes and cravats, arrow motifs) and numerous affectionate interactions across the Umamusume franchise.IRL, Symboli Rudolf is Teio's sire (father). Tokai Teio, foaled in 1988, was named with the word "Teio" (帝王, meaning "monarch") specifically in reference to his father's imperial title, "Emperor" (皇帝, Kōtei).  This naming convention reflected the high expectations placed upon him as Rudolf's most successful offspring. Both horses shared incredible careers and historical parallels. Teio won the Japan Cup in 1992, exactly seven years after his father won the same race in 1985. Teio also was jockeyed by Yukio Okabe, the same jockey who rode Symboli Rudolf to his Triple Crown victories, creating another layer of continuity between father and son. Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi- Underclassman. Similar to Teio, Tsuyoshi also idolizes Rudolf, and wishes to be a Triple Crown winner as well, though her condition is a persistent obstacle to that goal. Rudolf is also one of the few people to just call her Tsuyoshi, as others simply call her Tsuru.IRL, as with Tokai Teio, Symboli Rudolf is also Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's sire. IRL, as with Tokai Teio, Symboli Rudolf is also Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's sire. Air Groove- Friend and student council co-member. Teammates on the anime-only team,Team Rigil. Symboli Rudolf and Air Groove form the core leadership duo of Tracen Academy's student council, with Rudolf serving as President and Air Groove as Vice President. A recurring element of their interactions involves Rudolf making elaborate puns that Air Groove struggles to comprehend fast enough, leading to comedic frustration directed at herself rather than Rudolf. Despite this, Air Groove deeply respects Rudolf's leadership and the two work closely together in managing the student body.IRL, The two horses never raced against each other, as Rudolf retired in 1985 and Air Groove began racing a decade later in 1995. IRL, The two horses never raced against each other, as Rudolf retired in 1985 and Air Groove began racing a decade later in 1995. Narita Brian- Fellow student council co-member. Teammates on the anime-only team,Team Rigil. Symboli Rudolf and Narita Brian serve as President and Vice President respectively of Tracen Academy's student council, forming part of the institution's core leadership alongside Air Groove. Rudolf and Brian run Tracen's student council as President and Vice President, working alongside Air Groove as part of the school's leadership team. Both belong to Team Rigil, though their dynamic is more professional than personal. There is mutual respect rather than much warmth. Rudolf apparently handpicked Brian for the role because she represents pure racing talent and potential. In Rudolf's eyes, Brian has what it takes to eventually step up as the academy's next standard-bearer.IRL, Symboli Rudolf and Narita Brian had no biological relationship. The two horses never competed against each other either, as Rudolf retired in 1985, six years before Narita Brian's birth. Both, however, achieved the prestigious Triple Crown. The two horses also experienced career-altering injuries. Rudolf's international race injury led to retirement, while Brian's hip joint disease and subsequent tendonitis stopped what could have been an even more dominant career. This shared "what if" element adds a layer to their relationship in the series, as both understand the fragility of greatness and the burden of unfulfilled potential. Spe truly respects Rudolf as an undefeated Triple Crown champion and President. Rudolf also finds Spe's earnest hard working personality and optimism admirable and expects great things from her. Mr. C.B.- Rival. Rudolf has displayed jealousy towards Mr. C.B.'s charismatic, free-spirited popularity. Mr. C.B. also maintains an "unbounded" racing philosophy that diverges with Rudolf's disciplined style and authority. Both are recognized as champions who defined their era. Mr. C.B. frequently appears in a trio withKatsuragi Aceand Rudolf, creating a dynamic where Rudolf's dignified composure clashes with Mr. C.B.'s impulsive nature. Despite their rivalry, moments of mutual respect pop up, especially when mentoring younger generations of racers.IRL - A rare occurrence of back-to-back Triple Crown winners, with Mr. C.B. bearing the 1983 Triple Crown and Rudolf, the 1984 Triple Crown. The consecutive victories marked the first time since Shinzan's 1964 triumph that the sport had produced Triple Crown winners in successive years. These back to back accomplishments created enormous anticipation for their matchups. They raced against each other a few times, each time Rudolf beating out or placing higher than Mr. C.B. Katsuragi Ace- Rival. Rudolf places great respect on Ace for delivering her first defeat, considering her a worthy rival who provided essential lessons in humility. The two share a comedic dynamic as they love making puns together, with Ace being receptive to Rudolf's wordplay. While Ace "admires Mr. C.B.", her relationship with Rudolf is different. Rudolf represents the "ultimate standard she must overcome".IRL - Symboli Rudolf and Katsuragi Ace were fierce rivals whose confrontations shaped the drama and importance of the 1984 Japanese racing season. Katsuragi Ace was the first horse to ever break Symboli Rudolf's winstreak, and they both ran against each other twice, in the Japan Cup of 1984 and the Arima Kinen of the same year, with Ace winning the Japan Cup and Rudolf winning the Arima Kinen. Mejiro Ramonu- Childhood friend and rival. Rudolf is dedicated to Ramonu and is willing to do anything for her. She says that Ramonu could summon her with just one phone call. Rudolf says that she would become perfect for Ramonu's happiness. Ramonu's persistence to run as a child despite her weak legs deeply impacted Rudolf and her desire to become the Emperor. When they were young, Ramonu's comment on how it's natural to give everything for what you want made her consider that she must leave everything behind to fulfill her goal as the Emperor. Rudolf wants Ramonu to stand alongside her in creating a better future for Umamusume, which contrasts with Ramonu's goal of standing alongside Rudolf only in races. Rudolf believes that as the first Triple Tiara, Ramonu could be truly valuable in her efforts to create a world where all Umamusume can be happy.IRL, Symboli Rudolf and Mejiro Ramonu were bred together and had a foal named Mejiro Rivera, whom was titled the "Ten-Crown Foal" due to the combined G1 wins her parents had. Though Mejiro Rivera only raced in her maiden race, lost and never raced furthermore. Though Mejiro Rivera only raced in her maiden race, lost and never raced furthermore. Sirius Symboli- Childhood friend and rival. Despite their messy relationship and tendency to get into arguments, Rudolf deeply values Sirius and wishes to mend their relationship. Sirius and Rudolf grew up as childhood friends, where Sirius was one of the only people that wanted to run with her. Sirius sincerely admired Rudolf, but as they grew up, Sirius grew distant from Rudolf due to the latter becoming the Emperor and abandoning her former self. Sirius believes that Rudolf lost her edge, and doesn't run the same rough way as Sirius liked. She also hates how Rudolf runs Tracen, and she believes that Rudolf couldn't possibly care for every student who slip through the cracks. They are both at odds in beliefs, as Sirius wants to help the outcasts in Tracen despite breaking the rules, while Rudolf wants to help in a stricter way. Sirius wants to prioritize the individual runners who need extra support rather than every student at Tracen like Rudolf does. Seeing as how Sirius values independence more than anything, she dislikes being seen as someone to be guided by Rudolf. Sirius wants to surpass Rudolf as a racer and outshine her, to the point where she forgets her own goal of becoming the brightest star. Rudolf loves racing with Sirius, and even asks to race with her one more time before Sirius leaves to go abroad for 2 years. Rudolf sends a letter to Sirius, saying that although she feels some frustration that Sirius surpassed her, she's still happy for her. She writes that Sirius was special for her strength in always believing in her own path, and that running with her sometimes saved her.[3] Maruzensky- Teammates on the anime-only team,Team Rigil. Friend and advisor onCinderella Gray. Unlike with many of the other Umamusume, Rudolf acts differently around Maruzensky because she finds the latter fascinating, bringing out her instincts as a racer. They share a unique advisor-confidante relationship. The franchise emphasizes their complementary dynamic, with Rudolf as formal and idealistic, burdened by the responsibility of creating "a world where all Umamusume can live in true happiness." Maruzensky, despite her own legendary credentials, takes a more laid-back approach, speaking in an old-fashioned, casual manner and treating interactions with a relaxed, sisterly warmth. This can be seen more prominently inCinderella Gray, where Maruzensky playfully challenges Rudolf, grounding her idealistic ambitions while supporting her decisions as Student Council President, though both have a mutual understanding of the burden of legendary status and unfulfilled potential. Maruzensky's firsthand experience with discriminatory racing regulations also fuels Rudolf's drive to reform URA rules, giving her efforts a personal edge.IRL, the two horses never faced each other, as they raced in different eras. However, both horses share thematic parallels that make their pairing in Umamusume quite meaningful. Rudolf's undefeated Triple Crown campaign in 1984 coincided with a pivotal moment in racing history, the lifting of Japan's foreign-bred horse restriction. The barrier that had defined and confined Maruzensky's career. Maruzensky retired undefeated in all races he was permitted to enter, but was forever denied the opportunity to compete for the sport's most prestigious titles. This creates a powerful symbolic connection between the two, as Rudolf became the beneficiary of a racing system that was beginning to open up, while Maruzensky had been the victim of that same system's restrictive past. This parallel would seep into the two's dynamic in the franchise. IRL, the two horses never faced each other, as they raced in different eras. I am the star of this play, and it shall be known the world over as a masterpiece!" The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room! An opera queen who's so self-absorbed, it's comical. Her mannerisms are over-the-top, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She truly believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She is admired byMeisho Doto. Self-IntroMuahahaha! She's been using the same hand mirror daily since elementary school. Appearance T.M. Opera O has short, light orange-colored hair with tufts that rise up and curl. The left side of her bangs exposes most of her forehead, while the left covers it. She wears a gold-pink crown on the top of her head, and her ears each bear two golden ornaments clipped on, the ones on her right ear have green jewel inserts. Her purple eyes surround her small ringed pupils. Opera O's race attire is truly fit for a king, with many golden flourishes, such as her pauldrons, plackart, and gauntlets. Her top is a long-sleeved white garment with golden trim, that is cropped at the stomach and with sleeves that tuck into her gauntlets. She wears seven golden rings on her fingers. Two medals adorn her torso, and a necklace with ribbons and other baubles sits on top. She wears a pink cape with gold trim, and various ribbons on the back. Her skirt is two-toned, with white and pink stripes that alternate. A golden belt with ornaments ties it down, with a green streak furling down onto and across it from her stomach plate. She wears white thigh socks bearing a pink stripe on each leg. Golden greaves lie at her ankles with a unique spiral design, sitting just above her boots. Relationships Meisho Doto- Best friend and rival. Doto and Opera O are seen together quite often, with Opera O being a shining light to Doto's less confident demeanor. Opera O sees Doto as one of her truest rivals, and she is the only one she does not use honorifics for. Doto also tries to imitate Opera O from time to time so that she can boost her confidence.In real life, they were competitive rivals in the early 2000's with Opera O claiming 1st place over Doto many times. In real life, they were competitive rivals in the early 2000's with Opera O claiming 1st place over Doto many times. Biwa Hayahide- Roommate. Supposedly, Opera O is not the best student, so Hayahide helps her with her studies. Air Shakur- Mutual acquaintances. Shakur, on record, has called Opera O a clown, and views her as annoying compared to how reserved Doto - Shakur's roommate - is Haru Urara- Friends, as fellow believers of the "Never Give Up" attitude... with varying levels of success.Urara was in the same generation as Opera O. Because of Opera O's odd attitude, it inspires Rob Roy into becoming more confident and assertive like her.In real life, both of them won the Senior Autumn Triple Crown, which consists of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), the Japan Cup, and the Arima Kinen. A friendly girl born in the U.S. A cowgirl with a heart as big as her might. As friendly as they come, she's one heck of a hug machine. She tends to get lonely, however, so perhaps that's why she's one heck of a party planner too! Specializing in sprints, her powerful dash has even caught the eye of her friend,Silence Suzuka. Self-IntroHowdy! Taiki Shuttle here! I'm aimin' to put smiles on some faces with some hard runnin'! Howdy! Taiki Shuttle here! I'm aimin' to put smiles on some faces with some hard runnin'! LikesPositive thinking Positive thinking DislikesBeing alone Being alone EarsShe comes running the second she hears "party" She comes running the second she hears "party" TailShe uses a tail spray sent by the folks back home She uses a tail spray sent by the folks back home FamilyWelcome-home fireworks are always at the ready for her Welcome-home fireworks are always at the ready for her Personal RuleBakes using her mother's recipes Bakes using her mother's recipes Phone BackgroundA photo of her with her family and their sheepdogs A photo of her with her family and their sheepdogs Before a Race...She kisses a photo of her folks and sisters She kisses a photo of her folks and sisters Best SubjectsEnglish (Except she's told to work hard in her other subjects) English (Except she's told to work hard in her other subjects) Humble BragAt her parents' farm, she's well-liked by the sheep At her parents' farm, she's well-liked by the sheep Frequent BuysKetchup, wrapping supplies Ketchup, wrapping supplies SecretsShe's the reigning quick draw competition champion. She's the reigning quick draw competition champion. At barbecues, she likes to eat the hamburger last. At barbecues, she likes to eat the hamburger last. Appearance Taiki Shuttle has wavy golden-blonde hair tied back in a wild and messy ponytail by a star-shaped metallic-green hair clip. Her sidelocks curl and wave in a similar fashion to her ponytail. Instead of her ornament, a green star that matches her ponytail clip, being affixed to her ear itself, she has it pinned to her hair just below her right ear. Her ears have darker blonde interiors, and a slightly fluffy texture. Her round and expressive eyes are a sky-blue hue. Taiki Shuttle's racing outfit features a cowboy western aesthetic. A red scarf bandana is tied around her neck, with a brown rawhide Stetson cowboy hat slung over her back. She wears a bright green tied top over a dark green bikini top, leaving her shoulders and midriff exposed, with a pair of matching bright green cuffs sit around her upper arms to act as detached sleeves. She wears long brown leather gloves on both hands, the likes of which reach to her mid-forearms. A brown leather belt with silver edges and a silver buckle is slung around her waist; a brown leather half-skirt with fringe extends from the belt down her right hip. Opposite the half skirt is a leather pistol holster with a silver revolver in the sling (which is presumably functional, given her history of being a quickdraw champion, as well as her skill animation featuring her using the revolver to shoot a coin). Beneath the belt, Taiki Shuttle wears a bright green ruffled short skirt with white lace frills at the edge, as well as three white stars emblazoned on the left side of the skirt. She wears dark purple thigh-high stockings under a pair of knee-length brown leather high-heeled western boots. The boots feature criss-crossed dark leather lacings in 'X' patterns at the top, with long fringe frills right below them, as well as brass vamps. Taiki Shuttle's old design was largely identical to her current design, with the exception of her sleeve cuffs; in the original design, they were attached to her top, and had a broader line detailing at the top that formed a pseudo-collar on her top. Relationships Silence Suzuka- Friend and rival. Taiki Shuttle is very competitive and loves racing against Suzuka, though she can sometimes let this friendship get in the way of her competitiveness. Suzuka also looks up to Taiki Shuttle, and is impressed by her speed and her ability to keep going no matter what. Taiki Shuttle is also very supportive, making sure to attend all of Silence Suzuka's races. Matikanefukukitaru- Friend. Despite Taiki understanding Japanese, Fukukitaru tries to accommodate her by communicating to her in English, albeit poorly. I'm the White Lightning of Naniwa!" Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of! A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life. She grew up in a less fortunate environment, but her power comes from her persistent spirit—you won't find much getting her down. She and the effortlessly funnyOguri Capmake for a good comedic duo.[1] Self-IntroI'm Tamamo Cross! I'm gonna race my butt off and make a name for myself! She's a purist about making takoyaki and cooks them on a gas stove. An Umamusume with a strong Kansai dialect, active in the Central's Twinkle Series. She may be small-statured, but she boasts incredible skills, as she is described as "the strongest active Umamusume". Ever since she sawOguri Caprunning in Kasamatsu, she has been conscious of her due to Oguri being a fellow gray Umamusume.[2] A Proud Osaka Girl At Heart, Tho' I'm Small, My Effort And Guts Are Risin'! Appearance Tama has long gray hair that curls up into spikes at the ends. Each fringe of her bangs comes to a neat point at the end. She wears red ear covers, with a red and blue ball on her right ear, and a red headband around her forehead. On top of her head, she wears another blue and red headband, and at the end of either side are golden clips with long red and blue tassels attached at the end. She has large blue eyes, and a snaggle tooth on the left side of her mouth. For her race outfit, she wears a blue cropped sports bra with a red band, and a white lightning bolt on the center. She also wears white pants with a red stripe on either seam, and the ends are cuffed just under her knee. She wears a blue belt on the belt loop, and a red and white striped belt hanging off one side of her hip. Over top of this outfit, she wears a blue jacket with red trimming and a red collar, with the kanji "疾風迅雷" (Shippuujinrai"Swift Thunderclap") written on it and separated into half on each sleeve. She has white gloves with a blue lightning-bolt pattern on either hand. Over top of her red socks, she wears blue high-top sneakers with red heels and white laces, and the sneakers have a white lightning pattern. Relationships Oguri Cap- Friend, rival, and roommate. Tamamo usually tends to look after Oguri due to the latter's obliviousness and naivete, and is usually the one that Oguri comes to for advice. Tamamo lit a fire in Oguri when it came to racing, and they both get fired up when competing against each other. While Tamamo gets exasperated by Oguri's airheaded nature from time to time, she still genuinely cares for her as a friend. Oguri also appreciates her friendship, and would even eat less if Tamamo said she couldn't buy her a lot of food for her birthday.The two had an incredibly heated rivalry together in real life, even though they only fought thrice. They first encountered each other in the 1988 Tenno Sho (Autumn), where Tamamo Cross defeated Oguri Cap. In the 1988 Japan Cup, they both lost, though Tamamo was a place above Oguri. In their final race together, the 1988 Arima Kinen, Oguri Cap surged past Tamamo Cross and defeated him for the first and final time. I'm in search of the ideal "me". I have no intention of cheating myself in my current sate. Demolish it, kick it down― and keep fighting until the end!" Get drunk on her aesthetic! Peaky Aesthetic God of Destruction. She has a unique aesthetic and acts in accordance with it. There is a golden ornament fixed onto her right ear. Her race outfit consists of a yellow sleeveless undershirt with a flared collar, a ruffled blue striped top, and a navy-blue vest decorated with gold baubles atop them. A teal neckpiece resembling a tie hangs at her neck, under a choker adorned with a jewel. A pair of navy-blue sleeves with white and gold accents are attached to the undershirt with straps. The white gloves and soles of the boots reflect the markings on the motif horse's legs, while the black arm cover and boots are taken from his dark coat color. As she often kicks and breaks fences as the "God of Destruction" in Umamusume, she is given long, sturdy looking boots to hope to protect her legs. In her career story, the term "MC Rotation", used to describe running both the NHK Mile Cup and the Japanese Derby back-to-back, is a reference to the real term "Matsukuni Route". This term is based on how trainer Kunihide Matsuda would train horses like Tanino Gimlet and King Kamehameha, where he would make them run both the NHK Mile Cup and the Japanese Derby to test their strength. Appearance Tap Dance City is tall and has shoulder-length brown hair with a red and blue dyed braid. On her right ear is a goldenshachihokodecoration. She has light purple eyes with blue highlights to them. Her racing outfit includes a red top with white stripes, a navy top section, and white belts accented on the sleeves and around the neck to attach to her blue corset. She wears a sweeping white skirt over a dark purple or deep navy bottom, that slowly fades into a bright red when it reaches the far end. The white skirt has gold-yellow designs and patterns, resembling stars and decorative flourishes, visible particularly around the bottom edge and center. Her legs are covered in black tights, and she is wearing white and light blue tap dancing shoes with a golden cleat attached. She also shows off bright red gloves that fade into a darker maroon to match her sleeves that have the same gradient. Relationships Daitaku Helios- Roommate. Appearance Tokai Teio has chestnut brown hair styled into a neat ponytail, tied with a vibrant pink ribbon. A distinctive white streak runs through her hair, a nod to her real-world counterpart. Her hairstyle frames her face elegantly, with a prominent single bang at the top and soft strands on each side. Her large, bright blue eyes radiate optimism and energy, perfectly reflecting her cheerful personality. Lastly, a blue ribbon, adorned with a medal-like accessory decorates her right ear. Her outfit is a chip off the old block. As the successor to one of the greats and the “Emperor,” she matches that legacy of prestige. Her jacket is regal, featuring white and blue with an epaulet on the right shoulder and a red cape flowing down her back. Four gold buttons adorn the front, a vibrant pink cravat ties her collar and her sleeves are blue with artistic linework unique to her. Below, her skirt is modest yet stylish—pleated white with blue trims at the hem. Her knee-high white boots, cutely tied with ribbons, complete the look. Relationships Mayano Top Gun- Roommate. Mayano tends to tease Teio about her not knowing anything about love, much to Teio's dismay.IRL, both horses were ridden by the jockey Seiki Tabara. Both characters' motivation for enrolling in Tracen is so that they can surpass a role model of theirs. Zephyr also looks out for Teio, and empathizes with her when she gets her fractures.In real life, Tokai Teio was sired by Symboli Rudolf, while Yamanin Zephyr was sired by Nihon Pillow Winner. Teio aimed to remain undefeated, while McQueen sought to defend her title for a consecutive win. McQueen and Teio share with each other mutual support through hardships, with McQueen’s continued excellence on the track served as Teio's primary motivation to return to racing, and when McQueen suffered a serious injury and believed she could never race again, Teio promised to show her a "miracle". Teio's iconic victory at the Arima Kinen was a direct tribute to McQueen, proving to her that recovery and success are possible, regardless of the odds. Even though she had appeared in the project before this date, her original character profile was uploaded to the officialTwitteraccount on February 18th, 2018 as a part of a giveaway campaign.Her voice actress,Machico, was announced to be voicing Teio throughTwitteron August 3rd, 2017. Her voice actress,Machico, was announced to be voicing Teio throughTwitteron August 3rd, 2017. Her initial setting was more hostile than what we see now, which can be seen inSeason 1of the anime through her relationship withMejiro McQueen. Although the famous "Teio Step" is shown in the anime as a way to show off before a race, in real life, if a horse walked like this, it would be assumed that they may have an injury. Teio was allowed to continue running was because of his physical flexibility, which is also mentioned in the anime. When the Umamusume project was first announced,Anju Inamiwas supposed to be Teio's voice actress, although this was later changed to the current one, Machico. It is assumed that this was because of the former's activities with Love Live. "Umamusume: Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.1" explains why her character designer made specific choices when designing her in relation to her real-life counterpart, which were as follows:The reason she wears a cape is to mimic that of Symboli Rudolf's race outfit, as Symboli Rudolf is her father in real life.Due to her real life counterpart's jockey's silks (which can be foundhere) being white with a blue zig-zag in the center, the sash down her racing outfit is zig-zag shaped.The four buttons on her race outfit represent her four G1 wins. The reason she wears a cape is to mimic that of Symboli Rudolf's race outfit, as Symboli Rudolf is her father in real life. Due to her real life counterpart's jockey's silks (which can be foundhere) being white with a blue zig-zag in the center, the sash down her racing outfit is zig-zag shaped. The four buttons on her race outfit represent her four G1 wins. She listens to classical music to help her sleep, since she thinks it's boring. She is good at arcade games, like dancing games. Her back-length twin tails fade into a lighter brown at the tips. She has rounded ears, with two diamond-shaped jewels on her left ear, one in royal blue, and the other in turquoise. Her right ear has a golden cusp around it, with a de-saturated dark blue ribbon attached to it. Her round eyes are light gray, and she has long eyelashes. Jordan's nails are always painted a plethora of colors. Jordan's race outfit has a black cropped jacket, with teal and white decorations on the torso. On her sleeves, a purple stripe goes down the back, with the text "TOSEN JORDAN" repeated between the black and purple sections of the sleeve. Underneath her jacket she wears a cropped turquoise and blue diamond-patterned tank top, with a fishnet shirt layered underneath. She wears a purple belt around her neck like a choker, and has a golden diamond-shaped necklace atop of that. She wears a short black miniskirt with two galaxy-pattern cutouts on the front of her legs. It is held up by a lavender belt adorned with gold accessories. She wears a silver watch on her left wrist, and a light blue bracelet on her right. On her left leg, she has a black thigh-high sock with a blue to purple diamond gradient pattern, and a pink band on the top. On her right leg, she wears a knee-high fishnet stocking, with a blue and purple band around her thigh, with a heart emblem in the center. She wears sneakers that say "JORDAN" on the tongue, her left shoe being turquoise and blue, and her right shoe is lavender and white. Relationships Gold City- Best friend and classmate. City is someone Jordan not only deeply cherishes, but also admires as well (at times to the point of jealousy). She may not realize it, but she is a rare presence who City can be authentically herself around, a safe space. Though their relationship began on the rocks due to Jordan's inability to read the mood, with time the two of them became completely inseparable. They may have communication breakdowns but the two of them always bounce back. The two gals are always there for each other no matter what, both looking out for each other during their respective hard times. Jordan also gets help from City in her studies (given City is a star student and Jordan is a rather poor one). Nakayama Festa- Friend, classmate, and rival. The somewhat unsophisticated Jordan often finds herself perplexed by Nakayama's esoteric turns of phrase. In fact, she doesn't understand Nakayama at all, which leads to her to have complex feelings of jealousy towards her. With time, Jordan comes to grow into a bonafide rival and aims to surpass her, finding inspiration in her tenacity and following in her footsteps (in turn inspiring Nakayama as well, both of them becoming each other's hope). The two of them are very friendly, participating in bets and challenges for fun frequently. Jordan rarely refuses Nakayama's challenges, as she is a gal who hates to lose. Overall they have a strong, profound bond as companions who keep each other in check.They are part of the same 2009 generation along with Buena Vista and Red Desire. They had little overlap during their careers due to Tosen Jordan suffering from chronic cracked hoof before the Classics and Nakayama Festa focusing on overseas races later in his career, but they raced once, at 2009's Chunichi Shimbun Hai. They are part of the same 2009 generation along with Buena Vista and Red Desire. They had little overlap during their careers due to Tosen Jordan suffering from chronic cracked hoof before the Classics and Nakayama Festa focusing on overseas races later in his career, but they raced once, at 2009's Chunichi Shimbun Hai. Gold Ship- Rival and friend. If Gold Ship had a list of targets to mess around with, Jordan would be high up on it. Gold Ship never tires of performing all manner of pranks on her, justifying it by citing that Jordan always gives the best and most entertaining reactions. Given Jordan is a nice girl, she is quite gullible, and will usually believe Gold Ship quickly with enough social engineering. Given how much she gets troubled by Gold Ship, she makes it a point to get so strong that she'll never lose to her again. Despite all of this, she continues to try to be kind to Gold Ship, and even offers to paint Gold Ship's nails on her birthday, showing that despite their feuds, there isn't any actual bad blood between the two of them.Not only did they have quite the overlap in their racing careers in real life, but Gold Ship also famously disliked the fact that Tosen Jordan presided as the stable boss at Ikee Stables (the two of them were both trained by Ikee Yasutoshi). Off the track, Jordan attempts to appeal to the strict and straight laced Flash by offering to give her gal makeovers. Such offers are always swiftly and politely turned down, as expected.Eishin Flash is from the 2010 generation, one year Tosen Jordan's junior. If the two of them are talking, Jordan is usually close to crawling out of her skin from cringe due to the sheer difference in what the two of them find to be worthy pastimes. We can do that over a batch of newly made sweets.” I want to be thrilled! An informant seeking the unknown. Transcend is an information-savvy Umamusume who loves delving into subcultures. She has a keen eye for the latest gadgets and her curiosity about what's new and cool always thrills her everyday. An excellent communicator, Transcend has the ability to pop into any group and join their conversation, hungry for the information she might find out. Appearance Transcend has rust-colored hair styled in a sharply-cut bob, with her sidelocks framing her face, and her blunt bangs slightly curving downwards towards her sidelocks. The rust-colored portion of her hair transitions into a jagged gradient as it goes upwards, becoming a dark brown at the top of her head, and has a white diamond-shaped blaze in the front center, which thins into a wispy 'tail' as it reaches her bangs. Her short, round ears are the same dark brown as the top of her hair, and her right ear is ornamented with a black cloth band, which in turn is wrapped and tied in a bow by a red string lace. Transcend wears red lense-less glasses that complement her reddish-pink eyes. Transcend takes her glasses off while racing. Transcend's racing outfit prominently features a loose techwear hooded jacket. The jacket itself is mainly a bright turquoise shade with white accents on the torso, lower edge, and collar, and has a white hood that Transcend keeps lowered. The outermost section of the sleeves from the shoulder-down are black, and features 'TRANSCEND' printed in blocky white text on both arms. Several red strap belts are present as part of the jacket; two sets form X's on both sides of her torso, her sleeves have one on each bicep area, and another wrapped several times around the bottom portion of her sleeves, with the end dangling past her arms. Transcend wears a black form-fitting turtleneck sweater under her jacket, with a white-and-cyan accessory around her neck that resembles a pair of headphones. She has a red-and-black fanny pack with four pin buttons with various designs on it slung across her chest, and wears a pair of black fingerless gloves. She wears black shorts under an asymmetric pleated skirt that only hangs on her right side, and wears similarly-asymmetric leg garters with an intact left garter and a torn right garter. A red lace similar to the one on her ear ornament is wrapped around her left thigh. She also wears black techwear boots, with her right boot having white straps and accents, and her left boot being completely black. Relationships Wonder Acute- Roommate, friend, and rival. Acute isn't very good at things like technology and Transcend often helps her out with tech related issues. The two are close though and Transcend remarks that she believes Wonder Acute has the ability to be the best of the best. Smart Falcon- Friend and rival. Transcend admires her ability as an Umadol and thinks she has a lot of potential. Furioso- Friend and rival. Transcend remarks how Furioso has an "honor student" vibe to her and takes interest in how other students seem to avoid her. Transcend doesn't think Furioso is actually scary, just serious and focused on running and her studies. Espoir City- Friend and rival. Transcend thinks she's a bit cocky, but knows she's pure of heart. The two often go to watch races together, and Transcend remarks about how one time Espoir seemed startled by the intensity of the giant trackside screen, noting how it seems like Espoir seems to have a sensitive side to her as well. Curren Chan- Friend. The two get along well, and Transcend often gives Curren Chan info on things like trends and new overseas smartphone releases.In real life, they were both trained by Takayuki Yasuda. In real life, they were both trained by Takayuki Yasuda. Mihono Bourbon- Classmates. Transcend tries and helps with Mihono Bourbon's inability to use technology correctly to no avail. Red Desire- Friend. From time to time, Desire hands Transcend snacks. Transcend also gets surprised by Red Desire's hidden strength on dirt tracks, since she usually runs on turf.[1] Rulership- Friend and rival. On the left side of her bangs is a red zig-zag shaped hair ornament, and on her right ear is a silver charm wrapped around her ear. Underneath her right ear she wears a hair-clip, featuring a yellow circle, with gray wings coming off the top. She has de-saturated light-purple eyes, and small but thick eyebrows. Her racing uniform consists of a multi-colored purple, black, and red outfit. The top portion of her outfit is a dark purple sleeveless coat overlaid with golden trim and accents around the fabric's perimeter, and a red interior fabric, and attached to the ends of the coat are several golden diamonds. The jacket is clasped in the center with a golden corded rope. She wears a black high-neck top, with a triangle shaped cutout at the neckline. Let's race, right now! Hey! You listenin' to me?!" Turbo boost! This wild charger knows no limits! A student brimming with youthful energy who just wants to run, run, run like crazy! She doesn't really know her own limits yet, so she has a tendency to hit them full-force, but she seems to be enjoying life on the wild side. She's a bit immature compared to the other runners her age, and she can be a bit selfish, but it's hard to fault her honest, whimsical personality. Self-IntroTwin Turbo here about to take first place! Let's go! Turbo booost! Twin Turbo here about to take first place! Let's go! Turbo booost! When she uses eye drops, she opens her mouth for some reason. When she uses eye drops, she opens her mouth for some reason. Appearance Turbo sports vibrant blue hair styled into dramatic twin tails, secured by bold black-and-white striped ribbons. Her twin tails flow outward into curly waves, almost elegant and would be if she wasn't unhinged. Her bangs are wildly messy, with strands curling at the ends and a prominent, sorta chaotic and giant bang. Turbo’s eyes showcase heterochromia, with one eye purple and the other blue, both featuring a mesmerizing swirly pattern. Her ears are equally unique, sporting a teal, ridged, and futuristic design on the inside. To cap it off are these sharp, shark-like teeth of hers, fortunately she doesn't bite people unlike a certain other student in the same dorm. Her outfit is uniquely her own, a vibrant futuristic streetwear style, something rarely seen amongst the girls. She wears an oversized hoodie that explodes with a chaotic mix of black, white, purple, and green. A large star emblem dominates the center, while the word “!SPREE!” runs boldly down both sleeves. What truly sets it apart, though, are the four gears embedded into the design—not just printed details but actual, tangible components, as if they hold some mysterious mechanical purpose. On her torso is a blue and white plush rabbit. Her leggings are equally distinctive. They’re sleek, form-fitting, and paneled, resembling a futuristic bodysuit. With a slight metallic sheen, they appear to adapt and cling to her legs, enhancing her abilities as she races at full speed—almost like a second skin designed for maximum performance. Finally, her shoes are a wild and innovative design. They’re bright yellow with striking blue energy-like linings, possibly representing an energy indicator. On either side, they featureTwin Turboexhaust-pipes. Relationships Nice Nature- Friend, classmate and teammate on the anime-only team,Team Canopus. They met each other in one of Tokai Teio's races, and have remained friends ever since.In Twin Turbo's character story, Nice Nature even helps Turbo's trainer convince her to train when she doesn't want to. She is good at video editing, but she doesn't know whether to pursue it as a career or continue racing. She often falls after winning a race due to exhaustion, which references the Runaway running style requiring much more stamina to keep the lead by a large margin. Character Design Notes fromUmamusume Pretty Derby Artworks Vol.3:From the hood's colors of the motif horse, her hair color is blue, and the green stripes in the ear also reflect the ear cover's patterns.From the character's desire for speed, her inner wear is one that resembles a swimmer's or a speed skater's.From the name "Twin Turbo", her shoes have two accessories that are inspired by a car's exhaust pipe on each side. From the hood's colors of the motif horse, her hair color is blue, and the green stripes in the ear also reflect the ear cover's patterns. From the character's desire for speed, her inner wear is one that resembles a swimmer's or a speed skater's. From the name "Twin Turbo", her shoes have two accessories that are inspired by a car's exhaust pipe on each side. Twin Turbo is one of the three characters in the Umamusume cast that has heterochromia, alongsideAdmire GrooveandForever Young. In the game's lobby, she is one of the few Umamusume who skips her steps in a upbeat manner. Other Umamusume who do this includeHaru Urara,Daitaku Helios,Vivlos, andSonon Elfie. Twin Turbo is one of the few Umamusume in the game to not have her personality entirely based on the real horse. While Twin Turbo is extroverted and loud, Twin Turbo in real life was known to be quiet despite his front-running style in races.[1]In addition, the Umamusume Twin Turbo loves the front-running style as she loves to apply full force straight up in races, but the real Twin Turbo does so because he was scared of other horses. I refuse to give up until I conquer everything, and become the queen." Arise to your worthy title of "Queen". A celebrity Umamusume with a determined spirit. She is a confident young lady who takes pride in the fact that she deserves the title of "Queen," which is the highest position in the world. She is the eldest of three sisters and strives to set a good example for both of her sisters. She has been given a high-level education in a wealthy family and is very talented and accomplished. However, she has been cursed by the number "2", and has a difficult time winning. Appearance Verxina has long, dark indigo hair with a white diamond in the middle of her bangs. Her ears are short and round, and on her right ear she has two teal ear piercings. On her left ear she wears a black ear cover, she also sports a dark blue sailor cap that fades into turquoise, decorated with gold trim, as well as her family's crest, a golden anchor. Attached to the hat is a dangling circle earring with a white X-shaped gemstone in the center, and a blue gemstone at the end. Her eyes are dark purple, fading into light blue at the bottom, and she has a mole under her right eye. Her racing uniform is a stylish outfit with multiple layers. She wears a blue and gold detachable collar(collar-type choker) with golden ornament around her neck. The top of her dress is a rich blue, with a straight across neckline, folded in a "V" shape at the center to reveal a black piece of fabric. Around her waist is a black corset with four gold buttons in the center. Verxina has asymmetrical sleeves, her right arm being bare with a dark blue cuff around her wrist, and her left arm covered with a white half-jacket, and full dark blue sleeve, attached is a turquoise cape that fades into pastel green. She has a layered skirt, the top half being dark blue with golden decor, underneath that is light turquoise translucent fabric that fades into pastel green. Attached to the dark blue section is a blue gradient strap that reads "VERXINA" in white lettering, with a golden "V" emblem at the end. The final layer is a dark blue pleated skirt, each pleat decorated with two light-gray chevrons. She wears plain black tights, and a copper bracelet composed of four-pointed stars around her left ankle. Her court shoes are plain, with golden heels and fan decorations in the center, however the left one is white, whereas the right is blue. Relationships Cheval Grand- Younger sister. They share similar adversities in their racing careers, despite taking different routes in their classic years. Because Verxina took the Tiara route and not the Crown route like Cheval, she struggles to help her and give her advice like she does with Vivlos, though she admires the strength Cheval has inside. Cheval feels frustration towards her and Vivlos internally, because she feels weak compared to both of them. Vivlos- Youngest sister. She looks up to Verxina as a role model and shares her celebrity like personality. She was even inspired to take on the Triple Tiara route because of her, since Verxina constantly got beaten byGentildonnain that route. She vows to take revenge by entering the Tiara route, even at the risk of her health. On Verxina's end, she tends to pamper Vivlos the most, and wants what's best for her. She is also extremely protective of Vivlos, as she vows to not forgive the trainer if Vivlos ever gets hurt during her racing career because of them.[1]They both go shopping together, and are around each other a lot.IRL, Verxina, Cheval Grand, and Vivlos are all foaled by Halwa Sweet.Verxina and Vivlos are both sired by Deep Impact, thus making them full sisters, whereas Cheval Grand was sired by Heart's Cry.Vivlos eventually won the Shuka Sho in 2016, a race Verxina came 2nd in during her career, finally claiming them a tiara race victory. That is my wish." An Umamusume with a pure and warm heart who dislikes loneliness or solitude. If she sees anyone troubled by such woes, she'll run up to them right away and keep company until their heart has connected to hope. This act of hers is described as "angelic" by many, or so they say. Her hobbies are stargazing and appreciating art. She never misses when playing Quoits. Appearance Victoire Pisa has very long, curly light-blonde hair that flows below her waist; she has two long bangs framing her face extending below her shoulders. On her right ear is a white ear cover with a frilled, blue-and-white striped bow. She also has a left side ponytail fastened by a frilly white hair tie with blue accents. Her eyes are a vivid gradient, beginning in a magenta color before transitioning into purple and a lighter cyan nearing the bottom. For her race outfit, Victoire Pisa wears a white backless dress while donning a white beret decorated with gold trim, which features a ribbon tied into a large bow and fastened by a gold button at the back. She wears a red neckerchief with blue and white stripes around her collar underneath a black nylon underlayer that covers her neckline. She wears a primarily white bodice with navy blue accents on the lapels and down the front of the chest, with gold trim, buttons, and ornamentation resembling vines on the lapels. Her detached white sleeves are secured by navy blue cuffs adorned with the same ornamentation on her bodice; the sleeves are puffier at the ends, decorated with a small blue bow and a layer of frills, before tapering into thinner golden cuffs with red and navy blue stripes and white gloves. The bows on her outfit transition from a dark to a vibrant blue color with a glittering starscape pattern along the ends, which form into pairs of wings. Below her bodice is a long, multi-tiered skirt. The first layer consists of white pleated fabric with a golden border and navy blue lining. The skirt itself is primarily white, just above ankle-length, and flares to form an opening down the front while secured by a pair of ornate gold aiguillettes. A long, banner-shaped piece of fabric with alternating white and navy blue stripes drapes over the opening of the skirt, revealing a navy blue petticoat underneath. The skirt is decorated in a golden trim and stylized vine ornamentation, as well as a hemline adorned with red and navy blue stripes. Underneath the skirt, she wears black pantyhose and high-heeled, navy blue shoes with hazel-colored toe boxes and laces; the left shoe has a white cuff with a navy blue border, while the right shoe has the opposite. Relationships Sounds of Earth- Roommate. Earth recommends concerts to Pisa, while Pisa recommends art exhibitions to her. Pisa also enjoys Earth's music. Neo Universe- Friend. They often stargaze together. Pisa also understands Universe's speech very well.IRL, Victoire Pisa and Sounds of Earth were both sired by Neo Universe. IRL, Victoire Pisa and Sounds of Earth were both sired by Neo Universe. Eishin Flash- Friend and rival. Pisa looks up to her, as Flash is able to connect people through her victories in races. They get along well, and they train together. Rose Kingdom- Friend and rival. While at first, Rose is closed off, Pisa reaches out to her, and shows her that friendship and connection is a good thing. They get along well, and they train together from time to time. Rulership- Friend and rival. Victoire Pisa tends to comfort Rulership when she's in a weakened mental state. Rulership looks up to Pisa, and is somewhat envious of her good qualities, such as her kindness. She also views Pisa as inspiring, and was brought to tears when Pisa won the Dubai World Cup.[1]In real life, Eishin Flash, Rose Kingdom, Rulership and Victoire Pisa were rivals throughout their careers, starting with their classic years.Rulership and Victoire Pisa were also stablemates at Sumii Stable while they were active. Red Desire finds Pisa's angelic behavior inspiring and saint-like, while Pisa views her as a sweet and helpful friend. Red Desire is also considerate of the games they play together, as she actively takes out connection puzzles so that Pisa won't be upset. Vivlos is a devilishly cute young lady. She's the youngest of three sisters, and has been a spoiled brat since she was a child, because of her family's wealth. She has been fascinated by Dubai since she went there on vacation, and longed to live a celebrity life in a luxurious country. Her goal is to run a race in Dubai, using her natural talent and great sense of timing as her weapons. The upper half of her twin-tails are wrapped in stylish dark blue and cyan ribbons. She has a large strand of hair swept to the right of her head, and her simple and cute bangs grown past her eyes, with a single, small strand of white hair growing off of her bangs. Atop her head she wears a white sailors hat, which has her family crest―a golden anchor―in the center, and a blue and yellow striped ribbon attached at the base. On her left ear she wears a black ear cover that has a distinctive gold triangle pattern on the side. At the base of her ear cover is a golden cuff, decorated with teal gemstones. Her large, cheery, eyes are dark purple, fading into a light blue, with white pupils in the center. Additionally, she has a mole under her left eye. Her racing outfit is sailor-inspired. She wears a white, cropped, sailor uniform top, the collar lined with dark blue and cyan lines, and gold buttons in the center. In the center, she wears a large blue bow, decorated with a gold diamond in the center, and attached to both the uniform's collar, and the center of this ribbon, is a gold chain with a golden anchor at the end. Also attached to the right side of her collar is a cyan and dark blue strap, decorated with golden embellishments, with large white text that says "VIVLOS". She also wears a dark blue cape. Her white pleated skirt matches her top perfectly, also accompanied by cyan and dark blue lines at the base, but underneath is a black lacy trim. The skirt is held up by a simple tan belt, with a gold buckle. Underneath this ensemble she wears a black leotard with a gold line going down either side. She wears a pair of loose knee-socks, each with the same cyan and dark blue trim at the top. Her shoes are simple white heels, with a gold trimming, gold heels, and a gold chain in the center. Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold. Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter. Her grandstanding nature sees her charge daringly into any challenge, never afraid of what she might face. She has a bit of a cat-and-dog relationship with her roommate,Daiwa Scarlet.[1] Self-IntroYo! Vodka here! Listen up. My policy is to be the coolest at all times! I don't act all lame. Got that? Yo! Appearance Vodka has short dark brown hair, with ends that point outwards. She has a cream-colored patch on her bangs, with her right eye covered by it. Her hair is tied into arattailthat fades into cream. Her eyes are light brown, with a dark brown ring around her pupil. She wears a golden band on her left ear, adorned with a glowing teal jewel, and sextant-shaped[2]accessories on the sides of her head adorned with glowing teal and yellow jewels. Her race outfit consists of a yellow tank top with two teal stripes going diagonally down the center. She wears a necklace with a stopwatch at the end. On top of this is a leather jacket with a collar that flares outwards. The jacket's sleeves are folded up, and underneath lies white long sleeves that go to her wrist covered in brown belts. She is wearing a black pair of leather shorts held up by a brown belt with a silver buckle in the center. A yellow and teal towel is hanging off of the right side of her belt. She wears thigh-high black leather boots, with yellow and teal stripes at the top. Her boots have two yellow bands across her feet. She has a necklace with a clock at the end, and wears golden rings on her fingers. Relationships Daiwa Scarlet- Friend, roommate, rival, and classmate. The two first met after being paired together as roommates, but their conflicting personalities led to them bickering constantly, which drove them to become rivals on the track.Their relationship is inspired by the pair's rivalry in real life, racing against each other in five graded races, with both horses taking home two wins each: the 2007 Tulip Sho and 2008 Tenno Sho (Autumn) for Vodka, the Oka Sho and Shuka Sho for Scarlet in 2007, and one draw in the 2007 Arima Kinen.The two are also teammates on the anime-only team,Team Spica. The anime's official website[3]describes the two's relationship as: "Her and her teammate, Daiwa Scarlet, are always fighting because they're polar opposites: a delinquent and an honor student. While others are confused by Vodka's desire to run in the Japanese Derby, Journey doesn't look down on her for it, and instead encourages her to run her own path. Vodka finds Journey cool as her upperclassman, and they get along well. They both ventured to Dubai to pursue the Dubai World Cup, only for Vodka to be withdrawn due to a nosebleed after the Al Maktoum Challenge R3. Vodka's real life counterpart began getting nosebleeds near the end of her career, which led to her no longer being able to run in the Grand Prix.[6]As a reference to this event, Vodka tends to get nosebleeds when faced with anything related to romance.She also tends to get nosebleeds when she gets overexcited before a race, as depicted in her Christmas outfit story. She also tends to get nosebleeds when she gets overexcited before a race, as depicted in her Christmas outfit story. During the midpoint of Vodka's career, she has the goal ofrunning,not winning, theArima Kinen. Due to the fact that Vodka's base aptitude for long is F, it is essentially impossible to have her win without good legacies. While winning the Arima Kinen with Vodka is in fact possible, it is proven to be difficult.This is in reference to the real horse running her only Arima Kinen in 2007, but placing 11th. This is in reference to the real horse running her only Arima Kinen in 2007, but placing 11th. As depicted in her in-game comic, her flask is full of barley tea, not alcohol. Vodka's final race with Daiwa Scarlet was during the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in 2008. Vodka beat Daiwa Scarlet by a margin of 2cm, which is why Vodka is 2cm taller than Daiwa Scarlet. Vodka's blaze is reminiscent of the blaze on herreal-life counterpart. However, in her race outfit, both of her sleeves appear to be white, this is a reference to her real-life counterpart having two white socks, though the real horse's socks are on her back left, and front left, hooves. While playing as her duringBeyond Dreamsscenario, Red Desire shows her admiration to her during the scenario's win animation. Despite being a mare in real-life, Vodka uses the masculine personal pronoun 俺 (Ore).Believeis the only other real-life mare who uses a masculine personal pronoun.In Japanese, 俺 is a very rough personal pronoun that is very rarely used by women, considered rude in formal situations but oftentimes considered cool in casual situations, which suits Vodka's personality. Vodka using 俺 might also be a connection to why Tanino Gimlet (real life sire) uses the same pronoun. Hard work always pays off in the end!” Win Variation is sporty, healthy, and dedicated to hard work. She has a strong desire to win and becomes as depressed as anybody else were she to fail at any point in time. However, she believes in the parable that if she falls down seven times, she will rise an eighth time. She works hard everyday to become the protagonist... No, a 'principal' that makes any story shine. Appearance Win Variation has vibrant red hair styled in a loose and fluffy bob, with side bangs that frame her face, long bangs growing past her eyes, and a long strand of hair on either side, growing past her shoulder. She has a small white stripe of hair on the middle of her forehead. She wears white ear covers with a red stripe on each one. She has two, long, low twin-tails, each tied by a red and black bow. On her right ear, she wears a diamond-shaped accessory with a red gem and silver trim, accompanied by a white plume of feathers. Her kind eyes are dark blue that fade into a vibrant light green. Her racing uniform is that of a ballerina. She wears a red off-shoulder ballet dress with black trims, and intricate silver decor. Two red detached sleeves sit around her upper-arm, decorated with white frills and an emerald-green diamond. Layered under her red and black dress is a puffy white skirt with a silver trim, and a layer of black ruffles underneath. Around her neck, she wears a black collar type choker, tied with a red bow with silver trim, and a green diamond in the center. She wears low-denier pantyhose underneath. On her feet are a simple pair of ballet flats, laced above her ankles. Each shoe has a silver piece of decor, and an emerald gem in the center. Her left shoe is black, while the right is colored white. She wears black gloves on both of her hands. Relationships Orfevre- Friend and rival. Shion has an incredibly complex relationship with Orfevre, and she barely knows how to describe it herself. Her goal is to keep up with Orfevre, but she can never seem to reach the same prestige as her, and often puts herself down due to her inability. She sees herself as beneath Orfevre, and despite being labelled as "The One Who Understands Orfevre", she doesn't fully understand what Orfevre thinks of her. But, truth be told, Orfevre thinks of her fondly. In fact, Orfevre even gets upset that Shion is thinking of quitting racing, and though she claims she has no rivals, she states that no other competitor could "irritate her" more than Shion. Outside of the racetrack, Orfevre is blunt but treats her nicely compared to others. She calls her by her nickname, and Orfevre also likes the apples Shion gives her. Cheval Grand- Roommate. The two can relate to each other's shortcomings very well, both having very strong inferiority complexes in relation to their powerful rivals.IRL, they were both sired by Heart's Cry. IRL, they were both sired by Heart's Cry. Verxina- Friend. The two seem to be kindred spirits, and encourage one another in times of need. Like Verxina, Win Variation is also the oldest of three sisters. However, despite Win Variation being the older one, Verxina sometimes treats her like a little sister, which annoys her. Dream Journey- Friend. While Win Variation feels inferior in racing ability compared to Orfevre, Journey sees the talent in her. In fact, she even envies her for the fact that she gets to compete with Orfevre, while she is unable to due to the fact that she had stopped racing at that point.[1] Nice Nature- Friend. They get along as the "supporting characters" in races, and Nature also accidentally uses Shion's speech mannerisms of "-ssu" sometimes. Daiwa Scarlet,Believe,Buena Vista- Teammates underKitahara's TeaminCinderella Gray.They had all been ridden by the jockey Katsumi Ando, whoKitaharais based on, at some point in their careers. Ando rode him for most of his classics year, up until the next year ending off with 2012's Kyoto Kinen. With Ando onboard, they won the Aoba Sho, placed 2nd against the eventual Triple Crown champion Orfevre on both the 2011 Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho, and placed 5th behind Buena Vista and Tosen Jordan in the 2011 Japan Cup. They had all been ridden by the jockey Katsumi Ando, whoKitaharais based on, at some point in their careers. Appearance Winning Ticket has chin-length black hair with swept bangs; her left bangs are pinned to the side by a small red hairclip. Her long ears have a lime-green interior color, and her right ear bears a similarly-green ornamental cuff that is accessorized by a gold-and-ruby pendant. Her deep crimson eyes fade to a lighter garnet shade at the bottom of her irises, and she wears a single band-aid on her right cheek at all times. Winning Ticket's racing outfit features a sleeveless red hoodie with a white hood and accents worn over a simple blue sports bandeau. The hoodie has large arm holes that reach to Winning Ticket's midsection, and the chest features a golden insignia with a horseshoe circling the bottom of a 'V' that symbolizes victory. Winning Ticket wears a red sports wristband on her left wrist, and red, blue, and black bracelets on her right. She also wears a blue short stiff-pleated skirt over her dark blue-and-white runner spats; the skirt is open at the front of her left thigh, and features two lime-green belts with buckles to complete it. She wears running shoes with white, lime, blue, and red accents, topped off by bright yellow laces. Winning Ticket's old racing outfit had similarities to her current one in terms of color scheme, featuring primarily red and blue with some yellow/gold accents. Instead of a runner's hoodie and bandeau, she used to wear a deep red track jacket with gold accents and blue stripes across her chest. Her neck was adorned by a white ribbon that made her outfit resemble a school uniform, and her skirt was a more traditional pleated skirt with a dark blue checkered pattern. Her spats were a deep blue color with some gold ornamentation that resembles her ear ornament on her left thigh, and a simple brown belt strap on her right thigh. She also used to wear dark brown socks that ended just below the knee, as well as looser-fitting sports shoes. Additionally, she was also depicted with a blue sports duffel bag and a scooter, and had more bandages on her fingers. Relationships Biwa Hayahide- Friend and rival. She wears dark brown fingerless gloves with a diamond cutout on the top of her hand, with a silver decorative trim around the edge. Her pink dress flows outwards, and underneath is a pastel red and yellow striped large pleated skirt that flows down to her knees. Around her neck, she wears a frilled choker with two white pom-poms in the center, and underneath her dress she wears a dark brown tank top with frilled sleeves. She wears dark brown stockings, with lighter brown boots over top. Her high boots have a pink and white gradient down the center, and are tied by white laces.
