Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances4.1Anime4.2Manga 4.1Anime 4.2Manga 5Event Appearances5.1Story Events (Main)5.2Anniversary Events5.3Seasonal Events 5.1Story Events (Main) 5.2Anniversary Events 5.3Seasonal Events 6Song Discography 7Trivia 8Student Introduction 9External Links Biography "Ensuring that the Kongo Yaegaki school thrives is the only way I can repay gram—ahem, my grandparents, for everything they've given me." She runs with the dignity of a warrior. This Umamusume is rough and rugged. With fists that pierce the wind and kicks that shake the earth, this martial artist trains not to harm others but to succeed on the track. Though she strives to maintain discipline and decorum, her hotheaded side sometimes seeps to the surface. She loves her grandparents very much, and seeks to do them proud by spreading their school of martial arts far and wide. Self-IntroI am Yaeno Muteki. As a student of the Kongo Yaegaki style, I am always in search of honorable opponents with whom to race. Let us fight fair and square! I am Yaeno Muteki. As a student of the Kongo Yaegaki style, I am always in search of honorable opponents with whom to race. Let us fight fair and square! LikesSewing, dusting Sewing, dusting DislikesSitting on the floor, when others snack between meals Sitting on the floor, when others snack between meals EarsShe blushes a little bit when she hears a pretty voice. She blushes a little bit when she hears a pretty voice. TailIt's strong enough to knock down anything flying at her. It's strong enough to knock down anything flying at her. FamilyWhenever she returns home, she pats her grandfather on the shoulder. Whenever she returns home, she pats her grandfather on the shoulder. Personal RuleAll the socks she buys for herself are plain white. All the socks she buys for herself are plain white. Phone BackgroundA double-bloomed camellia she saw with her grandparents. A double-bloomed camellia she saw with her grandparents. Before a Race...Always takes a bow before entering the racecourse. Always takes a bow before entering the racecourse. SecretsWhen she's agitated, itreallyshows in her handwriting. When she's agitated, itreallyshows in her handwriting. She can't watch movies about animals, because just watching the trailer for one makes her cry. She can't watch movies about animals, because just watching the trailer for one makes her cry. Appearance Yaeno-san, as fierce as fire and as calm as water, has focused brown eyes with a subtle greyish hue. Her short brown hair, calm in a bob-cut style, carries her fiery spirit with its spiked layers and a striking white blaze streak through her pointy bang. Her ears carry a unique and rare lightening at the tips. At the base of her right ear is a flower pinwheel with a hanging black ribbon. This pinwheel may symbolize the passage of life and growth in Shinto beliefs, represent good fortune, or simply just reflect her unique fashion sense. Yaeno’s outfit draws inspiration from a Japanese Yukata, but with her own battle-ready spirit imbued. It’s multilayered and designed for mobility, featuring a sharp collar and a more flexible structure. The main dress is black and white with geometric red patterns near the chest, and it has a cutout design along with a sleeveless style. A traditional Obi belt is tied at the back, but Yaeno adds a separate red sash on top of it. She wears white sleeves tied to her arms with blue ribbons, and red fight gloves with metallic knuckles. Her skirt is ruffled black, are white at the hem, and features a large tie at the top. The black and white parts of the skirt appear to be stitched together, possibly as separate pieces when you see the sides. Yaeno’s socks have a gradient design from dark to light, and her shoes combine two classic Japanese styles. The right shoe is a Waraji, a lightweight sandal worn during labor, while the left is a Geta sandal, a platform shoe commonly worn daily. Imbalanced footwear reflecting her journey to find balance and harmony within herself. Relationships No Reason-  Friend and roommate. Bamboo Memory- Friend, rival, and training partner. Bamboo looks up to Yaeno. To Yaeno's surprise, Bamboo likes the fiery side of Yaeno when she races. Oguri Cap- Friend and rival. Yaeno has respect for Oguri as a racer, and they both get along. Oguri believes that Yaeno is strong, and vice versa. However, Yaeno also feels jealous of Oguri, and feels anger towards her because to her, Oguri took all of the attention away from the other racers of their generation like Ardan and Chiyono. Yaeno vows to defeat Oguri, and Oguri lights a fire into Yaeno that she cannot suppress. Super Creek- Friend and rival. Sakura Chiyono O- Friend and rival. Chiyono lights a fire in Yaeno as her rival, and they train together. Yaeno sees the strength in Chiyono that Chiyono is unable to see, and Yaeno vows to defeat Oguri so that she could bring attention to herself, Chiyono, and Ardan. Mejiro Ardan- Friends and rival. Ardan, like Chiyono, also lights a fire in Yaeno, even though Ardan has to miss out on races due to her poor health. Because Yaeno does not Ardan nor Chiyono to be overshadowed by Oguri, she vows to defeat Oguri and the other members of the Eternal Big Three; Super Creek and Inari One. Inari One- Friend and rival. Tamamo Cross- Friend. I'll run with the speed of a howling gale." A natural Umamusume similar to a gentle breeze, but her soul is like a gust of wind. A breezy Umamusume grounded in nature with a particular fondness for the wind. When she enters a race, however, she overwhelms the competition with her tempestuous speed. As a child, she grew to admire a certain mile racer who blew past her rivals with overwhelming strength. Ever since, she has pledged to become as the wind, just like her idol. Self-IntroI'm Yamanin Zephyr... My goal is to be like the wind... running faster and more freely than anything. That's what I aspire to be. I'm Yamanin Zephyr... My goal is to be like the wind... running faster and more freely than anything. That's what I aspire to be. LikesPlaying wind instruments, flying kites, impromptu singing and dancing Playing wind instruments, flying kites, impromptu singing and dancing DislikesAir conditioning Air conditioning EarsA resting place for butterflies and birds. A resting place for butterflies and birds. TailShe's a part of the "natural drying gang". She's a part of the "natural drying gang". FamilyHer home is famous locally for being a place where fairies live. Her home is famous locally for being a place where fairies live. Personal RuleI cannot lie to the wind that blows within my heart. I cannot lie to the wind that blows within my heart. Phone BackgroundBlooming sasamorpha borealis (a species of bamboo grass). Blooming sasamorpha borealis (a species of bamboo grass). Before a Race...She rides the winds of the race track, and dances to her heart's content. She rides the winds of the race track, and dances to her heart's content. SecretsShe's quite good at playing the trumpet. She's quite good at playing the trumpet. She knows a very popular Umamusume actress. She knows a very popular Umamusume actress. Appearance Yamanin Zephyr has long, rosy brown hair, tied into two low twin tails by large, gray, metal clips. She has white bangs that come to a point, whereas the rest of her hair that frames her face is fluffy and windswept. She wears an orange-red flower-esque decoration around her right ear. Her calm, down-turned eyes are light yellow. For her racing outfit, she wears a cream colored, sleeveless, bodice with frills at the top, decorated with red four-pointed stars. Around her waist is a red ribbon, with a large blue flower on her hip. The skirt of her dress is large and layered. The first layer is a set of light blue pleats, with the right side having a layer of white pleats underneath. Layered under that is a ring of black fabric, with decorative key-hole shaped cutouts on each petal-shaped pleat. And the final layer of this skirt is a large white base, decorated with a trim of white ruffles. On the back of her dress is a large blue ribbon, outlined with dark brown trimming, and decorated with golden diamonds. Around her neck is a red choker, with a silver four-pointed star charm in the center. She wears long, light blue, detached sleeves with a metal cuff holding them to her upper arms, the sleeves frill out into light blue ruffles. She wears light blue leggings underneath this ensemble, and a pair of black loafers with a white flower on the toe of either foot. Story Zephyr is an idiosyncratic and highly aloof Umamusume that lives life at her own pace, doesn't pay much attention to the world around her, and doesn't seem to have any friends. She goes wherever and whenever the wind tells her to, including walking away mid-conversation if she must. Her motivation to run and "become the wind" was sparked when she watched a certain famous Umamusume, the "Emperor of Miles", run an impressive Mile Championship race. When Zephyr was younger, she had to recover in a secluded place surrounded by nature because she would frequently get injuries. Because Zephyr tries to keep her negative feelings out of her racing as much as possible, she would rather not race at all than race with problems on her mind. This leads to rumors among trainers at Tracen that she's unmotivated to race and therefore a poor trainee candidate. Relationships Curren Bouquetd'or- Roommate. Sakura Bakushin O- Friend and rival. Nishino Flower- Friend and rival. Despite Flower's age, Zephyr sees her as a rival she mustn't overlook. She also likes the flowers that Flower grows. Tokai Teio- Friend from the same generation. Both characters' motivation for enrolling in Tracen is so that they can surpass a role model of theirs. Zephyr also looks out for Teio, and empathizes with her when she gets her fractures.In real life, Tokai Teio was sired by Symboli Rudolf, while Yamanin Zephyr was sired by Nihon Pillow Winner. Both sires lost the 1985 Tenno Sho (Autumn), which explains the connection. In real life, Tokai Teio was sired by Symboli Rudolf, while Yamanin Zephyr was sired by Nihon Pillow Winner. Both sires lost the 1985 Tenno Sho (Autumn), which explains the connection. Daiichi Ruby- Friend and rival. Zephyr cares for Ruby, and though she is introverted, Ruby appreciates her friendship. Daitaku Helios- Friend and rival. They both hang out and train together from time to time. Zephyr is also very intrigued in Helios' gyaru speech, and even says "wei" with her on rare occasions. K.S.Miracle- Friend and rival. Zephyr worries a lot for Miracle's health, and they both train and spend time together. Aston Machan- Friend. Together, they form the "Mazepha" alliance, and they get along well. On occasion, they do streams together. Ikuno Dictus- Friend. Ikuno taught her how to ride a bicycle a while ago. She's gonna be a real city girl! Just a hardwork'n girl from the country. A simple girl from the Iwate countryside, she would often lend a hand on the family farm. Yet despite her humble country background, her true desire is to be a cosmopolitan city girl and compete in the Twinkle Series. Her rural northern upbringing has made her a sincere Umamusume who doesn't back down from a challenge. She sees Gold City as that very ideal. Self-IntroMy name's, uh, Yukino Bijin! Appearance Yukino Bijin's looks suit her simplistic country bumpkin personality. Her large round eyes are light brown, and she has a simple brown bob haircut, with her bangs pushed to her left. She has a braid wrapped around the backside of her head. She wears a white headband, with two white earmuffs to boot, the left muff has a pink lace pattern at the base. In her race outfit, the previously mentioned pink lace is now red. Around her neck is a white choker with a snowflake charm. She wears a white long sleeved dress with dark blue accents and simple floral patterns along the skirt and near her collar. The dress' collar is dark blue with white lace decor along the trim, and the dress is fastened with two rows of brown buttons down the center. On the top of either sleeve is two blue bands, and her lacy frilled sleeves are tied with a thin blue ribbon. She wears white fingerless gloves on either hand. Around her waist is a brown belt with gold buckles, and tied to the belt is a white ribbon with blue chevrons acting as a background to a floral pattern. Her box pleated skirt has dark blue stripes along the base, with floral patterns above. The fabric under the box pleat has yellow and red vertical pleats, with a fluffy petticoat underneath. Her white boots have dark blue heels and brown X-shaped ribbon laces, with the same red floral pattern on the outside. The boots' top edges are folded inward, with a cream cable knitted pattern on the inside, adorned by blue bows on the outside, and frills coming out of the top. Relationships Gold City- Close friend. She aspires to be a pretty and modern girl like her, while Gold City envies Yukino's simplistic way of life. Manhattan Cafe- Friend and roommate. The two frequently spend time together, and it seems that Yukino's bright demeanor tends to put Cafe at ease.IRL, Yukino Bijin and Manhattan Cafe had a foal in 2006. The foal was never registered, so is only listed as Yukino Bijin's 2006.[1] IRL, Yukino Bijin and Manhattan Cafe had a foal in 2006. The foal was never registered, so is only listed as Yukino Bijin's 2006.[1] Winning Ticket- Friend.IRL, Yukino Bijin and Winning Ticket had a foal in 2004 named Maruhachi Dolan.[2] IRL, Yukino Bijin and Winning Ticket had a foal in 2004 named Maruhachi Dolan.[2] Mayano Top Gun- Friend. Haru Urara- Rival in competitions of hometown pride, with Yukino representing Iwate. Sakura Bakushin O- Friend. Bakushin reminds Yukino of her father, and talking to her helps to put her at ease.IRL, both were sired by Sakura Yutaka O. IRL, both were sired by Sakura Yutaka O. I can't imagine any book lover not wishing the same." One day, she'll write her own epic tale. A voracious reader with a rich imagination. A bibliophile who serves as a student library assistant at Tracen Academy. Though she comes off as quiet and reserved, within her burns the desire to embody the hero of an epic tale. She had always overcome most hurdles with ease, but rarely stood out. Ever since winning a certain freestyle race, however, the humble dream of becoming like the hero Rob Roy has welled up within her. Self-IntroMy name is Zenno Rob Roy. It's a little embarrassing, but I love fantasy novels, and... well, someday I hope to write my own legend through racing! My name is Zenno Rob Roy. She likes the smell of liqueur-flavored candy and chocolate. Appearance Rob Roy has cool gray hair, tied into a braid that rests over her shoulder. She has blunt cut bangs, and a braid across her forehead, with two white clips consisting of two triangles on either side. Her ears are longer than most Umamusume, and have a de-saturated pink inside. She has a band of white flowers with blue centers around her right ear. She wears large glasses with thick black frames, and has downturned blue eyes. Her race outfit is very reminiscent of a Scottish folktale hero. She wears a dark green brimless hat on her head, with a gold medal on the side. Her outfit is dark green with gold trims, and consists of a long sleeved coat on top of a long skirt. Her jacket's cuffs are yellow with a dark green band around the center, and she wears a green and gold band around her right arm. Over top of her shirt she has a brown belt around her waist and shoulder with gold adornments. The belt holds a green, yellow, blue, and white plaid shawl in place. Her dark green skirt has a yellow zig-zag pattern at the base, with a white stripe underneath, and the hem is decorated with white frills. She wears white knitted knee-high socks with green ribbons on either side. Her shoes are simple loafers with brown buckles, the left shoe being white, and the right is brown. Relationships Neo Universe- Close friend. Rob Roy was one of the first people who went out of her way to understand Universe's strange mannerisms, they both share interest in books, and Rob Roy often recommends Uni books about space. Agnes Digital- Friend. Both enjoy reading, and can often sympathize with each other. Digital also notices Rob Roy while others don't, which surprises Rob Roy. Sweep Tosho-  Friend. Rob Roy often teaches Sweep knowledge related to magic. While Rob Roy is obsessed with being a folk hero, Sweep is obsessed with being a witch, and they both like to read fantasy books in the library. Sweep enjoys teaching Rob Roy about magic, and Rob Roy herself seems to believe in her power and strength. Rob Roy admires Sweep as a friend and rival, and vows to defeat her in future races.In real life, they challenged each other in the 2005 Takarazuka Kinen, where Sweep Tosho defeated him in an upset win. They also challenged each other in the 2005 Tenno Sho (Autumn), where they both lost to the long-shot mareHeavenly Romance. In real life, they challenged each other in the 2005 Takarazuka Kinen, where Sweep Tosho defeated him in an upset win. They also challenged each other in the 2005 Tenno Sho (Autumn), where they both lost to the long-shot mareHeavenly Romance. Symboli Kris S- Friend, upperclassman, and mentor. Rob Roy deeply admires Kris S, and wants to emulate her. She is one of the reasons why she wants to take on the Triple Crown route, especially the Derby. She looks up to her strength and her quiet demeanor. Kris S, though not very sociable, acknowledges Rob Roy as a strong racer, and they both train and spend time together. Rob Roy also finds Kris S' ears cute and fluffy.In real life, Symboli Kris S and Zenno Rob Roy raced together once in the 2003 Arima Kinen, where Symboli Kris S won by nine lengths. They both enjoy books, Rice's interest being in picture books, and can understand each other as they're both a bit reserved. Admire Groove- Friend. Rob Roy admires the assertive behavior of Admire Groove, despite also being concerned over her cold demeanor.[2] T.M. Opera O- Friend. Opera O and Rob Roy sometimes hang out other, and Opera O likes to drag Rob Roy into her operas and plays. However, Opera O can sense the true strength yet the insecurities Rob Roy has about herself, so she tries to lift her up and give her confidence. Because of Opera O's odd attitude, it inspires Rob Roy into becoming more confident and assertive like her.In real life, both of them won the Senior Autumn Triple Crown, which consists of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), the Japan Cup, and the Arima Kinen. T.M. Opera O won this in 2000, while Zenno Rob Roy won this in 2004. The single green stripe on the jockey silk is kept as is, and the yellow and green sawtooth pattern is boldly used as a pattern on the skirt. The design is toned down to match the style of the cloths and the character's personality. As the motif horse only has a white mark on the left hind leg, her leather shoes have mismatched color as a design. She is very ticklish.[3] She is afraid of ghosts. Automated doors don't respond to her presence immediately.[4] She tends to act out scenes from books out loud in public.[5] She likes going to the zoo.[6] In her career story, fans talk about a certain Umamusume who won both the NHK Mile Cup and the Japanese Derby.[7]This Umamusume is a reference to the real horseKing Kamehameha, who won both races in 2004.While she is at summer camp in her senior year, numerous journalists swarm the camp to observe a junior-year Umamusume who could make a "profound impact" in the URA.[8]This is a reference to the real horseDeep Impact, who debuted in 2004 and went on to win seven G1 races, including the Triple Crown. Deep Impact and King Kamehameha both have the same owner, Makoto Kaneko. While she is at summer camp in her senior year, numerous journalists swarm the camp to observe a junior-year Umamusume who could make a "profound impact" in the URA.[8]This is a reference to the real horseDeep Impact, who debuted in 2004 and went on to win seven G1 races, including the Triple Crown. Deep Impact and King Kamehameha both have the same owner, Makoto Kaneko. In her good ending, Zenno Rob Roy receives an offer to travel to England to compete in races. This is a nod to real life, as Zenno Rob Roy challenged the International Stakes in 2005 for the wish of his owner and trainer.[9] She likes to go to collab shops that collaborate with her favorite novels.[10] In the cover art of herSR guts card, a book with a pierrot on it can be seen behind Zenno Rob Roy and Rice Shower. This book is likely a reference to Zenno Rob Roy's granddaughter, Juryoku Pierrot. But as your colleague and rival, I can't back down now!" Meeting challenges head-on! This trainer is highly motivated. The sole daughter of the Kiryuin family, a prestigious family of trainers. Using the Trainer's Handbook, a collection of Kiryuin techniques, she works hard every day to help her trainee Happy Meek win. Her dedication to everything she does has earned high expectations from those around her.  Self-IntroHello. I'm Aoi Kiryuin, a new trainer here at Tracen Academy. Appearance Aoi is a pale-skinned human woman with gentle purple eyes. She has neck-length black hair with blunt bangs, with her left side-bangs pinned behind her ear with a small diamond-shaped gold clip. Some hair in the back is tied into a small ponytail. She wears a white long sleeve blouse with a frilled collar, and a black vest with gold buttons adorning the center. She has a simple pair of cuffed jeans on, cuffed with gold buttons, and black ankle boots. Relationships Happy Meek- Trainee Riko Kashimoto- Colleague. Riko is the exact opposite of Aoi, being a serious, seasoned and professional trainer, who can easily train her trainees to the best of their abilities, but has dismal physical ability whereas Aoi is a cheerful rookie trainer with outstanding athletic ability but struggles to train her trainee due to her lack of experience, intellect and confidence. To me, an Umamusume encountering her racewear is like a date with destiny, and their bond is like an engagement!” Beauty Anshinzawa is not only a world-renowned fashion designer specializing in Umamusume race outfits, but also the younger sister ofSasami Anshinzawa. However, unlike her sister, she has found a great amount of success pursuing her dreams, and due to this, the two don't seem to get along very well. Her real name is "Isami Anshinzawa" (安心沢　衣咲美). Appearance Beauty has a sharp but bold blonde bob, that flares out at the ends, and giant but neat ahoge sticks up from the top of her head. She has a gorgeous full face of makeup, with plump pink lipstick, and her eyes are concealed by white cat eye sunglasses with brown lenses. Attached to her human ears are black diamond hoop earrings, with three diamonds making up a chain, each getting smaller. Her nails are painted a stunning red. She wears a bright red leather jacket with white cuffs and a white collar, brown trim is around both the collar and the cuffs. Under this jacket, she wears a brown crop-top, and a sleek pair of brown pants that are flared and ruffled at the ends. She also wears a simple, bright red pair of heels. Relationships Sasami Anshinzawa- Older Sister. The two don't get along well, as Beauty had a much more successful career, causing Sasami to become jealous. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances4.1Anime4.2Manga 4.1Anime 4.2Manga 5Trivia Biography I can do this, I got this, I've got plenty of guts!" She loves to compete, is endlessly energetic, and boasts her amazing strength. Her love for training so hard has regarded her as being incomprehensible to others. In all honesty, she's not a good team player, but she doesn't mind. She wants to be strong in everything she does! Also, her hobby is seeing how long she can last in a sauna. SecretsShe's popular among foodies for her soba noodle blog. She's popular among foodies for her soba noodle blog. Appearance Bitter Glasse is a fiery Umamusume with tan skin, and amber eyes. She has short, messy, brown hair, with a large ahoge on the top of her head, and two strands of hair grown down to her shoulder. The inside of her ears are light red, and on her right ear she wears a golden cuff with an orange ribbon tied around it. Her race outfit is light, sporty, and airy. She wears a white sports bra-esque tank top with black hems, with a cropped red sleeveless jacket on top, also sporting black hems, and black belts in the center. She wears a black choker, and a brown belt around her upper arm, as well as black metal cuffs around her wrist, and black and red fingerless gloves. Her shorts are white and red with black hems, with a brown belt with gold trims along the edge. On her left leg she wears two brown belts around her knee. She has black crew-length stockings, with red, white, and black boots that have black metal cuffs at the top. Her legs both have white band-aids on them. Relationships Little Cocon- Teammates on the game-only team,Team Zenith. Riko Kashimoto- Trainer on the game-only team,Team Zenith. Media Appearances Beginning of a New Era(Cameo) Umamusumeshi Trivia There's been a horse presumably named after her in real life, though the horse's name is romanized as Bitter Glace. This is possibly derived from the alternative spelling of グラッセ, Glacé. The horse was born in 2020, before the mobile game's release, but was sold in 2021, which would have occurred after the release of theAoharu Haiscenario. The real life horse is a mare, while Glasse has her accessory on the right, denoting being a colt. I will train you to become strong enough to etch your name into the earth." Behind the military-like strictness is a deep love for Umamusume. She is an AI formation who thinks in terms of discipline. She has incredibly short hair with short bangs, with the front being dark brown, and the back being light brow, Her ears are light brown that fade into dark brown, and her tail is light brown. There are many ties― and many beings, that help Umamusume run. I will help you, too." One overflowing with kindness, an elegant teacher. She is a being created by AI that thinks in terms of "Love". She is the most generous of the Three Goddesses, loving and tenderly watching over everyone. She understands the concerns of others before they do. She has a light cobalt-blue hair and tail, with both fading to a bright teal at the end. She wears white and blue striped futuristic ear covers, with blue glowing lights at the base. On her right ear, she wears a light blue swirled metal band with a pearl at the end, and three triangle-shaped decorations on the spiral. The zipper is a golden horseshoe with a blue gem in the center. She wears a pair of black shorts with a white horseshoe-adjacent stripe pattern on the right leg. She wears black socks with simple blue tennis shoes and white laces, with white soles and a glowing blue strip at the base. Relationships Calstone Light O- Friend. Godolphin Barb watches over Light O, and is one of the few Umamusume to support her dream of becoming the fastest Umamusume. IRL, Calstone Light O is Godolphin Barb's distant descendant through his sire-line. Trivia Godolphin Barb's love for cats is a reference to a real life anecdote about the horse, as he was noted to have befriended a cat named Grimalkin.[1]This trait was also referenced in Calstone Light O's character, as she is obsessed with cats. Leave it to me to analyze European races. Let's achieve the unprecedented dream of winning the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" together!" Keep on challenging the world! A leader in pursuit of her dreams. She is the founder of "Project L'Arc," a program that aims for a Japanese team to win the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe". Mei is a member of the URA's Tracen Academy enhancement division, and is close friends with President Akikawa, as if they were sisters. She has previously attempted to win the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" with other participants, and the knowledge she gained from that experience lives on in her. SecretsShe's very good at hand-to-hand sumo wrestling. She's very good at hand-to-hand sumo wrestling. Appearance Mei has messy short blonde hair, and wears a yellow and white baseball cap with Tracen Academy's logo front-and-center. Her cap is decorated with a golden ring on the left side, and three brown and teal buttons on the right side. She has short and thick blond eyebrows, and light yellow eyes. Mei wears a white hoodie with a dark brown shirt with several holes and tears on it on top. Atop of this, she wears a yellow jacket, decorated with brown hems, and brown stripes down her sleeves. On her back is a large yellow backpack. She wears a pair of brown shorts, and has lime green ankle socks underneath her yellow, white, and brown tennis shoes. Media Appearances Umamusumeshi Trivia Mei was highly speculated to be an Umamusume, based on the race horse Dictus.References to Dictus include:Her overall color scheme is similar to the Shadai racing silk.She has chestnut-colored hair - Dictus was a chestnut horse.She founded the "Project L'Arc" - Dictus was a French race horse, and Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was a race that takes place in France.She was a close friend ofYayoi Akikawa, who was speculated to be based on Northern Taste. In real life, Northern Taste and Dictus were both top stallions of Shadai Farm at the time.She has three badges on the right side of her cap. Umamusumes with ear accessories on their right side were based of horses that were male in real life, such as Dictus.Her height was short, referencing the real life Dictus, who was known to have a small build.Her birthday is the same as the real Dictus.In addition to the above traits, her hair sidelocks are coincidentally long enough to cover where her human ears should be. She has a white diamond marking in the center of her bangs. Her ears are scalloped down the sides, almost resembling ear fluff. On her left had, she wears several golden rings, and on her right, a full-length black sleeve, accompanied by a thick golden bracelet. She wears white flats with red toes, and golden decoration found throughout. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances4.1Anime4.2Manga 4.1Anime 4.2Manga 5Trivia Biography "It is our duty as trainers to ensure an Umamusume's peak condition. Our management and record keeping must be flawless." A professional straight from the URA, she is firm yet kind. A veteran trainer from the URA, she came to assist Tracen Academy with a quiet zeal in her heart. Her direct and inflexible attitude may make her seem cold-hearted at first glance, but her passion for the well-being of Umamusume is second to none. While she excels thoroughly at her job, it would appear that physical activity isn't her strong suit... Self-IntroI'm Riko Kashimoto. It is the role of a trainer to look after the health of their Umamusume. Therefore, it's appropriate to have some level of anxiety regarding one's work. I'm Riko Kashimoto. It is the role of a trainer to look after the health of their Umamusume. Therefore, it's appropriate to have some level of anxiety regarding one's work. SecretsIf she has more than two cups of coffee, she won't be able to sleep all night. If she has more than two cups of coffee, she won't be able to sleep all night. Appearance Riko has black hair, with a dark blue tint. Wavy and a bit unkempt, it falls messily falls down her back, accompanied by her slightly unkempt blunt-cut bangs. Her eyes are a warm gray, and she seems to wear a permanently determined expression. On her human ears are two gold earrings, a charm at the end shaped like the letter "V". She wears a dark gray two-piece suit, the jacket being patterned with golden pinstripes, golden buttons, an intricate silver lapel pin, in the shape of a cross. She wears a white collared button-up shirt, the collar decorated with a vague floral pattern. She wears a black belt with a simple golden buckle, and a pair of black flats. Relationships Bitter Glasse,Little Cocon- Trainees on the game-only team,Team Zenith. Tazuna Hayakawa- Secretary during her tenure as Acting Director for Tracen.Her roles differ from her depiction inCinderella Gray Mangaand in theUnity Cup. In Unity Cup, she reintroduced the aforementioned tournament in order to showcase her style of training. While in Cinderella Gray, she simply observes all the scenes duringOguri Cap's rise to stardom in the national stage. Her roles differ from her depiction inCinderella Gray Mangaand in theUnity Cup. In Unity Cup, she reintroduced the aforementioned tournament in order to showcase her style of training. While in Cinderella Gray, she simply observes all the scenes duringOguri Cap's rise to stardom in the national stage. Aoi Kiryuin- Colleague. Aoi is the exact opposite of Riko, being an cheerful rookie trainer with outstanding athletic ability but struggles to train her trainee due to her lack of experience, intellect and confidence, whereas Riko is a serious, seasoned and professional trainer, who can easily train her trainees to the best of their abilities, but has dismal physical ability. Yayoi Akikawa- Accomplice. Riko would step in as Acting Director once Akikawa leave the country for business trips. Media Appearances Beginning of a New Era(Cameo) Cinderella Gray Umamusumeshi Trivia Riko has been shown to be shockingly unathletic, in contrast to her sharp intellect, quite possibly being the weakest character in the entire series.Throughout her life, simple physical activities, such as running in a race and catching a ball, all prove to be extremely difficult. She even had to take the vaulting test multiple times. She was always at the top when it came to academics but always at the bottom when it came to her physical tests.Even as an adult, she is incapable of running even short distances, requiring assistance to even walk after, and struggles to lift anything even remotely heavy, like a mochi mallet or a bag of trash. Throughout her life, simple physical activities, such as running in a race and catching a ball, all prove to be extremely difficult. She even had to take the vaulting test multiple times. She was always at the top when it came to academics but always at the bottom when it came to her physical tests. Even as an adult, she is incapable of running even short distances, requiring assistance to even walk after, and struggles to lift anything even remotely heavy, like a mochi mallet or a bag of trash. She is shown to be good at singing, but due to her terrible physical ability, she is horrible at dancing, has abysmal rhythm, and initially gets a 0 combo score on a dancing machine. She was properly introduced during the 4th anniversary of the game, as a supporting character in The Twinkle Legends scenario.Another race to be using a name of an IRL horse isShinzan Kinen, using Shinzan's namesake. However, unlike Saint Lite, Shinzan currently does not have an Umamusume appearance.On a related note, the other two races that have alternate names using a horse's namesake, which are the Yayoi Sho and the Kyodo Tsushin Hai, did not use their alternative names. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Trivia Biography "I've got this! There's probably a pressure point around... here! See? No worries! ☆ ...Right? Right?!" The subject of pointed interest wherever she goes. World's greatest(?) acupuncturist. While it's unclear who would bestow such a title, she's (allegedly) a budding legend in the acupuncture sphere. She (claims to be) the sole apprentice of a master acupuncturist, and has learned the godly techniques for herself. It's said that any concern could hypothetically be cured by her pinpoint-precise needlework. She even claims she can also imbue patients with power untold. Should you chose to believe her, ultimately, is up to you. Self-IntroSasami Anshinzawa, (apprentice of a) legendary acupuncturist, at your service! With one little poke, I'll have you ready to take on the world! Wow, right? No worries! ☆ Sasami Anshinzawa, (apprentice of a) legendary acupuncturist, at your service! With one little poke, I'll have you ready to take on the world! Wow, right? No worries! ☆ SecretsShe makes all her own clothes. She makes all her own clothes. Appearance Sasami is a young adult woman with fair skin and blonde, hip-length curly hair with a large cowlick sticking out on top. The "[This Might Sting!]" SSR support card reveals her eyes to be bright blue, which are usually covered by her cat-eye sunglasses. Sasami's costume consists of a white pearl necklace and mask that covers her eyes, a short red strapless dress with a small slit, red heels and a long white lab coat accented with red. She keeps some of her needles on a gray thigh garter on her left leg. Her needles themselves are edged and have a red cover while the other half is white. Relationships Beauty Anshinzawa- Younger Sister. The two don't get along well, as Beauty had a much more successful career, causing Sasami to become jealous. Trivia The "Sasa" (刺々) part of Sasami's name means thorn, pierce, stab, prick or sting, fitting her acupuncturist profession. All of her needles have hearts on the ends, complimenting her somewhat flirty personality. She is featured in theU.A.F. Ready GO!scenario alongsideRyoka Tsurugi. Biography “Shining sweat connects the world! Come on! Let's get fired up about sports together!” She's an Umatuber who makes videos focused on athletics, who posts daily videos in order to share the joy of sports with the world. Elfie is popular for her videos that showcase her utilizing her physical abilities, as well as her enthusiastic and upbeat character. She is the mascot of "U.A.F." (Umamusume Athletic Festival), a brand new all-round sporting event for Umamusume. SecretsGoing out withRyokais a reward to her. Going out withRyokais a reward to her. Appearance Sonon Elfie is an Umamusume with long white hair. She has her hair styled in both a long side ponytail and a braid on the right side of her head. Her hair is parted down the center, with two large band-aids on her forehead. She has several different accessories on her head, an orange and yellow scrunchie holds her ponytail up, and she has two ear covers, a yellow one on her left ear, and a green on her right. She wears a pink headband with "XI" in bold white lettering. Elfie also has pale yellow eyes with a white pupil in the center. She wears a sporty outfit to match her incredibly athletic personality. Over top a dark brown cropped and tight tank-top is a loose-fit orange sweater with detached sleeves. The center of the sweater has a white triangle pattern in the center, and the sleeves have light orange stripes running down either side. She wears a pair of black fingerless gloves, each finger sporting pink rims. She wears black leggings with green stripes down either side, the left side of the leggings reach just below her knee, while the right side is cropped to above her thigh. She wears a light orange fanny pack, and a black knee guard on her left leg. Her left leg also has green and yellow band-aids on her shins. She wears black crew-length socks, each having a green and yellow stripe on the perimeter. She wears white and green sneakers, with yellow laces, and pink and yellow accents. Trivia The "XI" on her headband is assumed to be a reference to her real-life counterpart,Osumi Eleven. In the game's lobby, she is one of the few Umamusume who skips her steps in a upbeat manner. Other Umamusume who do this includeHaru Urara,Daitaku Helios,Twin Turbo, andVivlos. content: ST-2 MainGallery Main  Gallery  ST-2 MainOriginal Design MainOriginal Design         Names EnglishST-2 English ST-2 JapaneseST-2 Japanese ST-2 Kanaサティ Kana サティ Romajisati Romaji sati   Profile BirthdayAugust 2 Birthday August 2 Height157cm Height 157cm Image Colors#74EDCE#072AB0 Image Colors #74EDCE#072AB0 ST-2is a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby. She is the main focus of theHashire! Mecha UmamusumeScenario. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Song Discography 5Trivia Biography ST-2 (Sati) is a Mecha Umamusume designed bySugar Lights. She is an NPC character in the scenario,Run! Mecha Umamusume, and trains beside the player's chosen Umamusume, procedurally receiving upgrades throughout the scenario. Appearance ST-2 has three forms, as she is upgraded throughout the scenario. Her first form is very simplistic, and a bit blocky. She has a white rounded face with square light blue eyes. Her hair is designed to give her a teal bob with blunt bangs, and a teal ring around the outside of her head. She has a singular antenna on the right side of her head, and her mechanical ears are composed of vents with a royal blue trim around the outside, her ears connected by a white headband. She has a navy blue inside layer on her build, mostly prominent in her arms and torso. She has white plating on her lower arms, chest, hips, and on the entirety of both of her legs. She has a green gem in the center o f her chest. She has black "fingerless gloves" with white fingers underneath. All of her limbs are attacked with dark gray ball joints, and she has white feet with royal blue trims on the top. She has a white and blue metal "cape" on her lower back, with three large teal boosters in the shape of a tail. Her second form has the head of her final version, which can be found below, atop of the body of the first version. Her final form is a lot more intricate, with a more "humanoid" build, as opposed to a blocky one. She has a plain white human-shaped face with large green robotic eyes, and a nose, but no mouth. Her hair is bright teal, and has more intricate strands in comparison to her first form. She still has a ring around her head, but the tips are now dark blue. The headband that holds her ears is now larger, and her ears are now far more pointed, the blue trim has stayed, but her inner ears are now yellow. Her antenna has now become a pointed rhombus with a white tip. Her body is composed of mostly white paneling, with dark blue padding underneath, and glowing blue trims decorating the white panels. The green gem has now gotten wider, and takes up about half of her upper chest. She has two white glove modules with light blue and royal blue trims, and her gloves have black undersides. Her ball joints are dark blue, but now more hidden by her form. She wears a skirt that fades from dark blue to light blue, and is adhered to her form with white panels. Her legs are still mostly white, but have dark blue paneling on the thighs. Her feet are white with blue heels. She has a normal Umamusume tail that is bright blue, and two large jet boosters on her back. Relationships Sugar Lights- Creator. The inventor of the full dive-type robot "ST-2" (Saty), and a scientist of exceptional talent. Having set the completion of the robot as her objective, she devotes herself to research day and night. Despite appearing human, Tazuna is often speculated to be anUmamusumebased on the racehorseTokino Minoru, who was undefeated in all 10 races he participated in and won theSatsuki ShoandJapanese Derby, but passed away 17 days after the latter following complications with contracting tetanus that led to a fatal case of sepsis. He is often nicknamed the "Phantom Horse" for passing away before he could compete in the Kikuka Sho to complete the Triple Crown. Tokino Minoru was also the only horse in the history Japanese horse racing to end a career with a perfect 10 out of 10 wins.References to Minoru include:Her birthday is listed in-game as May 2nd, which is Minoru's birthday as well.In the events ofSSR [Tracen Reception] Tazuna Hayakawa, an ad promotes a movie about the "Phantom Umamusume" whose legend endures long after her permanent departure from racing. Tazuna also mentions having a "special connection" to the Japanese Derby.In a previous event, she is fast enough to catchTaiki Shuttle, who is also considered a fast Umamusume, which references Tokino Minoru's racing records that is mainly composed of sprint and mile races and having most of his time records being new records.In the event "Inexplicable Speed", Trainer suggests that Tazuna make her debut as a racer after witnessing her extraordinary speed, believing that she has the potential to become one. This may suggest that Trainer had begun to suspect that Tazuna was an Umamusume herself.The mahjong hand tilesTanino Gimletmakes in episode 20 ofUmayurufeatures Mihono Bourbon, Tokai Teio and Tazuna. Bourbon, Teio and Minoru were all Double Crown winners in real life, with all three winning the first two races but being unable to complete the crown by winning the Kikuka Sho.Tazuna mentions in one ofMr. C.B.'s events that she has fond memories of theKyodo Tsushin Hai, a G3 race named after Minoru which is also named in some instances as the Tokino Minoru Kinen.Tazuna's green and black clothing matches the colors Minoru's jockey, Mitsumasa Iwashita, wore.Tazuna's hat has a horseshoe on her right side. An accessory on the Umamusume's right ear indicates that their real-life counterpart was male.Tazuna also wears a watch on her right wrist. The Japanese word for "time" istoki(時), which may be another reference to Tokino Minoru.Tazuna's hat constantly covers the top of her head, which many fans speculate may possibly be hiding her horse ears.In one of theUmayoncomics, her bare head is notably framed in a way to hide the top of it.A picture from the art book for thefirst season of the animedepicts Tazuna with horse ears, though this is never shown in the actual anime.InBeginning of a New Era, the films rolling whileAgnes Tachyonis entering the Zone depicts a running Umamusume, wearing the usual race suits for races below GI, who has almost identical hair to Tazuna's.This is possibly due to the similar nicknames attributed to both their in-real-life counterparts, with Agnes Tachyon as thePhantom Triple Crownand Tokino Minoru as thePhantom Horse.Tokino Minoru participated in his races before the international grading system was introduced in 1984, where all races in Japan were open races. I hope all you Umamusume will leap to greater heights, so I founded the Deserted Island Project! Now, unleash your instincts! "Dash ahead, Umamusume! Set your souls...ABLAAAZE! Dah-hahahaha!" The chief and field supervisor of the Deserted Island Project, moving forward with a blazing heart. Hoping for Umamusume to be able to take further leaps forward, she busily runs around day after day in an effort to construct training facilities most powerful on the island. With a big-hearted and cheerful personality, she is a perfect fit for the island where summer never ends, but...sometimes, she might show a glimpse of a different side. Tucker Bryne also wears a brown leather holster anchored on her right leg above short, ripped blue jeans. She has thick beige socks and dark brown work boots. content: Venus Paques MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Venus Paques Main Main      Names EnglishVenus Paques English Venus Paques Japaneseヴェニュスパーク Japanese ヴェニュスパーク RomajiVenyusu Paaku Romaji Venyusu Paaku Chinese (Traditional)金星復活節 Chinese (Traditional) 金星復活節 Chinese (Simplified)金星公园 Chinese (Simplified) 金星公园 Korean베누스 파크 Korean 베누스 파크   Profile BirthdayApril 7 Birthday April 7 Height155cm Height 155cm Image Colors#215A95#DB4977 Image Colors #215A95#DB4977 Calls self私 (Atashi) Calls self 私 (Atashi)   Voice Voice ActorHina Orihara Voice Actor Hina Orihara Venus Paquesis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby. She is featured in theProject L'Arcscenario alongsideRigantonaandMei Satake. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Media Appearances3.1Manga 3.1Manga 4Trivia Biography "D'accord!I will win, as the hope of all France!" She's a genius who loves her home country, France, and the country loves her back. She has a natural talent for racing, and has entered the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe without losing a single race. She has a "master" whom she has admired since she was young, but to her, her master is one of the rivals she must surpass. SecretsHer personal life is so sloppy that her master sometimes gets angry at her. Her personal life is so sloppy that her master sometimes gets angry at her. Appearance Venus Paques wears her short blonde hair into a short low ponytail. Her bangs are messily swept to the right, with a contrasting neat braid holding the left side of her bangs in place. Paques wears a white sailor cap with blue lines on her left ear, decorated with a large red ribbon. She has a blonde tail, cut bluntly at the ends. Her eyes are bright blue, with dark blue diamond-shaped pupils. Her race outfit is simple, yet elegant. She wears a light blue top with flared short sleeves. Her top garment is decorated by gold trim, as well as red accents, including red shoulder pads, tied in the center by a gold corded rope. Attached to her back are two separate blue capes, decorated with an elaborate gold pattern. In the center of her collar, she wears a large red diamond atop of a blue ribbon. On her right hand, she wears a white glove with gold trim, and on her left, a dark gray compression sleeve accompanied by a dark blue cuff. She wears light blue shorts with white frills at the end, with golden chevron-esque laces down the center. Around her waist is a dark blue belt with a golden shield-shaped emblem, and attached is a chain of golden diamonds, with red and blue gems dangling off the chain. On her left leg she wears a white knee-high sock with two blue stripes around the perimeter, as well as two simple light blue boots with gold trims. Media Appearances Umamusumeshi Trivia She is a game original character, meaning there is no real life race horse with the same name, but fans assume she's based on the real life horseTreve.Although she has made an appearance outside the game in the mangaUmamusumeshi, where it's also revealed that she's not good with knives (or cooking for that matter). Although she has made an appearance outside the game in the mangaUmamusumeshi, where it's also revealed that she's not good with knives (or cooking for that matter). She's the main roadblock for Trainers in the scenario Project L'Arc, she's presented as the biggest rival in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, with her stats at a higher level and with an unremovable jinx. At the senior race, she usually has stats exceeding a UG rank and multiple gold skills. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Song Discography 6Trivia Biography "Please, stay awhile and heal yourselves up.Yukomaa~ hot springs~♪　Pyoiya, soi soi~♪" An Umamusume in apprenticeship at the 'Yukoma Inn'. She works slowly and strenuously to eventually become a proprietress. She may seem laid back, but she has a playful side, being able to liven up moods and sometimes goofing about nonchalantly. Her considerate and gentle hospitality provides guests with a therapeutic experience. SecretsShe'll look forward to the end-of-the-year comedy competition for several months. She'll look forward to the end-of-the-year comedy competition for several months. Appearance Yunohana has light gray hair that is nearly shoulder length that is tied loosely in the backside. She has a fluffy white-beaded ear accessory on her right ear with a red ribbon tied to it alongside two small white flower earrings. Under her side bangs, she wears a white bow tied neatly at the front. Her complexion is a light peach color, and her eyes are a mix of pale red and yellow with a darker red pupil. Her tail is also light gray, and is cut neatly across at the bottom.Yunohana wears a formal kimono with a generally light pink color. The kimono has a red logo that appears to be a combination of a horseshoe and a hot springs symbol on the left side of her chest. Cream-colored side strings are attached to her lower kimono, the right strap having a bow on the front side. Herhan-eriappears white, and herobi-ageis a red that matches her ear accessories' ribbon. Herobiis a dark purple with a redobi-jime. Herobi-domeis peach-colored, encapsulated within an upside down gold horseshoe. The lower side of her kimono is yellow that fades into a yellow-and-white check pattern. Both herhakimonoand herzorimatch the main color of her kimono. The middle of herhakimonohave a small connecting gold horseshoe in the middle. Relationships Kiyoko Hoshina- Trainer during her racing career, also her senior at the Yukoma Inn. content: Read Fantasy MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Read Fantasy Main Main      Names EnglishRead Fantasy English Read Fantasy   Profile Read Fantasyis an anime-exclusive minor character inSeason 3 of the Umamusume Anime. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Media Appearances3.1Anime 3.1Anime 4Trivia 5External Links Biography Appearance Media Appearances Season 3(ep. 7) Trivia Due to her race placements and appearance in the anime, she is likely based on the Japanese racehorse Maltese Apogee.Maltese Apogee participated in the 2016 Arima Kinen, which is depicted in episode 7 of Season 3. He took the lead from the start and was followed by Kitasan Black, with Satono Diamond later moving into contention[1]. In the anime, Read Fantasy is likewise shown taking the lead early in the race before being overtaken by Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond.Maltese Apogee was known for front-runner tactics, and his performance in the 2016 Arima Kinen closely matches Read Fantasy's depiction in the anime.Further evidence of this is her appearance. Read Fantasy's racing outfit is predominantly light blue with red stripes, closely matching the racing silks of Maltese Apogee's owner, Nagako Fujita, which are light blue with red vertical stripes and a red armband[2]. She also has bay-colored hair, matching Maltese Apogee's bay coat.Her name is likely a wordplay-based alteration of Maltese Apogee.“Read” is derived from a wordplay on the Japanese rendering of Maltese, マルターズ (Marutāzu). The beginning of the name, マル (maru), can be associated with the idea of something being whole or complete, as in 丸ごと (marugoto, “the whole thing”). Combined with 読む (yomu, “to read”), this gives the expression 丸ごと読む (marugoto yomu, “to read the whole thing”). Thus, the idea of “reading” is represented by Read.“Fantasy” is derived from the meaning and imagery associated with Apogee. In astronomy, an apogee is the point in an object's orbit at which it is farthest from the Earth[3]. The word can also be used figuratively to mean a highest point, peak, or culmination. As something situated at a distant, lofty point in the sky, it can evoke imagery of the heavens, imagination, and the fantastical, leading to Fantasy as an indirect replacement for Apogee. title: Trainer Tanabe
content: Trainer Tanabe MainGallery Main  Gallery  Trainer Tanabe Main Main      Names EnglishTrainer Tanabe English Trainer Tanabe Japaneseタナベトレーナー Japanese タナベトレーナー RomajiTanabe Toreenaa Romaji Tanabe Toreenaa Nicknamesナベさん (Nabe-san) Nicknames ナベさん (Nabe-san)   Profile Calls selfWashi (わし) Calls self Washi (わし)   Voice Voice ActorKenichi Ogata Voice Actor Kenichi Ogata Trainer Tanabe(タナベトレーナー) is one of the supporting characters fromBeginning of a New Era.  Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Personality 4Media Appearances Biography Tanabe is the former trainer ofFuji Kisekiand trainer ofJungle Pocket. In his younger days, his mentor instilled in him the dream to help a trainee win the Japanese Derby. After Fuji Kiseki's injury forced her to stop racing, he retired. He later comes out of his long retirement to train Pokke at the request of Fuji Kiseki. As a veteran, he is looked up to by his juniors and Tracen staff[1], even experienced trainers such asTrainer OkitaandRiko Kashimoto. Appearance Tanabe is an elderly mustached man with long grey hair combed back with a prominent widow's peak. His height has shrunk with age. His round sunglasses are a key identifier. He dresses casually, with his shirt untucked, tie hanging low, and wearing sneakers and loose pants. In his younger days, he wore normal glasses, a news cap, and a tracksuit. Personality He believes that Umamusume hold feelings that can only be truly understood by other Umamusume. Reflecting this, Tanabe initially takes a passive role in training, standing on the sidelines. While he lectures Jungle Pocket often, he does not reprimand her, and goes along with her whims. After Fuji Kiseki reignites the spark in him, he takes a more active role, riding alongside his trainees on his motorcycle. Tanabe has a strong sense of responsibility toward Fuji Kiseki's injury. Following his retirement, he could no longer dream of being a Derby Trainer until meeting Jungle Pocket. content: Belno Light MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Belno Light Main Main      Names EnglishBelno Light English Belno Light Japaneseベルノライト Japanese ベルノライト Romajiberuno raito Romaji beruno raito Nicknamesベルノ (Belno) Nicknames ベルノ (Belno)   Profile BirthdayMay 22 Birthday May 22 Height146cm Height 146cm Three SizesB89 W53 H77 Three Sizes B89 W53 H77   Voice Voice ActorMomoko Seto Voice Actor Momoko Seto Belno Lightis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in the Cinderella Graymangaandanime. Contents 1Biography1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Trivia 5External Links Biography An Umamusume attendingKasamatsu Training Academy. She meetsOguri Capon her first day and they become friends, joiningJo Kitahara's team alongside her soon after. Her family runs a major sporting goods chain store specialized on gear for Umamusume, so she has a lot of knowledge on race equipment, and helps out Oguri on deciding shoes. After Oguri gets an offer to transfer to the national course, she takes the staff trainee transfer exam and passes, moving with her to Tokyo. A teammate ofOguri Cap's. She is a brilliant student with excellent perception and analytical skills. Her family owns a major sporting goods store that specializes in Umamusume equipment, so she has a deep understanding of the gear.[1] Appearance Belno Light has short brown hair, fluffing out into fringes at the end, and in the center of her forehead is a large white patch of bangs swept to her left. She wears golden rotated "B" hair clips on either side of her bangs, and wears a thin red ribbon tied into a bow on her left ear. Belno has large, round, brown eyes. She wears the Kasamatsu school uniform every day. This consists of a white button-up blazer with a black stripe down the torso, and black long sleeves. Underneath the blazer is a white collar, and a red ribbon adorned with a golden horseshoe in the center. Putting her own twist on the uniform, Belno wears a light pink cardigan between the blazer and the dress shirt. As for the skirt, it is a simple white pleated skirt, with a black line around the bottom perimeter. She wears white knee-socks that are rolled down to her shins, and a pair of simple brown loafers. Relationships Oguri Cap- Best Friend. She supports Oguri Cap's racing goals, often by providing her with the right equipment and advice, as well as analyzing possible strategies on Oguri's races, most notably on her first run at the Arima Kinen. Jo Kitahara- Friend and eventual co-trainer for his team. Trivia Due to her role in the story, she is based on various people:Twin Bee: A racehorse who was in the same generation as Oguri Cap that mainly ran at Kasamatsu Racecourse, although they never faced each other. title: Bright Rock
content: Bright Rock MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Bright Rock MainRace Outfit MainRace Outfit         Names EnglishBright Rock English Bright Rock Japaneseブライトロック Japanese ブライトロック Romajiburaito rokku Romaji buraito rokku   Profile BirthdayApril 2 Birthday April 2 Bright Rockis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Graymanga. She's a student at Tracen Academy. She is likely based on the real horseWhite Stone, who was grey-haired and a year younger than Osaichi George (Mill Wakaba). Biography Bright Rock is a friend ofMill Wakabawho is a year older than her. Although Bright has not been seen racing yet, she supports Mill's own efforts. She is seen distracting Mill from bad thoughts, bringing her favourite milk drinks, and making strategy plans before Mill's races against Oguri Cap and others. Bright and Mill used to have a third friend (currently unnamed) who gave up racing out of frustration at Oguri Cap dominating the headlines. Now that her senior Mill is becoming a serious rival to Oguri, Bright supports her in seeking revenge. Appearance She has long, straight, light-coloured hair, some of which is tied back in a bundle, underneath a small white maid-like hat. From this, two strings dangle with beads on them. She wears ear covers that are slightly darker in shade, with horizontal white stripes near the tips, and a flower-shaped ornament on her right ear. She always appears with her eyes closed (even when shocked) and usually a 'cute' grinning expression. The colours of Bright Rock's design are currently unknown, but the real White Stone's racing silk was bright pink with a single horizontal yellow stripe, so her ear covers might match this. The maid cap might be inspired by the circular red bobble on the top of White Stone's bridle, and the strings with beads somewhat resemble the horse's tied-up mane decoration, with red rope dangling down the withers. content: Dicta Striker MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Dicta Striker Main Main      Names EnglishDicta Striker English Dicta Striker Japaneseディクタストライカ Japanese ディクタストライカ RomajiDikuta Sutoraika Romaji Dikuta Sutoraika Nicknamesディクタ (Dicta) Nicknames ディクタ (Dicta)   Profile BirthdayApril 28 Birthday April 28 Calls selfオレ (Ore) Calls self オレ (Ore)   Voice Voice ActorYumiri Hanamori Voice Actor Yumiri Hanamori Dicta Strikeris a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in the Cinderella Graymangaandanime. Biography "When I win... I don't want people to sayshe wasn't in perfect shape." She is a student at Tracen Academy, known as "The Chestnut-Haired Bullet" due to her famously fast sprint, the "Bullet Shot" (弾丸蹴脚Danganshuukyaku/Dangan Shoot). She is very competitive and desires to take on the strongest opponents. Despite being rivals, she helps Oguri Cap to train and improve her skills before they race each other. Appearance As her nickname suggests, she has chestnut hair, with some white parts that are hard to see, and ears sticking out from the hood she wears. Her right ear has four lined-up piercings on it. The hood is attached to a yellow hoodie she wears and has a blue-colored banded and checkerboard pattern on it. In her racing outfit, she also wears a black top with black overalls, which are tied with two long belts, a blue and a yellow, with the remaining lengths forming like a sash. She also wears a pair of black and brown shoes. Outside of racing, Dicta wears her hoodie over her school uniform and the trackwear used for below G1 races. Trivia Due to her role in the story, she is based on the real horseSoccer Boy, an outstanding miler. content: Ellerslie Pride MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Ellerslie Pride Main Main      Names EnglishEllerslie Pride English Ellerslie Pride Japaneseエラズリープライド Japanese エラズリープライド Romajierazurii puraido Romaji erazurii puraido   Profile   Voice Voice Actor富田美憂(Miyu Tomita) Voice Actor 富田美憂(Miyu Tomita) Ellerslie Prideis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in the Cinderella Graymangaandanime.  Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Trivia 4External Links Biography [DESCRIPTION HERE] [BIOGRAPHY HERE] Appearance Ellerslie Pride has light blue hair kept long with ears and tail of the same color. She has a red ribbon at the back of her head and an ear ornament around attached to her right ear resembling a skull, a short dark cloth with four pointy ends extend from the ornament. Her eyes are magenta colored with both her eyebrows and eyelashes being lights blue. She also has a vertical scar across her left cheek. Her physique is slim but toned. As her racing outfit Ellerslie Pride wears a black sleeveless blazer with long lapels crossed over each other, a white frill covering her chest, and a thick white stripe running diagonally that connects to a large white belt with a gold buckle tied around her waist, resembling a strap; below the belt, the blazer separates into three square flaps. With the blazer, she wears a matching pair of black detached sleeves with a white stripe that cover her arms between her shoulders and her hands; and a black skirt with white ruffled ends, beneath which she wears plain dark tights. For shoes, she wears matching black-and-white collared boots with silver soles and heels. She also wears a black necklace with a small silver skull pendant. Trivia Due to her role in the story, she is likely based off of the real-life New Zealand racehorse Bonecrusher, who placed eighth in the 1988 Japan Cup.Her name comes from the inscription on the plaque of a bronze life-size statue of Bonecrusher. It reads: "Bonecrusher: The Pride of Ellerslie."[1] Her name comes from the inscription on the plaque of a bronze life-size statue of Bonecrusher. content: Face No More MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Face No More Main Main      Names EnglishFace No More English Face No More Japaneseフェイスノーモア Japanese フェイスノーモア Romajifeisu noo moa Romaji feisu noo moa   Profile   Voice Voice ActorMikako Komatsu Voice Actor Mikako Komatsu Face No Moreis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Graymanga. She resides at Kasamatsu, having transferred there from Central, and is trained by Shibasaki. She also travels to Oi racecourse to compete against Inari One. After Inari One moves to Central, Face No More likes to watch her races on TV, and fondly regards her as a "big sister figure". title: Folkqueen
content: Folkqueen MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Folkqueen Main Main      Names EnglishFolkqueen English Folkqueen Japaneseフォークイン Japanese フォークイン RomajiFookuin Romaji Fookuin   Profile BirthdayOctober 7 Birthday October 7 Height150cm Height 150cm Folkqueenis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Graymanga. Biography An Umamusume hailing from the country of New Zealand, composed of equal parts pride and ferocity. A health buff that enjoys visiting hot springs, she has been nicknamed the "Health Land Master" byOguri Cap. She is often compared toEllerslie Pride, another New Zealand Umamusume whose success in Japan seems to follow Folkqueen's career overseas. With the hope of New Zealand's people on her back, will she seize victory...? Appearance Folkqueen has long hair that cascades down her back in messy waves, with her bangs parted in the center. She has two prominent ahoges sprouting off of the top of her head, and her large ears have fringes of fluff all the way to the top. On her left ear, she wears a piece of black and red torn cloth, and on her right ear, a longer piece of red torn cloth. She has heterocromatic eyes, her right eye red, and the left yellow. As for her race outfit, she wears a long, dark gray, button up blouse, fading into black at the ends, while also appearing to be ripped and tattered. The sleeves of her shirt are cut open at the shoulders, attached by X-shaped ribbons on either side, the cuffs of her long sleeves are black. Around her waist is a set of leather belts, with suspenders going over her shoulders, and gold buckles as decoration. She wears a black leather choker with a golden buckle, as well as two matching black thigh belts on her left leg. She wears a pair of short black shorts, decorated with a white belt. On her feet are a pair of knee-high leather boots, with several belts adorning the front, all with golden clasps. Trivia Due to her role in the story, she is likely based off of the real-life New Zealand racehorse Horlicks, who defeatedOguri Capat the 1989 Japan Cup. content: God Hannibal MainGallery Main  Gallery  God Hannibal Main Main      Names EnglishGod Hannibal English God Hannibal Japaneseゴッドハンニバル Japanese ゴッドハンニバル Romajigoddo hannibaru Romaji goddo hannibaru   Profile Height175cm Height 175cm   Voice Voice ActorMichiko Kaiden Voice Actor Michiko Kaiden God Hannibalis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Graymanga andCinderella Gray anime. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Trivia 6Sources Biography A mysterious, clumsy senior. God Hannibalis a senior trainee ofGinjirou MusakaatTracen Academyand an experiencedG1Racer.[1]She is often portrayed as detached and absent-minded, and her thoughts and behavior rarely make complete sense to others. God Hannibal is also clumsy, getting lost often, losing track of things,[2]and getting stuck in the Tracen Academy stump on multiple occasions.[3]However, she is still able to appear quietly and suddenly, startling characters likeBelno Light.[2][4] In contrast to her mysterious and aloof demeanor, God Hannibal has a playful and childishly whimsical side. She reports to Musaka that she will be hunting for kaiju with a bug net.[5]She also has a sweet tooth, frequently carrying and eating ice cream and other sweets.[2][4] She was supposed to participate in parallel run training withOguri Cap,Meikun TsukasaandKraft Univerunder the watch ofGinjirou Musaka, andBelno Lightto prepareOguri Capfor her showdown againstBlack Aleat the Pegasus Stakes, however, she mistook her jersey for a tub of ice cream and brought the ice cream instead, much to her teammates' confusion. As a result, she had to watch from the sidelines withBelno LightandGinjirou Musakainstead.[1] Appearance [Physical appearance and outfit here] God Hannibal usually has a vacant expression that rarely changes. Relationships Meikun Tsukasa- Teammate and friend.[1]They are often depicted together. She usually has to help God Hannibal out of the stump when the latter gets stuck. Kraft Univer- Teammate and friend.[1]They are often depicted together. She usually has to help God Hannibal out of the stump when the latter gets stuck. Ginjirou Musaka- Trainer.[1]She places a lot of faith and confidence in Musaka, believing that he would always prioritize what is best for his trainees.[4]Sometimes when she gets lost, she texts Musaka for help, who tries to stay patient with her.[6] Oguri Cap- Junior teammate. God Hannibal and the other seniors partner train with her throughout the story. Belno Light- Junior teammate. Mr. CB- Friend. Although their relationship is not elaborated on in the main story, God Hannibal and Mr. CB are on good terms with each other. In a post-chapter sketch, God Hannibal gives Mr. CB a popsicle when they run into each other.[7] Media Appearances Cinderella Gray (manga) Cinderella Gray (anime) Trivia Like the other senior members of Musaka's team, God Hannibal's name is derived from real horses that were trained by Musaka's real-life counterpart, Tsutomu Setoguchi. In God Hannibal's case, her name is derived from Godspeed and Maruka Hannibal.Godspeed won the JRA Award for Best Steeplechase Horse in 1999[8].[9]Maruka Hannibal's sire isSpecial Week.[10] Godspeed won the JRA Award for Best Steeplechase Horse in 1999[8].[9] Maruka Hannibal's sire isSpecial Week.[10] Sources ↑1.01.11.21.31.4Cinderella Gray Manga Chapter 19 / Cinderella Gray Anime Episode 7 ↑2.02.12.2Cinderella Gray Manga Chapter 19 ↑Cinderella Gray Manga Chapter 31 ↑4.04.14.2Cinderella Gray Manga Chapter 105 ↑Cinderella Gray Manga Chapter 76.5 ↑Cinderella Gray Manga Chapter 61 ↑Cinderella Gray Manga Chapter 92 ↑https://www.jbis.jp/horse/0000284247/ ↑https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%B4%E3%83%83%E3%83%89%E3%82%B9%E3%83%94%E3%83%BC%E3%83%89_(%E7%AB%B6%E8%B5%B0%E9%A6%AC)#%E5%BC%95%E9%80%80%E5%BE%8C ↑https://www.jbis.jp/horse/0000807101/ Characters Supporting Characters Umamusume Characters Cinderella Gray Characters Pages using Tabber parser tag Navigation menu Create account Log in Page Discussion Read View source View history Main page Recent changes Random page Random Umamusume Contributing List of Characters List of Albums List of Live Events List of Media List of Merchandise New Player Guide List of Skills List of Trainees List of Support Cards List of Scouts (EN) List of Scouts (JP) What links here Related changes Printable version Permanent link Page information Cargo data Cite this page This page was last edited on 22 August 2026, at 11:04. Contents 1Biography1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 2Trivia 3External Links Biography A trainer from theKasamatsu Training Academy, who has a dream of winning the Tokai Derby, though there was no excitement for him at Kasamatsu, until he sawOguri Cap, who he scouted, alongsideBelno Light. Under his advice, Oguri was able to win races by a landslide, and againsthis uncle's advice, allowed Oguri to race in the Chukyo Cup, and as a result of her winning the race, was scouted bySymboli Rudolfto the central, meaning that Jo wouldn't be able to continue working with Oguri, as he didn't have a central trainer license. Although his dream of the Tokai Derby was shattered, his new goal is to be a trainer worthy of Oguri, and starts studying for his central trainer license. A trainer hailing from Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. He sees the star potential inOguri Cap, and scouts her for his own team. His dream is to win the Tokai Derby with the Umamusume he has trained.[1] Trivia Fans say he is not based off a single real life person, but multiple:Koichi Oguri: The owner of the real life horse Oguri CapKatsumi Ando: A horse jockey who was Oguri Cap's jockey during his time at Kasamatsu, and like Oguri, transferred from regional to centrals. He failed his first license exam, and after a flood of protests, the JRA established the "Ankatsu Rule", based on track record.Masao Sumi: A trainer who managed real life Oguri Cap during his time at Kasamatsu. Koichi Oguri: The owner of the real life horse Oguri Cap Katsumi Ando: A horse jockey who was Oguri Cap's jockey during his time at Kasamatsu, and like Oguri, transferred from regional to centrals. He failed his first license exam, and after a flood of protests, the JRA established the "Ankatsu Rule", based on track record. content: Joy Maker MainGallery Main  Gallery  Joy Maker Main Main      Names EnglishJoy Maker English Joy Maker Japaneseジョイメーカー Japanese ジョイメーカー Romajijoi meekaa Romaji joi meekaa   Profile Joy Makeris a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Graymanga. title: Kraft Univer
content: Kraft Univer MainGallery Main  Gallery  Kraft Univer MainRace Outfit MainRace Outfit         Names EnglishKraft Univer English Kraft Univer Japaneseクラフトユニヴァ Japanese クラフトユニヴァ Romajikurafuto yuniva Romaji kurafuto yuniva Nicknamesユニヴァ (Univer) Nicknames ユニヴァ (Univer)   Profile ClassSenior Division Class Senior Division Height158cm Height 158cm Calls self私 (Watashi) Calls self 私 (Watashi)   Voice Voice ActorTakako Tanaka Voice Actor Takako Tanaka Kraft Univeris a minor recurring character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Gray mangaandanime. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances 5Trivia 6Sources Biography A shy and caring senior. Kraft Univer is a senior trainee ofGinjirou MusakaatTracen Academyand an experiencedGradedRacer.[1]She is described as shy and caring and she speaks quite formally. It's shown that she usually worries more about others than she worries about herself and she is arguably the most grounded, reasonable and sensible but least talkative ofMusaka's seniors.[2][3][4][5]She cares a lot for, and has a lot of admiration for her juniorOguri Cap, who she times and trains with regularly alongsideBelno LightandMusaka's other seniors,Meikun TsukasaandGod Hannibal, whom she most often spends her time with.[6][2][7][3][8][9][10][11] Appearance Kraft Univer has long and glossy black hair that reaches all the way down to her upper leg, the hair is loose for the most part and at the front, she has straight blunt bangs which cover her left eye and go down to her nose level. Her right ear is covered with white and blue striped fabric and the frontal region of her head over her hair is covered with a matching blue zigzag stitched rectangle headdress with white frilled edges. She's 158 cm tall,[1]has chestnut brown eyes in her first appearance in theanime, crimson red eyes in her secondanimeappearance and blue eyes in themanga. She has beige coloured skin and freckles over her nose and cheeks. Her race outfit is a deep blue gothic lolita style dress with a bell shaped skirt terminating in tiered frills and a large lighter blue pussycat bow at the back. It also features a navy blue sailor collar with white trim, a navy blue torso bodice with a lighter blue pussycat bow over her chest, a gold star over the knot and wide trumpet sleeves finished with navy blue frills. The sides of the shoulders are adorned a decoration consisting of a large lighter blue diamond above smaller one outlined by navy blue fabric. A dark teal fabric sash wraps around the lower torso and waist over part of the bodice, coming together in the front. Finally, her legs are adorned with white and blue striped tights matching her headdress and ear cover (the same ones as in her regular outfit) as well as chunky heeled pumps in deep blue which match her dress. Relationships God Hannibal- Teammate and Friend.[1]She usually has to be helped out of the stump by Kraft Univer andMeikun Tsukasa.[7] Meikun Tsukasa- Teammate and Friend.[1]She is often depicted with Kraft Univer.[1][8][7][3][5][4] Belno Light- Junior Teammate and Friend.[8]BesidesMusaka's seniors, she's the character Kraft Univer is most frequently depicted with.[1][8][4][6][5] Oguri Cap- Junior Teammate and Friend.[3]Kraft Univer and the other seniors train with her throughout the story.[1][6][3] Ginjirou Musaka- Trainer.[1]He tells Kraft Univer off for going out without telling anyone,[2]most likely out of concern for her well-being.[8] Media Appearances Cinderella Gray (manga) Cinderella Gray (anime) Trivia When brought up, she is often compared to the more well knownManhattan CafeandRice Showerdue to similarities in their personalities, mannerisms and physical appearances. In theCinderella Gray manga, she's depicted with blue eyes however in theanimeshe's depicted with brown or red eyes. This is most likely a mistake. Although she appears short next toMusaka's other seniors, especiallyGod Hannibal, her height is actually close to the average for JapaneseUmamusume. She is almost always depicted with her ears drooped in official media. It is speculated though not officially confirmed that she is a composite ofRhein KraftandNeo Universeas both horses were trained byTsutomu Setoguchi, whomGinjirou Musakais based on. BothRhein KraftandNeo Universewould later be officially implemented in the franchise.In theCinderella Gray animeandmanga, Kraft Univer is depicted asOguri Cap's senior, however in real life,Rhein KraftandNeo Universeare far younger and raced much later thanOguri Cap.
