title: Mill Wakaba
content: Mill Wakaba MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Mill Wakaba Main Main      Names EnglishMill Wakaba English Mill Wakaba Japaneseミルワカバ Japanese ミルワカバ Romajimiru wakaba Romaji miru wakaba   Profile Mill Wakabais a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Graymanga. She is a student at Tracen Academy. Biography "I'm going to crush you. Be prepared, okay? ♡" She has a very combative personality, and an intense dislike of Oguri Cap for dominating the headlines and overshadowing everyone else. One of her best friends gave up racing due to the frustration, and threw away her horned headband. Mill Wakaba started wearing it instead, and is full of angry determination to challenge Oguri. Bright Rockis her remaining friend, a year younger, who supports her in racing. Appearance Mill Wakaba has a tanned complexion, and a small stature. She sports short black hair with red streaks framing her face, and symmetrical fringes spiking from either side of her head, as well as a large black ahoge. She has long black ears with yellow insides, and a white blaze in the shape of a "less-than" sign (<). Her hair is longer in the back, and tied into a low ponytail, with both her ponytail and actual tail being black with a read streak. On her ears, she wears two red horns that curl around her ears, with a yellow tassel attached to her right ear. Her race outfit is very similar to a military uniform, with both her skirt and top being red. There is golden trim going down the center of the shirt, as well as framing the collar, and she sports golden roping on her left breast. She has a white belt sash going across her torso, and another on her waist. Her sleeves have a reddish-brown cusp with gold trim, and a black inner shirt. Her red skirt has a black frilled trim around it. She wears a black cape with gold trim, and the underside has a black and purple checkerboard pattern. She wears purple leggings and black knee-high laced boots. Trivia Due to her role in the story, she is likely based on the real horseOsaichi George, whose parents were called Mill George and Sachino Wakaba. content: Norn Ace MainGallery Main  Gallery  Norn Ace Main Main      Names EnglishNorn Ace English Norn Ace Japaneseノルンエース Japanese ノルンエース Romajinorun eesu Romaji norun eesu Nicknamesノルン (Norn) Nicknames ノルン (Norn)   Profile BirthdayMay 10 Birthday May 10 RoommateOguri Cap Roommate Oguri Cap Height167cm Height 167cm Calls selfあーし、私 (Aashi, Watashi) Calls self あーし、私 (Aashi, Watashi)   Voice Voice ActorAyano Shibuya Voice Actor Ayano Shibuya Norn Aceis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in the Cinderella Graymangaandanime. Contents 1Biography1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 2Appearance 3Personality 4Relationships 5Media Appearances 6Trivia 7External Links Biography An Umamusume famous in her hometown ofKasamatsu. She'sOguri Cap's roommate at Kasamatsu Tracen, and doesn't care for Oguri due to the way she stands out in class. Due to this distaste, her and her friends,Rudy LemonoandMini the Lady, bully Oguri.[1] Appearance Personality Norn Ace appears as level-headed, confident, and manipulative, though it's quickly revealed that she is deeply insecure and bulliesOguri Capout of jealousy. She doesn't see a point in getting dirty, and believes trying hard is embarassing. Norn, Mini, and Rudy all often ditch practice. After being defeated by Oguri, Norn opens up more to the people around her and shows a much softer side, especially to Oguri. Her parents own a dance studio. Relationships Oguri Cap- Rival, roommate, and eventual friend. Norn starts off bullying Oguri; kicking her out of their room, mocking her, and letting Mini and Rudy harass her. Oguri doesn't pick up on Norn's attempts to intimidate her, which only serves to infuriate Norn further. After defeating Norn, Oguri apologizes earnestly for kicking sand in Norn's face, to which Norn hesitantly says it's no problem. During Oguri's winning concert, Norn calls her dance cringe but smiles to herself. She later offers to give Oguri dance classes, and can be seen giving Oguri moves to mirror at her next concert. She proudly tears up at both of them working hard. Later, she buys a plush of Oguri and holds it close to her with a smile. Belno Light- Classmate and eventual friend. Their first interaction is Belno standing up for Oguri. Later, as Norn starts to accept Oguri, she becomes closer to Belno as well. They both help Oguri move from Kasamatsu Dorm to Ritto Dorm. Fujimasa March- Classmate and friend. Norn, Mini, and Rudy are often shown cheering for March. Hiyori Kawamura- Trainer. They have an antagonistic relationship, as Norn doesn't see a point to practicing and frequently ditches. Hiyori often chases after Norn, Mini, and Rudy whenever she can find them. Mini the Lady- Classmate and close friend. They're often seen together, alongside Rudy. Mini comes up with the plan for Norn to stomp on Oguri's foot, and later questions her for failing to do it. She also teases Norn for being embarassed about giving Oguri dance lesson tickets, and later about Oguri being her type. When Norn calls Mini and Rudy out for not apologizing to Oguri, Mini cheekily pretends she hasn't done anything. Rudy Lemono- Classmate and close friend. They're often seen together, alongside Mini. The two seem to have a somewhat abrasive friendship due to both having strong personalities. Rudy expresses exasperation at Norn using her handkerchief, and acts weirded out when Norn gets an Oguri plush. Though they often nitpick each other's actions and behavior, they remain close friends. Obey Your Masteris a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in the Cinderella Graymangaandanime. Contents 1Biography1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 1.1Cinderella Gray Anime Introduction 2Relationships 3Trivia Biography Obey Your Master (オベイユアマスター, Obei Yua Masutā) is an American Umamusume who emerges as a pivotal antagonist in the Japan Cup Arc, where she proves to be one of Cinderella Gray's most enigmatic and complex characters. She arrives in Japan as one of the representatives of the United States to compete in the Japan Cup. Obey Your Master is distinguished by her dual nature: presenting a carefree, eccentric persona while concealing a calculating, deeply observant competitor underneath. In the series, she rivalled the legendaryTamamo Crossand rising starOguri Capas well as other international competitors to achieve international recognition that had eluded her domestically. An Umamusume representing America. She's cheerful, bright, and easygoing, but exudes an air of mystery. She has no notable track record, and has never won a G1 race. Relationships Trivia Due to her role in the story, she is likely based off of the real-life American racehorse Pay the Butler, who defeated bothOguri CapandTamamo Crossat the 1988 Japan Cup.After her debut in theCinderella Graymanga, a real racehorse has been named afterObey Your Masterwho is racing since 2023. title: Satias
content: Satias MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Satias Main Main      Names EnglishSatias English Satias Japaneseサティアス Japanese サティアス Romajisatiasu Romaji satiasu   Profile Satiasis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theCinderella Graymanga. She travels to Tokyo to compete in the Japan Cup, and proudly represents the USA. She is based on the real horseAssatis. Biography "I RACE, I WIN! I'LL CRUSH THEM ALL!" Satias' personality seems as ferocious as her appearance. Unlike some of her opponents, she has no sense of friendly camaraderie or politeness, gripping the microphone and glaring into the cameras before the race. She doesn't talk to others while running, but swears and curses to herself about them. With the phrases "Peerless", "The Fastest and Strongest" and "Representative of the USA, Satias" plus a large star symbol embroidered or painted on her coat, it's clear that she's highly ambitious. Biography [DESCRIPTION HERE] [BIOGRAPHY HERE] Trivia Due to her nationality and race placement in the story, Shirley Sky is likely based on Shady Heights, a British Thoroughbred racehorse who competed in six countries: Britain, Ireland, France, Germany, Japan, and the United States. In the 1988 Japan Cup, Shady Heights finished last of 14 runners after being at the front of the field through the early stages of the race, mirroring Shirley Sky's performance inCinderella Gray.[1]Shirley Sky's name is likely derived in part from the name of her possible real-life counterpart's sire, Shirley Heights, with "Shirley" seemingly taken directly from the sire's name. "Sky" may also be a reference to "Heights", as both can evoke the idea of something high in the sky. content: Dance Limerick MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Dance Limerick Main Main      Names EnglishDance Limerick English Dance Limerick Japaneseダンスリムリック Japanese ダンスリムリック RomajiDansu Rimurikku Romaji Dansu Rimurikku   Profile Height158cm Height 158cm Be careful! Spoilers ahead!This page contains spoilers.Proceed with caution! Be careful! Spoilers ahead!This page contains spoilers.Proceed with caution!  Dance Limerickis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theStar Blossommanga. Contents 1Biography 2Relationships 3Media Appearances3.1Manga 3.1Manga 4Trivia Biography "For the one who believed in me, I'll... Believe in myself!" Dance Limerick is a member ofTeam Regulus, making her debut in Chapter 25 of Star Blossom, "The Prestigious Team Regulus." She is one of many racers hoping to beat Narita Brian, notably being much more rough in her wording, stating that she wants to "crush her arrogance", a desire that Limerick herself calls "selfish." Limerick seems to be quite weighed down by expectations, specifically the expectations of being on Team Regulus. Limerick's first attempt to beat Brian failed, placing 2nd in the Wakaba Stakes toFinal Third, therefore preventing her from entering the Satsuki Sho. A month later, she swears by the name of Team Regulus that she will face Brian in the Derby and defeat her. Kuroda, her trainer, helps her prepare by utilizing a strategy that works in tandem with her "clumsiness." After winning againstSakura LaurelandCelestial Pole, she's able to race against Narita Brian in the Derby, noting that her next race will be against all three of her rivals. Limerick expresses some frustration at her victory, as to win against Brian she felt she needed to win by a larger margin than she did. Nevertheless, Limerick goes into the Derby with high expectations. However, Laurel is unable to race in the Derby due to an injury, and Limerick ends up losing, placing second to Narita Brian. This loss is shown to affect Limerick quite deeply, as at summer camp she focuses more on training than relaxing, potentially overworking herself. However, a light nudge from Laurel and Celes gets her to loosen up. After summer camp, Brian and Limerick face off again at the Kyoto Shimbun Hai, but both to lose toStella Girl, with Limerick taking third. The two face off again at the Kikuka Sho, where Limerick once again loses to Brian. After this, Limerick raced on the Tenno Sho (Spring) where she was beaten byRice Shower, placing 5th. Relationships Narita Brian- Rival. Much like Laurel, the main reason she wants to beat Brian is because of Brian's supposed "arrogance." However, unlike Laurel, her language shows a bit more forcefulness in the matter. She raced against her in both the Derby and Kikuka Sho, but failed to beat her both times. Sakura Laurel- Rival and friend. The two of them are united in the front to beat Brian but they are also quite fond of each other. Although Limerick pushed her away at first, they're shown to be close enough during New Years for Limerick to give Laurel tips on the racers she'll be up against. She says she'll be waiting to race against Laurel again during Tenno Sho (Spring). Celestial Pole- Rival and friend. After racing in the Aoba Sho, they also race in the Derby together. Celestial Pole is a lot more aloof than Limerick though and generally more laidback than her as well. Despite how different they are, they get along well. Notably, Celeste is the one who brought up the fact Limerick should be taking it easy during Summer Camp. Winning Ticket,Matikanetannhauser,Air Groove,Daiichi Ruby- Teammates on the manga-only team ,Team Regulus. Although she is fond of her teammates, Regulus' reputation leads her to feeling quite pressured.All of the Umamusume on Team Regulus were trained by Yuji Ito in real life.She shares similar speech mannerisms with Daiichi Ruby in particular, although there doesn't seem to be a clear reason behind this. All of the Umamusume on Team Regulus were trained by Yuji Ito in real life. She shares similar speech mannerisms with Daiichi Ruby in particular, although there doesn't seem to be a clear reason behind this. Miyu Kuroda- Trainer. She looks up to Kuroda a lot, noting that he's the reason she believes in herself. Media Appearances Star Blossom Trivia Limerick has shockingly good stamina, as in the short segment we get of her training before the Aoba Sho, she's seen doing 10 laps and being seemingly fine and not tired at all. Due to her placements in the Satsuki Sho and Japanese Derby, fans link her to the real life horse Air Dublin.Another piece of evidence to Dance Limerick's base being Air Dublin is that he was trained by Yuji Ito, a trait shared with the real-life counterparts of the other members of Team Regulus.Air Dublin's dam, Dancing Key, also foaled several G1 winners, including Dance in the Dark, Dance in the Mood and Dance Partner. This might explain Dance Limerick's naming, and the expectations placed upon her. content: Final Third MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Final Third MainRace Outfit MainRace Outfit         Names EnglishFinal Third English Final Third Japaneseファイナルサード Japanese ファイナルサード RomajiFainaru Saado Romaji Fainaru Saado   Profile Calls selfおじさん (Ojisan, this uncle) Calls self おじさん (Ojisan, this uncle) Be careful! Spoilers ahead!This page contains spoilers.Proceed with caution! Be careful! Spoilers ahead!This page contains spoilers.Proceed with caution!  Final Thirdis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theStar Blossommanga. Contents 1Biography 2Relationships 3Media Appearances 4Trivia 5External Links Biography "I'll be able to surpass them. That's what I believed." Final Third is an Umamusume with unknown team affiliation, and makes her first notable appearance in Chapter 55 of Star Blossom "First Dream of the Year". Prior to her major appearance as an antagonist, she had a successful career with 3 wins over 5 races. She first beatDance Limerickat the Wakaba Stakes before becoming one of many racers to faceNarita Brianat the Satsuki Sho. Prior to her battles against Narita Brian, she was a hopeful and down-to-earth person. She would lose the Satsuki Sho, motivating Final Third to undergo rigorous training believing that as long as she had the will to keep going she could eventually surpass Brian. Despite this, she and everyone else in the Derby would lose to Narita Brian by a massive margin, causing Final Third to fall into despair. Nightmares of her races against Narita Brian would haunt her in her sleep, causing Final Third to become visibly worn and tired. Considering Narita Brian a monster, she would continue racing with a different goal in mind. From then on, she would aim to prevent other Umamusume from suffering the same despair and fate as her by purposefully increasing the pace of races to wear down her opponents into giving up. Relationships Sakura Laurel- Rival. Media Appearances Star Blossom Trivia Due to her role in the story, she is likely based off the real-life horse Offside Trap who won the 1998 Tenno Sho (Autumn) in whichSilence Suzukawould experience an injury that caused the real horse to be euthanized.Final Third later refers to herself as "Oji-san", playfully calling herself old. Offside Trap was seven years old at the time of his Tenno Sho victory, and was the oldest horse to win the Tenno Sho (Autumn) until 2009, when the eight-year old Company took first place. Additionally, Offside Trap's jockey in that race, Yoshitomi Shibata, is one of the oldest active jockeys in the JRA at 60 years old. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Trivia Biography A talented Umamusume who's sensitive to the cold, and lacks the tenacity and passion to win. Snow in Hazard is from America, a childhood friend ofHishi Amazon, and has an older sister who was a champion racer in North America, even defeating a Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe winner. She is a resident of Miho Dormitory. Snow has been shown to be physically stronger than some Umamusume, as she used a snow shovel with only one hand. Appearance Snow is a tall Umamusume with a strong build. She has light blue eyes and long, dark, wavy hair. She often wears a bored expression, expressing little interest in anything besides facing strong opponents and keeping warm. Snow is extremely sensitive to the cold and regularly wears a hoodie with her uniform as well as track pants under her skirt. Relationships Sakura Laurel- Friend and rival. It was Laurel who first got Snow to put effort into her races. Hishi Amazon- Childhood friend. The two grew up near each other in America, with Hishiama even staying in Snow's older sister's care at some point. Ishigami Isao- Trainer. Isao does his best to support Snow while she usually completely ignores him. He's become used to this. Trivia Due to her placement in the race she shared with Sakura Laurel, Snow in Hazard is speculated by fans to be based on the real horseTaiki Blizzard.In addition to that, her unnamed older sister has been speculated to beTheatrical, the 1987 American Champion Male Turf Horse and Hishi Amazon's sire. content: Sugar Nation MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Sugar Nation MainStarting Future MainStarting Future         Names EnglishSugar Nation English Sugar Nation Japaneseシュガーネイション Japanese シュガーネイション RomajiShugaa Neishon Romaji Shugaa Neishon   Profile Be careful! Sugar Nationis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured inVolume 2of theStar Blossommanga. She is one ofSakura Laurel's first rivals. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Media Appearances4.1Manga 4.1Manga 5Trivia Biography "That won't be happening. Because there's only one victor." Sugar Nation is an Umamusume with unknown team affiliation, making her first appearance in Chapter 10 of Star Blossom "The Maiden Class". She is one of the few characters in the franchise who have yet to win their debut, aspiring to be like her more successful older sisters,Monsieur SucreandSugar Safety. In her childhood, she and her sisters frequently raced each other, always resulting in Sugar Nation lagging behind and failing to catch up. After meeting withSakura Laurelon her break, they would race each other at Tokyo Racecourse. Sugar Nation would go on place 2nd to Laurel, both distancing themselves by the other racers by a large margin. The two become friends after this encounter, and would swap contacts on LANE. Laurel would also help Sugar Nation run an ehomaki stand during her next break. A few months later, she makes a brief appearance training in Chapter 17 "What You Really Need",Hishi Amazonnotes toTsubaki Akeishithat her intense battle with Laurel reinvigorated her ambitions to race, which would inspire Trainer Tsubaki to enter Laurel to fightSnow in Hazard. Seven months after, Sugar Nation would finally win her first debut, a 1700m dirt maiden race in Hakodate, Hokkaido. Appearance Sugar Nation has light brown hair, with cream-white tips, in a messy bob-cut with straight bangs covering her forehead. Her tail also has the same color scheme as her hair, with the lower half being cream-white. She wears a pink and black polka-dot bow hairclip on the left of her hair, and a miniature flan hat near her right ear, adored with a bright red cherry, pink ribbons, and a white ruffle. She has red and blue dual-colored eyes with bright yellow highlights and a white pupil. Relationships Monsieur SucreandSugar Safety- Older Sisters. Sugar Nation is very proud of both her older sisters, and they serve as her inspiration for racing. Sakura Laurel- Friend and Rival.The two talk to each other through LANE occasionally, with Sakura Laurel being very enthusiastic and eager in their text messages. The two talk to each other through LANE occasionally, with Sakura Laurel being very enthusiastic and eager in their text messages. Media Appearances Star Blossom Trivia Due to her placements in the race she and Laurel shared, as well as the results of her older sisters, fans link her to the real life horse Cyclennon Volk. title: Yoshino Prevail
content: Yoshino Prevail MainGalleryIRL Main  Gallery  IRL  Yoshino Prevail Main Main      Names EnglishYoshino Prevail English Yoshino Prevail Japaneseヨシノプリヴェール Japanese ヨシノプリヴェール RomajiYoshino Purivēru Romaji Yoshino Purivēru Nicknamesヨシノ (Yoshino) Nicknames ヨシノ (Yoshino)   Profile Height157cm Height 157cm Be careful! Spoilers ahead!This page contains spoilers.Proceed with caution! Be careful! Spoilers ahead!This page contains spoilers.Proceed with caution!   Yoshino Prevailis a character inUmamusume: Pretty Derby, featured in theStar Blossommanga. She is in Team Alkes. She is an original character, meaning that she's not directly based in any real life horse, though fans have linked her to Sakura Eiko O, a racehorse active in the 1990s. Contents 1Biography 2Appearance 3Relationships 4Trivia Biography "A race... isn't some kind of game!" Yoshino Prevail is a member ofTeam Alkes, debuting in the first chapter of Star Blossom, "There's A Dream I Want To Fulfill With You". A wild and mischievous umamusume who is one of the many racers vying to beat Narita Brian, as she wants to crush that "confidence" of hers. Not only would she have her GI debut at the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, this would be her first encounter withNarita Brian—where Yoshino would take the lead up into the fourth corner, but she would hit her limit around the 4th corner and fall back into the pack. Not too long after, she would overhearSakura Laurel,GorouandTsubaki Akeishidiscussing joining Team Alkes and pursuing her dream to defeat Narita Brian and winning the Arc de Triomphe. However, Yoshino would barge in upon hearing Laurel wanting to beat Narita Brian, and challenge her to a mock race in order to make her "know her place" as she hates, and cannot stand people who are "all bark and no bite." Despite being close, with Yoshino coming out on top, she would unexpectedly apologize to Laurel—much toSakura Chiyono O's shock— stating that she thought she had already won by a landslide at the fourth corner, but did not expect Laurel to close the distance. The two would get along and become friends from there on. In order to challenge Narita Brian again, she would participate in the Yayoi Sho—one of the preliminaries to the Satsuki Sho, but before running, she would cheer on Laurel in her maiden race where she would race against Snow In Hazard. Upon witnessing Laurel's defeat and seeing her frustration at being unable to race Narita Brian in the Satsuki Sho, she would be noted to be unusually quiet entering the Yayoi Sho by trainer Momo—though she would break the silence by slamming her head into the gate in frustration. Despite this, she would go on to cause an upset—outlasting the competition, including the 1st and 2nd favourites,Dear CharlotteandMatsukaze Ryu Oto not only earn the chance to run in the Satsuki Sho, but she would also inspire Laurel to not let her loss stop her and for her to keep pushing forward and catch up. Laurel would return her answer by taking her second victory and win her maiden race three weeks later, with the two high fiving after the race. She, along withAmagi Happiness, who returned from her travels withTrainer Kawase, would then participate in the Satsuki Sho hoping to defeat Brian. However, the two would fail to beat her, with the former being overtaken and the latter being unable to close the distance. Despite the loss, Yoshino would state at the flower viewing party the team had after the Satsuki Sho that the Derby is where she'll get her revenge on not just Amagi, but Brian too— though Amagi would not participate in the race. Her last attempt would be at the Derby, where she would be the only one from the team to enter due to Laurel's injury two weeks prior and Amagi resumed her travels. Here, she — with the help of the team — would adapt a pace-chaser strategy instead of her usual front-running. Ultimately, it would not be enough, as she would then be overtaken by Brian despite her best efforts. This loss would have a lingering impact on Yoshino, as she would distance herself from training and the others during summer camp. But with the help of Laurel, she would soon return to being her old self. Appearance Yoshino Prevail has thick, brown, voluminous, hair that reaches down to her waist—with the ends of her hair curl outwards adding more to it—and has a small white star on the midlle of her bangs. Her tail is has the same colour scheme as her hair, as well as having noticeably more volume like it when compared to others. She wears a spiked metal ear piece on that wraps around the outside of her right ear. Her eyes are light blue eyes with purple pupils, and has noticeably sharp, shark-like teeth. Her race outfit consists of a matte dark grey sailor shirt with white accents that stops above the waist, adorned with a pink neckerchief that fades to white. On top, she wears a open sukajan, with the sleeves being dark grey and the body of the jacket and accents along said sleeves being dark pink. A sakura flower design is embroidered in white on the left side of the sukajan. Her sleeves are pushed up to the ends of her elbows, and has brown, tied up arm bands on each upper arm. Her skirt is dark grey as well, reaching all the way down to her ankles, splitting on the right, exposing her right leg. Underneath, she wears dark pink studded leg-harnesses on both legs, with the one on her right leg being visible. A long chain hangs around her left thigh, wrapped around the left side of the seam of the skirt. She wears two long, loose white socks and wears a pair of dark grey and pink shoes. She wears dark grey fingerless gloves, with dark pink coloured spiked cuffs with a similar styled choker. Like with her sukajan, she has a habit of wearing her jackets left opened, like with her training outfit and winter coat. Relationships Sakura Laurel- Friend, Rival and Teammate. Despite looking down on her at first, Yoshino would recognize Laurel's strength after their mock race. Since then, she has been caring and supportive of Laurel, being mindful of her condition during training, cheering her on at her races, and motivating her after being unable to run at the Satsuki Sho— to name a few. And despite sometimes bickering on who will achieve their common goal of defeating Narita Brian— the two care for one another, as the both of them have had a positive influence on each other. Sakura Chiyono O- Friend and Teammate. The two can occasionally be seen together, whether they are training together or supporting their fellow teammates. She appears to be the one to catch Yoshino whenever she runs away from her training and sometimes handles her antics. Sakura Bakushin O- Friend and Teammate. The two appear to be fond of each other, having trained together and supporting each other at their races. Amagi Happiness- Friend, Rival and Teammate. Although Yoshino doesn't get her and the two can be seen bickering, they each acknowledge the strength the other has, with Yoshino wanting to challenge said strength get her revenge against Amagi. Sakura Chitose O- Friend and Teammate. The two appear to be fond of each other, having trained together and supporting each other at their races. Tsubaki Akeishi- Trainer in the manga-only team, Team Alkes. The two appear close as Yoshino acts very casually around her, occasionally messing around and teasing her despite Tsubaki being a trainer, though she does care about her as she can be seen trying to cheer her up. There are times where she can get carried away, however. Gorou Akeishi- Trainer in the manga-only team, Team Alkes. He is very supportive of each of the members of the team, and in Yoshino's case, he along with everyone's support on the team helped her control and tame her aggressive fighting spirit—to which he notes that she has grown from it. He does appear to be one of the few members that are able to keep Yoshino in check, as he has been seen scolding her for her rash and childish behaviour on multiple occasions. Momo- Trainer in the manga-only team, Team Alkes. She is heavily implied to be Yoshino's trainer as she is seen with her at the paddock at the Yayoi Sho, as well as noticing Yoshino's unusual silence. Narita Brian- Rival. Yoshino, much like Laurel and a few others in her generation, wanted to challenge Narita Brian's arrogance and strength. Although Yoshino would race her at the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, Satsuki Sho, and the Derby— she would fail to beat Brian in all three attempts. Biko Pegasus- Friend? They appear hanging out together with Biko admiring the bokken bought on the train back in Star Blossom Chapter 52. Trivia Due to the races she is seen participating in as well as her placements, fans link her to the real life horseSakura Eiko O.A link that reinforces the idea of Yoshino Prevail being Sakura Eiko O is that the real horse counterparts of the current known members of Team Alkes were all owned by Sakura Commerce, sharing the "Sakura" crown name.Similarly to Sakura Chiyono O, she does not share the distinct sakura-patterned pink eyes with the Sakura name.
